title: Happy Sisters Life
description: That day, you were born, together with a younger sister. That day, your parents remarried, and you got a younger sister. That day, you ran into someone in the neighborhood, and it turned out to be a younger sister. Great, it’s a younger sister! We are saved!

title: Magical Girl Opal
description: Hikari Saitou was just an ordinary student... until a fateful encounter with Magical Girl Aquamarine and a fairy named Lala transformed her into Magical Girl Opal! Now her days of studying at university are spent fighting against the evil organization, Cynthia, who are hell-bent on taking over the Earth. In this RPG, you play as Hikari as she protects Mikamai Town from the evil forces of Cynthia.

title: Advent: Dawn
description: A research trip turns deadly when seven strangers are trapped in a vast cave beneath a remote island. 『Advent: Dawn』 is a sci-fi mystery visual novel where you must escape through fear, fractured trust, and whispers from the deep. Will you unravel the mystery before the cave unravels you?

title: Illusive Domain
description: Deflect, parry, and defeat your opponents through intense boss rush action. Fight for you and your allies’ freedom, lest you remain entombed forever more.

title: Poolcore: Submersion
description: Immerse yourself in poolcore-inspired vibes as you explore a vast complex of mind-bending liminal architecture straight out of your dreams. Navigate through a facility filled with obstacles and puzzles, venturing into depths that descend far below the rippling, chlorinated waters.

title: Hellcam
description: HELLCAM is a hyper-realistic psychological horror exploration game focusing on navigating liminal spaces. Follow the story of a stranded backrooms researcher through a VHS camera, uncovering the harrowing reality of the backrooms.

title: Our Bad Ending
description: A girl’s dark, romantic desire for her best friend and the spiral of pursuing a doomed love.

title: Frutiger Aero
description: Welcome to Frutigo Aero, a cozy 2-player puzzle adventure set in the nostalgic future we were promised but never got. Explore dreamy zones of bubbly glass, glowing gradients, and soft retro UI. Solve puzzles, unlock cosmetics, and vibe solo or with a friend in a world made to ease your mind.

title: College Kings 2: Episode 2 "The Pool Party" Reworked
description: Tensions on the campus are high, the college is clamping down on the frats, and a mysterious social media page has students paranoid and on edge. Join the Social Planning Committee and work to bring the campus back together. Your first job? Organize the ultimate blow-out Pool Party! We’re going to need inflatables, beach balls and bikinis.

title: College Kings 2: Episode 3 "Back To Basics"
description:
With the second most important fighting tournament of the year on the horizon, the frats will struggle for survival as a newly appointed auditor is looking to end the violence once and for all.

Meanwhile, Nora throws a schoolwide sleepover hoping to unite the students against this new threat.

title: Grow Home & Grow Up
description: This bundle includes the two platformer titles developed by Ubisoft Reflections.

title: Dungeon Market Simulator
description: A strategic medieval market simulation game. Equip your dungeon with traps. Hunt down outcast warriors and earn mysterious chests. Upgrade the items you obtain and increase their value. Bargain with customers and earn promotions.

title: The Lone Keeper
description: A psychological horror game where nothing is as it seems. Maintain a remote lighthouse, perform daily tasks while descending into isolation, hallucinations, and distorted reality.

title: Natsuki And Chill
description: After telling her that you're interested in her, Natsuki wants to come to your place! Spend a chill evening with her... And maybe get a little more intimate...

title: Possession Game
description:
Possession
Team up. Uncover the unknown. Survive the haunting.

Possession is a 1v4 co-op horror game where one player takes on the role of a malevolent ghost, while a team of four investigators must work together to uncover its identity—and banish it before time runs out.

title: Tempaux
description: Tempaux is a four-directional rhythm game inspired by both the gameplay of cornerstone arcade rhythm games from around the world, and the customization and appearance of classic operating systems. Blast incoming notes with your ship, develop your skills, and compete to become the best player.

title: Associate
description: Associate is a short horror adventure game made with RPG Maker. It's a game about [...] as you deal with [...]. You wake up in an unknown room, unware of what happened, having lost any memories besides your name. Little do you know, the truth is actually [...].

title: Infinite Lives
description: Explore infinite possibilities with INFINITE LIVES - where superhumans and subhumans fight for control of the ultimate shared universe! Bursting into the 3rd dimension brings new powers with unprecedented freedom, in a vicious cycle that never ends...

title: Fantasy Burger
description: A chill fantasy cooking game. Serve meals to knights, mages, and mythical creatures. Play solo or with up to 7 friends!

title: Encounter: The Lost Cards
description: The unhinged roguelike for the tactically obsessed. Forget maps—your journey is a deck of Tarot cards you build on the fly. Manage a tight inventory, chain questionable combos, and watch your gear shatter. Got unlucky? The virtuous can resurrect; the sinful, however...

title: QQQbeats!!!
description: QQQbeats!!! is a new game that features both rhythm and puzzle elements. Support is included for two-player online and offline battles.

title: Dreadcore: Locked Unit
description: A first-person psychological horror game focused on exploration, puzzle-solving, and environmental storytelling. Discover the tragic story of Unit 199, where a fragmented consciousness still haunts the place.

title: Holy Deadline
description: Holy Deadline is a surreal, story-rich visual novel where you play as a demigod lawyer. You have one week to investigate the divine divorce of Adam and Eve! Flirt, drink, raise your stats and make bold choices in minigames and Heaven's drama.

title: Train Sim World 5: Frankfurt S-Bahn: S1, S8 & S9 Route Add-On

title: Train Sim World 5: Thomas & Friends Visit the West Somerset Railway
description: Embark on a special journey as Thomas the Tank Engine makes his debut in Train Sim World 5! Drive with Thomas as he makes his way to the West Somerset Railway, Diesel’s tagging along for the ride as well, what mischief will he get up to?

title: Train Sim World 5: Thomas & Friends 80th Anniversary Expansion
description: Continue the story of Thomas’ visit to the West Somerset Railway with the Thomas & Friends 80th Anniversary Expansion! Sir Topham Hatt and Diesel are preparing to throw a surprise birthday celebration for Thomas, who has been given a special coat of paint!

title: Train Sim World 5: Spoorlijn Zwolle - Groningen Route Add-On
description: Embark on an all-new journey in Train Sim World 5 with Spoorlijn Zwolle - Groningen. Run express services with the iconic ICMm Koploper and dash between commuter towns with the modern SNG Sprinter. New challenges await with our first Dutch route!

title: Train Simulator Classic: Wien - St. Pölten Route Add-On
description: Travel from Wien (Vienna) to St. Pölten with this scenic Austrian route from RSSLO.

title: Sterile
description: Follow five kids in their quest to not die!

title: Paranoir
description:
Paranoir is a comical visual novel that makes you play as an annoyed grandchild, trying their best to help their grandpa remember the day of his first detective case.

Age is taking a toll on him, and so the flashback might contain some inaccuracies. It's up to you to figure out what is real and what isn't, as you help him remember forgotten words.

Paranoir was developed in the span of 4 months by a small team of part-time developers.

title: Earth Invasion 99
description:
Earth is being invaded, cities are being torn down by those aggressive aliens. They do not come in peace and they do not negotiate.

Our only option is to fight back and defend our planet, but the situation is grim. Only one trooper is capable of putting up a fight anymore. The likelihood of complete human extinction is 99%.

Earth Invasion 99 is a fast paced shooter inspired by EDF franchise. Shoot and power up yourself to victory.

title: Pokémon Villain Jam
description: An entirely different playthrough everytime! Since the tournament is randomized every time, and each character has a wide variety of Pokémon to choose from, everyone's playthrough will be different!

title: Open Starbound
description: OpenStarbound is a mod of the latest version of Starbound, 1.4.4. It fixes many bugs, adds many new features and improves performance.

title: Superkid
description: Set in New York in the year 2089, the city has become a no-go area for ordinary citizens as the street gangs conduct open warfare. Crime is rampant and the streets are littered with the dead bodies of innocent citizens and gang members alike. A super hero is needed to clean up the city. Enter......Superkid.

title: Soccer Challenge
description: Soccer Challenge is a series of mini-games designed to 'hone your skills' in some of the key disciplines of the sport (tackling, passing and penalties) before taking on a stamina building assault course.

title: ZacJumper
description: A little game in which you have to jump to get a better score while avoiding monsters.

title: Touhou Farming: Minoriko's Homestead Harvest
description: The unofficial Touhou farm sim! Play as harvest god Minoriko Aki and grow your popularity with your home-grown produce and specialty sweet potatoes. Mingle with other gods and youkai in newly-constructed Yasaka Resort Town, explore Youkai Mountain, and maybe get into a fight or two!

title: Pirates: The Spectacular Treasure Trail
description:
In this PC game, children aged 6 and over can embark on an exciting treasure hunt. Who will find the treasure in the end with a compass and map? The trail of a mysterious treasure map leads to a teeming pirate island in this CD-ROM adventure! Who has enough courage and pirate cunning to take on the legacy of an old pirate captain?

The future pirates are first given a detailed description of the person or flag they are looking for and also learn about piracy. With their compass, they use the cardinal points and the squares on the map to guide their search! With eagle eyes, they have to find all the secret hiding places and track down legendary sailors, because only then will the pirates get all the puzzle pieces of the treasure map they need to set off in search of the treasure with their own ship and crew.

If the treasure chambers are empty, the pirates must use their skill to steal the loot from other pirates. There are also pirate-themed games, information and extras to print out in the old captain's cabin!

This adventurous pirate game requires geographical skills, a sense of direction, eagle eyes and concentration in order to shine as a proud pirate captain with a full treasure chest at the end.

Players can continue their treasure hunt at any time from where they left off. The game is automatically saved under the respective name.

The totally crazy treasure map is a fun and varied computer game for primary school children that teaches knowledge about the popular pirate theme in a playful way and, in particular, promotes concentration and the first use of the computer.

title: Project Code M
description: A mystery adventure where the protagonists are a pair of crime scene cleaners! You clean up dead bodies—and there’s also a “killer’s perspective” where you do all sorts of shady stuff, like scam phone calls.

title: Duke Nukem 64
description:
2018 Build Engine PC port of Duke Nukem 64 packaged in the "rednukem" release.

Created by the EDuke32 Team!

title: Cubescape
description: CubeScape is a philosophical game of self-discovery. You enter a gallery called "Tesseract," but soon everything vanishes. Now you wander through bizarre cubic worlds, trying to understand what truly lies within you.

title: The Shadows Over Lighthouse
description: Investigate your grandfather’s mysterious disappearance in Shadows Over Lighthouse, a Lovecraftian survival horror adventure. Explore eerie 1912 America, solve puzzles, and face horrors as reality twists around you. Can you uncover the truth, or will you lose yourself to madness?

title: Galduen of the Void
description: A fantasy space agency management game! Manage your team, design your space ship and research new technology! Reach moons, planets and the void beyond. Can you reach the void? Can you bring Galduen to the void?

title: Climb The Backrooms
description: Ascend through the twisted levels of the Backrooms using physics-based object manipulation to overcome obstacles, solve mind-bending puzzles, and uncover unsettling secrets.

title: Hordeguard: Winds of the North
description: Gather resources, fortify your village, recruit your warband, and defend against waves of monsters. With the clock ticking, every decision counts – strategize quickly and act swiftly to ensure the survival of your village. Play solo or team up with a friend in local co-op mode.

title: The Retrospection of Tomorrow
description: In this non-linear, time-travel romance visual novel, you'll date four captivating love interests just like in any ordinary otome game… until they die before your eyes(!). Trapped between memories and delusions, fighting fate itself—can you rewrite their endings? Dear time traveler, welcome home.

title: The Saturnians
description: Saturnians are moth wizards. For many generations, they have passed down techniques for making "light weaving" wands. They yearn to explore the unknown and meet new species. Saturnian villages are usually built on floating islands. When Saturnians ally with each other they typically connect these cities together into a larger network. Most Saturnians are from the largest network of cities, the country Solalei.

title: Scyphojel, Space Jellyfish!
description: Scyphojel are space jellyfish. They hover above ground with some type of levitation, and can produce electricity at the ends of their tentacles. They're genderless and reproduce through strobilation. They also like to eat metal.

title: No World Dreamers: Sticky Zeitgeist
description: No World Dreamers: Sticky Zeitgeist is an episodic game-comic about a town plagued by space waste, and the girls working to clean it. After a satellite in orbit is destroyed, the company INNOCENT tasks itself with scavenging for the fallen parts, placing its workers at risk for radiation. In the first episode, players meet Ever, Brava, Chalcedony, and Agate, animal and robot girls who work at INNOCENT. Players quickly immerse themselves in the culture of No World Dreamer’s swamp world.

title: How I Met My Healthy Hentai Neighbors!
description: The third installment of ClockUp's popular Healthy Hentai series (How to Live a Healthy Hentai Lifestyle! and How a Healthy Hentai Administers Public Service!): How I Met My Healthy Hentai Neighbors! Featuring art by Butcha-U and the cast of the previous two titles, and many new and exciting erotic situations!

title: SweetCanvas
description: An untimely transfer. An unexpected encounter. A chance meeting between two students sets in motion a chain of events that will fundamentally change both of their lives... Or, perhaps, just their love life!

title: Nandome ka no Hajimemashite
description:
Kinou Yumeto lives a hollow existence. He went to a mediocre university, got a job at a mediocre company, and realizes that there’s something missing in his mediocre life.

Then one day he crosses paths with a demon named “Laplace” when everything disappears and he suddenly finds himself 13 years in the past. Before him are familiar friends, a familiar school and a familiar life.

“If I can rewrite the world, perhaps I can change my life as well…?”

Yumeto spends his days enjoying these nostalgic and fun times. But there’s also a girl intertwined with his memories that he does not remember…

title: No-good Streamer Mirai-chan! (Now accepting lewd comments)
description: Chat and play with a cute streamer girl! Flirt with clumsy streamer Mirai-chan and spice up her stream! The more excited she gets, the longer the stream—and maybe you’ll get some special services, too…

title: Don't Break
description: Break out of a dungeon as a fragile soul in a potion bottle. Roll, bounce, and avoid fall damage while fighting awkward physics to survive the impossible. Can you escape without breaking?

title: Her Age, My Sex, Your Location
description: A boy-meets-girl story? or maybe a girl-meets-girl story? or maybe this is a Mage-meets-Princess story? who knows!

title: Summer Shift At Arbor's
description:
Welcome to Arbor's Discovery Center, where science meets fiction!

Arbor and his friends were designed to teach kids STEM subjects during the day, but at night, something has gone haywire within the complex positronic brains of these bots.

title: Ergo Sum
description: When the boundary between the material and psychic worlds collapsed, for a brief moment anything seemed possible. Crushing reality reasserted itself quickly enough, though.

title: Noel the Mortal Fate: Complete Edition
description: This is a tale of revenge — of a demon, a girl, and their companions. After seven years of development, the popular dark suspense adventure "Noel the Mortal Fate" finally arrives as a complete edition with all 13 seasons included, fully upgraded and with no extra charges.

title: Capsule Guy
description: Capsule Guy is a challenging platforming game where you shoot lasers at things and win sometimes.

title: Lethal Cosmic Hunt
description: Hide, survive, and outsmart terrifying creatures in a deadly hunt.

title: Pro Craps
description: Where Every Roll Feels Real.

title: Saiko Bot
description: Saiko Bot is a Single & Multiplayer Adventure with 20+ minigames. Featuring Saiko Fall (multiplayer), a chaotic tower-fall with bouncing objects, and Saiko Bird (single-player), a flying challenge.

title: Accordion Solitaire
description:
Accordion Solitaire is a more difficult, more strategic variation of solitaire. Starting with a shuffled deck, you will draw cards and make decisions about how to stack them based on matching ranks and suits.

Cards can only be stacked when a stack is adjacent to a matching rank or suit, or when a stack is separated from a matching rank or suit by exactly two other stacks. The goal of the game is to begin with one deck of cards and end up with one stack of cards.

title: Who Trained the Hero?: Spin of Fate
description: "Who Trained the Hero? -Spin of Fate-" is a slot-powered roguelike where you customize your reels, team up with allies, and forge the hero destined to save the world!

title: Platonica Space
description:
Open the door and step into someone's memories.
Platonica Space is a psychological exploration adventure where you search countless rooms to recover lost memories.

title: Terrol
description: Terrol is a grand strategy game focused on capturing and holding strategic resources. The objective is simple: control all resources and destroy rival empires.

title: Draugar
description: Fight through unyielding hordes of ancient Nordic undeads. Set during WW2, you and up to 3 other survivors must hold the line against the Draugar.

title: 14: Overmind
description: 14: Overmind is an immersive first-person survival-adventure in an anomalous sci-fi space, where reality is torn apart by mysterious zones that alter the laws of physics. Waking up among ship wreckage with amnesia, you are a lone survivor with your AI companion S.A.M. Use high-tech exosuit and vehicles to gather resources, study all lost blueprints, and battle fractals from other dimensions. Will you unravel the mystery of your arrival and escape this hostile vacuum?

title: Cropdeck
description: Plant, grow, and harvest in this farming roguelite deckbuilder. Craft a powerful deck of plants and combine quirky scarecrows with passive effects for wild synergies. Pay taxes. Strategic, satisfying, and delightfully wholesome.

title: Facility 37
description: Explore an abandoned research facility, uncover evidence of horrific experiments, and escape alive. Complete randomized objectives with your team while evading bio-engineered threats in this atmospheric co-op horror experience.

title: ArmourX
description:
ArmourX is a thrilling blockchain-based game blending Play-and-Earn mechanics with immersive gameplay. Set in a futuristic world, players become skilled warriors defending their planet against a formidable alien threat. Customize and upgrade your armor and weapons, trade them as unique assets, and earn rewards both in-game and through blockchain trading. Featuring intense battles and challenging missions, ArmourX delivers an exhilarating experience while offering the chance to earn valuable digital assets.

Dive into the action and join the fun today!

title: Zugaran
description: Zugaran is a casual first-person horror. You rent an apartment in Dreamtown for a business trip, but get trapped in a looping nightmare. Each night, you wake up to pee and face a new terror.

title: Bearplane
description: Blast off as a rocket-powered bear in this hand-drawn 2D arcade shooter! Ram enemy planes, roast villains with jet flames, and roar them out of the sky. Unlock flair-packed hats, snack on atomic power-ups, and team up with Rifle Rat for couch co-op chaos!

title: Godforge
description: Godforge is a cinematic hero collector RPG where myths and legends clash in a battle for divine power. Collect over 250 legendary heroes inspired by gods, warriors, and monsters from across the world. Build your squad, forge powerful gear, and unleash game-changing abilities in strategic turn-based combat. Born from a thriving community of millions, Godforge is the ultimate test of skill, synergy, and mythic might.

title: Mythswayer
description: Embark on an epic fantasy adventure in Mythswayer, a turn-based rogue-lite where every run is a new challenge through magical tomes filled with danger, secrets, and powerful discoveries.

title: MandarinMastermind
description: This is an adventure game that uses voice to solve puzzles. You will play as an amnesiac girl trapped in the ether world. You need to learn Mandarin words to solve puzzles, and use these words to activate magic and defeat enemies. Can you complete the challenge of using Mandarin?

title: Bioneers
description: A strategy and simulation game set in a microworld. Build an organism from cells, automate biological processes, and fend off viral attacks. Explore the world, unlock mutations, and evolve into a predator, parasite, or herbivore. Survive, adapt, and grow.

title: Place
description: You are a random person trapped in an empty concrete room under the watchful eye of a camera. The only way out is to risk pressing the forbidden button, after which more buttons appear. Each press brings you closer to the exit or to your demise.

title: Golden Idol Investigations: The Age of Restraint
description: When reports of the unlawful use of Lemurian technology begin to surface, an inquisition squad is sent to investigate. Are they truly immune to the Idol's influence? See the fabled civilization that created Golden Idol and catch a glimpse at the world during the creation of the artifact itself.

title: The Rage of Mert
description:
A rage game themed around Moarf23, as featured on twitch.tv/moarf23

After Evilmoarf23 teamed up with the devious Trent, the devious duo steal Lomster straight from behind the back of Moarf23, Mert has no choice but to journey, climb, race and jump up the many levels, seamlessly integrated and combined into a challenging rage game! Can he meet all of his awesome mods and collect their individual hats before beating up EvilMoarf and reclaiming his lomster at the top!?

title: Sunshine Backwards
description: Sunshine Backwards is a distorted, autofictitious stream of consciousness. Sunshine Backwards is time travel, 2d porn, call-out culture, curses, teeth, detransitioning, and sonic creepypastas.

title: The Last Shores
description: The Last Shores is a chill solar-punk adventure. Clean, explore, and uncover the secrets of a forgotten island while restoring its lost harmony.

title: Treeplanter
description:
Create and enjoy a peaceful, interactive woodland throughout the changing seasons.
For every copy sold, we plant a real tree!

title: A Home Below
description:
A Home Below is a single-player, story-driven exploration game where you play as a hermit crab exploring the ruins of a house that’s been lost to the sea.

Platform around large underwater rooms, drifting and floating your way further into the house, harnessing ocean currents and hitching lifts, climbing over surfaces and through cracks in the walls as you travel from room to room.

As a hermit crab with the ability to change shells, putting on the Salt family’s forgotten possessions allows you to see memories from the past, revealing the ghostly traces of the lives that once filled the house. Physically platform across these tableaus, providing new pathways and access to other rooms in the house.

Discover a wonderful world of responsive, characterful sea creatures based on real UK species, from skittish sea urchins and friendly anemones to a scary wrasse and a curious octopus. Add to your bestiary as you explore, learning real facts about sea life and forming powerful connections.

title: Seconds Till Destruction
description: Seconds Till Destruction is a lightning-fast, randomized top-down shooter played in six-second bursts. Warp onto different floors, kill them all, then do it again! Pick up and play for instant action, or try to clear as many floors as you can!

title: Pressure Cooker
description: A short visual novel about two women trapped in an elevator. Made for the Toxic Yuri Visual Novel Jam.

title: Cosmic Construct
description: Cosmic Construct is a 2D cozy colony simulation game starring a cast of cute animal characters that can be individually managed. You take the role of a researcher and colonist studying an ancient and mysterious totem left behind by a precursor civilization.

title: Tile Jumper!
description: "Tile Jumper!" is a simple platformer game that tests your reflexes and platforming skills. You will be shown a random color and must quickly jump on the correct platform to avoid falling down. After each color is shown your time to react is reduced!

title: Cloudscrapers
description:
Cloudscrapers is a minimalist strategy game with a relaxing atmosphere.

Start with simple tools and build the tallest tower you can. With each climb, you’ll improve, unlock upgrades, and reach new heights. As your tower rises, you’ll discover ancient relics and uncover secrets hidden deep within the clouds.

Designed for players who enjoy thoughtful gameplay without unnecessary complexity, the game blends replayable puzzle-strategy, meaningful progression, and a hand-drawn world you can get lost in.

title: Lab Run
description: Congratulations! You are an intern in the underground E.K.R.E Science Facility and you have just created a 20,000 gigaton mixture! All you have to do now is get it to your supervisors. Just make sure you don't bump into anyone, your mixture isn't exactly stable.

title: Gash Rabbet
description:
As Orion, the wanderer slays the antient forest god, she finds the offering to the now deceased god - a girl named Sphene. With Sphene now under Orion's care, they must now tread lightly to ensure their survival.

But Orion has never traveled alone. By her side is her dearest and closest companion; her blade by the name of Selene.

title: Everdream Village
description:
Set sail and explore a collection of enchanted islands, each with their own ecosystems, treasures, and resources to help you grow and expand your village. Whether you're gathering rare flora, collecting new creatures or discovering secrets, there's always a journey to enjoy too!

Your village isn’t just the buildings you construct, it’s a thriving community that reacts to your choices. Befriend NPCs, manage their moods, and even possibly find romance. The village you build and maintain affects how everyone feels and behaves from a variety of factors. Add decorations, care for your animals, remove pests, and so much more to make this a happy place to be.

Interact with a massive variety of wild and domestic animals that each bring something different to the ecosystem. Breed and cross-breed animals to create unique variations of inherited traits, with hundreds of possible variations and combinations. And when the islands' magic takes hold, transform into different animals to see the world through their eyes and maybe even cause a little mischief along the way.

Turn your little village into a thriving farm! Grow crops, care for animals, and build relationships with your fellow villagers. Each has their own routines, personality, and needs. The more they like you, the more they’ll help around the place - harvesting crops, chopping wood, and even feeding your animals.

Shape the world to match your vision! Raise hills, carve out rivers, or dig deep underground to uncover hidden secrets, lost treasures, and rare resources.

Beyond farming and building, Everdream Village is packed with activities! Cook delicious meals, fish in scenic waters, collect rare creatures, or help villagers with unique quests. Every day offers something to make your time here feel like a never-ending adventure.

title: Fireside Fables
description:
Fireside Fables is a narrative driven 3D platformer, which follows a group of children telling stories around a campfire. These stories then come to life, and you play through them as your favourite plushie!

You will be transported across worlds! From a pirate island, to a lush forest, even to outer space - Anywhere that the children's imaginations can take you!

title: Madvent Calendar 2021
description: Madvent Calendar 2021 is a collection of short game vignettes from members of the HPS1 community. There are 25 games available from a launcher, one for each day from December 1st through the 25th; these games are not demos, so there is no further development for these titles unless specified otherwise. Unlike the first Madvent Calendar, the games in this launcher are not locked behind an advent system that would unlock the games when their specific day is reached, except for the final game.

title: KinPath
description:
Plan your journey in this micro RPG autobattler, leading generations of brave frogs through growth, uncovering treasures, confronting mysterious foes, and building a lasting family legacy.

Chart a course for your frog’s adventure and shape their destiny. As they travel through diverse locations, your little hero will grow stronger, gain new skills, and uncover treasures.

Will they delve into magic, embrace the swiftness of a rogue, or stand firm as a resilient fighter? The journey is yours to plan!

Every adventure has new enemies to face. Watch your frog tackle these challenges with the skills and items they’ve gathered along the way. Their success depends on the choices you made when planning their path.

Guide your frogs through different locations and uncover the map piece by piece. Embark on quests to develop your skills, collect resources and shape your character's story.

title: BoB: Battle of Bots
description:
Are you ready for a bot-breaking battle?
Dive into the world of BoB - Battle of Bots and test your skills against an endless tide of robotic foes. How long can you survive? How powerful can you become? There's only one way to find out. Download now and join the battle!

title: Stealpop's Basics Unity
description: Stealpop takes you onto a 3D world! Just avoid him and you will be alright. Just don't get caught or you will regret it for the rest of your life.

title: Vibes
description:
Vibes, the new Pudgy Penguins trading card game, brings together strategy and fun, perfect for newcomers to TCGs as well as experienced players. In Vibes, players create a custom “huddle” of quirky Penguin characters and augment it with bold Actions and powerful Relics. The goal? Outsmart your opponent to win the favor of Baron Fishpockets and claim victory.

To add even more excitement, each pack of Vibes trading cards includes QR codes that can be redeemed for free packs in the digital game, making it easy to build your collection across both formats.

Are you ready to join the Penguins and make your way to the top? Dive into Vibes and let the adventure begin!

title: OpenSandbox
description: Sandbox game inspired by Garry's mod, using the ID Tech 3 Engine

title: D.P.S: Weapons Testing Facility 2
description: A tower defense game where you program your weapons with different components. Combine and rearrange the components to create the ultimate weapon and beat all the enemy waves.

title: PrehistoricBound
description: This mod adds monsters, biomes and dungeons

title: Dark Souls: Remastered Seamless Co-op
description:
Mod which removes all multiplayer boundaries and allows for connections to persist after death.

Play with friends from the tutorial to the very end of the game, with synchronised progress, and no resummoning or interruptions. Invasions are optional and active by default.

You can adjust the multiplayer scaling of the enemies to your liking.

title: Die For The Lich
description: Roll dice and magical trinkets and pair them with weapons to battle legendary monsters. Master the art of chance in a journey where every roll counts. Unlock new gear by completing grueling challenges and prepare for the final battle against the King of undead, the Lich!

title: Cat-a-strophic
description:
CAT-A-STROPHIC is a goofy arcade 3D city destruction game with rogue-like elements where you play as Bluu, a colossal kaiju cat, rampaging through different cities to rescue your precious kittens! Embrace the purr-fect blend of chaos and relaxation as you level multiple towns and cities.

Unleash havoc by swiping at buildings, pouncing on structures, and hurling objects with telekinesis. As the chaos unfolds, enemies will continuously spawn to capture Bluu and stop her destruction spree. Once the level is cleared, you can rescue a kitten that supercharges Bluu’s powers, enhancing her abilities with unique effects like summoning lightning storms or turning invisible. Embrace the carnage, adapt your playstyle, and lead Bluu to victory!

title: The Outlast Trials: Project Diarchy
description: Season 4 - Project Diarchy will include a new Prime Asset villain, a new map: Shopping Mall, Reborn 2.0 and more!

title: Cosmic Husbandry
description: Cosmic Husbandry is a farming-related mod that adds realistic animal breeds that behave with more "life", new deco objects, more ingredients, more food, and much more. Chickens in this mod can cluck, peck, look around, and make different chicken sounds, directly from real life!

title: Grassland Planet
description:
Welcome to Grassland Planet, a mod that adds a brand NEW planet type to your universe!

Grassland planets are hilly, vibrant planets with rich soil and colourful flora. Their rich soil makes them the best planets for farming, so a lot of farmers are drawn here! You'll find wild animals, plenty of crops, and more!
But keep an eye out for tornadoes, the planets' deadliest, unique weather type!

title: Let's Do Vinery
description: Create wine using a new crafting system. Each variant comes with unique positive effects.

title: Trinity 64
description: A Souls-like Monster Tamer inspired by 90's Retro Adventure games. Fight and form bonds with powerful creatures, explore a ruined world, and uncover secrets within dungeons and the bosses that lurk in them.

title: Alchemist Historical Simulator
description: Alchemist Historical Simulator invites you into the mystical world of medieval alchemy. Experience the daily lives of true alchemists, experiment with rare ingredients, and craft potions. Unlock ancient secrets, master transmutation, and shape your destiny in this immersive historical simulator.

title: Doomfields
description: Doomfields is a roguelite autobattler where you assemble a team of heroes. Every character transforms into a more specialized one as it levels up. You get to pick up to 5 characters that specialize in something different. You have to compose the best possible team based on loot and their abilities.

title: As The Leaves Fall
description: Point-and-click adventure game with a thrilling, Native American-inspired narrative. Use your wit to solve fun and challenging puzzles as you explore and interact with the townsfolk of Birchwood Hollow and the Native reservation. Secrets will be uncovered, and truths revealed, as the leaves fall.

title: Outclaw
description:
Ouclaw is a cosy minion-managing action adventure about herding cats. Play as Comet, a five eyed magic cat from space who commands mischievous shadow kittens called Shades.

Fight monsters, solve puzzles, collect treasure, and explore a galaxy of vibrant worlds.

Morph your underlings into various forms, creating shields, bridges, bombs and more to aid in your journey - Who knows what they’ll become next?

title: Tenkemo
description: Tenkemo is a cozy multiplayer open-world game packed with adventures. Craft tools, mine resources, and build homes and factories. Explore a vast world with friends and rescue adorable animals along the way!

title: The Last Gas Station
description: In a world where electric cars reign supreme, you are now the owner of an old gas station out in the wilderness. Establish trade, develop your business and uncover the secret of this strange place in the compact gas station simulator.

title: Entity Scavenger
description: Lethal Company x Minecraft; use your crowbar to open containers to get materials to craft better crowbars to open better containers; all while avoiding monsters!

title: Desktop Cat
description: Here's a black cat and a door—sometimes the cat will chase your mouse cursor around. The door leads to different places. Open it to check today's weather, invite idle friends to hang out on your screen, or go play some pinball and collect a few paintings.

title: Wonderland on Desktop
description: Wonderland on Desktop is a cozy farm sim idler game! The interface will locate at the bottom of your screen. Take care of your farm when working, studying, playing, experiencing the fun of multi threads! Cultivate magnificent thing on this little land on your screen!

title: Oriontis
description: Create prosperous cities and shape the future of Oriontis.Manage trade, economy, and society in a citybuilding experience that evolves across single-player and MMO modes.

title: Offsuit Pair
description: On a train ride to Chicago, two women try to repair their relationship over a game of poker

title: Among Space
description: Among Space is a horror game set on the planet EC-10013. You are a researcher of the anomalies of the planet, you were abandoned by your "comrades" during an emergency evacuation. Will you be able to leave the planet or will you find another way to survive?

title: Dogman95
description: Dogman RPG Dungeon Crawler

title: Blizz!
description: 90s Teen-Magazine Typing adventure

title: Milk Puzzle
description:
even though you have all the pieces, you don't get the point

Contains
-neurotic protagonist
-constant failure of the bechdel test
-cunnilingus
-a complete lack of agency with the world around you
-but your life is like sooooo hard
-people just don't get it...

title: Bionicle: Masks of Power - Legacy
description:
Remember those toys you played with as a kid? These are those. Play as your favorite Toa heroes and explore the mystic island of Mata-Nui. Find Villages, fight Rahi, talk to matoran, and experience quests.

The (Legacy) in the title refers to this being the Legacy/Original branch of the project, The rebuilt branch being 2.0, which will have it's own page once it is released.

This version of the game has been finished, while some minor patches or fixes may come to this version, no other content is being planned on. We recommend downloading Via the Itch.io App to get quicker updates.

title: StoneHold
description: StoneHold is a free-to-play 5v5 action MOBA where collectible card strategy meets intense third-person combat. Pick a Warden, build a deck, draw by crushing turrets and defeating enemies, then swap cards and skills at base for constant counterplay. UE5 visuals and a world of chiseled stone magic.

title: Cranked
description: Chase the top of the leaderboards in Cranked and experience the raw thrill of downhill mountain bike racing. It’s fast, responsive, and grounded -- we're chasing what it really feels like to ride. Easy to pick up, impossible to put down, and packed with virtually endless skill depth.

title: Half-A-Cado
description: An arithmetic puzzle game in which you must roll a number square through various modifiers to reach the goal with the correct number, in as few moves as possible.

title: Agent P Strikes Back
description:
Play Agent P Strikes Back Game and assist Perry the Platypus in his secret mission. Help him to win another battle against the evil Dr. Heinz Doofenshmirtz!

Perry the Platypus has to win another battle against the evil Dr. Heinz Doofenshmirtz in Agent P Strikes Back game! Perry, known as a quiet and funny pet, lives his ordinary life with Phineas and Ferb, leaving them no doubts about his simple nature. No one knows, but Perry is living a double life! He's also known as Agent P, an agent of O.W.C.A., a secret organization fighting evil scientists' plans.

And now it's time for Perry to embark on a new mission. He got a duty call: several of the O.W.C.A. agents are captured in The 2nd Dimension ruled by Dr. Doofenshmirtz. It's a dangerous and strange world, and none of Perry's friends is feeling familiar with. His boss, the Major Monogram, have sent him there to rescue the agents.

Assist Agent P in his mission!
Brave Agent P is ready to go! He's heading in The 2nd Dimension on his own since he's considered to be the best one of O.W.CA. Ever felt jealous about the life of a secret agent? Would you try it on if you had a chance? Perry invites you to join him for the secret mission! Follow him to The 2nd Dimension and save all the agents together with him!

Explore this strange and unfriendly world following Major Monogram's instructions. You have to gather all the tokens and find all the missing agents. They will help you to unlock the doors so you can go further. Run, climb, jump, and learn some neat tricks which can help you to overcome the obstacles in your way! Don't hesitate to fight when you meet evil robots. And don't get scared; Major Monogram is here to help you with a piece of advice whenever you might need it!

title: Vital Shell
description: Vital Shell is a single-player, top-down arena shooter that puts you in control of mechs inspired by classic fantasy archetypes. Unlock powerful synergies with unique weapons, traits and abilities as you take on increasingly challenging waves of enemies in a shattered realm.

title: Gotchi Guardians
description: Adapt, strategize, and dominate your rivals in this multiplayer roguelite tower defense brawler. Upgrade towers, wield powerful items, and outlast the madness to become the last Guardian standing!

title: Gridkeeper
description: Gridkeeper is an incremental game about managing "Grids" and using their power to run MineBots, research tech, and grow your mining empire by getting better Grids.

title: Moth Ma'am
description: Moth Ma'am is a 2D pixel art platformer meant to eventually be beatable in a single sitting, like old Mega Man or Sonic games. Jump, flap, shoot, swim, air drill, and ride through 8 stages of cryptid mayhem. Try to earn a S rank on every stage.

title: I Offered You the Crown
description: A drama/comedy visual novel about how holding a relationship together and surviving a deadly blizzard may not be all that different.

title: Twincantation
description: Twincantation is a short and emotionally resonant visual novel set in the haunted woods of Mirrorstone National Park. You play as a teen trespassing on sacred private property to hold a séance for your deceased twin—but something goes terribly wrong. Choose your path through cozy horror or psychological introspection, with hand-drawn ink and watercolor visuals and an original soundtrack.

title: Paranormal Files: Fatal Flaw - Collector's Edition
description: Can you stop a dangerous spirit haunted by unrequited love in time?

title: Echoes of Undeath
description: Echoes of Undeath is a gothic third-person survival action game. Fight endless waves of monsters! Master brutal combat, unlock forbidden powers, and survive alone or in co-op.

title: Sohee
description: Please help Sohee find her happiness.

title: Agent of Strange
description: Agent of Strange is a dark role-playing thriller where every mission is a labyrinth of choices and possibilities. You play as a Conspirator who infiltrates a sealed city ruled by the monstrous Family. Overthrow the regime, uncover occult secrets, and shape the City's fate.

title: Eona
description: Dive into Eona’s dark and strange tale. Survive the castle’s dangers—and Mélusine, the evil fairy who rules over it—for she has waited so long for a soul to torment. Escape this cursed place with your loot, hoping to save your mother.

title: Eilean Mor: The Lost Keepers
description: In 1900, off the coast of Scotland, the Eilean Mor lighthouse has gone silent. The light is out, and its three keepers are missing. No one is answering the radio. As a reserve keeper, you’re sent to investigate this horror mystery. But beware you may become the fourth to vanish.

title: Secrets of Salem: The Phantom Cab - Collector's Edition
description: A ghostly taxi prowls the streets of Salem. Step into a noir mystery where legends kill and ghosts remember. Solve puzzles, uncover secrets, and don’t look back—he’s right behind you.

title: DungeonBox
description: A new Dungeons & Dragons Party Game! Let our Dungeon Master take you and up to 8 players on an adventure, where you control the next move by answering and voting from your phones

title: The Fable of Fairy Glen
description: A Richly Layered Story: Explore themes of sacrifice, loyalty, and resistance as you witness the far-reaching consequences of one man’s selflessness. This is a free story driven game.

title: Rage Tower
description: Rage Tower is a pixel-art platformer full of traps and frustration. You play as a small white character thrown to the top of a deadly tower. Your goal is to descend safely, navigating handcrafted traps, collapsing floors, and deceptive safe zones. The game blends cheerful visuals with punishing level design, offering a contrast between cute aesthetics and relentless difficulty. Expect emotional outbursts, broken keyboards, and the irresistible urge to try “just one more time”

title: Store It!
description: A gravity gun. A tiny warehouse. Absolute chaos. Stack weird stuff, keep your cool, and try not to crush the customer's plant.

title: Night at the Lake: Silent Watcher
description: A night shift at a remote lake turns into something unsettling. Explore the area, log data, and uncover what lurks in the darkness.

title: Chipmatic
description: Chipmatic is a factory building game where you control a mining robot on a mission to reach Earth’s core. Explore deep underground, research new tech and create the best (and only) factory on Earth! Can you discover what mysteries lie beneath the surface in this ruined planet some used to call home?

title: Legends of Amberland III: The Crimson Tower
description: Legends of Amberland III: The Crimson Tower is a classic western RPG inspired by great 90s era games such as Might & Magic, Wizardry, Ultima, the Gold Box series. Light, fairy tale, epic, heroic, slightly humorous adventure.

title: 12 Labours of Hercules XVIII: Ghost Sheep
description: Help Hercules restore balance in a flooded, haunted Hellas.

title: Bearly Baking
description: Bearly Baking is a cooking and relationship-building game where you play as a bear running an inn to feed animals for hibernation. You cook bread and muffins in small mini-games, and based on the quality, you build better relationships with your patrons and learn more about their stories.

title: Void Authority
description: A sci-fi roguelike document-inspection game where you approve or deny alien travelers, scan for contraband, and navigate shifting galactic laws across border outposts, with each run shaping the future political climate.

title: Kitchen Gore
description: Cook disturbing meals before you become one! Use physics-based cooking to prepare gory dishes while keeping a monster distracted by scrolling her phone. Survive a surreal narrative across Story and Hardcore modes. The only culinary experience that redefines doomscrolling.

title: Farm of Rage
description: Farm of Rage is an action-packed, top-to-down shooter where you control various animals to defend the farm. Each character comes with unique abilities and weapon sets. Explore different environments filled with challenging enemies. Upcoming features include online multiplayer modes like PvP battles, group creation, and in-game chat.

title: Golden Idol Investigations: Detective Pass
description:
The Rise of the Golden Idol - Detective Pass gives you access to all four upcoming Investigations DLC releasing in 2025 at a discounted price

Investigations #1 - The Sins of New Wells
Follow Detective Roy Samson through four brand new cases of his dealings with an organized crime syndicate plaguing the city. Drugs, death, and ancient Lemurian magic will make headlines in The Sins of New Wells.

Investigations #2 - The Lemurian Phoenix
Travel to Lemuria and investigate a deep reaching conspiracy that has infiltrated the upper echelons of Lemurian aristocracy and its King. Mingle with new age cults from India, gurus with potentially supernatural powers and charlatans that just want to scam westerners in The Lemurian Phoenix.

Investigations #3 - The Age of Restraint
When reports of the unlawful use of Lemurian technology begin to surface, an inquisition squad is sent to investigate - but are they truly immune to the Idol’s influence? Explore a world before modern technology and catch a glimpse at the world during the creation of the artifact itself in The Age of Restraint.

Investigations #4 - The Curse of the Last Reaper
Set shortly after the events of The Case of the Golden Idol, follow a group of explorers as they set off on a seafaring adventure to discover a fabled and supposedly cursed treasure of a lost pirate captain. It’s all hands on deck in The Curse of the Last Reaper.

title: Death Kitchen
description: Death Kitchen is an immersive fast-paced co-op cooking horror game. You must coordinate with your friends to serve alien customers who can kill you in many situations. You can morph into a variety of characters! Embrace the chaos and deliver quality with your new intergalactic restaurant chain.

title: Hentai Games Collection Vol. 2
description: Four sizzling adventures in one ultimate hentai bundle.

title: Restorer
description: You are a restorer, come to repair an old mansion. With every improvement, the house seems to come alive—it speaks to you. Something roams the halls… It wants to share its secret—with the price being your sanity.

title: Untold Stories 2: Bigleaf Forest
description:
The second map in the Untold Stories series made by renderXR. Stranded on an island full of vast trees you must survive. Explore and
discover in this overgrown wilderness. This is an open-world map that is more of a survival map than an adventure map. Also, because this
map has many leaves, fire doesn't spread, just to save your computer some hassle.

title: Noctheria
description: Noctheria is an Action-adventure 3D game inspired by the N64 era, focused on exploration, horror elements, combat and puzzle solving.

title: Among Us: District 5
description: Among Us: District 5 is a custom map mod for Among Us set in a biological disaster in an underground bunker.

title: Star Conflict: Relic
description:
This pack includes:
Jericho destroyer “Relic” 17 rank
Heavy Gauss-cannon “G2” weapon

Additionally, the pilot receives:
Portrait “Jericho destroyer commander”

title: TheHunter: Call of the Wild - Alberta Hunting Preserve
description: It's bitterly cold, but the Albertan wilderness is teeming with life. Discover and hunt 19 local species, tackle 13 exclusive missions, and explore this stunning snowy preserve.

title: Fame
description: You’ve been invited to an exclusive stay at the Beggars Hotel, a once-glamorous retreat where only the elite gather. But when the guests begin dying one by one, your dream getaway turns into a deadly game of survival. Who can you trust?

title: 100 Trials
description: Try again and again in these 100 Trials. A top-down action puzzle game that requires precision and strategy to complete.

title: Chunk
description: In the vibrant lands of Lutum, where everything is made of clay, darkness once again rises and threatens to consume the world! Chunk must set out on a perilous adventure and morph his form to become powerful enough to vanquish the evil and save the day in this 3rd person action adventure game.

title: Terminal Shift
description: Trapped inside a desolate terminal, hunted by an unknown entity that has taken control and twisted the airport into a terrifying, looping nightmare. Gain access to the boarding gates and escape.

title: Brutalismus: Dystopia
description: A short, atmospheric walking simulator where brutalist architecture becomes the labyrinth of a decaying mind. Inspired by David Lynch's work, explore vast concrete spaces and unravel the story of an architect lost in his own creation.

title: Vínculo
description: Embark yourself on an adventure through the Marble Palace and uncover the plentiful secrets it hides! Explore magnificent views and fight through the hostile halls of the palace, all while making use of the innovative plane change mechanics!

title: Sakura Bunny Girls 2
description: Your favorite bunny girls are back! Picking up from the last chapter, you'll once again take on the role of the security guard who encountered the supergirls. This time, though, you'll dive into an investigation surrounding a mysterious crime linked to them.

title: Good God!
description: Good God! is a short adventure game developed in AGS. It offers up to an hour long gameplay and features a Game Boy-inspired artstyle, although the mechanics and controls are of a point'n'click game.

title: Rugby League 26
description:
Step onto the pitch in the most authentic Rugby League experience ever!

Whether you're chasing club glory, building a custom ‘Pro Team’, or rising through the ranks with a self-made superstar, Rugby League 26 puts YOU at the heart of the action.

title: Tongue of Dog
description:
Play as a cute dog. Stick out your tongue to grab onto things. Overcome 8 unique levels: swing high, slide on ice, float in space, and escape from a volcano.
No checkpoints.
Collectibles and leaderboards included. Customize your character.
Climb, fall, die, rage, learn, and repeat.

title: Bus Simulator 27
description: Get ready for Bus Simulator 27, the most advanced entry in the history of the franchise. Look forward to our most comprehensive bus fleet yet, with new officially licensed brands and bus models, as well as iconic buses from the series.

title: Sudden Strike 5
description: Sudden Strike 5 delivers real-time tactics in epic WWII battles. A host of tactical options and more than 300 playable units open-up multiple approaches to reach your objectives in a 25 mission campaign on historical battlefields in Europe and North Africa.

title: Co-op Kaiju Horror Cooking
description: In this absurd co-op horror game you are medieval monks--and the only chefs who can prevent the apocalypse. Feed enormous monsters with a catapult, evade supernatural enemies, and navigate a reality-bending labyrinth with up to 4+ players!

title: FTB Evolution
description: FTB Evolution re-imagines modded MC with a vast collection of advanced tech, intricate magic, and limitless exploration. Whether you're into building high-tech machinery or wielding powerful spells, Our flagship pack FTB Evolution has something new in store for you to explore.

title: Shuffle Sword
description: Shuffle Sword is a dark fantasy deck-builder roguelite. Fight your way through the blade cave, find different sword and magic cards to utilize, and prove yourself to the sword masters. They may have some strong swords, but nothing beats the Shuffle Sword Style!

title: Catharage
description: A space tactics extraction roguelite. Explore space, pick fights, collect loot, then escape. Upgrade and unlock new ships to strengthen your fleet and face tougher foes.

title: Viper Thunderground
description: Viper Thunderground is a physics-based 2.5D helicopter precision platformer with vehicular combat and light puzzle elements. Take control of an armed helicopter, maneuver it through challenging levels and use its cannon and missiles to fight enemy security installations and numerous other obstacles.

title: The Museum Sentinel
description: Left alone on the night shift in a forgotten museum, you must uncover its secrets and survive the horrors lurking within. Explore, solve, and stay alive in this story-rich first- and third-person psychological horror experience.

title: Pinono and the Magic Fiddle
description: Pinono, a girl who casts magic through music, sets off on a slightly free-spirited journey. In this turn-based RPG, you'll meet unique companions and explore a whimsical world. Your choices shape the story and ending, and melodies used in magic and events are procedurally generated each time.

title: Delivery Must Complete
description: High speed Acelike Roguelike with SSSTYLE. Cut across cel-shaded, action-packed, arcade-paced dogfights as you fly, fight, and upgrade your roster of kickass planes. Every battle is massive, every location is procedural, and every fight is a spectacle- whether it's aircraft, blimps, dragons or mechs

title: Salvage Shop Simulator
description: Enter the world of shopkeepers trading in reclaimed goods! Bid for the best items at auction, prepare and clean the bought items, and then sell them in your shop. Test your skills and watch your business grow!

title: Lost in Loss
description: Welcome to the strangest case of your career, detective: characters have forgotten who they are! In this cozy hidden object adventure, find items tied to memories and restore lost identities — uncover the truth behind the loss.

title: Untold Stories 3: Myriad Caves
description:
The Third map in the Untold Stories series by renderXR. An extensive network of caves providing plenty to explore. This map is experimental in two ways.
Firstly, the map layout is an open-world cave layout. So areas may have an abounding amount of pathways to other areas. Secondly, the map uses a different food/health system than a normal MC world. Instead of getting food points back you get health back directly when you eat a piece of food. This in combination with the challenging areas will provide you with a challenging yet rewarding experience. How far will you make it?

title: Assenizator
description: Become a sewage disposal worker and help Petrovich cope with all the difficulties of this difficult profession!

title: Sawmania
description: Protect your base against an onslaught of monsters using your mighty saw!

title: Late Stage Capitalism
description: You're stuck at your home desk, clicking away at your keyboard. If only you could get away from it all... but everything just costs, and costs, and costs some more. Going outside is expensive, walking has a price, passing a street will cost you, even meeting a puppy could prove to ruin your wallet! Amass more money, and reach the airport to finally escape this madness, hopefully for good!

title: Fallsaga
description: FALLSAGA! The journey of Marcel in search of a legendary waterfall!

title: Drill Rift
description: Build and manage a remote drill outpost in this turn-based strategy game. Upgrade strategic machinery and level up your dwarfs so they succeed. Balance resource management, strategic upgrades, and the mental toll of the rift. Because the deeper you drill, the louder the whispers grow.

title: Untold Stories 4: Corona Trials
description: The fourth installment in the Untold Stories series by renderXR. I've frequently gotten requests about an easier map, so here we go! This map is based around fire with a difficulty that builds up. It starts off at a manageable level suitable for newcomers to the CTM (Complete The Monument) genre, but will get quite tricky over time.

title: Untold Stories 5: Calamity Canyon
description: The fifth installment in the Untold Stories series by renderXR. These once fertile lands are now blighted and devoid of life. Dark clouds have covered the canyon and spread evil. Survival in this barren wasteland is difficult due to the absence of an infinite food source. Explore the mesa and uncover the secrets that it holds. Can you manage to stay alive?

title: BDSM Clicker
description: A casual clicker game where you stimulate your waifu, gradually turning her from simply horny to dripping wet, ahegao plastered, mega-nymph. Contains disproportionate amount of BDSM.

title: Untold Stories 6: Horrifeye
description:
The sixth installment of the Untold Stories series by renderXR. A shattered realm now void of life and filled with an eerie shadow. All that is left are remnants of a long-forgotten world.
This map features an expansive dark sky world filled with grand areas and brutal design not for the faint-hearted.
furthermore, expect a difficulty that ramps up as natural-spawning monsters scale with the map progress.
Can you survive in this forlorn wasteland or will you perish together with what is left?

title: Untold Stories 7: Nova Arcana
description: The seventh installment of the Untold Stories series by renderXR. Somewhat of an experimental CTM in a few aspects, it contains many traditional condensed dungeons that are connected via open cave areas. While intersections guide the player throughout the whacky cave layout, the player has the choice to skip around to other areas if he or she wants to. With a custom currency for trading and a custom healing/spell system to help players through this expansive network of ruins of a long-gone civilization. Adventure into the lonely dark spaces which never seen the light of day.

title: Untold Stories 8: Burnout Fantasy
description:
The eighth installment of the Untold Stories series by renderXR. In Burnout Fantasy you can explore a sprawling world, fight hordes of monsters, survive in your own way, and transform the world to make it your own.

Throughout your adventure you will encounter hunting grounds: spawners where you can fight strong enemies for resources and objectives. Every area has a boss hunting ground marked with a beacon. Beat them all and bring their wool to the Monument to complete the monument.

title: Reus 2: Everglades
description: Bring the Wetlands to life in Reus 2! This expansion adds over 60 new biotica, micros to help support growth and more human leaders join the roster. With new eras to explore, find all the new ways to fill the universe with more life!

title: Untold Stories 9: Castlemania
description:
The ninth installment of the Untold Stories series by renderXR.
Assault dangerous castles with arcane wands.
Explore grand landscapes with mystery around every corner.
Uncover the secrets that haunt the forlorn towers.

In this monstrosity you will explore a large single environment you will travel from castle to castle to collect all the wool.
Mechanically, this is a follow-up of Nova Arcana, with the soul star system and healing flask, additionally, it expands on it via wands to spice up the gameplay.

title: Escape to Moscow 2
description: This is a visual novel - a continuation of the game Escape to Moscow. More than 3 hours of gameplay, 6 game days. Immerse yourself in new adventures in Moscow and other locations. You need to help Aliya escape to freedom again! The plot of the game depends on the decisions you make.

title: Star Conflict: Pilum - Deluxe edition
description:
This bundle includes:
Jericho rank 17 covert ops interceptor “Pilum”
Unique weapon RF Blaster “Inferno”
Active module “Forced cooler”
Unique portrait “Yumi Kyra”

Additionally, the pilot receives:
10% bonus to credits gain for 90 days
Paint “Knox”
Decor “Giving hand”

title: Nose: The Great Keana Edition
description:
NOSE is a Souls Like RPG made by rightkamo and published in 2020

You're a nameless child that's only goal is to "Seek the Great Keana"

title: Star Conflict: Pilum
description:
This bundle includes:
Jericho rank 17 covert ops interceptor “Pilum”
Unique weapon RF Blaster “Inferno”
Active module “Forced cooler”
Unique portrait “Yumi Kyra”

title: Star Conflict: Shrike. Weapon of Victory
description:
This pack includes:
Hybrid blaster “Alpha-N” R15-17
Active module “Universal repair module” R13-17
Capacitor modifier “Adaptation mechanism” R15-17
CPU modifier “Plasma summator” R15-17
60 monocrystals
A set of resources for 50 ores: (Vanadium + Silicon + Graphite + Osmium) + 50 Crystal shards.
A set of colours: “Scarlet”, “Prosperity”, “Terracotta”
Unique portrait “Rahil “Coin” Weintraub”
Colouring preset “Predatory colour”

title: Star Conflict: Psiloi
description:
This pack includes:
Rank 17 Empire recon interceptor “Psiloi”
Unique weapon “Star blaster”
Active module “Star sail”
Unique portrait “Count Tenaris”

title: Super RMN Bros.
description: A collaborative SMBX episode made by members of the rpgmaker.net website

title: Bobo's Big Tower
description:
Bobo is building a Big Tower to reach Heaven and become God! Bibi must conquer Bobo's Big Tower to save the world..

Time only moves when you do, so outsmart your enemies to get past them! Explore the procedurally-generated floors of Bobo's Big Tower to endlessly modify your arsenal for taking on stronger foes. Complete challenges to unlock new shop items and playable characters with their own item pools, bosses, & story endings!

Do you have what it takes to thwart Bobo?

title: Jollibae
description: Jollibae is a horror parody game of a popular fast food restaurant, Jollibee. In this game, the player assumes control of a professional eater taking part in a challenge that Jollibae has set up. In addition to learning about the history of the locations, the player must eat and work through easy puzzles to win a mystery prize.

title: The Future Is Loading...
description: A game about an all-knowing phone app and soon-to-be graduates.

title: I Wanna Escape Into My Mind
description:
A game about change, identity and figuring out who you are.

Take the role of the kid as you enter a fortress that lets you enter your own mind. It'll take a lot of strength and willpower to get to the center of the fortress. Will you enter your own mind or will you perish? Or will you do something entirely different?

title: Dimension
description: Make full use of dimensions to clear the area.

title: Ms. Rein! Give me your Approval please!
description: Hello! This is VLyz Company's LEE REIN! A new employee, Kim Pang-mae, who just joined VLYZ! The company's manager is a pretty older sister who cooks food without telling other employees...?! A heart-pounding office romance(?) with the company's manager, REIN

title: Hollow Sorrow
description: Hollow Sorrow is a dark yet heartwarming 2D exploration adventure game where you confront your lost past.

title: Coin Slot
description: It's a coin pusher game where you can drop a large number of coins. Try to line up the numbers to win coins!

title: Ground Mine Girl
description: "Challenge the classic minesweeper and unlock the heart of the girl you like!", you will experience a story full of surprises and challenges. The game graphics are fresh and cute, and each character is full of personality and charm, bringing you a pleasant gaming experience.

title: Eternal Hand
description: Eternal Hand is an innovative narrative game that combines text and image-generating AI to create dynamic storytelling experiences. Unlike traditional visual novels with preset choices, players shape the narrative by freely typing their desired actions and dialogue, with the AI generating both story text and corresponding illustrations in real-time.

title: Ave Classic
description: Ave Classic is a productivity support tool game featuring personified classical music characters. It helps you create a focused work environment with a Pomodoro timer and background music for work.

title: Seal of Magic
description: A turn-based auto-battler roguelike where you strengthen Spirits by sticking and stacking Seals. Since enemies build their power the same way, their abilities evolve with every encounter. No story—just pure focus on deep build-crafting.

title: Allegro Molto wo Kiku Game
description: A relaxing visual novel where you tune in to Allegro Molto’s piano livestream. Enjoy calm improvisations and flowing chat as a quiet listener.

title: Parry de Bougai! Dual Runner
description: A grand sports festival of spirits held once every hundred years... Here it begins!! A competitive racing game where you compete in two separate lanes! The key to victory lies in "Parry"! When an enemy appears, jump! While in the air, press the jump button again... Let's Parry!

title: Dragons and Elves
description: This is a very traditional turn based strategy game. If you enjoy constantly fighting monsters, collecting guidebooks, experiencing and cultivating various characters, and enjoying the thrill of character growth, then please give this game a try .....

title: Black Goat
description: The game is a BL Cthulhu-style narrative romance game. It tells the story of the protagonist struggling to survive on a cruise ship filled with strange events after losing their memory. The game's setting is modern with a Cthulhu-inspired narrative.

title: Magic Survivors
description: Magic Survivors is a casual game that combines elements of survival, roguelike survival, and role - playing. Players will control their characters to embark on a survival adventure in a world full of monsters.

title: Witch's Tower
description: An innovative Tower of the Sorcerer strategy game with unique gameplay mechanics.

title: Guiling's Adventure
description: An action oriented shooting horror game, where players will be the hero GUILING from mysterious Eastern continent and engage in battles with demons to find ways to break curses, defeat zombies, and seal evil spirits. Can we fight against evil forces and escape from the cursed land?

title: Oni no Moribito
description: A thrilling 3D action RPG set in a world of Japanese folklore, where the Oni Princess “Chiho Itsutsuno” takes center stage! you delve deep into the Nabari-no-Miya to defeat its master and stop a looming catastrophe known as Kamimadoi.

title: Obara no Kiritsu: UAV Practical Simulator
Exorcism Agency
description: Welcome to Exorcism Agency. Exorcism Agency is an innovative game that blends match-3, Zuma, and paranormal adventures. By chance, you join a company that aims to eliminate ghosts. As stories are revealed, there seem to be deeper secrets hidden behind this supernatural world.

title: Meimetsu
description: You ponder the meaning of the world—and of humanity.

title: Dungeon Killing
description: When holy light fails, only killing can rewrite salvation. 《Dungeon Killing》is a dark fantasy match-3 roguelike where you command 8 fallen paladins, wield 16 unique skills, and face personal Nemeses in procedurally generated dungeons. Every match is a moral choice—purge? revenge?embrace corruption?

title: Akuro & Bahaku 2
description: A visual novel with fun interactions, rich story, vivid characters, cute art. Lonely Akuro meets life-changing friend Bahaku. Use clicks & drags to witness their passionate friendship! Immerse in joy, happiness, sorrow, feel friendship's power.

title: The Legend of Demon-Slaying Heroes
description: "The Legend of Demon-slaying Heroes": A fantasy idle game with an epic 200,000-word narrative, featuring quests, dungeons, forging, alchemy, enchanting, trading, and construction. Join the heroic adventure filled with battles!

title: Escape the School
description: Trapped in a repressive campus ruled by a brutal principal, you must survive a terrifying night and uncover buried truths. Escape the School is a student-made horror game blending suspenseful gameplay with sharp social commentary.

title: Journey to Chaos: Pilgrimage to the West
description: "Journey to Chaos: Pilgrimage to the West" on Steam! Pixel-art retelling of Xuanzang’s quest. 20+ story branches—shape heaven’s fate. 300+ characters, Havoc to 81 trials. Tactics & relics-rebirth = new adventures.

title: Fish Time
description: Fishing Time | FishTime — Your Ultimate Desktop Procrastination Companion Controls ✔ Hold Right-click — Reposition window freely

title: Tsurimasu
description: The mouse is the controller! Go fishing with “Tsurimasu”, a mouse combined with a fishing rod! A whole new operating experience awaits you!

title: Back to the War
description: This is a multi-player competitive shootout game, biased towards low configuration, low threshold, high fluency, comfortable operation feel, fast pace, leisure entertainment, decompression of the game experience. Subsequent copies of various skins will be dropped.

title: Return to College Age
description: Return to College Age "is a text-based adventure game set against the backdrop of college campus life. One day when you are reborn and return to college, will you choose to follow the rules and make some money by simply using information asymmetry to live a better life。

title: Train Plus: Kowa Dentetsu Regular Colors Train
description: The special train "Kōwa Dentetsu Regular Colors" is now drivable! Add this exclusive limited-edition "Regular Colors" train to Train Plus and take it for a spin. Enjoy riding the Regular Colors train as it speeds over 1000 km/h!

title: Reioku: Ghost House
description: The second installment of "Exit 8 Like," where all anomalies are terrifying, has arrived. Find it. And run!

title: My Splitting Image
description: A psychological horror where you play a man who can no longer even recognize his own reflection, tormented and at the same time welcomed by a mysterious figure with a book embedded in his face.

title: Ice Slider
description: Ice Slider is a game by Shining Watermelon Studios where you play as a hiker named Rob who enters Icy Cave. A cave with a Gauntlet of Ice Puzzles, in which he has to complete to exit. Play as Rob as he goes through this gauntlet of puzzles.

title: Jewel Warehouse
description: The Cyborg Queen's arrival is imminent. Amy must gather up the power crystals she has collected and stored in her warehouse. However her warehouse is a bit of a mess, some fires have broken out and strange creatures have invaded.

title: Rik the Roadie
description: Help long-suffering Rik the Roadie get the hit rockers Alternative Rock on stage for the gig in this slice of the rock n' roll lifestyle.

title: Run for Gold
description: Qualify for your chance to win the ultimate athletic prize - a gold medal.

title: Ugomeku Note
description: Welcome to the world of UGOMEKU NOTE (“Wriggling Note”). You—gentle, kind, and always wearing a lovely smile—have been chosen as a hero to embark on an adventure full of humor and heart. This is a handcrafted RPG made with RPG Maker MV. All graphics, music, and systems are being created by a solo developer.

title: Wanna Get Lucky?
description: A mystery adventure - uncover the truth behind a series of deaths by collecting clues hidden across internet. news articles, and wikipedias—creating an immersive experience that feels like real. Information is visually organized into a mind map, gradually open as the investigation progresses.

title: The Fixer
description: The Fixer is an adult life sim lite visual novel. You take the role of the protagonist, Samantha who is a Fixer. In order to solve her employer’s problems she has to face different challenges such as investigating industrial sabotage, diplomacy between factions and tracking down troublemakers. But she needs somehow to carry on with her everyday life while dealing with her missions.

title: Casa Caballero
description: Casa Caballero is a single-player, first-person survival horror game set in a fictional area in the Philippines.

title: The Last Flight: Return Home
description:
The Last Flight: Return Home is a 3D shooter with elements of survival, exploration, and a deep space atmosphere.

During the test flight of an experimental spacecraft, the protagonist loses consciousness. Upon waking, he finds himself on an unknown planet. Gradually, he realizes that the planet is on the brink of catastrophe — alien creatures are preparing to attack.

The player must survive in this new world, explore the environment, gather resources, and defend against hostile beings. Along the way, he uncovers the truth and faces a decision that could cost him his life — all to save others.

title: Worm Wars
description: Worm Wars is an Io arcade game where you join the fight to become the biggest worm in Worms War. You must eat as much food as possible to grow bigger. Slither your way towards the power-ups to get an edge. This .io game is addictive!

title: Tower! Simulator 3: NZAA Airport
description: Auckland Airport (IATA: AKL, ICAO: NZAA) is a major international airline hub serving New Zealand with many domestic and international destinations. The largest and busiest single-runway airport in Oceania.

title: Our Journey: The Silent Voice
description: Our Journey: The Silent Voice is a co-op (2 players) asymmetric adventure game. Communicate creatively with symbols to unveil the path to success. Find out who you really are by meeting intriguing characters and visiting new places.

title: Skull-Rung
description: Laura's landed the job of her dreams as junior partner to Amy, a trailblazing marketing exec. Laura's convinced she's finally going to make her name and escape the grey mire her life has become. Amy has other plans. A workplace thriller intended for adult audiences. Submitted to the Toxic Yuri VN Jam 2025.

title: Smokestack Saints: The Parkour Game Part I
description: An exciting and action-themed parkour game set in an steampunk-fantasy desert parkour! Are you ready to join the fun? Join the adventure and start playing today!

title: Starship Warbeasts
description: Become a space adventurer, a Lumen, and use Warbeasts to fight. Build your deck, fight against others, have fun for free!

title: Tournamentris
description: This is a new type of merge puzzle game with the theme of ‘tournament table x falling block puzzle’. To clear the rising panels, drop the pieces and stack them to complete the ‘tournament’!

title: Heart of Gaia
description: Lead the resistance against an ancient, dark order seeking to awaken an ancient evil and plunge Gaia into chaos. Explore a vast, Steampunk-themed fantasy world and face formidable adversaries in this action RPG featuring real-time character switching and dynamic combat.

title: Diecast
