description: In a valley forgotten by time, 4 survivors struggle to complete dark rituals while fleeing a brutal killer, all trapped in a cycle of terror and secrets from the past.

title: Argonauts Agency: Captive of Circe - Collectors Edition
Argonauts Agency: Chair of Hephaestus - Collector's Edition
Argonauts Agency: Glove of Midas - Collector's Edition
description:
One morning, Pelias the collector asked his old friends Jason and Medea to deliver him a package. The package was the legendary glove of Midas. Rumor has it that it bestows magical powers on the wearer. Pelias decided to upgrade it a little and performed an experiment...

The collector's edition includes a bonus campaign.

title: Mega Man DOS Remake
description:
"Break the death-grip of the ultimate computer! Legions of once peaceful robots have been mysteriously transformed into a horde of humanity-hating berserk droids! Nobody is safe - least of all Mega Man. Armed with every android-annihilator ever invented, they're determined to reduce the super-powered cyborg into a heap of radioactive waste!

Can our hero outfight, outwit and "out-robot" the robots? Will Mega Man pulverize the powerful robot-maniacs? Or will he melt down?"

Originally presented by Rozner Labs in 1990 and 1992 as Megaman and Megaman3 for dos. These games have since gone down in Megaman history as some of the worst entries in the series. With many not even knowing of their existence. The few who received a floppy disk instead of a cartridge for Christmas many years ago were greeted with unfair levels, plain bosses, and silent gameplay! Be it from lack of care, or maybe lack of ability. These games were bad, but every game can have a second chance right?

Two years of work have culminated in a full remake of these two games into one large project. A full remake of every stage in classic series nes gameplay! All 9 robot masters! Megaman X style level changes with alternate paths based on bosses defeated! Hidden bosses and secrets! A fully built fortress featuring new challenges instead of retreading the known hazards of the robot master stages! And finally, a fully built level editor. with built in time attack and challenge mode, and custom boss AI planner. Allowing you to make your own Megaman stages and bosses come to life to challenge your friends and community!

title: Dr. Mario Mania
description: Dr. Mario Mania is an unofficial fan-game based of the Dr. Mario series, bringing new features and improvements to the classic formula!

title: O.M.N.I.S.: Overnight Train
description:
O.M.N.I.S. – Overnight Train is a short, atmospheric walking simulator with psychological undertones.Inspired by late-night train rides, liminal spaces, and the sense of being caught in an endless loop.

A game about repetition, perception, and losing control.

title: Pokémon Stadium Club
description: PSC acts as a "hub" to select the minigame to play. All the minigames were made from scratch in Unity Engine supporting PvP (1 vs 1, 2, or 3 players), PvE (player against AI) and EvE (AI vs AI). There are 4 difficulties available: Easy, Normal, Hard and Hyper Hard. Every playthrough ends winning either 1 coin if the player loses, or 1 * difficulty coins if the player wins. These coins can be spent in the Gachapon machine to obtain a Pokémon-toy. There are +700 collectible Pokémon toys available in PSC in regular and shiny forms, so filling the Toy-Dex won't be easy. There are more than 1500 collectibles! If you are only interest in throwing to the gacha machine, you can use the code "I WANT GACHA" to gain 2 throws for free. In addition, you get 10 coins every day!

title: Méli-Mélo: L'Odyssée de la Crème de Marrons
description: Bigflo, Oli, and McFly & Carlito must find a mysterious jar of chestnut cream in a crazy 2D platform game! Switch heroes at each level, face mini-bosses, and embark on a speedrun!

title: Monsterium
description: Monsterium is a 2D pixel platformer where you play as a witch. Jump between platforms and cast magic to raise them and destroy the monster hanging from the ropes.

title: FPV Worldwide
description: Dive into our FPV drone simulator on Steam, featuring stunning global visuals with Unreal Engine 5. Share and discover spots, control the weather, use real drone controllers, and teleport anywhere. Perfect for drone enthusiasts.

title: Particle Accelerator
description: A simple, short, and beautiful arcade game about gaining enough momentum and ripping through dimensions!

title: SuperDucks
description: Welcome to SuperDucks – a dynamic 2D platformer-puzzle game! Choose one of seven unique ducks with special abilities and embark on an exciting journey through dark and vibrant levels. Solve puzzles, overcome obstacles, and enjoy the unique style of each tour!

title: Detective Mane
description: When items go missing and mysterious occurrences disrupt every day life, Detective Leonardo Mane is on the scene. Investigate, interrogate, accuse and solve the case.

title: Sleepy Heroes
description: A great Deck-Building Rogue-Like with Lo-Fi heroes awaits you! With Sleepy Heroes, where each round is a completely different puzzle, you can make great card combos, build your deck and win victories against sleepy creatures.

title: Northstar Courier
description: In Northstar Courier, you take the role of a 20-year-old delivery worker as she becomes accustomed to her new life in a small town. With the help of a rusty scooter, you make your way around town as you talk to the local residents, enjoy photography and fulfil your company's mysterious requests regarding odd sightings. With over 10+ cryptids to track down, will you find them all before the clock strikes midnight. Who knows what lurks in your dreams...

title: Stock the Shelves
description: A Frantic Store Management Sim. Create the best shop you can imagine, then make it better! Manage, Upgrade, Keep Customers Happy, but most importantly STOCK THOSE SHELVES!

title: Warcana: Dog DLC
description: Warcana's Dog DLC introduces dog-themed content, including a Dog of War unit, Warrior's Rest barracks, two new campaign missions, five profile titles, and a redesigned advisor.

title: Warcana: Cat DLC
description: Cat DLC introduces cat-themed content, featuring a Silent Prowler unit, Shinobi's Abode barracks, two new campaign missions, five profile titles, and a redesigned advisor.

title: Hamster Playground: Cute Pets
description: Hamster Playground's new Cute Pets DLC introduces farm-themed content, including new home decorations, animal costumes, unique quests, and jobs for hamsters. The pack allows players to explore a farm-inspired setting and dress up their hamsters as various adorable animals.

title: Grumpy Gaffer
description: Join Mr. Gaffer on his mission to protect the peace of his home in this dynamic strategy game. Test your wits and reflexes as you face intense waves of enemies, and compete in thrilling mini-games against other players.

title: Perlin Festival
description: Perlin Festival is an experimental fever-dream inspired by many of the surreal classics, with an emphasis on random events and interactions with the denizens within The Noise. You'll join the newest denizen, Pluto, uncovering only what you need to.

title: World of Warcraft: The War Within - Ghosts of K’aresh
description:
In The Ghosts of K’aresh, the campaign continues as more pieces to a troubling puzzle fall into place. Players immerse themselves in The War Within story as it leads up to the next chapter of the Worldsoul Saga—Midnight.

There’s some unfinished business to be had on K’aresh and the specter of an old enemy looms large. Forces with ill-intent are determined to bring forth Dimensius, the All-Devouring once more to finish off the ethereals. Should he arise, Azeroth will also be in peril from this dangerous Void Lord.

title: Teknokrat
description:
In the futuristic techno-metropolis of Nu-Vika, you are but a number in the system.

You have been branded as unemployed, and rely on the state to survive. Until you are assigned a temporary position at a cyborg repair workshop, giving you a shot at gaining freedom.

But when strange glitches start happening to your eye implants, you find yourself thrust into a plan far beyond your comprehension, tying your fate to one of three patients in your care.

TEKNOKRAT is a gay, y2k-fuelled sci-fi thriller/romance about the danger of enforced stagnation in the face of unstoppable change.

Explore a city where might makes right, and technology is absolute. Choose a partner in crime, and face the consequences of your actions with them.

title: Dave Gnukem
description: Parody of Duke nukem 1

title: Blind Trust: The City
description: Blind Trust: The City is a co-op game for 2 to 5 players, where only one player can see while the others are completely “blind.” The seeing player must guide their teammates verbally through traps and obstacles. Each round demands precise communication and high trust, as any mistake restarts the team. The game is fun, intense, and relies more on teamwork and communication than visual skill.

title: Farm Vet
description:
You're in charge of dozens of barnyard critters. Diagnose and treat their ailments using more than 30 realistic vet tools. It's your job to take care of and nurture all the animals!

Ride around the farm while treating 60 medical problems. Play 5 different minigames on your way to becoming the Head Vet.

Treat, feed and pamper horses, calves, bunnies, ducks, sheep, chickens and more!

With 3 levels of difficulty, Farm Vet is perfect for animal lovers and budding vets of all ages!

title: Sylox
description: Sylox is a short, minimalist base-building game with a touch of worker placement and strategic expansion. Assign limited workers to key tasks, unlock new buildings, and defend your growing base against increasing enemy attacks.

description: Take the throttle of a notable, and memorable, Alco second-generation diesel – with Diesel Workshop’s striking Century 424 for Train Simulator Classic!

description: The SW1 for Train Simulator Classic is a superb re-creation of the 600-horsepower Electro-Motive diesel, with carefully crafted details, authentic cab and controls, and realistic sounds. The SW1 is provided in both “running” and “cold and dark” versions.

title: Train Simulator Classic: Linz - Passau Route Add-On
description: Embark on more services throughout Austria, through towns, countryside, and right to the German border with another expansive stretch from RSSLO for Train Simulator Classic!

title: Train Simulator Classic: Boston & Albany - Boston - Springfield Route Add-On
description: The Boston & Albany and New York Central stood among America's greatest and most remarkable of railroads, and now the experience of the B&A can be yours - with the superlative and bustling Boston & Albany: Boston - Springfield Route for Train Simulator Classic!

title: Train Simulator Classic: Rio Grande Southern - Placerville - Rico & Telluride Route Add-On
description: Experience the extraordinary - and the magic of legendary Colorado narrow-gauge railroading - with the Rio Grande Southern: Placerville - Rico & Telluride route for Train Simulator Classic!

title: Raven II

title: Session: Skate Sim Waterpark & Chris Cole
description: Explore a brand-new map with the latest spots and missions. Your new playground is an old abandoned water park.

title: Resonating Cords
description: Whose will is God's will? Follow the chosen saint in his journey through the Communion, the mysterious process of God's replacement.

title: Hemomancer
description: Hemomancer is a story set in a surreal world. It's also a roguelite game with RPG, visual novel and musical/rhythm elements. Gameplay and narrative is designed to challenge you, so prepare to struggle.

title: True Tree
description: a turn-based RPG where four children try to protect their neighborhood’s last tree from being cut down. instead of just protesting in the real world, they dive into a surreal fantasy where city developers become monsters, bureaucracy turns into magic, and childhood memories become the battlefield.

title: Abyss Rebel
description: ABYSS REBEL is a Turn-Based Tactical RPG combining grid strategy, intense combat, and loot progression. Set sail for a frozen archipelago at the universe’s edge, lead a four-member squad on a skiff, equipping skills, relics, tackling bosses and summoning mechs to shatter encroaching darkness!

title: Disney Dreamlight Valley: Arcade Edition
description: Experience this life-sim and adventure game rich with quests, exploration, and engaging activities featuring Disney and Pixar friends. This apple arcade edition requires a subscription to play. It includes The Storybook Vale and A Rift in Time Expansion Passes.

title: Ghost Castle: Gengar's Love Quest
description: Ghost Castle: Gengar's Love Quest is a BL visual novel with three separate routes, over 50 unique CGs, and a fully functioning sprite and CG gallery. Explore the castle through the eyes of Gengar, a charming ghost who is eager to learn all about the residents (especially the cute ones!).

title: Argonauts Agency: Missing Daughter - Collector's Edition
Argonauts Agency: Pandora's Box - Collector's Edition
Around the World 2 with the Johnson Family
description: Explore with the Johnsons. Play ten casual mini-games in different places around the world.

title: Hero in an All-forgiving Fantasy World RPG
description: Players will take on the role of a brave hero, embarking on a journey to defeat the Demon Lord, fighting thrilling battles alongside three companions! No matter what you do, you'll be met with warmth and acceptance—so immerse yourself in this hero-friendly fantasy world to your heart's content!

title: Pc Building Empire
description: Build your own computer store and turn it into an empire in PC Building Empire. Hire employees, assemble PCs, manage sales and ensure the success of your business. Grow your company, expand your operations and conquer an empire of PC gamers.

title: Ghostmoons: Arcade
description: Ghostmoons - Arcade, is a vehicle based first person shooter, focusing on rapid movements or strafing, to avoid projectiles and attacks. Your goal is to remove the unknown military's portals from the moons of the Ghostmoons system, while avoiding collateral damage of the native life forms.

title: Maru Expedition: We Can Fly
description: Catch falling allies and dominate the battlefield! Control your flying platform to catch characters and auto-attack enemies. Build your team, link skills, and shape your own strategy in this evolving arcade action game.

title: Godproof
description: GODPROOF is a story-rich tactical RPG laden with thought-provoking dark fantasy content. Play as Raiden, a gifted young warrior who has immunity to the direct supernatural interaction and influence of godly entities. Recruit companions, overcome chaos, and discover the sinister truth.

title: Kind () Station
description: Lost in the colossal labyrinth of Kind () Station, the protagonist uses scattered wayfinding signs to reach the transfer to the Rinkama Line. Decode the increasingly bizarre signage as you progress, and unravel the mysteries of Kind () Station.

title: Zompell
description:
Zompell is a fast-paced single-player FPS zombie game featuring a story-driven campaign and an intense survival mode. Use advanced spell-tech and tactical weapons to fight the undead across diverse maps and scenarios.
In Campaign Mode, you follow a gripping storyline as a soldier tasked with investigating and containing a zombie outbreak. Travel through a variety of environments—including military bases, rural village maps, and abandoned facilities—as you uncover the truth behind the infection. Encounter mission briefings, in-game dialogues, and scripted events that bring the story to life.

In Survival Mode, the mission is simple: stay alive. Select from multiple unique maps, each with its own layout and hazards. Customize your experience with a wide range of gameplay settings—choose the types of zombies you'll face, enable options like infinite health or ammo, and select your starting weapons. Defend your zone using modern firearms and experimental spell-tech. Equip one spell from each category—Fire, Cold, Blood, and Shadow—and upgrade them by earning spell points from kills. A tactical drone assists you with targeting and support, adding a strategic edge to the chaos.

With two distinct modes, deep customization, upgrade systems, and fast-paced zombie combat, Zompell offers an exciting and replayable FPS experience for players who enjoy action and survival challenges.

title: The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom Online
Super Mario Odyssey: A Galaxy Story

title: Dead Exhale
description: Make a sound on your mic, and something will hear you. This isn’t your typical monster. He won’t just hunt you, he’ll toy with you. And as you get better, he adapts, evolving to match your skill in this tentacle-infested nightmare.

title: My Femboy Roommate: Special Weekend
description: You take your roommate turned boyfriend, Robin, to a fancy resort for your one year anniversary. Explore and enjoy everything the high-end resort has to offer while bonding and getting closer to Robin. Will you make the most of this special weekend?

title: Paper Mario: The Thousand-Year Door Encore
Intravenous Collection
description:
Experience the full saga with the Intravenous Collection.

Immerse yourself in the tactical gameplay of Intravenous 2, now including the Intravenous: Remastered DLC - a modernized version of the original game with improved visuals and mechanics.

title: Monster Tutor
description: In "Monster Tutor" you step into the shoes of a professor unexpectedly sent to teach at Netherworld Academy, a school for monster girls. Right from the start, your job is anything but normal. On day one, you meet Azazel, a troublemaker demon; Phanta, a shy ghost; and Josa, a vampire who's not too thrilled about having a human teacher. The game kicks off with you trying to make the best of this weird situation, figuring out how to connect with your students and manage their unique personalities. Do you have what it takes to tutor these girls and form a connection with them, despite being the only human in the Netherworld?

description: Recount for the errors

title: Ward 777
description: A psychological horror game where you solve puzzles, explore a haunted hospital, and uncover terrifying secrets to escape.

title: The Day in a Life of a Dayfly
description: A melancholic journey through the cemetery... and far beyond its gates.

title: Dream Tower
description: This is a hyper-casual idle game for office workers, where players collect maritime materials and treasure chests for lucky draws. Focused on material collection, it's simple and perfect for relaxing at work.

title: The DeadLine
description: The DeadLine is an online third-person asymmetric horror game. Become the killer and hunt down survivors without mercy, or become a survivor and escape from the killer's pursuit. Hunt or escape — which fate awaits you?

title: Patch Me if You Can
description: Patch me if you can is a puzzle adventure where you dive into a game world and manipulate objects however you want. Equip blocks to shrink boulders, move the sun, and thwart Lord's conspiracy. This broken world needs your 'patch'!

title: Clowncore
description: Your sister went missing in the woods. It's been years, but you never stopped searching. The only lead is the mysterious carnival she kept talking about.

title: Pact Between Us
description: "Pact between us" is a FMV. After the loss parents, you and your younger sister become siblings who only have each other. You must tenderly care for her daily life.What kind of woman will your sister grow into? Every arrangement you implement during her upbringing carries profound weight.

title: Your Magic Hook
description: A light rogue-like casual game. Players fight enemies, mine for “minerals,” and gain upgrades to improve their stats. Between rounds, buy items to boost your character. Also includes an idle desktop pet mode—every keyboard or mouse input feeds your mushroom and helps it grow!

title: Hidden Heir
description: Wield the power of magic and steel in a dark medieval world. Explore an open world, craft unique armor, fight enemies, and forge your destiny. A story-rich action-RPG with immersive realism.

title: Hedgehog and Cat: Explore the World Action
description: hedgehog and cat set out to explore the world together...! One day the cat suddenly disappeared...

title: Bold Ideas
description: Bold Ideas!Bold Ideas!Bold Ideas!

title: Stellar Witch
description: "Stellar Witch" is a grid-dodge action game with inventory management. Become a star-powered witch on a journey to become the Grand Mage. Collect gold in battle, buy and place constellations, and use their powers and synergies to fight ever-stronger enemies.

title: Deckstination
description: Deckstination is a real-time combat and deck-building hybrid. In this action roguelike, players use customized skill decks to overcome enemies in battles. Combine randomly drawn skills to survive intense encounters and take control of the battlefield with your own actions and strategy.

title: Confidentiality Agreement
description: Become a counselor in Confidentiality Agreement and engage in conversations with your clients. Listen to their thoughts, observe their expressions, and choose your words carefully. A few words from you could save a client's life... or destroy it.

title: Beat the Odds
description: You just joined Melody School, but like in most schools, bullies are everywhere. Luckily, you can fight back with music! Match the falling arrows with your arrow keys to stand your ground, defeat bullies, and make it to the next class.

title: Tank 2025
description: Enemy tanks are on the attack. Defend your base, destroy them all, and advance to the next level! TANK 2025 is a classic 2D arcade-style top-down tank shooter with pixel art graphics.

title: Articrow
description: Articrow is a 2D top-down action roguelike. Play as a magical crow exploring dungeons, collecting and upgrading artifacts with unique parts. Equip these powerful artifacts and defeat challenging enemies to escape.

title: Darkness Takeover
description: Darkness Takeover is a short psychological horror game that places you in the mind of Karim a man trapped inside a haunted maze, pursued by an unrelenting force known as The Stalker Master.

title: Moondrills
description: Gather up to six friends for a merciless battle over resources on a asteroid! Drill pixel by pixel to gather materials, power up your gear, and meet your extraction quota — or unleash mysterious artifacts to wipe out the competition!

title: Fold & Fly
description: Fold & Fly is a relaxing yet fast-paced flying game where you guide a paper plane through whimsical worlds. Collect stars to raise your score, catch origami dragonflies to open portals, explore infinite, procedurally generated dreamscapes and use seeds to create new maps and save your favorites.

title: Kawaii Girls Panic
description: Classic arcade gameplay remastered! Conquer the bigger portion of the screen and save the panic girls from the various absurd troublemakers.

title: Stay&stack: Hotel Operation
description: Build your dream hotel empire in a dynamic city. Design rooms, hire staff, react to events, and compete for guests from VIPs to backpackers. The city never sleeps—and neither should your strategy.

title: Sabotrix
description: Sabotrix – A New Kind of Trolling Game! Use cunning strategy, precise control, and a variety of skill combinations to sabotage your enemies' operations and bring down those who seek to corrupt the Matrix World!

title: I Am A Stick
description: Advance, fall, suffer, repeat. You're a stick with something to prove.

title: Straftat: Supporter Edition
description:
This DLC unlocks :
13 exclusive suits
17 exclusive hats

title: Kioku: Last Summer
description: Kioku: Last Summer is a cozy, story-driven adventure where you play as Asti, a young girl spending her first summer on the mysterious island of Kioku. Set in a hand-crafted world blending Scandinavian and Japanese influences, players explore, build friendships, play minigames, uncover secrets, and relive the magic of early 2000s childhood summers.

title: Four Divine Abidings: Supporter
description: This DLC provides a way to support the game development. It includes additional 7 Seedlings as a token of appreciation. Seedlings can be planted to slightly boost all Divine Abidings, Encounter rewards and visual look.

title: Death Trash: Perished City
description: Perished City is a major update for Death Trash (version 0.14) that expands the main campaign with new locations, quests, characters, enemies, and items. The update introduces a story centered around a mysterious woman who transforms into a revered figure within a decaying city. It also includes UI improvements, bug fixes, co-op sync updates, and performance optimizations.

title: MineMogul
description: Design and build a factory deep underground in this physics-based automation sandbox. Mine resources, buy machines and master the chaos as you become the ultimate Mine Mogul!

title: Tartarus Engine
description: A group of plucky technicians exploit an ancient machine's seemingly untapped vulnerability.

title: EoW: Willer's Dominion
description: Willer's Dominion is a TPS rogue-lite action game where you unlock and upgrade weapons, master new skills, shape your build through powerful perks, and face the growing risk of corrupted items as you grow stronger with each run. Reclaim your will before the Eye’s curse consumes what’s left of you.

title: Touch Grass
description: Touch Grass is a brutal first-person parkour platformer set in a surreal, beautiful simulation created by Nova Ascension. Dash, double jump, and wall run through 13 unforgiving levels. No checkpoints. Just movement, madness, and the desperate need to escape.

title: Hunter's Moon: A Sovereign Syndicate Adventure
description: A Victorian Steampunk Roguelike Deckbuilder. Choose from four characters with unique cards and abilities. Customize your deck and character as you investigate a mysterious plague. Battle corrupted beasts and bosses in turn-based combat to unlock powerful relics and enchanted tarot cards.

title: Bound City
description: An action-packed and bittersweet adventure in a city of endless night. Explore the dying city and try to find your way to the tower that seems to be at the heart of it all. Nothing is quite as it appears to be, and only by facing death can you hope to understand the mysteries of Bound City.

title: The Lord of the Rings: Return to Moria - Durin's Folk Expansion
description:
Your story doesn’t end here, oh no…

The Dimrill Gate is open but what’s next for you, Dwarf? As Lord of Moria, it is now your responsibility to bring Khazad-dûm back to its former glory and repopulate it. That means only one thing - Durin’s folk are coming back to Moria!

In this expansion, NPCs join you and your Company to establish trade and help you rebuild Moria, while you embark on Expeditions to uncover even greater treasures and long-buried secrets…

title: The Freak Circus
description:
The Circus of Horrors has arrived in town.

Uncover its secrets and face the terror it hides, all while being led by Pierrot, the silent yandere, or Harlequin, his seductive rival.

Don’t be fooled by their smiles, they’re not what they seem.

You work at a café, and one day, on your way to work, fate leads you to cross paths with Pierrot. That’s when his obsession begins. But he’s not alone, his stage rival decides to join the game, turning this twisted dance into a dangerous competition… all for you.

title: The Witcher: Enhanced Edition – Platinum Edition
description:
The Witcher: Enhanced Edition – Platinum Edition is an upgraded physical release of The Witcher: Enhanced Edition, distributed on 2 DVDs and fully patched to version 1.5. What sets this edition apart is its wealth of bonus content and additional scenarios, making it the most complete version of the game available.

In addition to the two official adventures from the Enhanced Edition (The Price of Neutrality and Side Effects), this release includes five fan-made scenarios: Blight of Bogs, Deceits, Wraiths of the Quiet Hamlet, The Wedding, and Merry Witchmas. These extra modules, available in English and Polish (subtitles only), add several hours of new gameplay.

The Platinum Edition removes all DRM, allowing the game and the D’jinni Adventure Editor to run without the disc. It also includes voiceovers and subtitles in nine languages, with the option to mix audio and subtitle languages independently.

A second DVD contains rich bonus content: a 204-page artbook in PDF format, multiple official game guides and manuals in several languages, exclusive artwork and wallpapers, character avatars, walkthroughs for the fan-made adventures, and four music collections including the full official soundtrack. It also includes fun extras like a behind-the-scenes video and April Fools bonus material.

This edition is ideal for collectors and fans seeking the most extensive and DRM-free version of the original Witcher experience.

title: Sekai de Ichiban Kanashii Egao
description: The protagonist, Gaku Serizawa, is a pachinko addict who goes to a pachinko parlor every day. One day, he happens to stop by a park on his way home from pachinko and meets a mysterious girl who wants sweets. His world starts to change little by little as he comes to know her.

title: Ship Graveyard Simulator 2: Fishing Boats DLC
description: Step aboard four distinctive fishing vessels: Arc, Sea Hunter, Mono-brew, and Richi-Kali. Each boat offers its own structure, secrets, and opportunities to be discovered.

title: The Red House on the third hill of Mataperros
description:
A Stop Motion fable about finding an old online friend.
A game about communities and their absence.

title: Dark Sea
description: When the research team from the classified Soviet organization known as O.D.I.S.E.A. went radio silent during an expedition deep beneath the Earth, you - a simple mechanic - were called upon to pilot an old prototype submarine and search for any trace of what happened and where they might have gone.

title: Grosseries
description: A late-night snack turns into a nightmare. GROSSERIES is an online co-op survival horror game set in a weird grocery. Investigate with up to 8 friends to explore, survive, and defend yourself from monstrosities guarding this deformed dimension. Will you let hunger consume you before the monsters do?

title: Project 7: Escape Room
description: An escape room inspired adventure. Play as an investigator exploring the mysterious disappearance of a physicist involved in a secretive experiment known as Project 7. Explore the mansion, observe carefully, and use your puzzle-solving skills to uncover the truth behind Dr. Hillman's vanishing.

title: Avernum 4: Greed and Glory
description: The cult-classic saga is back! Battle for fame, power, and wealth in the subterranean nation of Avernum. Conquer an enormous underworld in this epic turn-based fantasy RPG. Features huge, clever dungeons, varied and cunning foes, 100s of artifacts to find or craft, and a really cool story.

title: Underdark
description: You woke up after the accident, and now you're looking for help and a way out of this dark land. Surrounded by darkness, traps, and... those creatures... you come across him...

title: The Guardians
description: The Guardians is a decision based RPG with flight simulator and first person shooter mechanics. Every decision you make has consequences, your actions will shape the outcome.

title: Zoo Football League
description: A fully custom mod of 32 ZFL teams for Legend Bowl!

title: Beat Saber: Britney Spears - "Till the World Ends"
description: Get the track ‘Till the World Ends’ by Britney Spears on Beat Saber now. This track is part of Britney Spears Music Pack.

title: Corporate Fury
description: Corporate Fury is a needlessly violent and profane fighter with RPG elements (story, open-world exploration, upgrades, items), midgets, and shitting dogs. It was originally released in 2010, running at a solid 30 frames per second on first-generation iOS devices.

title: The Goofy Giraffe Game
description: The Goofy Giraffe Game is a 3D platformer in which you play Softy, a giraffe locked in a child's bedroom ruled by the terrifying Cube Rouge King. Find your spots and jump higher and higher, breaking your neck to escape from this room !

title: The Last Ski Trip
description: The main character, travels to a remote snowy valley with his brother for a skiing trip. But soon after their arrival, strange events begin to unfold. What was meant to be a peaceful getaway quickly turns into a nightmare. Over time, he realizes that something terrible is live in the valley...

title: Twisted Gallery
description: You're trapped in an endlessly looping art gallery — familiar, yet uncanny. If you can notice the changes, maybe you can find your way out.

title: Ice Cream Typer
description: A fast-paced typing arcade game where each round gives you less time to type bizarre phrases. Test your speed, accuracy, and endurance in an endless challenge that gets harder every step

title: Fishing Friends 3D
description: Bait your hooks and go fishing with friends. Customise your fishing rods for optimal performance to catch giant and legendary fish. Chat in-game with fellow anglers and win competitions and tournaments together. Tight lines!

title: Cageling
description: Here, you are just a 'player' trapped in the game world. Faced with various challenges from 'developers', do you want to be willing to be a bird in a cage or choose to break the rules and escape from this game world.

title: Bob's Crystals
description: Tile-based chaos meets crystal-powered mystery in this action-puzzle platformer adventure. Restore the shield. Save the world.

title: Moebious: Endless Dream
description: You wake up in a strange room. You must find a way out. Solve puzzles, uncover clues, and escape. The truth awaits you. In the end, where will your final choice lead you?

title: Pyrite Tycoon
description: In Pyrite Tycoon, watch Pyrite the Goldfish go to work for you, mining minerals and selling them. Want to earn faster? Add more Pyrites and her friends to crank up the chaos. Still not rich enough? Catch creatures and take their valuable treasure for yourself. You monster!

title: Cartoon Survivor
description: Survive the wildest adventure of your life in Cartoon Survivor! Run, jump, and glide through a vibrant prehistoric world filled with dangerous creatures and crazy obstacles. Can you outlast the chaos and save the show? It’s time to prove you’ve got what it takes!

title: Paper Cut
description: Grief and guilt consume Adam. As his mind unravels, a kind presence offers comfort, but something feels wrong.

title: Investormania
description: GET ALL COUNTRIES! Compete with your FRIENDS. Get Countries, build buildings, hotels on a colorful and live map. Establish your political party and strive to come to power. Be the POLITICAL PARTY that wins with the right policies. INVESTORMANIA, Construction, Politics and more...

title: Xiao Jun
description: A dark, emotional RPG set in modern China. Follow Xiao Jun, a rural boy caught in a brutal journey from schoolyard bullying to street violence, love, betrayal, and revenge. A raw story of survival in an unforgiving world.

title: Barn Quest
description: Barn Quest – Merge, restore & wrangle horses (oh and one extremely bossy cat) in this cozy farm adventure!

title: The Mines
description: Trapped underground after a routine exploration gone wrong, you find yourself sprinting through claustrophobic tunnels. Hot on your heels is an immense, grotesque spider—its scuttling echoes drown out your own panicked breaths. With each step, the shadowy walls seem to close.

title: The Girl in the Clouds
description: This is a casual puzzle game, where the position of each game image is random and can be repeated.At first, it may be very chaotic,Then gradually place the image in the corresponding position,The image gradually becomes complete,Come and give it a try!

title: Stranded With Darkness
description: From an Indie developer in Sweden we bring you Stranded With Darkness. A base building tower-defense like game, with up to 4 player online CO-OP. Stranded on a desert like planet, gather resources during the day, defend the SOS transmitter during the night. Survive as many days as possible.

title: Thunderman: Adventures in Another Realm
description: Thunderman: Adventures in Another Realm is an exhilarating 2D action-platformer where you embark on an epic journey alongside Kaelan, a young archer chosen as the defender of the universe. To restore peace, you must face dangerous enemies, gather resources to survive.

title: Snapshot Spirit Live!
description: Play as jetpack-flying photographer Katie as she hunts ghosts in this educational photography game with minimalist 1-bit-inspired graphics and a Game Boy-inspired soundtrack.

title: Death Trial
description: This is a casual game with platform jumping!

title: Friday Night Knockout
description: A casual arcade stick fighter, great as an introductory title to the genre made for quick 1v1 games.

title: DTC
description: DTC (Defend The Cubes) is a tower defense game where you deploy units to stop enemies before they destroy the cube. Strategize, fight off waves, and keep the cube safe!

title: Moonsouls: The Lost Sanctum - Collector's Edition
Bee Careful!
description: A defiant Bee puzzle where you will have to control different groups of bees by remote control to collect pollen, avoid obstacles and be able to take them to the honeycomb.

title: Mystery Tales: Dealer's Choices - Collector's Edition
Endless Fables: Shadow Within - Collector's Edition
The Backrooms: Expedition
description: Explore the world of backrooms from this solo developed game. explore creepy and eerie levels, and also calm and liminal levels, but be careful, you're not the only one there.

title: Sanitism
description: Sanitism: A rare mental illness with an unknown origin that causes its victims to lose their rationality and empathy, leading to uncontrollable, violent behavior. The disease induces a state of severe aggression, prompting individuals to attack anyone in their vicinity.

title: Bouncing Missile
description: “Bouncing Missile” is a 2D strategic shooting game.

title: Edge of Reality: Great Deeds Collector's Edition
Dicey Decisions
description: Dicey Decisions is a multiplayer, strategy based board game where you compete against another person through cards, dice, and collecting runes and points. The game ends at round 6, and the person who gets the most wins! But watch out for your exhaustion levels!

title: Rat Race Combat: Zombie Tribute
description: Rat Race Combat: Zombie Tribute 🧟 A zombie survival mode where you fight through endless waves of the undead, earn credits to upgrade weapons, unlock new areas, grab power-ups, and discover hidden bonuses. Every run is a fresh grind through chaos.

title: Hidden Expedition: Neptune's Gift - Collector's Edition
Id & I
description: id & i is a psychological horror visual novel that takes place in the Ad Nauseam (a VN also developed by throwpup) universe. However, it is a standalone experience that does not require you to have played Ad Nauseam first, nor will it spoil anything from the series.

title: My Pet Flesh Monster
description: The cosmic horrors are at your doorstep! Will you adopt an adorable little creature for yourself? Pick the cutest monster out of 4 horrifying creatures, take care for your Pet Flesh Monster, feed them, take them to competitions and teach them new tricks! Watch out, don't neglect your cosmic pet...

title: Carnage Cliff
description: In this battle game you won't shoot a single bullet. Your job will be to heal your teammates and upgrade them so that together you reach the end of a level and rescue a captured general.A great game to spend a couple of minutes on every day.

title: Ants: Leaf-al Warfare
description: Ants: Leaf-Al Warfare is a 2D turn based strategy game where you must command your army of Ants, headed by a Queen, against up to three other foes, being wary of the various environmental hazards. Putting your tactical prowess to good use is the key to victory. War has never been so Leaf-al.

title: Jojon Wik
description: He just wanted his cat back now everyone's getting punched. Play as Jojon Wik, a legendary brawler on a rampage after a corrupt official’s spoiled son steals his beloved cat. In this hilarious fighting game, battle through enemies, flashy combos, and over-the-top action. Justice is coming.

title: Giantess Girls! Job Jigsaw Jamboree
description: Giant Fun, Towering Challenges: Piece Together Epic Proportions!

title: Jumping Jump Ninja
description: JUMPING JUMP NINJA is a super-high difficulty action game in which you jump over every obstacle with ninja leaps and wall kicks! Adjust your strength and position to climb up buildings and cliffs! However, a vigorous climb means a quick fall...

title: Bounce Quest
description: Bounce Quest is a brutally challenging platformer where you explore a treacherous mountain to uncover what lies at the top. But climb carefully, one wrong jump may send you bouncing all the way down.

title: The Temple: Ch 1
description: Between Dimensions Stands A Haunted Cathedral, Night‑Vision Flickers, Ghosts Lurk & A Monster Awaits Beyond The Portal To Shatter Your Sanity.

title: Survive the Descent
description: A very casual approach to the survivor-like genre. Trudge through the onslaught of foes with your own customized builds of automatically firing weapons, self-activated abilities, and scaling up with powerful synergies, all the while garnering lost souls to empower yourself for the next run.

title: Polytopia
description: Survive, craft, and thrive in Polytopia, an open-world sandbox adventure where exploration and resourcefulness are the keys to survival.

title: Trapped at Home
description: Trapped At Home is a horror game focused on hiding and avoiding a serial killer who has broken into your house and is looking for his next victim.

title: Red Core Division
description: Red Core Division is a co-op survival horror game for 1–4 players. Enter a classified containment facility, where something has gone horribly wrong. Your mission: find evidence of paranormal activity, complete high-risk objectives, and escape alive. But, something is down there—something that hunts.

title: Realm Runner
description: Realm Runner is a 3D fast paced action platformer starring Astro Eskii Dawdle, a competitor in the multiversal game show titled the Microcosm Marathon. Run through beautiful and branching levels as you take full advantage of Astro's speed and squid-like powers!

title: Zone-0
description: Zone-0 is a psychological horror experience built using one of our free game frameworks, offering a chilling glimpse into what you can create with it.

title: Dinoslap
description: Slap your way to victory over your friends in this multiplayer brawler. Use items strategically to edge out the competition. Customize your dinosaur and accessorize your victory in style.

title: Hotdog Hustler
description: Fry meat, stack buns, and serve sketchy customers fast.  Set prices, upsell extras, or pocket shady bribes. ️ Handle weirdos who want ketchup… or chaos.  A gritty, lo-fi PS2-style hotdog sim with janky charm.

title: The Memological Dungeon
description: The Memological Dungeon is a voxel-based 3D adventure. Forget about robes and swords — shoot magic at monsters with your bare hands (well, almost)! A fun journey filled with traps, meme treasures, and quirky enemies

title: Ferb
description: Descend into darkness in FERB, a horror adventure where you explore a foreboding cave, uncover secrets, and face a half-robotic beast that thrives on fear. Solve puzzles, survive five intense chapters, and outsmart FERB in solo or co-op play. Will you uncover the truth—or be hunted?

title: Cat's Showdown
description: A casual card battle game where mischievous cat brothers fight using poker-based rules. Designed for quick and fun singleplayer matches.

title: Fukiage
description: Based on real-life haunted tunnels, this is a first-person horror game. Can you escape the tunnel filled with fear and tension and make it back home safely?

title: Mushroom Survivors
description: Mushroom Survivors is a roguelike survivor game where you must endure endless waves of deadly mushroom monsters! Harness magical powers, fight automatically, upgrade your abilities, and rescue fellow survivors in a cursed world overrun by fungal creatures.

title: GladiArena
description: It's very inadequate. Please take care of it.

title: Hundred Doors
description: A psychological horror experience where reality twists behind every corner. Explore disturbing rooms, uncover buried memories, and descend into madness. Can you make it through all one hundred doors?

title: Sketchy Driver
description: An arcade, roguelike endless racer where you dodge traffic, jump ramps, perform tricks, earn points, and level up to make the run more entertaining, aiming for the best score. No story. No brakes. No problem.

title: Deepest Well
description: Deepest Well is a game where you fight off waves of enemies in a descending well with destructible terrain. Get upgrades after each wave and make insane builds to break the game!

title: Odyssey RPG
description: A JRPG where you play as Ulysses. After the victory in Troy, you must face the arduous journey home. This will make your commute sound like child's play

title: Vexcell
description: Vexcell is an elegant, minimalist puzzle game. Embrace the satisfaction of everything falling into place.

title: Rogue Paper Scissors
description: What if Rock-Paper-Scissors became a roguelite extraction deckbuilder? You'll build a deck of deadly choices, master bizarre traits, and craft powerful hybrid cards. Extract your loot, or risk everything for the next floor. Sometimes, the best strategy is knowing when to run.

title: Hear The Bell Toll
description: A roguelike city-building game focused on short satisfying runs. Buy unique buildings from a shop, place them strategically and manage class synergies and statuses carefully to meet the tribute requirements and survive for 25 years!

title: Korean Drone Flying Tour Sang-jog-am
description: This game is a drone simulation game that allows you to experience real drone flight based on footage shot by a real flying drone. There is no up, down, left or right direction control, only the control to increase or decrease the drone speed.

title: Animal Strikers
description: Customize your animal. Use wild powers. Score big in fast-paced 1v1 soccer!

title: AirJet Fighter: Sky Assault
description: Airborne chaos at your fingertips.

title: Gravity Force
description: Gravity Force puts you into the seat of a drone pilot. Steer your spaceship through narrow caves (2.5D) to fulfill your job: locate and retrieve cargo crates without wrecking the ship. The minimalistic controls and realistic physics are easy to learn, but hard to master.

title: The Way Down
description: Absurdist Interactive fiction. Talk to the beings that inhabitant the world at its end. We forgot how to die.

title: Calice
description: Calice is a card strategy deck building game. It's a game in which Alice who falls into a strange country escapes from a strange country with the help of various people. It is a game that uses various cards to defeat enemies and experience various events in the process of escaping.

title: Wizard Fight!
description: Wizard Fight is a bullet hell game where you play as the blue wizard and battle various types of monsters. Enjoy dodging curtains of bullets with a retro aesthetic. Collect keys to venture deeper into the dungeon to claim the holy grail and secure epic victory!

title: Schizophrenia: R.E.M. Protocol
description: Schizophrenia is a game where you have to not go crazy and get out of the bunker. Use all the items you can find to survive. Remember. The main thing is not to go crazy. And further. Don't make loud noises. They can hear you.

title: Dungeon Run
description: Race through 100 floors of massive dungeons, collect all the keys, and compete for glory!

title: Rotten Crop
description: Rotten Crop is an atmospheric horror game based on the lost game "That Evil Farming Game". Can you hide what you've done from your neighbors and the police? More importantly... can you live with it?

title: 3D Puzzle Dark Fantasy
description: Collect a 3D puzzle, transferring things to the right places to create a beautiful place.

title: Epicross
description: EPICROSS is a relaxing, colorful 2D picross puzzle game where players use numerical clues to fill in grids and reveal vibrant images. Solve increasingly challenging puzzles in a calm, no-time-pressure environment—perfect for puzzle lovers of all ages.

title: 3D Puzzle: Winter Outpost
description: Collect a 3D puzzle, transferring things to the right places to create a beautiful place.

title: 3D Puzzle: Steampunk City
description: Collect a 3D puzzle, transferring things to the right places to create a beautiful place.

description: Collect a 3D puzzle, transferring things to the right places to create a beautiful place.

title: 3D Puzzle: Mountain Life
description: Collect a 3D puzzle, transferring things to the right places to create a beautiful place.

title: 3D Puzzle: Leafless
description: Collect a 3D puzzle, transferring things to the right places to create a beautiful house.

title: 3D Puzzle: Gas Station
description: Collect a 3D puzzle, transferring things to the right places to create a beautiful place.

808 is a surreal and introspective first-person narrative experience about memories and feelings that we avoid. Memories define us—but what happens when they’re taken away? This is a game about love, loss, acceptance. A game about being a human.

title: 7 Keys Saga
description: 7 Keys Saga is a top-down 2D action RPG where you embark on a quest to find seven mystical keys scattered across a dangerous world.

title: 7821 Akuji
description: 7821 Akuji is a first person liminal horror experience. Pilot a tiny, jury-rigged submersible to rescue a lost science crew.

title: 9 Souls
description: An atmospheric horror trip between reality and madness. Three paths—only one without anomalies. Observe carefully, choose wisely, save lost souls.

title: Puzzle Temptation: Anime Reveal
description: A relaxing puzzle game where you reveal beautiful anime artwork by clearing away colored tiles. No timers, no pressure, just aim, click, and enjoy the view.

title: A.A.U. Black Site
description: The consequence of a mission gone wrong leaves you trapped in an endless cycle of nihilistic, man-made hell on earth, with your only option for survival being to trust a stranger’s voice that guides you through the darkest depths of the forgotten, shut-down Yugoslav town of Uzovnica.

title: Across the Obelisk: Bernard, the Alchemist
description: Bernard, the Alchemist is a Hero Pack that introduces the scout-healer multiclass to Across the Obelisk. Devise new party compositions and create advanced strategies thanks to Bernards unique class. Bernard is joined by a new pet, Inky, his faithful octopus friend.

title: Across the Obelisk: Shores of Sahti
description: Set sail for the Sahti Islands in this all-new pirate-themed adventure. Powerful factions are vying for dominance in this once-peaceful archipelago. Will you defend the indigenous people, exploit their natural resources or battle to emerge as king of the pirates? The choice is yours!

title: Across the Obelisk: Sigrun, the Valkyrie
description: Sigrun, the Valkyrie is a Hero Pack that brings the mage-scout multiclass to Across the Obelisk for the first time. Develop new strategies using Sigruns unique capabilities and reveal the secrets of her forgotten past. Sigrun is accompanied by a new pet, Jelly, the jellyfish.

title: Across the Obelisk: Tulah, the Spider Queen
description: Deep in the shadows, Tulah, the Spider Queen has been waiting. This brand-new hero brings a new deck-building strategy with her ability to summon spiderlings — tiny allies that weave their way into your hand, reshaping combat in new and unexpected ways.

title: Adventures in Calculon
description: Gather and choose adventurers by using your math skills to grow your army in this auto-battler to defeat all enemies through the world of Calculon.

title: Adventure Realm
description:
Adventure Realm is a JRPG Dungeon crawler! Follow the lives of Lusio and his friends as they are mysteriously transported to another Realm!

There, they must explore their new surroundings and travel to new dungeons to use the power of the gemstones to get back home!

But the journey won't be easy, as many challenges await our young heroes!

title: Adventurer Shop Simulator
description: Dive into a medieval fantasy world as a shopkeeper providing tools for brave adventurers embarking on their quests. Buy and sell weapons, upgrade and customize your shop, optimize your space, unlock new gear, and more. After all, behind every hero stands a master shopkeeper.

title: Aetherial
description: Exiled and disgraced, you lead a forgotten clan through the frozen wilds to reclaim your family’s honor. Build your warband, forge uneasy alliances, and shape your legacy in this grounded Viking survival adventure.

title: Aether Effect
description: Dig, Build, Explore! In this sandbox survival game, venture through a vast procedurally-generated infinite world. Mine resources, construct your homestead, craft and drive vehicles, delve into mining, cultivate, livestock, automated machinery, and uncover the truth behind the world.

title: A Father's Tale
description: After the tragic loss of his son, a father gets stuck inside a magic drawing book that contains magic places and dangerous creatures. Experience this journey through grief and restore the joy and color of this kingdom by solving puzzles and defeating evil monsters.

title: Affiliated Homies
description: Affiliated Homies is a casual high-stakes multiplayer game where trust is a luxury you can't afford. Set in chaotic environments, players are thrusted into a deadly game of cat and mouse, where the line between friend and foe is blurred!

title: Dentist Hour: Escape Room
description: Afraid of the dentist? You should be...Welcome to Dentist Hour, the escape room where your worst nightmares take shape. Enter a peculiar dental clinic where each room hides secrets, riddles... and horrors. Do you dare to sit in the chair?

title: Agent Forest
description: Agent Forest is a TDS shooter with a top view, you have to shoot back from many enemies and complete the task! Destroy competitors, find credits and most importantly you need to stay safe. Also, in addition to people, there are infected insects that are also hunting you!

title: Agent Sirius
description: Join Beni Akesuzu, the high school detective president and secret agent, in this thrilling mystery RPG! Investigate mysterious incidents, solve puzzles,and uncover a sinister plot as monsters lurk in the shadows in a race to save the school and it's students before it’s too late!

title: Agents of Shadow
description: Agents of Shadow is a horror RPG crawler set in the Folded World, a reality overlaid on ours, explaining paranormal phenomena. A hybrid of survival horror and dungeon crawler, it draws from urban legends. Features roguelike elements and a strong j-RPG foundation.

title: Sea of Secrets
description: Your family has been poor for generations, and now you have grown into manhood with one goal: free them from poverty and struggle. A loot-based RPG with over 150 items to use and equip, over 20 skills to use and many quests to complete.

title: Sasayu Meshiki
description: It's an action game in which the jellyfish in the aquarium comfort her as she sorrows and eases her heart. -> Carefully designed graphics and gentle sound. -> New voice cast added! -> Easy to use with just a mouse. Enjoy this miniature antique story!

title: Mask Fighting:Otherworldly Awakening
description: In this immersive 3D fighting game, embody Jack – a timid youth thrust into a realm where masked power reigns supreme. Master fluid combos and leverage environmental tactics to defeat foes, seize their masks, and gain new abilities. But true power lies not in masks... but in the awakening within.

title: Reyher Austerich’s Garden Worlds Adventure
description: Become the Dragon Girl of the Austerich Empire Assist neighboring nations in eliminating the pesky goblin menace! A lighthearted casual video game experience,Designed for Giantess Enthusiasts. Freely indulge in cathartic destruction across miniature worlds!

title: Reborn: Examine Again
description: "Reborn: Examine Again" is a Roguelike game that mainly offers the experience of deck building. What you need to do is to select the appropriate cards to add to your deck and then wait for the wonderful chemical reactions they produce.

title: Journey to the West: Unparalleled
description: Journey to the West: Unparalleled "is an adventure RPG based on the theme of Journey to the West. It tells the story of seven demon kings causing chaos, and Wukong adventuring to defeat them and protect Dongsheng Shenzhou.

title: Command-Ω Omega
description: Protect your six towers against relentless waves of enemies in Command-Ω Omega, a rogue-like shooter tower defense game with a synthwave 80’s aesthetic and modern graphics. Level up, collect upgrades, and enhance your arsenal as you battle to survive and dominate the neon battlefield.

title: Manic you and depressed me
description: “Which one is the real me…?” When "Utsumi" meets "Utsumi"—two sides of the same girl begin to blend,shaping what may become... a "wonderful girl." A romantic, yandere, horror visual novel adventurethat dives deep into the boundaries of love, guilt, and identity.

title: Leap Tactics
description: "Leap Tactics" is a pixel-art platform puzzle game where players alter mechanism states through jumping actions. Overcome obstacles and chart paths to the goal. Featuring 10+ jump-activated mechanisms, 100+ levels, a gentle difficulty curve, and an undo function.

title: WEGO World War II: Stalingrad
description: WEGO World War II: Stalingrad is a hex-based wargame depicting the German offensive to seize Stalingrad in 1942. With historical scenarios and dynamic campaigns, players command forces in one of WWII’s most pivotal battles.

title: Kaguya
description: High-School Heroines Take to the Skies!A fully-voiced bullet hell shoot-'em-up that's friendly to newcomers!Wipe out the AI robot army and save the day!

title: LexiLoong
description: Are you ready to memorize English words in a fun way?

title: Challenging Land
description: A Idle-based simulation game. Place objects in unique rooms to collect and process them! Make full use of the functions to meet the demands of the land and move on!

title: Polar Shift
description: Polar Shift is a puzzle-based escape room game where you must break out of an alien prison after an unexpected crash landing, all while you decode a foreign language, evade capture, and make bad decisions.

title: Chaos Rush: Tower Defense
description: A tower defense game that follows the story of Kalidos, a mercenary nation during the sixth period of chaos.

title: Billy's Tower
description: A platformer about climbing as high as you can. Also, you might encounter enemies along the way.

title: Big Burger Tower
description: How high can you stack ingredients to build the tallest burger before it all comes crashing down?! Test your skills in this fun game! Join the ranking challenge and compete to see who can build the biggest burger!

title: A Game About Building A Tower
description: Brick by brick build a tower that reaches Heaven. Be beware of natural disasters, collect feathers and various brick styles! Play through Story or build anything you want in Creative mode. Or become the fastest to reach the Heavens and get to the top of Leaderboard!

title: Fling your Friends TD
description: Gather your friends, unleash your creativity, and dive into the silly world of Fling your Friends TD. It's more than just a game; it's a laughter-filled adventure where strategy meets fun!

title: Fairy Tale Tower Defense
description: Fairy Tale Tower Defense is a 3D cartoon style tower defense game

title: Dunthera
description: Towers have always defended you… Now it’s your turn to keep them standing. Battle unique monsters across diverse maps, each with distinct abilities, looks, and stats. Upgrade your hero and fortify structures to hold the line!

title: Doomsday Tower Defense
description: Challenging tower defense game with 20 levels. Can be completed under 2-3 hours. Kill zombies in a doomsday vibe. Discover your own strategy to beat the horde. No fluff, no story, no BS.

title: Dead Soul Tower Defense: Shadow Labyrinth
description: This is a pixel-style classic tower defense game. You need to summon souls to fend off enemy attacks, and each type of soul has its unique skill tree. You can also build your own maze in the game to prevent enemy invasions.

title: Cyber Tower 2048
description: Cyber Tower 2048 is an action tower defense game where players fight insectoids by building defenses and developing tactics.

title: Cube Guardian: Tower Defender
description: Cube Guardian: Tower Defender is a rogue-like tower defense game on a procedurally generated, cube-based battlefield. Protect the Nexus by strategically placing resource buildings as enemy waves intensify every 10 seconds. Earn XP to unlock upgrades and beat your high score!

title: Idle Towers
description: An idle survival game with tower defense mechanics. Build your own perfect defese and face infinite waves of enemies!

title: Infinity Tower
description: Climb a deadly tower as fast as you can in this intense platformer. Timer is ticking — dodge obstacles and collect nuts on your way to the top!

title: Lichgate: Tower Survivor
description: Burn through the underworld legion in this auto-battler tower defense. Choose from over 100 items to craft your tower into the ultimate weapon of destruction!

title: Light Towers
description: A Tower Defense Action game, set in a bright geometric world. Combine shooting skills with strategic thinking to fight off waves of enemies, and defend your base.

title: Machine Tower 2984
description: 《Machine Tower 2984》 is a top-down mechanical fantasy style Roguelike game. You will embark on an adventure in a tower filled with mechanical mechanisms, challenging the five robots that control the machine tower and searching for the huge secrets behind the entire tower.

title: Frantic Birdies
description: Frantic bird management survival game. Collect worms, collect twigs, create a nest with twigs, lay eggs and hatch new birds and feed them until they are fully grown. title: A Haunting Novel: Surfaced Secrets - Collector's Edition
description: Can you unearth sunken secrets and save your son in time?

title: Immortal Love: Bitter Awakening - Collector's Edition
description: The Bear and Owl clans have despised each other for centuries, and their hatred has come to a head in the face of love. Do you have what it takes to break a curse that separates you from your beloved and save your people in time? The collector's edition of this hidden object game has a bonus gameplay chapter, ingame guide and other goodies.

title: The Secret Order: Return to the Buried Kingdom - Collector's Edition
description: The Mother Dragon has passed on, leaving the kingdom vulnerable. Strange anomalies are appearing across the land, indicating that an ancient evil is trying to return! The collector's edition contains a bonus gameplay chapter, ingame strategy guide and other goodies.

title: New York Mysteries: The Outbreak - Collector's Edition
description: Laura and her trusty workmate Will are investigating the complex case of a bizarre disease that’s plaguing the city. They discover that it might have something to do with a mysterious artifact preserved in the archives of a secret order. There is a shadow hanging over New York City and time is running out. The collector's edition includes a bonus gameplay chapter, ingame strategy guide and other goodies.

title: Paranormal Files: Chaos Weekend - Collector's Edition
description: Escape the wrath of this otherworldly monster and find safety in the confines of this secluded winter resort. Join the team for their greatest challenge yet in this hidden-object puzzle adventure. This collector's edition includes a bonus gameplay chapter, ingame strategy guide and other goodies.

title: Foodie's Furniture
description: A mod introducing only the highest quality placeable foods and food accessories!

title: Delicious: Emily's Road Trip - Collector's Edition
description: Try to master the challenges of being a chef, wife, mother and vlogging celebrity. Use your time management skills while cooking all the delicious dishes and serving your customers their food in time. This collector's edition contains 30 bonus challenge levels.

title: Pax Autocratica
description: Build a grand totalitarian colony and personally storm roguelite battlefields with your soldiers. Shape citizens fears, loyalties, bonds, and feuds. Capture enemies, convert them into true believers. Sacrifice the weak. Feed the strong. Wield absolute power and make every life bend to your will.

title: Asterix & Obelix: Mission Babylon
description: Dive into an epic and brand-new adventure with Asterix & Obelix! Experience a story full of humour, epic battles and unforgettable encounters in a thrilling platform game!

title: Detective: Scene Crime
description: Step into the role of a detective in DETECTIVE Scene Crime, a challenging mystery game where you’ll investigate five gripping crime scenes. Each level presents clues, testimonies, and puzzles to analyze carefully in your quest for the truth. Do you have what it takes to solve them all?

title: Soba's Gunpaw
description: Soba’s Gunpaw is a Short Incremental - Bullet Heaven game. Destroy everything, collect resources, then choose upgrades from a massive skill tree!

title: Cozy Desktop Konbini
description: Run your own Konbini in this Cozy and Relaxing Idle Game that stays at the bottom of your screen, accompanied by soothing lofi musics. Sort your selling products on the shelves. Decorate your Konbini, unlock new products and decorations—all while you work or relax.

title: Villa No. 1
description: "Villa No. 1": A suspenseful puzzle game set in a mysterious villa. A grad takes a high-paying job there, uncovering hidden secrets of the enigmatic family and discovering the house's dark past. His soul is tested as he uncovers the truth.

title: Millennium Strategy
description: Millennium Strategy is a real-time deck-building game with Roguelike, journeying through ancient wilderness, tribal invasions to noble wars.Finally, you can also directly create MODs and write code within the game to create your own cards.

title: Strategic Bastion
description: A Challenging Single-Player Strategy Game This is a turn-based strategy simulation game with considerable difficulty, perfect for players seeking a real challenge! This game is a passion project inspired by a certain classic strategy game I loved as a child, reimagined with my own creative twists.

title: Typomagical
description: Type and cast your own spells! Typomagical is a spell-casting roguelike with a twist: create and cast spells by typing incantations! Spells and the elements are at your fingertips, literally -- creative synergies are the key to victory!

title: ShaQu
description: This is a vampire survivor game, players get experience points by killing monsters, and then upgrade spells or props, there are a variety of spells and props for players to upgrade, players can choose spells or Props, how to clear the level, survive for 10 minutes and then defeat the final boss.

title: Kunkun Dream Startles the Soul-Kunkunzi
description: Lovely kunkunzi, don't be afraid of difficulties, face your fears bravely! Come on!

title: Kunkun Dream Startles the Soul-Ghost Animal Cosplay
description: KunKun's Dream of Horror-KunKun Cospaly

title: Dark Resolve
description: Immerse yourself in a chilling nightmare where the darkest corners of the past come to life to haunt you. This is a tense first-person psychological horror game that transports you to the heart of an abandoned police station. .

title: Harvest Island: Ending Expansion
description: The conclusion of Harvest Island. With 4 new added endings to late game, you'll be able to experience Will's Ending, Samantha's Ending, Greyson's Ending, and the Mother's Ending. New character portraits, illustrations, trophies/achievements, and music to tell the final story.

title: Get in Timelessness
description: A psychological horror about a man who, by the will of fate — or a joke of chance — had to face the unthinkable. Sometimes a person looks into the abyss. Sometimes the abyss looks at you. And sometimes... She turns out to be Hungry.

title: Floatineer
description: The game is set in a world where lands have vanished beneath the waves. Players experience life as floating engineers, using modular architectural blocks to rebuild shelters that can withstand various disasters and fulfill villagers' aesthetic requirements within a given time limit.

title: Mathletics
description: Relive a better math class with Mathletics. A fast-paced math game about collecting values to stay within whatever range you set. Add, subtract, and strategize your way through handmade math-based puzzles in the campaign, or brave different 'Events' and 'Powerups' as long as you can in 'Endless'!

title: Super Mario Bros. Remastered
description: Super Mario Bros. Remastered is an unofficial PC remake of the 1985 NES classic. It features enhanced graphics, widescreen support, smoother gameplay, custom resource packs, a level editor, and bonus content like The Lost Levels.

title: The Aquarium Does Not Dance: Special Edition
description: Navigate your way through an aquarium overrun by gruesome creatures known as creepies and unravel its hidden mysteries. With each riddle you solve, you’ll find yourself one step closer to uncovering the chilling truth of Bianca Aquarium. Your choices affect the outcome of the game, so choose wisely.

title: Hope: Unlived Life
description: How to get out of a dull life? How to overcome your fear and become happy? HOPE: Unlived Life is a story about growing up, finding yourself and lost love in the scenery of Russian reality.

title: Hope: Winter Tale
description: Every New Year is similar to the previous one. No friends, no family, no magic. But what if a fairy tale exists? And everything can change? HOPE: Winter Tale is a story about a man who has lost his all taste for life. But one winter night, everything changed.

title: Godbreakers
description: Absorb enemy powers and turn them against their masters in this frenetic, up to 4 player co-op hack’n’slash. Cancel actions for total control, chain devastating abilities, and take down brutal bosses across eclectic biomes. Sharpen your build with every thrilling run.

title: My Recycling Center: Resources Trading Expansion
description: Convert trash into valuable resources by using the new recycling machines. Store away the finished pallets with the forklift and sell them at the commodities exchange when prices are up.

title: My Recycling Center: Car Scrapyard Expansion
description: Join the scrapping business and part-out the cars environmentally friendly. Use the hydraulic hoist to lift the car. Take out the battery, catalytic converter, rims and tires. Then use the material handler excavator and throw the body into the crusher.

title: Under the Red Sky
description: Under The Red Sky is a 3D parkour game where speed is king! Your goal is to get to the end of each level as quick as possible by taking one of the many different routes possible, or by finding your own. Watch out though, this isn't all fun and games. You may accidentally fall into the past and uncover dark secrets, slowly deciphering the hidden propaganda behind it all and how to get back above. As you look up, you may find that you're Under the Red Sky.

title: BBA Ghost Story: Ward Edition
description: A 2D adventure horror game where you are chased by an old lady. You get lost in a hospital. Can you escape without being caught by the old lady?

title: Feudal Craft
description: Immerse yourself in an exciting medieval settlement simulator where you will have to fight for your place in the feudal hierarchy. Use a smart strategy to develop your settlement. After all, it is the skills and equipment of each peasant that can make the difference.

title: Dewazma
description: Dewazma is a psychological horror experience that draws from generational trauma, spiritual mystery, and the darkness we carry within. Step into Rameen's world, where silence speaks, time loops, and the truth waits in the shadows. Face what was lost. Or be consumed by it.

title: Tuggowar: Arsenal Management
description: Expansion pack #8 highlights the most important part of Tuggowar – managing your arsenal, also known as your deck.

title: Noor
description: Uncover a world where memories are magic and forgetting is a threat! Noor is a top-down action-adventure game inspired by ancient Arabic mythology.

title: PanzenTD
description: A charming tower defense game where heroic panda warriors defend their homeland against waves of destructive robots. Build towers, deploy unique heroes, and outsmart your enemies across stylized jungle battlefields.

title: Who's Beast
description:
Step into a medieval village where betrayal hides behind every smile…

This online multiplayer game pits up to 12 players against each other in a battle of trust, strategy, and survival. Among the noble knights, impostors lurk—able to shapeshift into terrifying creatures like the Banshee, Basilisk, or Werewolf to hunt their prey under the cover of darkness.

Each match unfolds in real time, driven by a dynamic day/night cycle. Work together to complete quests, gather clues, and find scattered weapons—but be careful who you trust. Not everyone has noble intentions.

title: Scale Bullet: After Story
description: A Roguelite action shooter where you dodge bullets, attack enemies, and power up with skills and items. While the map stays the same, different skill combos and item drops change your strategy each time. Keep challenging and master your own style!

title: Gachamon
description: Gachamon is a cozy idle clicker where gacha meets multitasking. Collect creatures, earn coins, and climb the ranks — all from the bottom of your screen!

title: NY Times
description:
A unique online PC game in the RolePlay (Role-Playing Game) genre, with an interesting open world, plenty of game entertainment, and a rich culture of the Big Apple.

In this game, you create your own character, who will later exist with other players in virtual New York. You can choose any role in this world: either you're a peaceful worker or a criminal mastermind, or vice versa - it's up to you. Be whoever you want to be!

title: Ballrun
description: Be a marble in this multiplayer racing game with snappy and satisfying physics! Use wild powers to bounce and roll your way through fun tracks filled with obstacles, shortcuts, and unpredictable rivals.

title: Swordflight
description: A chance meeting in a tavern may provide more than you bargained for, leading to a dangerous journey through desert and dungeon. This module provides a combination of challenging combat, numerous opportunities for the use of non-combat skills, and frequent occasions for role-playing and character interaction

title: Hellbound, Inc.
description: HELLBOUND INC is a hellish 2D platformer where you jump & carry packages to deliver against time, demons and HR. Play as an undead courier trapped in a fulfillment center recently purchased by Satan himself.

title: Future? No Thanks!
description: Future? No Thanks! is a narrative-driven, open-world adventure set in an ecosocialist utopia. You're old, bitter, and scheduled for euthanasia. Enjoy your last day in a future that works for everyone but you.

title: Mandragora: Whispers of the Witch Tree - Update 1.6
Lethalmon
description:
Lethalmon is a roguelike Pokémon fangame inspired by Lethal Company. Each playthrough is designed to feel unique, ensuring a fresh experience every time.

Explore planets to catch Pokémon and collect valuable items. Earn money by selling your catches at The Ship, the game’s central hub.

Fight your way to freedom by defeating the Gym Leaders!

title: Necrodungeon
description: Fight the undead scorge. Upgrade your powers. Retrieve holy relics. Free the world. NECRODUNGEON is a procedural retro first-person dungeon crawler where you can combine countless powers to raise against the forces of evil.

title: Yggdrasil Defenders
description: Yggdrasil Defenders is a solo roguelite game, based on Norse mythology, where you need to use your abilities and make choices to defend the realms of Yggdrasil.

title: Celeste Fusion Collab
description: The Celeste Fusion Collaboration is a community mod for Celeste featuring various difficulty levels for new and experienced players alike, with over a hundred unique levels to play with a unique gimmick: Fusion! Maps will come in trios- complete 2 base maps, and unlock a third map- the fusion of the two!

title: Case Blind: Stolen Route
description: A horror game about escaping from a mysterious place after a chilling encounter in the woods. Explore, stay quiet, and make tough choices as you search for a way out.

title: Battle Line the Rise of War
description: Dive into Battle Line: The Rise of War, an exhilarating third-person shooter (TPS) that throws you into the heart of fast-paced, action

title: Hallucinations
description: The protagonist of the game is suspected of suffering from hallucinations. Players need to find different places in the room. Can the protagonist survive the eighth day while being examined?

title: Mine Click
description: MINE CLICK Mine, upgrade, dominate - every click counts! Dive into a fast-paced 3D clicker game set in a wild, post-apocalyptic swamp. Mine valuable resources, upgrade your power, and battle enemies in intense click duels to steal their loot. Can you survive the swamp - one click at a time?

title: Number Merge Mania
description: Slide number blocks to fill the grid! In Number Merge Mania, each block has limited moves. Plan carefully, fill every tile, and solve challenging puzzles. A clean, clever brain game that rewards logic and strategy!

title: Capitalist Misadventures
description: Get ready for a bizarre capitalist challenge in this labor exploitation simulator, where your goal is to turn your tiny shack into a mega-corporation with megalomaniac capital. Hire beggars, stray kittens, and even TikTokers—and monetize their services!

title: My Rusty Submarine: New Waters
description: Grab a friend for a deep sea dive. Repair your submarine and try to get as far as possible with this old and rusty, but charming submarine!

title: Wega & The Lost Media
description:
Wega And The Lost Media is an in development shitpost 2D Platformer that follows the iconic Luigi and Mario recolors Wega and Urio, and their quest to stop the evil Maltigi from making their world LOST MEDIA!
