The game will contain 8 worlds of content, 4 weapons for you to break out of bounds with, a soundtrack that's probably better than this game deserves, and shoe bench.

title: Donki Hills
description: Ordinary guy James searches for missing Maria, his online match. His only clue: a photo from the mysterious Russian village of Donki Hills. Embark on a dangerous journey to unravel her disappearance and uncover a truth that could change everything.

title: Crypto Mining
description: “Crypto Mining” is a simulation game in which you have to create your own “Crypto-Imperia”, earn all the money in the world, or, fail.

title: Anomaly 13
description: Anomaly 13 is a psychological horror walking simulator with puzzle elements. As Cooper Evans, a house buyer, you’ll explore a mysterious home to uncover its secrets. The game features four distinct locations that you’ll traverse to progress through the storyline.

title: Imperfect Garden
description: Imperfect Garden is an action-packed boss rush with two levels, each culminating in a unique boss that tests your reflexes. You control a one-armed youth in a desolate world, fighting powerful Perpetuos—proving that determination can triumph over adversity.

title: I Scream Ice Cream
description: I Scream Ice Cream is a physics-based action game where players control an Ice Cream Soul through 30 levels using voice commands. Players navigate obstacles by literally shouting "Ice Cream" into their microphone, creating a unique voice-controlled gameplay experience that combines precision movement with audio input.

title: Nia: Jewel Hunter
description: Immerse yourself in an atmospheric world where a young girl named Nia is transported to an ancient realm. Solve puzzles, avoid dangers, collect artifacts, and activate portals to bring Nia back to the modern world. The challenges and mysteries of ancient civilizations await you!

title: USB-bot
description: Embark on an electrifying 2D platform puzzle adventure in USB-BOT, where a small, disconnected USB sets out on a quest to reunite with the device it was once a part of.

title: Crystal in Carnations
description: Two women bound by fate rise as Vivestria falls. Gather your allies and shape their journey through dual battle systems, life-altering choices, and multiple endings. In this story-rich tactical RPG, every decision leaves a scar. Will you save a dying kingdom, or forge one worth saving?

title: Soukh
description: Discover Soukh - a Middle Eastern-inspired fantasy shopkeeping and strategy game. Run a chaotic bazaar with demanding customers, dispatch caravans and conquer challenges to gather exotic loot. Guide an exiled merchant’s rise. Will the sands lift him to glory… or bury him in stories left untold?

title: The Squirrel & Sea
description: An underwater journey to the squirrel's past memories

title: Los Angeles 1985
description: “Los Angeles 1985” is a yuri romance kinetic novel bathed in neon heat. Two intimate tales follow four women as they navigate desire, heartbreak, and passion under the electric skies of LA. Love burns brightest after dark.

title: QBob: Remastered
description: Help QBob leap from rock to rock as he surveys an array of strangely shaped asteroids, all while avoiding a host of bizarre and deadly alien creatures in this modernized take on an arcade-inspired classic.

title: Magic Weapon
description: "Explore the ever-changing secrets! Collect rare materials, refine the strongest magic weapon and medicine, find and practice ancient secrets, and fight against the invincible enemy guarding the sky!" ​

title: Fruit Hoop 2
description: Oh no! Fruit is falling from the sky!!! Catch the fruit in your hoop!!

title: Slide Hexagon
description: This is a simple puzzle game. Click and slide the hexagon to solve it.

title: Tiny Dream Home
description: 🛋️ Ready to unbox, unwind, and create your dream rooms? Start decorating today.

title: Yuri Blossom!
description: What was projected to be a happy school life with cute schoolgirls became overshadowed by a conspiracy in the school...

title: Zenvader
description: Zenvader is a super retro shooter mixed with roguelite elements. Dodge the barrage of bullets, improve your unit, and try to defeat the Alien King!

title: Bloom for Me
description: 'Bloom for me' is about two young girls and their struggles to cope with the world around them.

title: The Hollow Lighthouse
description: The Hollow Lighthouse is a first-person survival horror experience set on a mysterious, fog-covered island in the Black Sea. Fix the broken lighthouse, uncover disturbing secrets, and survive what roams in the dark. You were sent to repair the light. But something is watching you.

title: Wise in the Heights
description: Climb a treacherous mountain one charged jump at a time while answering quick-fire trivia. Every correct choice creates a safe landing, every mistake is a fall. Reflex platforming meets brain-teasing quiz in this single-player challenge.

title: Panin
description: "Panin" is a single-player puzzle game where you control two characters simultaneously with a single key. They must each clear their own unique map.Can they reach the flags and meet their shared destiny?It's up to you to guide them to the goal!"

title: WASD: The Adventure of Tori
description: WASD: The Adventure of Tori is an online co-op game for 2 ~ 4 players. Each player can only use own key — W, A, S, or D. Even a small mistake can make the team fail, so talk with your teammates and work together! You need 2 ~ 4 players to play WASD: The Adventure of Tori.

title: Pixel Rampage
description: "Pixel Rampage" is an open-world game with day-night cycles. Fight monster hordes with precise shooting, dodging, and upgrades. Use 7-day login rewards to boost gear fast, enjoying intense combat and progression.

title: Super Mario Bros. X by 5438A38A
description: The remake of the SMBX Mario fan game made in China!

title: Victim 10 PM
description: Calling the emergency room on the 13th day of every month is no longer a good choice. The 911 emergency system has been hacked and turned into a human resource for a satanic doctor. Satan demands sacrifices and Dr. W, the devil's slave, ruthlessly offers innocent people as a gift to him.

title: The Third
description: Two have been reborn. One remains in the shadows. Explore a cursed temple, uncover ancient secrets, and survive a gripping and terrifying journey through forgotten gods and darkness.

title: Captain Toad: Prism Star Quest
description: Captain Toad: Prism Star Quest is a new fanmade adventure starring Captain Toad, carrying over the gameplay mechanics of Super Mario 3D World's Captain Toad levels and Captain Toad: Treasure Tracker into a completely 2D setting, with new gimmicks, levels and bosses to boot!

title: Slime Sexy Party
description: This is an adventure game set in a fantasy world without the concept of time, telling the story of a player rescuing his wife from the hands of monsters. In the game, players will embark on a thrilling adventure by operating their brainpower, intelligence and other aspects.

title: Marathon Recompiled
description: Marathon Recompiled is an unofficial PC port of the Xbox 360 version of Sonic the Hedgehog (2006) created through the process of static recompilation. The port offers Windows, Linux, and macOS support.

title: Money Laundering Simulator
description:
It's easy - just take a cash delivery. Find a problem you need to solve. Clean the money. Send it back to your customers. Repeat.

Don't be afraid to get your hands dirty - it's part of your business. You are a cash cleaner. So do your job. And do it well, or face the consequences.

To achieve results, you need tools and equipment, so buy everything you need and turn your lab into a dream place.

title: M.A.L.M.O: Scorched Earth
description: M.A.L.M.O: Scorched Earth is an open world, fast paced, first-person shooter. The Goal: Get rid of the Parasitic Zombie Population in the entirety of SOUTHERN SWEDEN!, and loot the city from up to down, and go FAST with the Source Engine Inspired Bunnyhopping System.

title: It's Breaking Out
description: Get ready to unravel the secrets of an ancient, mysterious box in this card-based roguelike game that is inspired by the work of H. P. Lovecraft. Collect unique decks as you dive deep into the cosmic horror, with each roll of the dice bringing you closer to the truth and madness.

title: DinoGore
description: Grand-Theft-DINO! Experience a caveman sim that takes place in a brutal PREHISTORIC OPEN WORLD, where DEATH and DINOSAURS roam! Ride around on DINOSAURS in search of WOMEN and MEAT! Become what the mighty TREX fears and rise to the challenge!

title: Generic Fighter Maybe
description: Generic Fighter Maybe is a traditional-style, 4-button, side-view fighting game for 2 players. Featuring all the classic fundamental fighting game mechanics, complete with big combos, multiple defensive mechanics, and meter management.

title: Find Sort Match
description: Develop your mental skills and have fun.

title: Little Helper Cafe
description: A hedgehog, sugar, and lots of logic on the table!

title: Mergery
description: Mergery is a puzzle game where each move combines images into higher-ranked visuals. Start with the basics and merge your way toward rare and powerful artwork. Every decision matters as you manage space, plan your moves, and push for the perfect merge.

title: Rogue Raccoon
description: Play as a fast and cheeky raccoon on a clear mission: clean out the food court, one hidden snack at a time. Jump, wall-jump, dash in eight directions, and use your trusty boomerang to defeat enemies, trigger secret mechanisms, and make your way through wild traps and dangerous exhibits.

title: Steampunch: Lost Tombs
description: Steam-powered adventure in forgotten ruins

title: Elite Sports Gaming Football
description: ESG Football 27 is bigger, faster, and more connected than ever. Build your player, compete with friends, and experience football your way with brand-new 11v11 Rec Mode, cross-play between PlayStation and Xbox, improved matchmaking and connectivity, tutorials to learn the fundamentals, nostalgia-inspired mini-games, and a deeper player progression system with grindable badges and boosts to increase your character's attributes. Whether you’re playing Head-to-Head, teaming up in 11v11, or grinding to build your player, ESG Football 27 brings the ultimate football experience to life.

title: Korean Drone Flying Tour Odong-do Dragon Cave
description: This game is a drone simulation game that allows you to experience real drone flight based on footage shot by a real flying drone. There is no up, down, left or right direction control, only the control to increase or decrease the drone speed.

title: Ouroboros Saiaku.exe: Crazy for you
description: To escape from the world of gal game, you must be in a relationship with your childhood friend and best friend, Mayumu.

title: Dragged Deep
description: Explore a hidden sewer beneath the forest in this tense survival horror game. Play solo or with friends, solve puzzles, stay quiet, and escape a maze of shifting tunnels while a deadly predator hunts you by sound. One wrong move—and you're not getting out.

title: Kitty's Adventure for XBox One
description: Kitty’s Adventure is a game developed in remembrance of Kitty. Kitty is lost in the maze and only you can help her escape! Guide Kitty to the exit of each maze. Every level is a uniquely generated maze configuration. As you complete the levels with Kitty, the maze complexity increases.

title: Seasons of Solitude
description: You are exiled. Seasons of Solitude is a turn-based strategy and resource management game where every move shapes a fragile landscape. Seasons shift, the land reacts to your choices, and balance is your way home in a hand-painted world inspired by Estonian myth.

title: Last Nova
description: Last Nova is a ruthless extraction-based PvPvE action game. 10–20 players dive into resource-depleted, hazardous zones where only melee, cold weapons are allowed. Fight, strategize, and survive. Only those who reach the final extraction point with what they’ve claimed make it out alive.

title: Silicone Heart
description: Survive on a junkyard planet filled with broken robots, machinery, and resources in this adventure sandbox game. Recycle resources, repair robots, invent items, create new plant species, grow them, and uncover the mysteries of this planet.

title: Rhythm of Annihilation
description: Rhythm of Annihilation is a rhythm-based third-person shooter. Sync to the beat and battle through a world on the brink of annihilation!

title: Astroburrow
description: Astroburrow is a thrilling space adventure combining exploration, strategy and arcade action! As a mousey space cadet, explore beautifully pixelated galaxies to build new civilizations and fight for your species' survival.

title: One Rotten Oath
description: One Rotten Oath is a story-driven FMV+FPS hybrid with horror elements. Created by the director of A Trip to Yugoslavia.

title: Cinema Theater Tycoon
description: Tycoon game where you manage your movie theater through more than 100 years of history. Build and customize your cinematic empire without being overtaken by the evolution of the 7th art.

title: Destiny Code
description: A card battle RPG woven with bishojo! In a clash over the relics of a lost civilization, what choices will they make? A dramatic chronicle where strategy and decisions shape fate.

title: Loner_Dog://Snuff Puppy Carnage Society
description: Argo works gas station night shifts. Maya humps a corpse. Haley is too high to care, she thinks. Roaches just vomited up blood. Can life just slow down? No? Okay, fuck me then. LONER_DOG is the sensation of stumbling your way through your local queer scene when you can't say "no" to people. LONER_DOG is grotesque. LONER_DOG is for those in hiding. LONER_DOG is an account of life. LONER_DOG is any of us and none of us. Forty-six thousand words. For accessibility, the dithering can be disabled in the options menu.

title: Hitotsubashi Animal Chronicles
description: "Hitotsubashi Animal Chronicles" is an adventure game where you lead an expedition to explore the mysterious Beast Island and discover a wide variety of animals. Enjoy the casual animal trivia shared by the expedition members and the story filled with conspiracies they get caught up in.

title: Ells Tales: Chairbound
description: You wake up tied to an office chair in the middle of an empty room. A mysterious device with a 10-minute timer is attached to you. Explore the office floors, try not to tip over, and find a way to escape!

title: Rudolph the Red-Nosed Reindeer
description: Dash into the enchanting world of Rudolph the Red-Nosed Reindeer and embark on a holly jolly quest to save Christmas in this magical adventure inspired by the beloved 1964 animated classic!

title: Soccer Superstar
description:
Play the brand new football game Soccer Super Star and enjoy real run-time and kick physics for an immersive and legendary football experience!

Love action arcade soccer but lack the time to practice? The new Soccer Super Star’s very easy to learn game controls allows you to jump-start the fun. Just flick your finger across the screen to kick the ball and score a goal!

title: Shutter Story
description: Your friend is convinced his house is haunted. Examine his family's photo album to reveal signs of the paranormal, as the horror unfolds in the house around you. Their fate is in your hands.

title: Sunset Beach
description: A short, atmospheric horror experience set on a beach. You needed some quick cash and took a job helping organize the local beach festival, but something feels off.

title: QuickMaze
description: A simple game of maze, the goal of which is to get the ball to the endpoint. As the player progresses the difficutly increases.

title: Left 4 Dead 2: Nightmare
description: Horror Themed Mod collection for Left 4 Dead 2 based on the first game and Cry of Fear

title: Travel Cuisine 3: The Sea of Flavours - Collector's Edition
description: Travel cuisine 3 is an interesting strategy about an experienced couple of restaurateurs rescuing a tourist liner from trouble.

title: Travel Cuisine 2: Sweet Life
description: Travel Cuisine 2 is an interesting strategy about an experienced couple of restaurateurs exploring the pastry shops of the world.

title: Elven Rivers VI: Guardians of Hope - Collector's Edition
description: A tense time management game set in the epic battle between elves and orcs.

title: Dead by Daylight: The Walking Dead
description: Dead by Daylight's The Walking Dead includes 2 new Survivors, Rick Grimes and Michonne. Purchasing this add-on unlocks an exclusive Sheriff's Hat badge and Tank in Ruins banner.

title: Dead by Daylight: The Walking Dead - Daryl Dixon
description: This is a cosmetic outfit for Rick Grimes available in the in-game store. Daryl Dixon is a totally new character minus the unique Perks. Designed after Norman Reedus’ likeness and featuring original voice lines from Reedus himself, this Outfit will allow you to don the wing-backed vest and channel your innermost bike-riding outdoorsman. Theres only one catch: the Entity’s Realm is a crossbow-free zone.

title: JumpStart Phonics
description:
JumpStart Learning Games Phonics is an educational game released by Knowledge Adventure in 1999, based on the JumpStart Kindergarten: Why Did the Bus Stop? video. Players explore three main locations - the Barn, Fire House, and Train Station - collecting clues to solve the mystery of why a bus stopped.

The game's core mechanics involve completing activities at each location, gathering clues that appear in the Look and Listen window, collecting objects from different areas, and deducing the bus stop reason from four randomized clues. Upon successfully solving the mystery, players earn a certificate and can print game characters and objects. Each game features multiple possible explanations for the bus stop, with clues randomized at the start, ensuring a unique experience each time.

title: Band Together
description: Band Together is a retro 2D action platformer game with cute pixel art graphics and challenging gameplay. Search for your fellow bandmates as you traverse a deserted island! Find and utilize the power of magical musical instruments to make your way past rough terrain and dangerous creatures.

title: Travel Cuisine 2: Sweet Life - Collector's Edition
Pimp Up Dungeon
description: Pack the Treasure and Master the Challenge!

title: Ants Empire Colony
description: Think like an ant. Rebuild what was lost and protect what remains.

title: Galaxy Roll
description: Roll through the stars. React, survive, repeat.

title: Sense: The Game
description: "Sense The Game" is a unique philosophical game inspired by the myth of Sisyphus, where you are tasked not just with pushing a boulder, but also with seeking answers to life's most profound questions.

title: Amalie
description: Amalie is a short and surreal RPG Maker game. It follows the story of a girl and an angel who attempts to convince her to commit suicide.

title: Manga Ninja
description: Manga Ninja is a unique platformer where you can’t jump directly. Instead, use ninja skills—throw shurikens to create mid-air grapple points and swing with your hook. Explore a stylish comic world full of thrilling challenges and Japanese-inspired stages.

title: Ceiling Mounted Sprinkler
description: This mod adds a ceiling mounted water sprinkler that is meant to match futuristic style builds. It covers 8-10 blocks and constantly waters.

title: Draconis Race
description: Adds a race of half dragons.

title: Perash
description:
"PERASH" is a PUZZLE game that uses a panel that moves while rotating.

If you move the panel while rotating it and connect all the same colors, it will be clear.

Transparent panels that do not need to connect colors, fixed panels that cannot be moved, conveyor that slides sideways when the panel is placed on top will appear.

title: Tiny Tengu Tactics
description:
Pick a commander and form your own mercenary troop of ferociously small tengu warriors to save villages from rampaging monsters for gold and glory!
In Tiny Tengu Tactics you explore a fantasy vision of Japan brought to life at a tiny scale through traditional toys, mythical creatures, and the power of cardboard!?
Strategically pick your unit types and formations to free monsters from their curses, see villages grow over time, and compete to amass the greatest treasure hoard ever seen!

title: Novaxandria Volume 01
description:
This game is a combination of a visual novel and a 2D turn-based strategy game. It marks the first volume in the Novaxandria series, taking you back to the very beginning of the story

Novaxandria is a vast cosmopolis full of enigma and mystery. Its atmosphere varies dramatically from one district to another, each with its own unique character. In the very north of its territory there’s the Starfall Home, an orphanage where our protagonists were raised.

Young Iris, our main protagonist, finds out that bullying is happening in the orphanage. As she stands up to fight against the bullies, she makes a group of friends, and together they uncover the darker secrets lurking within Starfall Home. They resolve to fight back against the injustice and give all the kids a better life.

title: Birth of X
description: Birth Of X is an atmospheric psychological horror about the pain of loss. A mysterious box left at your doorstep sets off a chain of terrifying events. Solve symbolic puzzles and face what crawls behind you…

title: BeetleQuest: The Puzzle Game
description: You are invited by the beetlefriends to come to their treehouse and play games together and have great fun! BeetleQuest: The Puzzle Game is a small, hand-drawn puzzle game set in the world of BeetleQuest.

title: Puzzleverse
description: Enjoy 60 well-crafted 3D jigsaw puzzles! Discover a nice collection of puzzles and relax. Let the soothing gameplay help you unwind and de-stress.

title: Fish Tales and Cozy Trails
description: Embark on a tranquil journey in this cozy fishing game, you're free to explore a vibrant world brimming with secrets. Discover hidden coves, find unique rods, and venture into the charming world as you seek out new fishing grounds.

title: Tales of Eden: Midgard
description: Midgard is a single-player, unforgiving, action-RPG with a handcrafted open world steeped in Norse mythology. Encounter intense combat and level up your character's skill sets to fight your way across the kingdoms of Midgard. Save the people from evil as you trade, craft, hunt and fish to survive!

title: Tales of Aradia: Idle RPG
description: Tales of Aradia is an enchanting idle RPG that blends active and offline progression in a vibrant pixel-art world—harvest magical resources, master diverse skills, craft epic gear, and face mythical creatures as you uncover the secrets of a realm on the brink of darkness.

title: Horror Tales Eats The World
description: Move silently through dark and desolate areas with a photorealistic bodycam perspective. Find the hidden tapes cassettes scattered across the map each one unveils a different paranormal horror story… stay silent, stay alive.

title: Plant Tales
description: Plant Tales is a casual farming sim where you collect different types of plants and sell them in your plant shop! Use the money to upgrade your gear, expand your shop, and explore further into the wilderness.

title: Glassy Stare
description: A story-driven psychological experience where memory fades, silence deepens, and something waits in the dark.

title: Way to Town
description: Way to Town is a casual 2D top-down game with pixel graphics. Pass through all the traps, collect bricks, and rebuild the bridge to reach your dream town

title: They Took the Sun
description: They Took the Sun is a short action flight game. Zip through vast forsaken environments in search of gigantic mechanical monstrosities. Find their weak points and shoot them down.

title: Rogolf
description:
ROGOLF is a minigolf roguelite, where each level has its own rules and each run is different.
Play mini-golf, buy equipment and score enough points to reach the top!

title: ShuXian Chronicles: Idle Ascension
description: Form a team, battle, AFK farming, loot grinding, divine weapon forging, artifact refining, pet catching, pet fusion, pet training... all the way to ascension!

title: Hollow Life and Insincere Words
description: One ordinary day in the future, change began. An energy source was suddenly developed, and people began to indulge in revelry. After the joy, 13 cities quietly emerged, leaving behind 13 terrifying pits and countless ordinary people···

title: The Lost Village: Monster Sect
description: One day, a vision appeared in the sky, with beams of light piercing through the heavens and earth in many places, like stars falling. However, this is not a sign of peace, but rather a portal for demons from another world to enter this place. They pair up in groups to conquer the entire world.

title: The Lost Village: Monster Sect Part 2
description: One day, a vision appeared in the sky, with beams of light piercing through the heavens and earth in many places, like stars falling. However, this is not a sign of peace, but rather a portal for demons from another world to enter this place. They pair up in groups to conquer the entire world.

title: Schrödinger’s Maze
description: Schrödinger’s Maze is an indie adventure game that combines tower-style combat with a real-time generated maze system. In this ever-shifting labyrinth, only what’s within your field of view truly "exists"

title: Hanafuta no Tora
description: Raise the JACKPOT with Koi-Koi and deal 10 quadrillion damage in this hyper-inflation hanafuda roguelite. Go for the ultimate “Ten Lights”!

title: Cha-no-Ma
description: Introducing the ultimate mind game! A simple game in which players choose a Samurai, Ninja, Bosan, Akindo, or Murabito and try to guess the character selected by their opponent. Use three types of commands: conversation, yawn, and tea to get closer to the character selected by your opponent.

title: Work Wrecker
description: In this 2D beat 'em up, become a maverick in the absurd corporate world! Grab your weapon, smash through chaos, and unleash destruction!

title: Rollover Alien
description: "Tumbling Alien" is a casual puzzle game, this game uses a classic pixel style, the picture is simple but full of challenge. Players need to control an alien to shuttle through the blue laser gap, by tapping the screen to adjust the height of the alien roll, avoid collision with the laser.

title: Blade of Wiz
description: A female knight returns to her cursed kingdom after years of battle. On her journey, she meets a magical black cat, and their fates become entwined. Together, they venture into a mysterious, perilous realm of magic, facing unknown enemies and uncovering the truth of an ancient mystery.

title: Mori no Naka de Mayoi Ie kara no Dasshutsu
Senkou
description: You must not extinguish any of the incense sticks. This is the only rule in this game. You can continue playing for longer by controlling the wind direction and timing when to add new incense sticks. When all the incense sticks are extinguished, the game ends.

title: Chinese Style School
description: Dean Simulator, a walking simulation game of looking for anomalies in a school full of bugs. The scene is a Chinese middle school campus. Experience the scenery and abnormal events of a Chinese campus. There are more than 200 anomalies, which is dozens of times the volume of the same type.

title: Seirei no Mori no Bouken
description: A short 3D action RPG where a girl escapes into a mysterious forest filled with cursed creatures. Fight, explore, and uncover a quiet story of healing—all in about 30 minutes.

title: Blazing Dragon Slayer · Divine Weapon Awakening
description: "Blazing Dragon Slayer · Divine Weapon Awakening" is a casual game. The game features a rich weapon and equipment enhancement system, allowing players to efficiently boost their combat power. Players can enjoy a comfortable gaming experience simply by using the mouse to choose upgrade directions.

title: Cosmic High Schooler
description: This is an AVG visual novel with romance elements, set against the backdrop of a Chinese high school. It tells a story about imagination, the universe, and the youthful innocence of high school students.

title: Graduate Battle
description: Graduate Battle is a turn-based card game where you fight words, grow stronger, and master tricky vocab through strategy.

title: Tong Create Thorns
description: Tong Create Thorns It is a side scrolling role-playing action adventure game with a storyline. Players will control the protagonist of a beautiful girl to gradually learn the story of this fantasy world under endless dusk, revealing certain conspiracies and crises hidden in the darkness.

title: Eyepuppet Company
description: You will play the role of a robot going to the company for testing, and undergo behavioral tests such as parkour maze decryption and confrontation during the testing.PS：The third level requires four machines to trigger the 1V3 capture special mode.The victories of both sides have different endings.

title: Underworld: Allied Expedition
description: Valhalla's sealed abyss unleashed dark hordes during a magical cataclysm. United surface races repelled the invasion but now venture into the unfathomable pit to confront ancient evils and uncover truths buried beneath their war-torn world.

title: Owari no Kane ga Naru mae ni Chapter3
description: Owari no Kane ga Naru mae ni Chapter 3 is the final installment of a visual novel trilogy focusing on protagonist Ryohei Hasebe's winter romance. As he realizes his feelings for Yukino Sugano, a love triangle develops when her best friend also shows interest in him. The story explores themes of choice, loss, and the pursuit of one's future while navigating complicated relationships.

title: The Clingy Ghost
description: Become the trending star exorcist and save the cursed haunted house! The worst spirit in history is about to awaken.

title: Coin Pusher Reloaded
description: A little coin pusher game made by MicroRaptor Games!

title: UltFoot: Football Manager
description: Manage your football team and take on challenging, realistic tournaments. Develop your squad, trade players, play real-time multiplayer matches, and customize every detail of your club to make it truly unique.

title: Dopingun
description: This is a 2D shooting game in which you use the Dopingun to enhance yourself messily and shoot a lot of bullets. Sometimes you can create an opening by shooting at the enemy, or use the Dopingun as a starting point to expand your strategy.

title: Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection
description: Twin Rathalos, born in a twist of fate. Two centuries after a conflict that divided neighboring kingdoms, the drums of war are reignited as twin Rathalos—long thought extinct—hatch from a single egg: an omen of destruction. Is there hope beyond the northern border?

title: Once Upon a Katamari
description: Keep the good times rolling with a new entry in the Katamari Damacy series! In this puzzle action-adventure game, you'll roll your Katamari through time itself. Journey through the Jurassic Period, Ice Age, historic Japan, and more eras to rebuild the starry sky.

title: Just Dance 2026 Edition
description:
Just Dance 2026 Edition is a dance rhythm game that scores you as you match choreography on screen. It includes a new tracklist with 40 songs ranging from recent hits to classics, plus modes for solo dancing, co-op play, and competitive challenges with up to 6 players in local multiplayer.
You can also dance using your phone as a camera controller and choose workout sessions to stay active while you play. The game brings together content from multiple Just Dance editions into one place for easy access to songs.

title: Plants vs. Zombies: Replanted
description:
The classic Plants vs. Zombies returns in glorious HD! DANG! After years in Crazy Dave’s attic, the original battle between Plants and Zombies is back — bigger, brighter, and crazier than ever before! Experience the game that started it all, now remastered with upscaled HD graphics and packed with new secrets to uncover.

Revisit the epic backyard standoffs you remember, this time with new levels, fresh twists, and 15 years of never-before-seen franchise history at your fingertips. Relive the glory days of peashooters, sunflowers, and brain-hungry chaos! Rejoin the ultimate garden defense and experience the backyard brawl that started a phenomenon — now back for a new era!

title: Pac-Man World 2 Re-Pac
description: PAC-MAN WORLD 2 Re-PAC modernizes, updates, and enhances the fan favorite 3D Platforming adventure in nearly every way! Venture across PAC-LAND to reclaim the golden fruit and put a stop to the ghosts and their dastardly boss, Spooky!

title: Chillin' by the Fire
description: Campfires. Humanity's oldest social network.

title: NBA Bounce
description: Step onto the court with your favorite NBA team and mascots. Dribble, dunk, unlock gear, and play solo or with friends in fun game modes.

title: Hello Kitty Island Adventure: Wheatflour Wonderland
description: Cogimyun, a beloved new Sanrio character, is coming to Hello Kitty Island Adventure in the whimsical world of Wheatflour Wonderland. Craft magic wands, transform into critters, solve puzzles to collect hidden Wheathearts, and explore our richest world yet.

title: The Adventures of Elliot: The Millennium Tales
description:
The Adventures of Elliot: The Millennium Tales is an action RPG set in the world of Philabieldia - a beautiful but savage land dominated by warring beast tribes. Humanity’s last bastion is the Kingdom of Huther, protected by its tall walls and Princess Heuria’s powerful magic.

When a mysterious set of ruins is discovered, a young adventurer named Elliot and his fairy companion Faie are sent off on a journey to investigate. What seems like a simple, if dangerous, mission soon becomes a grand saga that will be woven across time and space.

title: Octopath Traveler 0
description:
All the definitive elements of the Octopath Traveler series return in this exciting prequel set in the realm of Orsterra. Embark on a brand new adventure of your own creation in this stunning HD-2D RPG, Octopath Traveler 0!

Brand-new features to the series include a character creation system where you get to become the hero, and town building mechanics as you seek to restore your devastated home.

title: Village in the Shade
description: Enjoy quiet, countryside living in a Japanese village in this brand new farming sim! Just make sure you follow the rules—or else!

title: Pritto Prisoner
description: Get ready for chaotic 4v2 party game action in Pritto Prisoner! Play as mischievous animal inmates using strategically messy peepee/poopie tactics to outwit highly customizable robot wardens. Break out, or get put to "deep sleep" in this asymmetrical escape game. Easy to learn, hilarious to master.

title: Infinite Cards
description: Discover infinite cards in this roguelike deckbuilder. Every card is unique, every run a new experience. Craft, combine, and build your deck completely freely to defeat enemies and bosses, or take on cleverly designed puzzle challenges!

title: Magical Craft: Neko to Mahou no Dress
description:
The story unfolds in the tranquil village of Frune.

The protagonist, a young girl named Lilia, begins her journey as a dressmaker, using the “sewing magic” she inherited from her grandmother.

As she fulfills requests from the villagers and works toward becoming a legendary dressmaker, her everyday life of dressmaking begins.

With a friendly guide and simple controls, even children can enjoy the game with peace of mind.

title: Momotaro Dentetsu 2: Anata no Machi mo Kitto aru
description: The latest entry in the Momotaro Dentetesu series, Momotaro Dentetsu 2: Anata no Machi mo Kittoaru promises the largest volume of content to date, with approximately 1,000 stations—nearly three times the amount featured in Momotaro Dentetsu: Showa, Heisei, Reiwa mo Teiban!—and over 6,000 properties. The game uses two maps, one for western Japan and one for eastern Japan. The Nintendo Switch 2 Edition features a larger map display, as well as support for camera play.

title: Salvaprastar
description: It is a game that pushes back the left edge of the screen forcibly scrolling with a smash, earns a score until it reaches the end point, and aims for a high score.

title: Soup Raiders
description: Soup Raiders is an action-tactical RPG with a real time battle system, lovingly hand-drawn character in 3d environment, a lively story in an even livelier world and it is all contained in a single soup.

title: Roadside In Hell
description:
Rogue-like RPG in which you rip off the bodies of your enemies and attach them to your own.

A game in which the protagonist is cast into hell and aims for heaven by force.

You can customize your own body by "dismembering" enemies you meet along the way and attaching their body parts to yours.

title: Momi
description: Momi is an action game where a girl wearing a ribbon travels and walks around the World of Paintings. Explore a metaphysical world and find your favorite landscapes!

title: Butterfly Loop Night
description: You have 30 seconds to save the world from exploding.

title: Ticket to Ride: Heart of Africa Expansion
description: Explore challenging new terrain in the Ticket to Ride: Heart of Africa Expansion! Winner of the fan vote, Heart of Africa goes digital for the first time, bringing two more vehicles, carriages and characters to transform your strategies.

title: Welcome To Bon's Burgers
description: Welcome to Bon's Burgers is a cancelled indie-horror game, based off the hit game series Five Nights at Freddy's, that preceded The Walten Files. The first act of the game is available for download, along with the scrapped Act 2. The other acts are currently lost besides its Halloween game, Night of the Living Robot. Many of the elements seen in the game appear in the VHS series, such as the characters, settings, and story.

title: Starforged Legacy
description: Outlast the onslaught in a sci-fi survivors-like where your decisions matter as much as your firepower. Command customizable starships, enhance your arsenal with 100+ strategy-defining upgrades, and annihilate endless fleets of cosmic combatants! Carve your legacy among the stars and die trying!

title: Sidequest Survivors
description: Sidequest Survivors is a bullet-heaven roguelite where you control wacky characters, mow down waves of magical creatures, and tackle sidequests. Choose from a variety of weapons and create builds that match your playstyle.

title: Storm Seas
description: Set sail on an epic adventure across the Caribbean Sea in the 18th century. Storm Seas is an open-world maritime trading simulator where you take command of your own ship to build a fortune—or lose everything to storms, pirates, or poor choices.

title: Floodpunk
description: Build up your island in this resource management strategy game, battling the rising tides and the incoming flood. Grow your industry. Build the tower. Escape the flood!

title: Ravenrift
description: Craft custom brews from foraged ingredients, run your own potion shop, decorate your home, and fall in love with a mysterious town in a cozy new world filled with magic. Welcome to Ravenrift, a charming town where witches and other magical creatures live side by side.

title: Sealing Tower
description: This is a deck-building roguelike game with rich Chinese cultural elements. The player takes on the role of a Taoist who accidentally enters the Sealing Tower and becomes trapped. By defeating monsters, you earn random cards and build a powerful deck to overcome all enemies and escape.

title: Adventure in Hender´s Castle
description: Cast magic spells and explore an old Castle in this 3d action-adventure game. Overcome obstacles, solve puzzles and fight the dark forces that have taken hold of your ancestral home.

title: Trade Anchor
description: Amidst powerful alien empires, you are among the first humans in this corner of the procedurally generated galaxy. Trade and explore. With no combat, your success hinges on mastering complex alien economies and navigating intricate politics. Can you carve out a place for humanity in the cosmos?

title: Aggelos 2
description: With the gods of light about to lose the great battle against the gods of darkness, you must master two powerful forms. Dive into a challenging Metroidvania set across contrasting worlds filled with secrets, puzzles, and intense 2D combat in this action-packed sequel

title: He Stole My Panties, So I Stole His Virginity!
description: One day, Amelia enters her college's gym locker room to find a man rifling through her belongings. Upon closer inspection, she realizes that the mysterious man was once a former classmate of hers that she used to bully in high school! With a devious plan beginning to form in her mind, she takes out her phone and begins to record...

title: Freedome Farmers
description: Farm, build, defend. Team up with your friends in this crazy third-person horde shooter. You are farmers trying to colonize a planet, by day you plant, harvest and use these resources to build defences and prepare for night time. Because at night your farm animals are possessed by aliens and attack.

title: She Was Swallowed By The Sun
description:
Grief, death, and hate fill your veins. Let your girlfriend exsanguinate you.

Two girls, fulfilling their lives' work, and headed for the end. Witness as the burgeoning violence of fascism drives One and Anhedonia to the absolute breaking point.

title: Maji de Watashi ni Koishinasai! A: Ryouken Route After
description: A sequel of Margit's after story in Majikoi A-5.

title: Myth of Slayer
description: One day, mysterious portals appeared in every corner of the world, and many strange monsters that should not exist in reality came out of those portals, killing every living thing in their way. Some people were awakened to become slayers, and they fought to drive those monsters away successfully. But that was not the end, but the beginning of everything. You will play as an MC in a world three years after the invasion. What will happen to your story and your fate? Only you can decide.

title: Apocalypse Truck Simulator
description: Take control of powerful, all terrain vehicles and deliver various cargoes across a challenging, broken, post apocalyptic world.

title: Stufft TD
description: Build wild multi-class turrets, stack abilities, and outsmart waves of enemies in this fast-paced, cartoon-style sci-fi tower defense! Combine synergies, manipulate cooldowns, and unleash chaos with explosive effects and clever combos.

title: Shepherdmancer
description: Save sheep from evil monsters in this RPG puzzler. Collect skills and abilities as you make your way through 25 levels and utilize them to overcome great challenges.

title: Wandering Okali
description: Discover magical creatures while exploring a fantasy world in this whimsical, art-filled visual novel!

title: Palland
description: Craft your legacy from battle and stone.

title: Space Yugoslav 2D
description: Horizontal old school 2D shooter where you play as a bounty hunter named Nada. Survive another night at your very risky job, save the space non-alignment colonies from police raid and get back home at one piece alive! 7 levels, loads of new-retro-feel SHMUP fun!

title: Harvest Moon: Skytree Village
description: Revive the Land, Save a Village!

title: Harvest Moon: The Lost Valley
description: A New Evolution of Harvest Moon!

title: Star Jumper: Cosmic Adventure
description: Blast into the stars, bounce through galaxies!

title: Quiz Brain Workout
description: A daily challenge for puzzle lovers. Carefully curated quizzes inspired by Japanese logic and culture. From IQ tests to tricky riddles, it’s time to train your brain. Perfect for all ages — sharpen your thinking and enjoy every “aha!” moment.

title: Jalecolle Famicom Ver. Saiyuuki World II: The Demon God of Heaven - & Whomp'em
description: JALECOlle Famicom Ver. brings back classic Jaleco titles! Vol. 7: Saiyuuki World II - The Demon God of Heaven - & WHOMP'EM

title: Eggconsole Xak Precious Package: The Tower of Gazzel PC-8801mkIISR
description: Will Latok be able to conquer the Tower of Gazel? Make full use of your support members to overcome formidable foes and tricky puzzles!

title: Migakamikagami: Reviver
description: MIGAKAMIKAGAMI -reviver- is a Horror 2D Pixel art Adventure Escape game. The story is set in a rural hospital where a legend of divine abductions by a deity called "Migakami-sama" has been passed down. The protagonists, Mika and Nae, are caught up in the divine abduction.

title: The Interpretation of Dreams
description: At the beginning of the story, an "old friend" of yours, Sheriff Triss, suddenly calls you and asks you to go to a local exhibition hall to assist in the investigation of a heinous murder case...

title: The Box of Fear
description: A missing daughter. A father without answers. A suspicious company. Solve puzzles, connect clues, and discover what "The Box" hides in this first-person psychological horror.

title: Self Destruct
description:
Self Destruct is a hectic top-down arcade shooter made for the TIGSource PG competition. Players control a small ship that needs to survive 250 waves of enemies. The hook for this game is that all enemy waves are procedurally generated, making each gameplay sessions different.

The small ship is able to shoot, use a shield (limited amount) and launch a nuke that clears the entire screen. Defeated enemies leave behind four types of bonuses: blue (restores the shield), red (upgrades the weapons), yellow (restores the nuke) and green (maxes out everything). Despite using an offline executable, the game originally could only be played when connected to the internet to use the online highscore tables. Later, an offline version was released as well.

title: Lewd Mod XXXmas
description: A short game where you play as a content moderator with your job being to look for and remove lewd selfies. You're shown a mix of Christmas-themed photos & have to decide whether they need to be removed according to the strict guidelines your boss gives you.

title: TV-Chan's Great Escape!
description: Help TV-Chan sneak out in this NES game!

title: Pine: Segment_01
description: a trillion souls pine as a universe collapses.

title: Weeping Cherries
description: Among blossoming cherry trees sit two boys bound by a heart-wrenching promise. How will they spend their last day together now that it's time to fulfill it?

title: Cel by Date!
description: An age-gap romantic comedy between two women having a rough night at an anime convention.

title: JQ: Beautiful Japan
description: JQ is a quiz game about Japanese letters in which a player must choose the correct answer from 4 options.

title: Sneaky Claws
description: Blend in, hunt your friends, and become the sneakiest animal at the party!

title: Sugoi Girls: Firefighter Love
description: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!

title: Twin Fighters X
description: A kung-fu action game where you fight against the dark organization X!

title: Where is Billy?
description: Where is Billy? is a hide-and-seek party game for 2-8 players playable locally and online. Figure out which character you are and blend into the crowd to complete various objectives across multiple game modes. Act natural, avoid detection, and outsmart your opponents!

title: Where is the Culprit?
description: Find the hidden character in the illustration! A timed picture puzzle game that sharpens your eyes and challenges your brain

title: Pinedrop Vale
description: Let the wind guide you

title: Fitness Adventure Pro
description: Explore, train, and win: six fitness modes, four islands, one great result!

title: Hit! Spin! Watermelon Party
description:
Hit! Whack! Bam! It's watermelon-smashing time!
Play solo or with friends! Watermelon fun for everyone!

title: Money Wash Tycoon
description: Clean money, dirty job.

title: Learn to Play: Jungle Frog
description: Protect the frog from the bees!

title: Arcade Archives: Field Day
description: Face off across seven sporting events to become the champion!

title: Pac-Man World 2 Re-Pac: Deluxe Edition
description: PAC-MAN WORLD 2 Re-PAC modernizes, updates, and enhances the fan favorite 3D Platforming adventure in nearly every way! Venture across PAC-LAND to reclaim the golden fruit and put a stop to the ghosts and their dastardly boss, Spooky!

title: Once Upon A Katamari: King of All Sounds Edition
description:
The King of All Sounds Edition includes:
- Once Upon A KATAMARI
- Katamari Damacy Series Songs: Side A
- Katamari Damacy Series Songs: Side B

Once upon a time a katamari rolled through both past and present. In this story across time, the adage endures: Let The Good Times Roll! Now onward through new worlds to roll up thy heart's desires and to restore the stars!

title: Maze: Path of Light - Complete Edition
Goosebumps: Terror in Little Creek - Frightmare Edition
Final Fantasy Tactics: The Ivalice Chronicles - Deluxe Edition
description:
Final Fantasy Tactics: The Ivalice Chronicles is a tactical role-playing game that features turn-based, grid-based combat with a focus on positioning, terrain, and class-based progression. Players customize a party through a variety of jobs and abilities while engaging in strategy-driven battles.

The Deluxe Edition includes the following bonuses:
・ Weapon: Akademy Blade (Raises a unit's speed attribute slightly while equipped)
・ Headwear: Akademy Beret (Prevents the Charmed status while equipped)
・ Combat Garb: Akademy Tunic (Grants Shell while equipped)
・ Accessory: Ring of Aptitude (Boosts JP earned while equipped)
・ Consumable Items: Phoenix Down x10
・ Black Equipment for Ramza
・ Red Equipment for Ramza

title: Borderlands 4: Deluxe Edition
description:
Pre-Purchase Borderlands 4 and receive the Gilded Glory Pack featuring a Vault Hunter Skin, a Weapon Skin, and an ECHO-4 Drone Skin!
Take on new areas with unique missions and bosses, earn more rewards with Vault Cards, and collect all kinds of additional loot with the Borderlands 4 Deluxe Edition!

Borderlands 4 Deluxe Edition includes:
• Full base game
• Pre-Purchase Bonus: Gilded Glory Pack*

1 Vault Hunter Skin

1 Weapon Skin

1 ECHO-4 Drone Skin
• Firehawk's Fury Weapon Skin
• Bounty Pack Bundle**

4 unique areas, featuring new missions and unique bosses

4 Vault Cards with unique challenges and rewards

New gear and weapons

New Vault Hunter cosmetics

4 New vehicles with new cosmetics

Borderlands 4 brings intense action, badass Vault Hunters, and billions of wild and deadly weapons to an all-new planet ruled by a ruthless tyrant.

title: Last War
description: Partner with players from all over the globe to battle the zombies. Stay alert – alliances are complex, and not every survivor you encounter is friendly.

title: Exitless: Prologue
description: Get a glimpse into Exitless with this free story prologue!

title: Exitless
description: Explore endless labyrinths of eerie hallways while being hunted by an evil spider teddy. Locate different rooms, complete tasks, survive the surreal corridors and find the exit from your nightmare!

title: Runeblight
description: Runeblight is a retro, souls-like FPS set in a dying kingdom. As an eternal curse eats away at those who remain, an unlikely gift allows you to break the shackles of fate. Find secrets and hidden paths as you explore an interconnected world, tearing through cultists and monsters along the way.

title: Los Angeles Mod
description: The Los Angeles Mod is an USA modification for Emergency 4 and 911:First Responders.

title: House Flipper Remastered Collection
description: House Flipper Remastered Collection lets you become a one-person renovation crew. Clean, build, decorate, and sell for profit! Now with better graphics, voice acting, all expansions in one toolbox, and some more heartfelt addition. It’s flipping time!

title: Don't Lose Aggro
description: Experience the thrill of MMORPG tanking in this single-player roguelite that lets you perfect your tanking skills without guild drama or 4-hour raid nights!

title: Hearthstone: Book of Mercenaries
description:
Book of Mercenaries is a single-player game mode first released on April 6, 2021 with new chapters releasing until March 17, 2022.

It uses a classic linear adventure format with an appearance similar to Dungeon Run screen. Like Book of Heroes, Book of Mercenaries is about telling the journeys and stories, but the main characters are mercenaries, who were first introduced in Forged in the Barrens as legendary cards and unique to Hearthstone.

Like Book of Heroes, Book of Mercenaries featured a chapter for each of the ten classes that existed before Patch 25.0.0.158725, for a total of 80 missions or bosses. It is completely free to play and available to everyone. Additionally, completing a class's story rewards the player a corresponding class pack.

title: Hearthstone: Book of Heroes
description:
Book of Heroes is a single-player game mode first released on September 15, 2020.

It uses a classic linear adventure format with an appearance similar to Dungeon Run screen. Book of Heroes is about telling the journeys and stories of heroes, such as the ones who represent the classes in Hearthstone, like Jaina Proudmoore. Most of the stories told in this game mode are based on canonical stories of World of Warcraft.

Book of Heroes features a chapter for each of the ten classes before Patch 25.0.0.158725, as well as Ambassador Faelin, for a total of 100 unique missions or bosses. It is completely free to play and available to everyone. Additionally, completing a story rewards the player with a corresponding class pack, a special card back, or another type of card pack.

title: Hearthstone: Battlegrounds
description:
Battlegrounds is a game mode where eight players face off in 1v1 rounds, with the goal to be the last player standing. Each round consists of two phases. The Recruit Phase lets players purchase and sell minions, upgrade the tavern, use their hero power, and rearrange their minions' attack order. Combat Phase has minions automatically attacking the opponents' until one player (or both) has no minions remaining, at which point the victor attacks the loser.

Battlegrounds is significantly different from all other constructed play modes in Hearthstone, featuring completely different mechanics from anything previously seen. There is no mana: instead, the only resource is Coins (similar to the Bartender Bob, Bartendotron, and Bazaar Bob encounters from previous Single-player adventures). All minions cost 3 Coins, with the power of minions instead dictated by their Tavern Tier, shown in the usual place of mana on the card interface. This is a purple square on the upper-left with 1-6 (occasionally 7) gold stars. Minions do not attack the opponent directly - rather, surviving minions add Tavern Tier to the hero's attack once the round is over.

title: Gates of Eden
description: Imagine "Doom" but in Heaven. Demons, evil creatures, and rebellious warriors have taken over the Kingdom, and it's your job to restore order to paradise. Fight to protect the Garden of Eden and defeat the Prince of Darkness.

title: White Rats
description:
White Rats is a sci-fi survival visual novel set within the cold, decaying corridors of the research station UF-44.
When a group of survivors wakes up with fragmented memories and no clear way out, they must uncover the truth behind the station’s secrets — and the experiments that took place there.

Choices matter: each decision can lead to survival... or something far worse.
Investigate, adapt, and try to keep your mind intact as reality begins to twist.

Will you solve the mystery — or become just another test subject?

title: Hyouryuu, Nochi, Zashou
description: A first-person Japanese horror set in a secluded forest house. With no loud jump scares, it’s ideal for beginners. Playtime: 15–30 minutes. Monochrome visuals create quiet, creeping tension. Developed in two months by a 19-year-old student, focusing on slow, unsettling exploration.

title: We Love Mind Control Rocket
description: You control one of five gifted siblings, and your goal in the game is to eliminate the other four so that you can take over the world. You do this by building up mighty robot armies and fighting them in RPG-style battles. At the start of the game, you hold a 5% share in each of the seven country's resources. To get the resources to build up your army and take out your siblings, you need to buy more shares in each country and use your resources to create oil, metal, plastics and machine parts, which you use to build troops.

title: All Who Wander
description: All Who Wander is a traditional roguelike with 30 levels and 10 character classes, inspired by games such as Pixel Dungeon. Fight or evade your enemies, discover powerful items, gain companions, and master over 100 abilities. Explore a randomly-generated environment as you journey through blinding deserts, noxious swamps, gloomy caves, and more. But be careful: the world is unforgiving and death is permanent. Learn from your mistakes to improve your strategy and eventually achieve victory!

title: Euro Truck Simulator 2: KRONE Agriculture Equipment
description: The Krone Agriculture Equipment adds a fresh variety of cargo types, featuring cutting-edge machinery from Krone – a globally recognized leader in agricultural equipment.

title: American Truck Simulator: KRONE Agriculture Equipment
description: The Krone Agriculture Equipment adds a fresh variety of cargo types, featuring cutting-edge machinery from Krone – a globally recognized leader in agricultural equipment.

title: Tale of the Bullet Knight
description: All these years, piece was lying around on all of these fields. But one day, a sudden sad moment happened, since by fire and monsters our people got threatened. Nor heroes, nor luck was on our side, but a fallen knight, who had depression on his mind. He lost his home, he lost his sword, but he gain a new weapon, and now he ain't bored. In your hand, dear player, the future of our life, hope that you will be able to save all the people, husbands, kids and wives. The journey will have a lot to tell, but for now we just offer you a trial to tell. Shoot your way through the enemy lines, heal yourself with potions, like you would drinking nice wines. Modify your gun just like how feel, if you would happen to die quick, dont worry, its not a big deal. We all can learn from our mistakes, I hope though you will do whatever it takes. Save the Kingdom, save our lives, so we can offer you more start than fives.

title: Tyrant's Realm: Forbidden Fortune
description: Descend into two deadly new levels, face brutal bosses, and battle six monstrous foes. Wield cursed weapons, unlock ancient armor, and survive twisted challenges in this grim new chapter of dark fantasy combat.

title: Project Kouvola
description: A visual novel about a dystopian country and the things survivors must do to stay alive... The happiest country in the world is now in ruins and only a few remain alive. This couldn't get any worse...

title: Bane: Dawn of the Lost
description: Control a group of heroes or join a party of friends online in this old-school, turn-based, procedurally generated RPG. Be clever and careful while exploring ancient sites. Cooperate to survive traps, hazards, and quick, tactical combat. Collect loot and clues to prepare you for the next adventure.

title: Castle Hearts
description: As the lord and commander of your village, you'll defend it from incoming enemies, grow your buildings, and train soldiers. Engage in events triggered by conversations with NPCs in your village, acquire diverse heroes, and unify the continent.

title: Stomach
description: Stomach is a first-person survival horror cooking game located in a cruise ship with PS1 inspired graphics to capture that retro horror feeling. Your task is to read a food order, search for food ingredients, and make it back safely to the kitchen to cook your ingredients before time runs out.

title: SpongeBob SquarePants: Titans of the Tide
description: Prepare to be scared! A clash between the Flying Dutchman and King Neptune has unleashed ghostly mayhem all over Bikini Bottom. Switch seamlessly between SpongeBob and Patrick, combine their unique skills and save Bikini Bottom from total ghostification!

title: Sacred 2 Remaster
description:
Step into the world of Ancaria as one of six heroes. Explore a massive open world and master combat arts and spells for epic loot. This remaster brings a fan-favorite back to life — with hi-res textures, better combat and bugfixes, for longtime fans and newcomers alike.

Includes all expansions and updates in one definitive edition.

title: The Guild 1 Remake: Europa 1410
description: Forge your path to power in medieval Europe. Choose your profession and master trade, politics, and intrigue to climb the social ladder and found a dynasty. Secure your legacy and dominate history in this immersive economic simulation.

title: Gothic 3 Classic
description: This overhauled console version of the Cult Classic RPG integrates the community patch 1.75 and further gameplay improvements, features tailor-made gamepad UI & controls and delivers advanced optimization to offer the smoothest Gothic 3 experience yet.

title: Fatekeeper
description: Venture into a handcrafted world where ruins whisper of past cataclysms. Master the art of sword and sorcery and forge your path with relics, spells and choices that shape who you become in this first-person RPG.

title: Darksiders 4
description: The legendary saga of the Four Horsemen continues in Darksiders 4, an all-new action-adventure set in an apocalyptic version of earth and continues where the original Darksiders game left off.

title: Beyond the Doors
description: An atmospheric horror, exploration and automation game all set in the dim halls of an apartment building.

title: Memrrtiks, Suashem
description: A would have improduct desting quality, teamwork, cycle stratisfacticed the focused on increased by world-class leaderson that work environment.

title: The Crawling Dead
description: The Crawling Dead is a strategy simulation game where you take on the role of a lead scientist tasked with saving Stormveil National Park from ecological collapse. Swarms of invasive insects are devastating the park’s delicate ecosystems, and traditional methods of pest control have failed. Your solution? Genetically engineered parasitoid wasps. Harmless to humans, these beneficial wasps are killers of pest insects and utilize a variety of creepy strategies to manipulate and kill their hosts - turning them into The Crawling Dead!

title: Starship Eleven
description: "Starship Eleven" - The enlightening sequel to our blockbuster "Starship Seven". Choose one of two exciting different space ships and explore new worlds and strange places in more then 120 rocking levels.

title: Starfinder: Afterlight
description:
The first party-based RPG that brings Paizo's beloved science-fantasy universe to life. Battle across the Pact Worlds, lead a legendary crew where your choices shape their destiny, and well — save the galaxy while you're at it!

In Starfinder: Afterlight, you will assemble a crew of misfits from across the Pact Worlds and become the legends in this single player party-based RPG: find unique companions scattered across the stars, each with their personal stories and dilemmas.

There are no wrong answers: experience a story-driven game where choices matter and nothing is forbidden - everything has consequences. Factions remember your deeds and companions judge your heart in a game with branching storylines which ensure no two adventures are alike.

title: Tired
description: High-speed sci-fi time trial racing. Master five tracks with tight controls, instant restarts, and no distractions—just you, the clock, and the push to go faster. Your biggest rival is your own skill.

title: We Who Rise
description: A fast-paced vertical arcade platformer where you, a brave knight, climb an endless tower packed with tricky traps. Leap over spikes, dodge spears, outmaneuver blades and saws, stay ahead of danger, and chase your high score in a light-hearted but thrilling test of reflexes and timing.

title: Spirit Knight
description: Spirit Knight is a challenging 2D action game where players face three powerful bosses, using precise controls and strategy to defeat them.

title: Star of Providence: Into Oblivion
description: Into Oblivion is the first major update that Star of Providence received after it was renamed from Monolith, and the first major update released with Bigmode as the game's producer. Its release also corresponds with the game's launch on the Nintendo Switch.

title: Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O. World Stage
description:
Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O. World Stage takes the gameplay of Virtua Fighter 5 to new heights:

Rollback Netcode and Cross-play support let you take on any challenger, anywhere, across the globe in the most intense battles yet.

A brand-new single-player mode, ""World Stage"": Challenge powerful rivals on a solo quest to become the ultimate fighter

Enhanced replay functionality and improved training tools.

title: Throne of Blood
description: Celestial power thrums in your veins, Hell’s throne calls, and demons conspire. Will you ascend as savior, tyrant, or something in between? A text-based horror novel, 295,000 words and hundreds of choices, without graphics or sound effects.

title: Null.Process
description: Navigate a procedurally generated factory using limited LiDAR visibility. Scavenge for resources and vital upgrades to improve your abilities and keep your mechanical shell operational. Every run is a unique formation of rooms, upgrades, and secrets.

title: The Indigo Initiative
description: A first-person puzzle adventure where you harness fire, water, electricity, and magnetism to solve multi-step puzzles and explore atmospheric realms to restore balance before reality collapses.

title: Patterns of the Oak
description: The first roguelike deckbuilder where your skill is your mana. Patterns Of The Oak is a deckbuilding roguelike with turn-based combat. Cast spells in powerful combinations to defeat the ruthless invaders and bring back peace to the homeland of the sacred oak groves.

title: Forest Doesn’t Care
description: Forest Doesn't Care is a mushroom-picking simulator set in a realistic forest environment. Players explore the woodland area to forage for mushrooms while encountering secrets and unusual findings. The game features atmospheric elements and emphasizes the indifferent nature of the forest setting during gameplay.

title: Chronicles IV: Ebonheim
description: A turn-based dungeon-crawling CRPG with nuanced character building and brutal, turn-based tactical combat. Explore a fully non-procedural world that changes when you die. Progress on the backs of your past-slain heroes by using their gear and memories to carry onward.

title: Reflections of Life: In Screams and Sorrow - Collector's Edition
description: Can you stop a strange disease from another world?

title: Slammer Caps Xtreme
description: Slammer Caps Xtreme is a nostalgic RPG featuring physics-based battles, '90s wackiness playground energy and a dash of schoolyard. Blending impact simulation with collectibles and psychological duels, the game turns caps battles into rituals of power, identity and maybe something even crazier.

title: Cave of the Skinwalker
description: Journey through Elsana as a wizard, warrior, and archer in this fantasy 2D top down action-adventure game. Explore diverse environments, fight enemies, solve puzzles, and save the many regions of the world from hidden dangers. Can you discover the secrets of the Cave of the Skinwalker?

title: Nightmare Mines
description: Destroy enemies, collect XP, level up, grab power-ups, and face the final boss! Finish in the shortest time possible and compete for the top of the leaderboard in this electrifying reimagining of the classic bomb-hunting game.

title: Saving Princess
description:
Explore a space station crawling with rogue machines and even rival bounty hunters with the same objective as you - but with far, far different intentions!
Expand your arsenal as you collect upgrades to your trusty arm cannon and armor!
Test your might against several bosses - including a FREAKING SPACE NINJA!
Can you SAVE PRINCESS?

title: Dress-Up With Helene: Deluxe!
description:
Helene Marylin becomes your dress-up doll in this cute little Dress-up game!
Mix and match with 300+ different articles of clothing and accessories!

title: Flipping Phantom
description:
A puzzle platformer where you can’t jump?! Phase into the ground and flip upside-down to find your way around this spooky playground!

Flipping Phantom is a 2D pixel-art puzzle platformer with a simple twist: you can’t jump. Phase into solid ground to navigate negative space with reversed gravity and float to slow your descent.

title: NetDive
description: NetDive is a short, experimental incremental game about an AI learning what makes a human human.

title: Blyte
description: A wacky and hilarious walking simulator that throws you into a surreal universe alongside EVA (who cares about her name, anyway?), filled with improbable misadventures and traps worthy of a master troll. A breath of mocking fresh air in an industry that's far too tame!

title: Smith's Chronicles
description: Smith’s Chronicles is a cozy blacksmithing life sim about forging tools, fulfilling requests, and rebuilding a quiet town through the art of craftsmanship. Step into the boots of a young smith returning to their hometown, Grandall, and help breathe life back into the village. Mine ore, gather resources, and manage your workshop as every item you craft strengthens bonds, restores prosperity, and opens new paths for the community.

title: Harrowlight
description: Harrowlight is a third-person survival horror that combines a survival horror experience with exploration in an encapsulating story.

title: Wettop
description: WETTOP is a challenging first-person parkour adventure where every jump counts. With only 10 lives, your goal is to climb to the top of a towering world filled with thrilling jumps, moving platforms, and surprising tasks. Miss a jump, and you fall—lose a life. Lose them all? It's game over.

title: God Fishing
description: Once, there was a fisherman who preferred the quiet waves. On one night, the waves were not so quiet. For on this night, the fish would talk. In this idle experience, solve puzzles and wait in anticipation for your catch to be caught. Solve the mystery of the odd fish society and the god they serve.

title: Arctic Digger TCG Collection
description: A cozy simulation game where you dig through the arctic to collect ores and trading card packs. Use what you find to produce new items, upgrade your tools, and hire penguins to help run your business. Expand your area and turn it into the top trading spot in the frozen north.

title: The Rainbox
description: A cute and simple Sokoban-like puzzle adventure through the rainbow! Push blocks to solve puzzles in a variety of rainbow-themed levels. Each block has a different mechanic for you to work around, can you get all of them to their goal while dealing with their personalities?

title: Detective Worden
description: As a private detective, you’ll crack word clues left by a mysterious informant, gather evidence, and uncover the truth hidden in the shadows.

title: Rest in Paws
description: Explore the touching story of Kebab, a rural cat, as she copes with grief following her passing from old age. Delve into her world and discover the story of her life, from her adoption by a loving family to the meaningful recollections that shaped her being.

title: Run, Veggies!
description: Three unlikely heroes— a fiery tomato, a clever ear of corn, and a strong cabbage — must combine their unique skills to escape a dangerous food processing plant! Leap, swing, and smash through puzzles, hazards, and hidden threats before they end up on the plate. It’s time to Escape the Plate!

title: A Tale of Brothers
description: Caldwell and Caldwyn, two former soldiers in the army of the Ruskin Kingdom, fight together to survive in what used to be their hometown. One day, they find what could be the cure of their world, now full of disease, hunger and suffering. This cure comes in the form of a woman.

title: Drunken Wolf
description: During a hangover, the wolf always hunts anime girls. No one can escape from the wolf. Wolf simulator with innovative VFX drunkenness effect. Eat all anime girls.

title: Fast Food Frog
description: Fast Food Frog is an adventure game where you control a cute, chubby frog with a backpack and a refined palate. Tired of his natural diet, he embarks on a journey through the most unusual regions in search of juicy snacks like burgers, fries, and sodas.

title: Countup
description: Connect numbered tiles in ascending order within a time limit to create combos. The longer the combo, the higher your score in this casual puzzle game.

title: Scooter Slayer
description: Scooter Slayer is a musical racing rhythm arcade game that turns your or built-in songs into a unique track, the shape of which, as well as the speed of your car, will depend on the selected song.

title: Red Fox: Exploration on the the Red Fox Island
description: In the turbulent sea, there is a mysterious island where adventure and challenge converge. You will transform into a clever and agile fox, embarking on a fantastic adventure journey.

title: The Land of Morning Calm
description: A historical strategy tower defense game set in Joseon-era Korea. Build and upgrade towers like hwachas, catapults, and archer posts. Control unique heroes, summon allied units, and actively defend your base against waves of enemies across four tactical stages.

title: Silhouette of Fear
description: This game offers a collection of atmospheric and intense puzzles created for those who like to tickle their nerves.

title: DeepBubbles
description: A dreamy idle aquarium game set in the deep sea, where players collect, feed, and evolve a variety of fish to build their own underwater paradise. Tap bubbles to release food, attract fish, complete tasks, and relax in a soothing aquatic world.

title: Project S
description: "Project S" by Lionheart Studio is an upcoming looter shooter for console and PC with a post-apocalyptic theme.

title: Moon Break
description: Trapped in an alien structure on the Moon, your only mission is to escape. Navigate the desolate lunar surface and the vastness of space to find your way back to Earth.

title: Forest Factory
description: Build, automate, and thrive in Forest Factory! Chop trees, craft wooden goods, and sell them to grow your factory. Manage your depot, fulfill orders, and balance nature with machinery in a serene forest setting. Experience automation in the wild!

title: Ice Dodo
description: INSANE PARKOUR GAME IN OUTER SPACE. Using left and right arrow buttons, bring the character to the finish line. But watch out -- if you hit the cones or fall off the platform, then you must restart! All 711 maps totally unlocked!

title: Urban Hunter
description: A fast-paced action game with deadly traps, endless enemies, and only five lives. Survive the chaos and prove you're the ultimate master of combat!

title: Space Memory: Predators
description: Cute, relaxing memory game where you match pairs of cool predators in space

title: Mall Control
description: Start broke in a hideout and build your mall empire. Buy shops, attract customers, and hack rivals at night all while avoiding guards. Play solo or co-op in this chaotic sim-stealth game!

title: Bartholomew.exe
description: In this short FPS horror experience you are thrown into a maze where the game's state shifts between Nightmare and Dream, you are hunted by the monster Bartholomew in the nightmare and you get to hunt him in the dream. Upgrade your revolver, stock up on traps and kill Bartholomew.

title: Galaxar
description: Defend Terra against the onslaught of hostile invaders in this 2D top-down space shooter. Upgrade and empower your ship's different systems to stand a chance against the growing threat. If you fall, Terra falls, and the rest of the galaxy will soon follow.

title: Space Depot
description: Unemployed in a utopian future you've just received a job offer for Depot Manager with ZENCORP Logistics and Distribution. No need for pants. This is a work-from-home position. Telecommute 23 billion miles to manage the logistics needs of a small sector of outposts with your trusty drone.

title: Dungeons of Hinterberg: Episode Renaud
description: Get ready for a brand-new adventure in Episode Renaud. This exciting prequel introduces Renaud, the mysterious fan-favorite character, now fully playable. Dive into Renaud’s dark and intense journey, which offers thrilling new insights that connect directly to Luisa’s adventure in the main game.

title: Heir to the Queen
description: An ordinary high school girl, Yamu, suddenly finds herself destined to become the Queen of ancient Egypt…

title: Alpha Squadron
description: Classic Arcade Style Side Scrolling Shoot'Em Up. Dodge the enemy bullets as you fight your way through 13 levels of increasingly intense action. Play in various levels of difficulty and challenge the high score tables. Co-op up to 4 players, one survives the level, then you all start the next level.

title: Light of the Eternal Night
description: This world has been consumed by darkness, and light has faded into eternal night. It is said that only by collecting the seven-colored Shards of Light can darkness be dispelled. You are a traveler chosen by fate, able to travel through various scenes, collect the Shards, and restore the light.

title: Yuukyuu no Tierblade for Nintendo Switch
description: A bundle of both Yuukyuu no Tierblade games for the Nintendo Switch.

title: Nora and Frank
description: Blast through hordes of vicious mutants and science-gone-wrong experiments to save your goblin friends in a stylish retro-magic post-apocalypse. An auto-shooter where builds are made of baseball cards and candy. What? Yeah, we're confused too!

title: Draw Sword
description: Draw Sword combines the elements of Chinese fairy and meat pigeon to create a rogue like game with the theme of Chinese fairy. The choice of rewards is very important, and the reflection on the arrangement of skills and weapon also needs serious consideration.

title: Soul Apocalypto
description: 《Soul Apocalypto》 is a role-playing game that also emphasizes the selection of team strategies. You can summon different roles to form your own team, and realize team characteristics by deploying role skills. To defeat different enemies and pass bosses in this way!

title: Liese in the City of Trials
description:
Years after the hero Liese restored peace to the world, a new, fearsome fortress has suddenly risen. Monsters plague the world once more, and now it's up to Liese to save the day!
