title: Deadline Delivery
description: Strap in, floor it, and deliver the goods... before the bomb goes off. Play as Carl, a monkey driving a wildly unstable mail truck that's rigged with explosives on a tight deadline.

title: Handsum
description: Lose the game. Lose your fingers. With nothing but an arsenal of powerups and your gut instincts, the only way out of this high-stakes guessing game is to win.

title: Oliver
description: Oliver is a fast-paced, pixel-art adventure featuring three distinct game modes tailored for quick, exhilarating play sessions. Players can dive into a side-scrolling endless runner across sweeping landscapes, soar through volcanic caves in a precision-based flight challenge, or survive relentless waves of enemies in a top-down dungeon shooter. Designed with the Godot Engine from the ground up, Oliver blends responsive gameplay with handcrafted visuals and atmospheric sound. Its variety of mechanics—from obstacle dodging to combat endurance—offers a dynamic experience built around replayability and skill mastery, all wrapped in a retro-styled aesthetic that highlights the game’s creative depth.

title: The 1500 Year Old Forest Elf and My Anti-materiel Sniper Rifle
description: 1000 years ago, an alliance of humans and elves drove back the invasion of dragons. Peace was meant to return. Instead, humanity descended into endless bloodshed and tyranny. 1000 years later, the last surviving elves must defend their forests against man-made dragons forged from far deeper cruelty.

title: Game Shop Simulator
description: Game Shop Simulator is a chill first-person simulation where every detail of running a Game store comes alive. Create the ultimate video game store! where you sell video games, Consoles, or Gaming Notebooks, this game lets you live out your dream of running a thriving gaming business.

title: Gumball Guesser
description: A code-guessing puzzle game where you will decipher the correct combination of gumballs to solve a puzzle. You'll challenge yourself by raising the bar on the difficulty of the puzzles you'll solve.

title: OnlyGame
description: A pure gameplay game, a variety of classic gameplay plus extended game configurations, you can draw custom graphics and apply them to other gameplay in the game, it is a highly expansive game.

title: Table Tactics
description: Knock over tabletop figurines by shooting marbles and arrows, instead of calculating stats! A turn-base strategy game that's entirely physics-driven, with single player campaign and local multiplayer skirmishes between friends.

title: Legacy of Valor
description: Build, lead, trade, and fight to create a lasting legacy. Expand your village, build castle, protect your people, and guide them through wars, prosperity, and history in a living medieval world.

title: Reflections of Life: In Screams and Sorrow
Invokyr
description: A co-op survival horror game about a cursed board game. Play in a group of 6 players. Roll the dice, survive the horrors that are summoned, and beat the Gamemaster to win your freedom.

title: Doljnik
description: Doljnik is a comedy horror game with a comedic and creepy atmosphere. You play as a man who has to pay off his mother's loan. There are a lot of interesting dialogues and tasks on your way, and remember, you are constantly being watched!!

title: Spellbound Emporium
description: Open your own fantasy book store! Manage your store, stock shelves with enchanted books, potions and magical gifts to delight your customers. Grow herbs, craft potions, hire staff, host events and decorate your store to make it your own.

title: Megashigi Too
description: A platformer game made for supershigi by her community. This game features multiple levels helmed by community members, lots of inside jokes, and a heartwarming story that brings it all together.

title: Lust Sisters
description: In each level of the game, players need to turn over the cards in turn and find the same pattern combination. After turning over two cards each time, if their patterns are the same, they will be successfully matched and disappear.

title: Your Turn To Die: Chapter 1, Part One
description: Chapter 1, Part One is the first part of "Your Turn To Die: Death Game by Majority". It was originally released on NicoNico on August 28, 2017.

title: Your Turn To Die: Chapter 1, Part Two
description: Chapter 1, Part Two is the second part of Your Turn to Die: Death Game By Majority. It was originally released on NicoNico on January 31, 2018.

title: Your Turn To Die: Chapter 2, Part One
description: Chapter 2, Part One is the third part of Your Turn to Die: Death Game By Majority. It was originally released on NicoNico on August 7, 2018.

title: Your Turn To Die: Chapter 2, Part Two
description:
Chapter 2, Part Two is the fourth part of Your Turn to Die: Death Game By Majority. It was originally released on NicoNico on May 21, 2019.
On May 31st 2019, an English fan translation for it and all previous chapters would be released by VGpersons, which would later go on to be endorsed as official by Nankidai.

title: Your Turn To Die: Final Chapter, Part One
description: Final Chapter, Part One is the fifth part of Your Turn To Die: Death Game by Majority. This chapter is divided into further parts for the release due to technical difficulties. Part One - Section A was released on February 27, 2020, and Part One - Section B was released on May 30, 2021.

title: Billy Went to a Carnival
description:
Ten years ago, a girl went missing. Her friend recalls the events that lead to the night of her disappearance and the terrifying truth of a legend that turned out to be real...
Something horrible happened that night. The night that...Billy went to a carnival.

title: Lisa: Timeless in Pointless - Drunkard's Paradise
description:
A mod of a mod of a fangame that crosses it over with another fangame from the same fandom.

LISA: Timeless in Pointless - Drunkard's Paradise is a minor retooling of Scholar of the Wilbur Sin that lets you replay the expanded events of central Olathe as a new set of faces, those being Elton Broll and Bernard Connorfold.

title: Heart of Ice by Dave Morris
description: A unique adventure, where every choice shapes your fate. A classic gamebook brought to life, with countless paths to discover.

title: Candy Trail
description: Sweet Paths, Big Challenges

title: Animal Times
description: Command animal armies and conquer territories in this turn-based strategy game where every attack can backfire! Master blunder-style combat, where failed strikes let defenders capture your lands. Bold moves win big in this high-stakes battle for cunning victory.

title: Raccoon Crime Spree
description: Raccoon Crime Spree is a chaos mischief sandbox! Steal cars, dodge cops, bop pedestrians—and wreak raccoon mayhem across the city.

title: Realm of Taiwu
description: Demons ravage, calamities rage. Xiangshu's scourge devours the mortal realm. In this ink-wash dark fantasy world, you'll wander, unearth rare treasures, reclaim divine swords. Seek like-minded companions to save the world. Survive—in this dimming world, you can still kindle a faint light.

title: Presidential Social Media Manager
description: Welcome to the most stressful job in politics making the President look sane online. Fix typos, fight trolls, and spin chaos into strategy. One wrong emoji could spark a crisis. A satirical management game where timing and damage control are your only lifelines.

title: Girls' Dorm Wars
description: In this AVG game, players control freshman Lula Ruan, navigating dorm life and campus dynamics. Through choices, personality traits, and relationship management, they shape Lula's growth, unlock story paths, and influence endings with the “butterfly effect.

title: Halliwell's Garden
description: Build a thriving garden by day, survive monstrous hordes by night! Plant flowers to attract danger, unlock powerful upgrades, and defend your land in this vibrant roguelike with building, farming, and strategic chaos!

title: Jump Now
description: A simple yet challenging platformer. Jump from platform to platform, collect stars, and unlock new worlds every 15 stars. Each world brings fresh ideas, new mechanics, and tricky challenges. Precise jumps, pure platforming, no frills.

title: Wolvenrise
description: The game takes place in a dark, medieval-inspired village shrouded in air of suspense and mistrust. The atmospheric setting immerses players in a high-stakes battle of survival, where every decision and accusation can mean the difference between victory and defeat.

title: Epic War Collection
description: Command fantasy armies, make tactical choices, and observe epic battles unfold in this re-imagination of an old school classic!

title: Office Assistant
description: A top-down office-life simulator where you drink coffee, smash printers with a hammer, and survive the inbox. Welcome to corporate bliss.

title: Warrior Mage or Rogue alike
description: Customize your hero by choosing your base stats, class, weapon load-out, and passive skills! Your build determines how fast you run, how high you jump and of course how much damage you deal! Test your build on a monster-slaying adventure, leveling up as you go.

title: Mobsteria
description: A strategic text-based crime game where you build a criminal empire from the ground up. Execute heists, recruit associates, craft weapons, and compete against players in this deep browser-based game. Rise from street thug to crime boss through tactical decision-making and ruthless ambition.

title: RovNav
description: Program rovers with a visual Node Graph system to Navigate Complex Grids. Connect Movement, Sensor, and State Nodes to build custom logic. Use dropdowns to configure actions and wires to define flow.

title: Daisen
description: Forget about ammo. Forget about reloading. Don’t let your weapon overheat. Daisen is a fast-paced shooter. Step into the role of a girl plunging into chaos to unravel the anomalous influence spreading across the land.

title: The Last Purge
description: A unique indie game combining strategy card play, team building, and a distinctive take on the auto-battler genre. Easy to pick up, endlessly fun to explore, and surprisingly hard to put down.

title: Bher
description: Delve dungeons, craft items and build relationships as you work to recover your memory. Bher is a town under siege, and you are an amnesiac with nothing to your name. Search dark woods and caves for resources and craft powerful weapons to delve into infested mines, forgotten swamps, and worse.

title: Antero Sudoku
description: Antero Sudoku is a true random Sudoku puzzle game featuring a challenge mode and cool tunes. Challenge mode progress is saved on device. No ads, no in-app purchases or DLCs. You can play this game offline and it's got some easter egg effects if you click on things. I hope you enjoy the music!

title: Your Turn To Die: Final Chapter, Part Two
description: Final Chapter, Part Two is the sixth and final part of Your Turn To Die: Death Game by Majority. It will be released on Steam first, then the free version later. The chapter was scheduled to be released on Steam by February 21, 2024, but the date was postponed due to the amount of work. As for now, the chapter's release date is currently unknown.

title: Taxi Mayhem: London
description:
Tear through the streets of London like never before. Race through London and prove you're the best taxi driver. Take the fastest route and collect bonus points as you tear and shoot. Play with your friends in LAN multiplayer modes.
London is full of surprises!

title: Veil of Sight
description: Veil of Sight is a first-person psychological horror game. After disturbing eye experiments, blinking is no longer natural. Explore an abandoned hospital, solve puzzles and survive the doctor who turned your body against you.

title: Atelier Ryza: Ever Darkness & the Secret Hideout DX
description: This expanded version of Atelier Ryza: Ever Darkness & the Secret Hideout adds new story content, playable characters, and gameplay features. The game tells the story of Ryza and her friends as they discover alchemy and explore the secrets of their island.

title: Atelier Ryza 2: Lost Legends & the Secret Fairy DX
description: This DX edition of Atelier Ryza 2: Lost Legends & the Secret Fairy adds new story content, playable characters, and gameplay improvements. Set three years after Atelier Ryza, the game follows Ryza and her friends as they reunite and face new challenges tied to alchemy and personal growth.

title: Atelier Ryza 3: Alchemist of the End & the Secret Key DX
description: This edition of Atelier Ryza 3: Alchemist of the End & the Secret Key adds new story content, characters, and gameplay features. Set one year after Atelier Ryza 2, it follows Ryza and her friends in their final summer as they uncover the roots of alchemy.

title: Moonpath to Elsweyr
description:
Only the Khajiit know the secret paths of the moon that lead the followers of the Mane back to Elsweyr.

Now one of these paths is open to the dova of Skyrim, long thought lost this path leads to a base deep in the hart of the jungles of in Elsweyr. Enjoy the custom tropical foliage, forest queen spiders, river crabs, quests and a uniq

title: NHL 26
description: Play like a superstar in EA Sports NHL 26. That starts with ICE-Q 2.0, now powered by NHL EDGE data, so your favorite superstars think, move, and play like their on-ice selves. That includes data-informed Attributes and Tendencies which make star players perform in true-to-life fashion, with their playstyles and decision-making game-aware and impactful. A fine-tuned and enhanced arsenal of 28 X-Factors spans five different categories and is driven by unique animations, tactical gameplay outcomes, and tiers of impact, turning each into a formidable on-ice weapon. Superstars now truly feel like superstars.

title: Sakuna: Hinuka Junreitan
description: A free-to-play game based on the Sakuna series.

title: Race For Nuts
description:
Save your squirrel tribe from the impending disaster and help other squirrels to escape!
High mountains and icy valleys, hot deserts and bottomless pits await you!
You will find new friends and enemies. The world of the Race For Nuts is waiting for you!

title: Train Sim World 5: Southern BR Class 313 EMU
description: Pep up operations on the South Coast of England with the classic BR Class 313/2, adorned in the distinctive Southern Coastway livery and ready to serve Brighton, Seaford and beyond in Train Sim World: East Coastway.

title: Train Sim World 5: Thameslink BR Class 700/0 EMU Add-On
description: Modern commuting doesn’t get any better than this, experience the state-of-the-art Desiro City and crunch capacity through the Medway Towns with the Thameslink BR Class 700/0, ready for Kentish service in Train Sim World!

title: Train Sim World 5: DB BR 187 Loco Add-On
description: Experience the pinnacle of modern motive power and the latest generation in a long line of classics with Skyhook Games’ DB BR 187 for Train Sim World!

title: Train Sim World 5: ScotRail BR Class 158 Sprinter DMU Add-On
description: Skyhook Games' BR Class 158 makes a new appearance on Scottish routes in Train Sim World 4! Sporting the Saltire insignia of ScotRail, the Class 158 works in tandem with Class 170 and Class 385 traction through the Scottish Lowlands.

title: Train Sim World 5: ScotRail Express: Edinburgh - Glasgow Route Add-On
description: Rapid inter-city action in state-of-the-art traction awaits! Discover Scotland’s two biggest cities and take charge of dense commuter services on ScotRail’s principal rail line. The modern Class 385 is ready for service in Train Sim World: ScotRail Express: Edinburgh - Glasgow.

title: Train Sim World 5: S-Bahn Zentralschweiz: Luzern - Sursee Route Add-On
description: Experience the thrill of racing around tight bends, tackling steep gradients, and providing an intense passenger service in the heart of Switzerland. State-of-the-art traction and systems await with Rivet Games’ S-Bahn Zentralschweiz: Luzern - Sursee!

title: Train Sim World 5: West Somerset Railway Route Add-On
description: Rolling hills, golden meadows and seaside views await along Britain's longest standard gauge preserved line, the West Somerset Railway. Now fully remastered as part of a free update, operate heritage galas with classic British traction in Train Sim World 4!

title: Train Sim World 5: Rhein-Ruhr Osten: Wuppertal - Hagen Route Add-On
description: The hustle and bustle of urban sprawl passenger operations and intermix of freight are yours to experience in Train Sim World 2: Rhein-Ruhr Osten. Take in the scenic backdrop of the North Rhine-Westphalia as you carry out passenger and freight duties.

title: Train Sim World 5: Berninalinie: Tirano - Ospizio Bernina Route Add-On
description: Adventure to the Alps and drive famed RhB services as you climb, descend and weave your way through the cross-border peaks of Switzerland and Italy. You are invited into the stunning landscape of Europe, with Berninalinie for Train Sim World 4!

title: Train Sim World 5: Cajon Pass: Barstow - San Bernardino Route Add-On
description: Experience the challenge of hauling a nation's freight industry on the back of your 4000-horsepower shoulders. Tackle stunning mountain ranges and blinding deserts as you tote tonnage through the winding curves of California with Train Sim World 3: Cajon Pass.

title: Train Sim World 5: West Cornwall Local: Penzance - St Austell & St Ives Route
description: Experience the rolling hills and picturesque countryside of the “Great Western”, aboard classic British diesel traction, with Rivet Games' West Cornwall Local: Penzance - St Austell & St Ives route.

title: Train Sim World 5: Glossop Line: Manchester - Hadfield & Glossop Route Add-On
description: Climb aboard the Northern Class 323 “Hyper Networker” and embark on a journey in Northwest England. Magnificent Mancunian scenery comes to life along the quaint Glossop Line: Manchester - Hadfield & Glossop in Train Sim World!

title: Train Sim World 5: Cargo Line Vol. 1 - Petroleum
description: Discover different freight services with Skyhook Games' Cargo Line for Train Sim World 4. In Volume 1, keep the UK running with modern, VTG-branded TEA tankers, driving heavy fuel-laden services - a flammable challenge awaits.

title: Train Sim World 5: East Coastway: Brighton - Eastbourne & Seaford Route Add-On
description: Experience modern commuter traction along the wonderfully picturesque countryside of Southern England in Train Sim World: East Coastway. Operate your trains over a rail network represented how it is today, complete with modern signalling on a route that defines commuter and seaside rail operations

title: Train Sim World 5: BR Class 20 'Chopper' Loco Add-On
description: A veteran in every right, having been in use since the 1950s, the BR Class 20 “Chopper” has earned its place among enthusiasts’ hearts; and now Type 1 traction comes to life in Train Sim World, ready for hard-working duty on the Tees Valley Line!

title: Train Sim World 5: Main-Spessart Bahn: Aschaffenburg - Gemunden Route Add-On
description: A wondrous mix of steep gradients, scenic hillsides and swooping turns come to life in Train Sim World: Main Spessart Bahn, a timeless freight-heavy and passenger-laden corridor through the heart of the German countryside.

title: Train Sim World 5: Caltrain MP36PH-3C Baby Bullet Loco Add-On
description: Caltrain’s modern and flashy MP36PH-3C diesels have been operating on Baby Bullet services since 2003, and now you can experience them for yourself in Train Sim World! Race southbound from the futuristic cab of the MP36 and be pushed on the return from the immersive Bi-Level Cab Car.

title: Train Sim World 5: Harlem Line: Grand Central Terminal - North White Plains Route Add-On
description: Operate modern and classic equipment as you ferry commuters in and out of the iconic Grand Central Terminal; hurry them across the tightly packed Park Avenue, over the Harlem River, and out to the New York suburbs with Train Sim World: Harlem Line.

title: Train Sim World 5: CSX C40-8W Loco Add-On
description: As created for Train Sim World, the versatile CSX C40-8W is richly detailed and features realistic controls and operating performance. The powerful locomotive wears CSX’s attractive YN2 livery and is authentically suited for duty on Sand Patch Grade.

title: Train Sim World 5: West Cornwall Steam Railtour Add-On
description: Take on a new steam-hauled challenge in Train Sim World, tackle the Cornish countryside with regulator at full blast, race through forestry and power to the end of the line at Penzance in Rivet Games’ West Cornwall Steam Railtour Add-On!

title: Train Sim World 5: BNSF SD70ACe
description: Tackle the harsh and mountainous grades of California in a modern masterpiece; experience heavy freight hauling aboard electro-motive power with an orange twist, battle the summit with Train Sim World 3: BNSF SD70ACe!

title: Train Sim World 5: BR Class 52 Add-On
description: Built to work top-link expresses across British Rail’s Western Region, the Class 52 now spends its days in retirement on heritage railways, and is primed for diesel gala duty on Train Sim World’s freshly remastered West Somerset Railway!

title: Train Sim World 5: Centro Regional Railways BR Class 323 Add-On
description: Return to Birmingham Cross-City in nostalgic fashion with 323 221, freshly sporting the “Centro” variant of Regional Railways livery, to mark 30 years of Class 323 service in the West Midlands, across all-new gameplay, in Train Sim World!

title: Train Sim World 5: Birmingham Cross-City Line: Lichfield - Bromsgrove & Redditch Route Add-On
description: All aboard for Brum! Climb onto one of the most unique modern trains in Britain, delve into dense commuter operations and explore West Midlands territory, including the famed Lickey Incline. Bustling duties await in Train Sim World 3:Birmingham Cross-City Line

title: Train Sim World 5: Clinchfield Railroad: Elkhorn - Dante Route Add-On
description: Experience classic railroading moving heavy coal and manifest freight through the heart of Virginia's coalfields with Train Sim World: Clinchfield Railroad.

title: Train Sim World 5: Rail Operations Group BR Class 37/7 Add-On
description: Take charge of the hardest working locomotives in Britain today; experience unique Unit Drag services, hauling EMUs to and from refurbishment, thrashing throughout the Medway Towns and beyond with Train Sim World: Rail Operations Group BR Class 37/7!

title: Train Sim World 5: Schnellfahrstrecke Koln-Aachen Route Add-On
description: Experience the thrill of high-speed inter-city German rail as you push the throttle through bustling German Metropolis and the rolling open countryside in the exquisite Train Sim World: Schnellfahrstrecke Köln - Aachen.

title: Deadly Metropolis
description: Deadly Metropolis is an intense, fast paced beat 'em up that takes the genre to brutal new heights. The deadliest era is here, a battle rages in the depths of Neo Babylos! Are you ready?!

title: Sweetie Candy Maze: Red Cherry
description: Dive into a vibrant candy world! Collect delicious sweets and find your way through playful red cherry mazes in this sweet and colorful adventure.

title: Popcorn Popstars
description: Build a team of three heroes worthy of the big screen! Popcorn Popstars is a rhythm autobattler where you tap the drums to keep the beat alive. Drop the spotlight on your squad, get the crowd pumped and put on a show-stopping performance.

title: Devils Due
description: DEVIL'S DUE - A hellish slot machine RPG! Face demonic bosses in slot-based combat, collect Lucky Charms, and manage your debt to the Devil. Win big to deal damage, but demons turn your victories against you. Three phases of challenge await. Will you pay the Devil's Due?

title: Neon Divide
description: An action RPG blending mechanical Cthulhu aesthetics with class-based storytelling. Players control a genius girl who, armed with a modular weapon system, fights against three major factions and uncovers the truth behind the breakdown of the pact across two parallel worlds.

title: Pawker
description: Pawker is a supurrr satisfying deckbuilder roguelike where you play as cat adventurers trying to create purrfect combos. Find crazy felines, battle memes, and modify your deck to do insane numbers. Play Pawker meow!

title: Danmaku Unlimited 4 Wyver Ultra
description: Arise Wyver and fly against overwhelming odds in this modern labor of love tribute to classic shoot'em ups!

title: The Bigger Picture
description:
Just Press The Button...
Go through the levels, pressing the buttons as they appear to zoom out and see more of your environment.
Push levers to move platforms and walls.
Get to higher points by jumping into pipes or bouncing on trampolines.
Walk past arrows to pan across the screen and discover more at the current zoom level.
Turn fans on and off to get to blocked areas.

title: Smashy Cannon
description: Aim sharp. Fire fast. Smash everything.

title: Cyber AI Defense
description: Humanity was hacked — except you

title: Back 3: Spooky
description: After escaping the Art Horror Dimension from the last game, the protagonist awakens in an enigmatic faction, only to find his escape companion Gao Yan missing. When interrogated about Gao Yan's whereabouts, Ye Tan – who survived the Haunted Manor Dimension – appears as a member of the faction and rescues you. With her assistance, you enter a wholly distinct new dimension unlike the previous two, embarking on another adventure. In this uncharted dimension, you'll forge new alliances, confront fresh dangers, and your choices will determine the branching paths to multiple endings.

title: Golden Sand Dream Curse
description: The player plays the role of a treasure hunter who pursues wealth but unexpectedly encounters a gift from a mysterious antique dealer and travels to the world in the treasure map. The player will explore and collect clues to battle the boss and complete the shattered memories of their past life.

title: Monativity Surveillance
description: Your duties will be to enter specific sentences and report anomalies in the surveillance video. The period will be 5 days and you are expected to work hard.

title: Animal God
description: Animal God is a rogue-lite turn-based RPG. Players will make a pact with the Mamba Demon and use the power of the Mamba to resurrect the 24 fallen warriors. And in the limited time, train your own team and take the "Stick Mother Search" to go around the world to weaken the power of the Void King.

title: Become Deity
description: Ascending to Immortal "is a horizontal board combat adventure game with a cultivation theme. You are the last bloodline of a cultivation family. In this era of sparse spiritual energy, in this gradually recovering spiritual forest, it will be your last chance to embark on the path of immortality.

title: Life Bug
description: Experience the latest exciting work in PNG's "Life Bug" series. Players can fight and upgrade in the game, control characters, eat ancient bugs, and fight against powerful and terrifying enemies!

title: Necomen
description: Find cats that live in the city and befriend them! This game is about exploring one city and befriending the cats. 5 days later, invite many cats to a festival day.

title: Cat God Ranch:​​ Age of Dinosaurs​
description:
First DLC for Cat God Ranch: Age of Dinosaurs​​ includes:
9 difficulty-tiered rainforest maps
20+ new dinosaur family animals
20+ brand new items
2 new Cat Gods
10+ new achievements
One-click unlock all content feature
Leaderboard reset
And much more!

title: Wild Web
description: This is a relaxing turn based puzzle adventure game. This is a closed island, so hungry. Anyway, first defeat the creatures on the island to fill your stomach, and then walk all the way to the other end of the island.

title: 100 Day Term
description: A casual text game where the player, chosen as a lucky leader, heads the "Economic Efficiency Optimization Department." Under a great president, they must boost economic benefits and government efficiency within 100 days.

title: 100 Cats Lost in Australia Find & Color
description: Grab your crayons and hunt for 200 hidden cats across 2 beautifully hand-drawn maps. Play solo or team up with a friend in local co-op, then bring each scene to life with guided color-by-numbers or your own palette—all in a relaxing, soothing atmosphere.

title: 100 Hiddensaurs: Renaissance
description: Dinosaurs visited the Renaissance. Try to find them all. And get a mini-game. By purchasing DLC, you will get a new level in the game 100 Hiddensaurs. DLC INCLUDE: New level New mini game

title: 100 Hiddensaurs: Medieval
description: This is DLC for 100 Hiddensaurs. The game is drawn by hand.

title: The Scientist Battles
description: The Scientist Battles is a short, narrative-driven game about the human side of science. Step into the shoes of a scientist facing burnout, self-doubt, and pressure in the lab, and explore an introspective story filled with emotional moments. The game also features light 2D combat inspired by laboratory tools.

title: 100 Hidden Cats: The Mill DLC
description: This is a hidden object game set in a black and white 3D world.

title: 100 Hidden Cats: The Island DLC
description: This is a hidden object game set in a fantasy 3D world.

title: 100 Cats Lost In Poland: Extra Content
description: This DLC unlocks an extra Poland-themed level, where even more mischievous cats are waiting to be found and colored. Explore the scene, spot every kitty, and bring it to life with color-by-number! THIS DLC INCLUDES: 1 extra level 100 new hidden cats Full color-by-number mode for the new scene

title: 100 Romantic Cats: Extra Content
description: By purchasing DLC, you will get extra content in the game Get an extra level with 100 more adorable cats!

title: Banana Ninja vs. 100 Mann
description: A gorilla. One hundred men. And you're caught in the middle. No story, no talk. Just you, pure violence, and 100 Mann asking for trouble.

title: Can you clear up to 100 stages?
description: Don't be fooled by the cute appearance. This game ruthlessly tests your reflexes, concentration, and patience. Jump, dodge, and try again. How far can you go?

title: Idle to Level 1000
description: This is a 2D idle game. You can choose 8 professions to team up and fight monsters and brush equipment. By selecting different attributes for different professions and adding points, the combat effectiveness of the character can be significantly improved.

title: Octane100
description: Join the fight against a corrupt oil corporation flooding the world with low-quality fuel in a turn-based roguelite adventure. Switch between intense battles and peaceful exploration to bring a better future to the world.

title: Velocity Racing: 1000
description: A sleek, customizable arcade-style racer built by a solo developer. Unlock 21+ cars, race across 5 detailed maps, tweak every setting, and compete solo or in co-op via Steam lobbies.

title: Lost my Collection of 100 Shells
description: Lost my Collection of 100 Shells is a casual 2D hidden object game with a hand-drawn and relaxing aesthetic.

title: Battle Spirit CrossOver: [BSC41] Greatest Record 2023 Rare Card Set
Irradiate 235
description: Discover and automate unique materials. Engineer the machines and tools for your factory. Handle hazardous materials to make explosives and near-limitless energy. Use your own tools to navigate a labyrinth of alien passages and uncover untouched tunnels in this innovative Automation-Metroidvania.

title: Seed 2313
description: Seed 2313 blends top-down bullet-hell shooting with tower defense. You'll explore an infinite, randomized future world, travel between cities, build structures with various functions, and battle fiercely in ever-changing levels.

title: Car For Sale Simulator 2023: PickUp & SUV
City Transport Simulator: Bus
description: Become a real driver and experience the most immersive and authentic bus simulation to date in City Transport Simulator: Bus! Drive highly detailled and licensed real-world buses, build and customize your own transport company, plan routes and grow your network across a European-inspired city.

title: City Transport Simulator: E1 Vienna Add-On
description: The E1 first arrived on Viennese streets in 1966, and while similar in appearance to their Type E predecessors, they came equipped with a much powerful motor.

title: City Transport Simulator: Bus DLC - Gräf/Steyr NG235
description: The NG235 offers deep simulation with analog systems and a more hands-on driving style. It was the first Viennese Low-floor Bus and offers enough depth for players who enjoy a slightly older vehicle setup.

title: City Transport Simulator: Bus DLC - MAN Lion's City A23
description: The Articulated MAN Lions City A23 brings added capacity and complexity to your fleet. With up to four doors and dynamic joint physics, the A23 challenges players to manage longer vehicles in busy urban traffic while maintaining passenger satisfaction.

title: City Transport Simulator: GT8N Mannheim​ Add-On
description: The GT8N is a renovation of the GT6, having been equipped with a low-floor middle section and converted to eight-axles trams in the 1990s.

title: City Transport Simulator: StadtRegioTram Add-On
description: This fully electric tram can achieve a maximum speed of 70kph and has a passenger carrying capacity of 160 people - It's a real fan favourite!

title: City Transport Simulator: Type D Vienna Add-On
description: With a striking red and white livery, this tram was specifically designed for the city of Vienna and made its first appearance on Viennese streets in 2018.

title: City Transport Simulator: Tram Depot + Southern-Route Add-On
description: Experience the most exciting map expansion for CTS: Tram yet!

title: Coffee Shop "Keyhole"
description: This is a mystery adventure game where you run a coffee shop and explore the mysteries of this coffee shop and this town! This coffee shop has some secrets Main character quit his job as a locksmith and rented a property last month to run a coffee shop. But this property seems to have a history...

title: Coffee Beans
description: Coffee Beans - A fun and challenging Match 3 Type Game

title: Capture Catcoffee
description: You will play the role of a cat cafe operator and go through the mysterious door to adventure in the cat kingdom. You can meet various cats, defeat them and hire them as your own cat employees! Bring your own cat, build your own cat cafe, and enjoy delicious food from another world!

title: Anomalous Coffee Machine 2
description: In this game, meet a mysterious girl who demands you use an "Anomalous Coffee Machine". Type any word to create a drink, then choose who drinks: her or you. Some cups whisper, some scream, some change what you are. She watches quietly, like she already knows what you’ll choose. Now it's your turn!

title: Turkish Coffee Daily
description: Run your own Turkish coffeehouse! Take weird orders, wipe messy tables, brew legendary tea. Upgrade your place, deal with grumpy customers, and try not to spill the coffee. One chair, one player, endless drama...

title: Wiener Coffee
description: Wiener Coffee is a 3D action game where a wiener protagonist adventures toward a coffee cup.With simple jump & retry controls, you'll start over if you fall to the floor! The unique stages and surreal character are what make this game special.

title: Drinking Song
description: 3D grass-cutting game: Players need to control their characters to avoid continuously respawning monsters. After the monsters respawn, they will chase the player. Upon contact, the player will lose health until they die. Players can craft equipment using materials to enhance their survival abilities

title: Drink Factory Simulator
description: Build your own drink factory, discover recipes, improve production, and fulfill customer orders to grow your beverage empire! Drink Factory Simulator is a fun simulation game that combines creativity and strategy.

title: Cozy Factory
description: Cozy Factory is a relaxing automation game that lets you design your own production line to make cakes in the shape, flavor, and color your customers want. Place the machines correctly, complete the orders, and enjoy a sweet production flow!

title: Coin Factory 2
description: Welcome to Coin Factory 2. An idle game about placing tiles strategically to make as many coins as possible. Level them up to get the numbers growing or make them evolve to adapt your play to new needs!

title: Car Factory Empire
description: Create a car company from scratch! Go from the first mechanical carriages to luxurious racing cars! Design cars, sell them, participate in races, expand your company and lead it to market dominance!

title: Room Football: Abandoned Factory
description: Puzzle, artillery, casual puzzle video game with realistic physics.

title: Recycling Factory
description: Your goal in this horror game is simple: collect bodies, get rid of them, and find a way out. But in this dark place, everything is dangerous. Solve puzzles and escape the fear that surrounds you.

title: ModernFactory
description: 3D fixed perspective, unique level, just press the spacebar to push the wrong robot into the ruins to get points. Note: There were only 5 chances of turnover.

title: MegaFactory Tycoon
description: In MegaFactory Tycoon, you are the manager of a fully automated factory. The factory produces consumer products that can be sold for profit on the central market. The factory is fully simulated in real-time.

title: Mannequin: Factory
description: Assemble and pack orders in a mannequin factory. It's your weekend shift alone and your job is simple... But something's off.

title: Irobot Factory
description: Solve logic puzzles and obstacle courses in this robot simulation game! Immerse yourself in the exciting world of robotics and programming! Create your own robot, connect logic blocks and teach it to solve challenging tasks!

title: Geometry Factory
description: Geometry Factory is a minimalist puzzle game. Use basic geometric elements such as points, lines, circles, etc. to build infinite possible graphics on the panel, complete the score goals in the exquisite level puzzles, and feel the beauty of geometry and mathematics.

title: Frustration Factory
description: Frustration Factory is an asset management puzzle game requiring concentration, patience and thinking ahead. Each level will challenge you to carefully direct game pieces down an increasingly complex series of conveyor belts to eventually assemble and ship finished products to waiting customers.

title: Factory Reset
description: Stop moving, and you explode.A 2.5D precision platformer where momentum means survival. Dash through a decaying factory ruled by a sarcastic AI. Avoid death, unlock hidden logs, and endure the relentless commentary of REACTOR. It’s watching. Always.

title: The Meat Factory
description: The world has gone to ruin, communities slowly dwindle, and food is scarce. Folks have heard rumors of an operation on the rise to solve the food shortage... but at what cost?

title: The Gears: Factory
description: [The Gears: Factory] is a third-person 3D factory-building game where the player's main goal is to build automated systems by mining minerals and producing industrial units.

title: The Factory
description: The Factory is a first-person, factory sim game with machine purchasing, upgrading, and building expansion. Use income from crafted products to buy and upgrade tools and buildings. Upgrade your factory layout to gain infinite wealth while trying not to lose money from damaging products.

title: Satisfactory Modeler
description: Model your Satisfactory builds. Set up your machines however you like, adding optional limits to the number of any of those machines and the tool will calculate how the parts will flow and how many of each machine type are getting used.

title: Warno: RP #5 - Valley and Factory
description: Expand the WARNO battlefields for free with two new massive maps as part of Reinforcement Pack #5, featuring the rugged Valley and the industrial Factory maps.

title: Rune Factory: Guardians of Azuma - Super Digital Deluxe DLC Set
description:
This premium set contains the following items:
Rune Factory: Guardians of Azuma - Seasons of Love Bundle
Pilika's Bonding Stories

title: 99 Managers Futsal Edition
description: An open-source Futsal team-management game. Build a world-class Futsal team, find new talents and a tactic that fit's your play style. Become the best Futsal Manager and win all competitions on national and international levels.

title: 99999 Ryo
description: Bet on which dueling ninja will emerge victorious! Win, and you get double your wager!Lose, and you lose it all! Start with 100 ryō and aim for the maximum of 99,999 ryō! A pure test of luck—no strategy required!

"99%" is a first-person survival horror puzzle game set in an eerie research facility. The protagonist, having lost all memories, explores the twisted and terrifying environment in a desperate attempt to escape.

title: 1899: Secrets of the Maze
description: "1899: Secrets of the Maze" is a survival journey in a mysterious labyrinth. Subject No. 3 embarks on an adventure triggered by a Rubik's cube, battling zombies, setting traps, and uncovering the secrets of Dimension Technology Lab.

title: Death Stairwell 99F
description: You are trapped in a stairwell, and as you delve deeper, the stairwell becomes increasingly abnormal and dangerous. Abnormal event, unknown monster, can you escape alive.

title: Dark 4799
description: The game is set in the basement of a house as well as in the house itself where the player is trapped by an evil witch in the basement of the house.

title: Everfall 1999
description: A very basic cyberpunk action game.

title: Simulator of Ukraine 1991: Play for Canada
description: DLS gives the opportunity to play for Canada

title: Simulator of Ukraine 1991: Play for Germany
description: DLS gives the opportunity to play for Germany

title: Simulator of Ukraine 1991: Play for Lithuania
description: DLS gives the opportunity to play for Lithuania

title: Simulator of Ukraine 1991: Play for Poland
description: DLS makes it possible to play for Poland

title: Simulator of Ukraine 1991: Play for United Kingdom
description: DLS allows you to play for the United Kingdom

title: Galactic Plague 2000
description: A classic shoot 'em up with a modern edge. Galactic Plague throws you into a cosmic nightmare where survival means upgrading your ship, mastering legendary weapons, and battling the relentless Martian invasion. Are you ready to face the chaos?

title: Time Gamers: 12000 Years in One Square Mile
description: You have just been trained and certified as a "Time Gamer". Your first task is to travel back in time to the area of the longest running period of continuous human history in the United States. There, you must collect the DNA of extinct animals and important people of the past.

title: SZ2000
description: a southern town in the year of 2000, in the melting summer, kid rabbits without adult supervision are sent to the daycare, how do they spend time in this long summer ..?

title: HyperTyper 2000
description: Type, dodge, parry, and survive in HyperTyper 2000! A hybrid typing/bullet hell game where both halves of the action are nonstop! Test your typing skills with one hand and dodge with the other.

title: Hymer 2000
description: Hymer 2000 is an interactive text puzzle game, where players freely converse with the "Hymer" and use an open "Search" function to retrieve past conversations. By discovering keywords, gathering clues, and collecting "Faces", players uncover Hymer's secrets and ultimately shut it down.

title: Car Mechanic Simulator 2021: Taxi DLC
description:
Available Models in the Taxi DLC:
Liner Navigator – an American street legend and an enduring symbol of New York taxis.
CAB Roamer – a classic British taxi with iconic styling and unmatched maneuverability.
Olsen Pramie Club – a luxurious German taxi that combines elegance with reliability.
Lacroix Marseille – available in two versions: classic French model with sleek lines and a comfortable interior, perfect for city streets and a unique special edition!
Sakura Tiara– an icon of Japanese taxis, celebrated for its dependability and comfort.
Bolt Escapade Mk IV – a popular choice in the USA, known for its spaciousness and comfortable ride.

DLC also includes a selection of 8 customizable taxi roof lights for you to choose from! Select from a range of modern and classic styles inspired by different regions around the world, including the USA, Germany, the UK, Japan and France.
Tailor each taxi to suit your style and bring a touch of international flair!

title: Dune: Awakening - Dune Film Stillsuit
description: Don the Dune (2021) Film Stillsuit, and survive the desert like a true Fremen.

title: BankingSim
description: BankingSim puts you in charge of a growing bank. Issue loans, set interest rates, manage risk, and deal with defaults as you grow your financial empire.

title: DOBA: Dogs Battle Arena
description: All urban packs of dogs need an alpha, and when it comes to rule over parks, dogs have their own ways! Splat pee all around to claim territory or knock your rivals using your crafted set of the craziest skills ever found in a battle arena.

title: Book of Fei
description: Lead adorable warriors to form an adventure team to work and adventure on the computer desktop. Defeat the warriors to save the world. Rich nurturing and collection elements, idle and slack off to earn money and fight monsters!

title: Blue Book
description: Blue Book is a visual novel that blends science fiction and detective genres. Investigate mysterious disappearances in a small provincial town as an FBI agent. Interrogate residents, analyze their words, and uncover the secret: are the kidnappings caused by people… or something else?

title: Booklet's Big Story
description: Booklet is the only empty storybook in all of the Grand Library! Journey alongside them as they wrestle with feelings of unbelonging while striving to find their own story in this 3D puzzle platformer.

title: Book of Decisions
description: A game in the Chatbot Roleplay category.Among the ancient Egyptian ruins, a book is found, and in our game, we talk to this book. The book answers everything we write. The book's general power is that everything written in it becomes real in the world, but we discuss the consequences with the book.

title: Comic Book Store Simulator
description: Manage your very own comic book store and unlock over 70+ comics, each having 5 volumes & unique art in this casual simulation game!

title: Corner BookShop
description: A Magical Journey into the World of Picture Books Step into Corner Bookshop, where picture books come to life and stories await in every corner. In collaboration with Dreaming Kite Corp., this virtual bookshop brings Dreaming Kite’s inspiring picture books vividly to life.

title: Fakebook
description: Point-and-click mystery adventure on the virtual SNS! Find secrets hidden by family, friends, companies, and idols.

title: Ascension Gamebook
description: A 2d6 dice narrative adventure game book. Play as an acolyte of the Gilded Order. Venture out on quests with the Spellbook of Sky under the guise of the Ancients. Death and folly reign in this world of Dungeons and Dragons, where the realm is torn under warring clans you'll come to discover.

title: I Wanna Kill The Kamilia 2
description: I Wanna Kill The Kamilia 2 is an I Wanna Be The Guy fangame made by Influcca and it is the second entry of the medley game series "Kill The Kamilia". This is a sequel/remake to I Wanna Kill The Kamilia, a game originally made by oyo. Your mission is to, once again, defeat The Kamilia, but this time the challenges are much tougher and the stage remixes are much better refined.

title: Baron: The Real Estate Simulation
description: A turn-based real estate simulation where players speculate in the American property market over 60 months, buying and selling properties, trading options, and taking out loans. Starting with $35,000 and the rank of Novice, the goal is to accumulate a net worth of $1,000,000 to achieve the title of Baron. Up to 14 players can track their progress, though only one plays at a time.

title: Barrel Patrol 3D
description: Barrel Patrol 3D is an arcade-style 3D shooter in which you protect fuel cells from enemy attackers inside circular arena levels. Gameplay mixes fast-paced shooting and defense across progressively harder waves, with simple controls and retro-style graphics.

title: Santa's Adventure
description: Lost in the North Pole, Santa must find his way back to the factory. In this retro 2D platformer, jump past hazards, master tough levels, and face the challenge of Hard Mode. Christmas won’t wait.

title: Running With Rifles 2
description: The fan-favorite top-down tactical shooter is back! Bigger, smarter, and more tactical than ever. RUNNING WITH RIFLES 2 builds on the acclaimed RUNNING WITH RIFLES with fresh possibilities and familiar charm.

title: HorrorToleranceTest
description: A horror game that challenges you to play three different games and diagnoses your tolerance for fear. “Surprise fear,” “hiding fear,” “escaping fear”—are you tolerant of all types of fear?

title: Omen
description: Infiltrate the remnants of a fallen empire in this dark sci-fi isometric action game where extraction meets base defense. Extract valuable loot, establish defenses against hostile fanatics, and unlock the gateway to a dimension of cosmic dread that defies comprehension.

title: Metal Combat
description: The owner of the landfill, Scrappy Muldune, has agreed to bury toxic waste. But he had no idea that the landfill would live and become the progenitor of metal monsters - Dominators. Now they are joined in a deadly battle for the right to become the Sovereign of toxic waste!

title: Retail Simulator
description: Retail Simulator is a 1-4 Co-op game where you build your dream store from scratch in this immersive retail experience. Design the layout with our custom build mode, stock shelves, order inventory. Customize your store's look to attract customers. Choose your scale, from local shop to mega-store.

title: Liminal Industries
description:
As you find yourself inside the endelessly changing and evolving backrooms.

You realise that the only thing standing between you and your escape, is building your own automated factory in the middle of this liminal place.

Explore, conquer and industrialise the backrooms with tech and magic. Collect and repurpose forgotten furniture to fuel your automation endeavours. Evolve your factory using a completely customised multi-chaptered tech tree. Push your creations to their limits to escape into the overworld.

title: Harem of Lust
description: A strategic collectible card game with deep deckbuilding, explosive combos, and flirty social twists-featuring bold visuals, powerful heroines, and hundreds of unique cards to collect.

title: Plagun: The Plague Goes On
description: A plague-mutated doctor fights through wave after wave of infected husks in this fast-paced roguelike pixel shooter. Equip cursed masks, wield biomechanical weapons, and mutate your build as you survive a kingdom undone by immortality.

title: Ire: A Prologue
description: WHAT IF HIDE AND SEEK WAS LIFE AND DEATH? It’s 1986, and you're stranded on a ship in the Bermuda Triangle. Everyone is missing — but you’re not alone. You’re trapped in a terrifying loop with a monster, and you’ll have to stay one step ahead to survive. Ready or not, here it comes.

title: OF Model Simulator
description: From first post to full-blown icon - manage fans, cash, and chaos in the ultimate exclusive model simulator. Fame has never been this hands-on.

title: Recycling Station Simulator
description: The ultimate recycling business challenge awaits you.

title: Meteor Break Mission
description: Meteor Break Mission is a 2D arcade shooter where you control a cannon to destroy falling meteors, earn points and money, and upgrade your health, fire rate, and shot power. Survive as long as you can and aim for the highest score!

title: Terminator: Dark Fate - Defiance: Uprising
description: Command the Resistance in a dynamic, sandbox campaign across 22 sectors. Make strategic choices, manage resources, and fight Legion, Cartel, and more in a living world where every move shapes the outcome.

title: Bunkers 1944 FPS
description: Infiltrate. Eliminate. Obliterate.

title: Intuitive Level Design
description: "Intuitive Level Design" is an interactive course designed for aspiring game developers. Find and activate commentary nodes scattered throughout the game to learn about the core principles of intuitive level design, illustrated with dozens of practical examples. Learn while having fun!

title: Quarantine Area
description: Trust your instincts. The future depends on it.

title: Tung Tung Sahur Extreme
description: It’s not just a game — it’s TUNG TUNG time.

title: Ultrashot: Kill Protocol
description: When the system fails, the protocol begins.

title: Sandspeed: Camel Racing
description: Forget SUPERCARS, this is how real legends race! Dash through endless dunes, Outrun your rivals, and gobble up power-ups to stay in the lead. It's wild, it's fast — do you have what it takes to become the ultimate Egyptian champion?

title: Quarantine Zone: Border Zombie Checkpoint
description: Control the border, safeguard countless lives.

title: Sushi Attack
description: Sushi Attack is a playful arcade shooter where you control a single animated chopstick to defend your wasabi from waves of mischievous sushi invaders. With vibrant visuals and escalating challenges, it’s a fun twist on a classic arcade experience.

title: TrackDown: Genesis
description: The Most Realistic Sprinting Game to date! • The right balance between arcade like fun and real-world sprinting simulation. • How Fast Can You Go?

title: MX vs. ATV: Legends - 2025 AMA Pro Motocross Championship
description: Compete like the pros on 12 official tracks from the 2025 AMA Pro Motocross Championship, including the legendary Loretta Lynn's!

title: Police Officers Simulator
description: Step into the uniform and protect the city you serve!

title: Ship Simulator: Ocean Fishing
description:
Embark on the Ultimate Ocean Fishing Adventure!
In SHIP SIMULATOR: OCEAN FISHING, you are an independent fisherman starting with nothing but an old boat and the open sea. Navigate coastal waters in search of fish, crabs, and rare seafood, then sell your catch at bustling ports – each offering different prices, challenges, and opportunities.
Every voyage is a test of skill and strategy. Monitor your fuel, adapt to realistic water physics, and face the ever-changing moods of the ocean – from calm sunrises wrapped in fog to raging storms that push your ship to its limits.

title: Construction Sim: City and Road Builder
description: Take the reins of your own construction company and transform a small contracting gig into an industry-leading empire. In Construction Sim: City and Road Builder, every job is a stepping stone — from hauling materials and clearing sites to assembling massive bridges, paving roads, and even installing wind turbines.

title: Nocturnomaly
description: You're heading home from school. Something feels off. Observe your surroundings carefully to escape the endless street.

title: Retrowave Need For Speed Drift
description: Retrowave Need for Speed Drift (also known as Retrowave Drift) is an arcade speed game developed and published by ChangeMe for PC. A driving game that, despite its name, has nothing to do with the famous Electronic Arts series, in which we have to drive with vibrant, 80s-style neon colors, while listening to electronic synthesizer music, and overtake cars at full speed to get the best scores.

title: Real Boxing 2: Remastered - Jax Stone DLC
description: Play as the legendary Jax Stone and relive his journey to the top!

title: Chud Logic's: Gockbound
description: Chud Logic is isekai’d into a cursed commentary world. To escape, he must recover his leaked DMs and reach the elusive Princess Gock. A darkly comedic, turn-based RPG parody with retro pixel art and internet drama.

title: Real Boxing 2: Remastered - Lord Maywinner DLC
description: Play as the legendary Lord Maywinner and relive his journey to the top!

title: Real Boxing 2: Remastered - Landon Phil DLC
description: Play as the legendary Landon Phil and relive his journey to the top!

title: Real Boxing 2: Remastered - Masaru DLC
description: Play as the legendary Masaru and relive his journey to the top!

title: Metal Gear Solid Delta: Snake Eater - Deluxe Edition
description:
The Deluxe Edition includes:
• Metal Gear Solid △ Snake Eater Day One Edition
• DLC Uniform White Tuxedo
• Sneaking DLC Pack bonus items:
– Uniform: Battle Dress (Peace Walker ver.)

title: Blackout Football Manager
description: Blackout Football Manager is a football-club management sim where you build a squad, devise training plans and tactics, upgrade facilities, handle high-level finances, and join local and international federations (guilds). A card-based management system lets you boost players on the field, heal injuries, and train harder, while players’ distinct mental and physical attributes shape match strategy. Scout opponents, trade on an in-game market, and unlock tech trees to expand infrastructure, refine training regimes, and customize formations on the path to league success.

title: Jump Fucker
description: Jump Fucker is an adult platformer that combines classic platform jumping mechanics with steamy, sexual content.

title: The Protagonist
description: The Protagonist is a narrative-driven psychological horror game set 635 years after the sun died. You play as Varon, a man searching the underground ruins of humanity for his missing daughter.

title: Druggiemon: Lost Edition
description: The Lost Edition is an arbitrary placement in the Druggiemon franchise timeline, it’s more of a paradoxical prequel/sequel as in the beginning and the end combined, as well as a “timeline that should not exist” so you have to beat the game to destroy it. And the lore ties in with Druggiemon’s main story either way for the God Druggiemon and Anti-God (legendary Druggiemon are called Divine Druggiemon)

title: Shadow at school
description: The maraviwonderful adventure of gaster during a week of clasess

title: Dead Epidemic
description: Dead Epidemic is a total conversion for the game Land of the Dead: Road to Fiddlers Green. The game contains a variety of new enhancements for a brand new single player experience.

title: Escape Protocol
description: Escape Protocol is a multiplayer indie horror game in which you must maintain the abandoned facility of Necrova Industries, while avoiding what lurks beneath the surface.

title: OwlBox: Fantasy Gaming System
description:
OwlBox: Fantasy Gaming System is a compilation of games (described as a "gaming system" in marketing) where a common theme are pixelated graphics, simple gameplay and all characters/units being owls, with major updates including new titles. Games included are:

-Owl Bottlecap Mania (since 1.0) - a game in which the player moves bottlecaps with different abilities on a grid
-Owlboxer (since 1.1) - a first-person boxing game
-Legends of Owltopia (since 1.2) - a fantasy first-person role-playing game with top-down turn-based combat

title: Donut Riders
description: Donut Riders is an exciting racing and combat game. Customize your favorite donut and send it speeding through chaotic, destructible tracks, open worlds where no race is ever the same, and arenas for epic battles. Collect power-ups, attack, and defend yourself with awesome dual-function weapons.

title: Battlefield 6: Phantom Edition
description:
The Phantom Edition is an upgraded version of Battlefield 6.

It includes:
BF Pro Token: grants the first Battle Pass, 25 tier skips, and exclusive unlocks.
Phantom Pack: a collection of cosmetic items such as 4 soldier skins, two weapon skins, a melee knife skin, a vehicle skin, a weapon sticker, a weapon charm, and a dog tag.
Phantom XP Boost Set: temporary boosts for weapon and career XP rates.
Pre-order Bonus (Tombstone Pack): includes cosmetic items and XP boosts regardless of edition

title: Akashic Slingshot
description: Fight your way through a diverse world in this action-adventure side scroller, where you are given one weapon and die in one hit. Can you earn the right to peer beyond the Zeroed Abyss?

title: Rescue Team: Lights. Camera. Outer Space
description: What began as the ultimate sci-fi blockbuster has become a worldwide threat: robots, practical effects, and experimental technology now threaten the entire ecosystem. As tempers flare, betrayal brews. Someone threatens to sabotage the entire project.

title: Alien Morgue
description: Sci-fi pathologist simulator. Identify aliens, detect damages, and perform autopsies to determine the cause of death. Choose to follow protocols or fulfill special requests when handling bodies and their stuff. Your choices may have global consequences.

title: My Bookshop Dreams
description: A cozy bookshop management sim where you run, customize, and expand your dream bookstore. Restock shelves, host author events, play mini-games, and collect literary works as you grow your reputation across cities—and maybe even planets.

title: Business trip
description: You are on a business trip and will be stayin 3 nights at a business hotel. If you find anomaly in your room, you contact the front desk. If there is nothing wrong with the room, you will sleep in the bed.

title: Ashes of the Singularity II
description: In this massive RTS game, command vast armies fighting for control of entire worlds. Control the forces of Earth, the mechanical AI Substrate, or the enigmatic Post-Human Coalition as you battle across the solar system in single player, cooperative multiplayer, or competitive multiplayer.

title: Barbie: Horse Trails
description: Giddy up! Play as Barbie and Barbie in a new open-world adventure through Canterbury Trails Park with your horse, Lucky. Become a Junior Ranger and help give the already amazing park a fresh new look for everyone to enjoy. Gallop through wildflower fields and other beautiful landscapes. Tackle fun side missions with friends, capture amazing photos, dig up ceramics, and search for the mystery horse. Find chests filled with collectibles and add sparkle to Barbie and Lucky’s looks. From the cozy cabins to the lively campsite there is plenty to unlock and discover. Ride along on this wild adventure and see!

title: Concierge
description: Concierge is a challenging, suspenseful nonlinear adventure about an old man and an older hotel. Discover your identity and explore your purpose in a surrealistic world of puzzles and trials of every sort. You're on your own - but you are not alone.

title: Peregrino
description: Peregrino is a dark isometric survival adventure where you explore a cursed forest by day and manage your caravan by night. Gather resources, hunt deadly creatures, upgrade your caravan, care for your companions, and lead them through the vast wilderness in search of New Eden.

title: Shadow Project
description: Shadow Project is a narrative-focused, horror FPS that takes place during the fall of the Soviet Union. Immerse yourself in a world of brutal historical fiction, where the events of the late 20th century have taken a dark turn.

title: HMUR
description: Clock in. Survive the shift. HMUR is a brutal, fast-paced FPS where one shot can kill and ammo is precious. An ordinary factory worker must blast his way through a facility gone violently out of control — before he loses his grip on reality.

title: For What Will Come: Reimagined
description: A narrative-driven psychological mystery where time twists and secrets wait to be uncovered. Return home, explore the past, and shape your future in this hauntingly emotional adventure.

title: SculptrVR
description:
Create sprawling, brilliant worlds and explore them with your friends! Invite your friends to an online game, then race to the finish with hang-gliders, or switch to climbing mode for even more fun.

Discover thousands of amazing creations in the interactive gallery then remix them however you want! When you're happy with your creation, you can upload to the SculptrVR content gallery and let others see the incredible things you've made.

Unleash your creativity by building with SculptrVR’s intuitive and fun creation tools. Then destroy it all with rockets!

Add mind-boggling detail with SculptrVR's voxel tech and 10,000X zoom.

Export everything you’ve made to FBX or OBJ for 3D printing or sharing online!

Procedurally generate landscapes, then delve underground, but be careful not to delve too deep!

There’s a million ways to have fun in SculptrVR and in your world, anything is possible.

title: Serious Sam 4: Reborn
description: Serious sam 4 but if are Goofy and Less serious on his story.

title: Azaran: The Demon Bottle
description: A short dungeon crawler packed with monsters, traps, and cryptic puzzles. Made in 3 weeks as a companion to Azaran: Islands of the Jinn.

title: Hatastrophe
description: An adventure platformer where your hat is more than just a tool; it’s your lifeline. Use it to float, climb, and cross impossible gaps in a journey shaped by emotion, memory, and change.

title: Black Tower Enigma
description: Puzzle-Solving Game Boy Adventure about an Orc inside a Mysterious Tower looking for his Wife

title: Tommy and the Monster Prison
description: A point-and-click stealth adventure. The player must disarm traps and reach the chests, which open the prison gates without being detected. Eighty stages set in a dark, medieval dungeon atmosphere teeming with monsters.

title: Wilderless: Meadowfell
description: Welcome to Meadowfell, the newest addition to the Wilderless series - a cozy open-world game crafted for those who seek to unwind and explore at their own pace. Immerse yourself in a serene, untamed wilderness designed for relaxation and creativity, perfect for players who enjoy non-violent exploration and cozy escapes.

title: Mecha Survivors
description: Mecha Survivors is a fast-paced Survivors-like where you pilot a combat mech to purge alien-infested planets. Dodge, upgrade, and adapt as you fight endless waves in this sci-fi roguelite bullet hell.

title: Inferis: Dead Below
description: You're a journalist searching for answers... but beneath the surface lies only terror. The labyrinth you’ve entered to find the missing may never let you leave.

title: The Home County
description: Build your dream village in The Home County! Work alongside skilled villagers to build a flourishing community. Pursue charming hobbies, mine treasures, and explore a world inspired by the British countryside.

title: Out Of Water
description: OUT OF WATER is a visual novel about survival, myths, love, and choice. In 1 CE Watarholt, a quiet village prepares for winter - until bodies begin to surface. Shape your path through bonds, ancient horrors, and a fading peace. Will you fight, plead, or surrender to the waters?

title: The Mightiest Sword is Mine!
description: A clicker game where you can enjoy limitless growth! Strengthen your skills to embark on a journey aiming for the strongest in your preferred playstyle!

title: The Cruciball
description: An action roguelike played by throwing balls at enemies that are projected in the real world! Adventure across strange lands, collect upgrades, and find secrets. Grow your strength, refine yourself in The Cruciball, and save your pet from the nefarious Warlock!

title: Mesopotamia: The Game
description: Mesopotamia: The Game is a historical adventure where you engage in farming, blacksmithing, soldiering as you uncover secrets, gather allies, and rise to power. Experience rich storytelling, strategic gameplay, deep character interactions and moral dilemmas in a quest for vengeance and justice.

title: Happy Runner
description: A classic and severe one-button run game. It is a difficult stage, but if you keep saying "I AM SO HAPPY." you will survive. Even if you are not happy, you have to say you are happy to survive. It's just like modern society.

title: Train Sim World 5: Arosalinie: Chur - Arosa Route Add-On
description: Experience nail-biting gradients, stunning Swiss scenery and classic motive power with Rivet Games Train Sim World: Arosalinie!

title: Train Sim World 5: Bahnstrecke Bremen - Oldenburg Route Add-On
description: Take a trip to the late 2000s and experience frequent regional passenger and heavy freight services, be in control of classic and modern traction as you traverse through the heart of Northern Germany.

title: Train Sim World 5: DB BR 403 ICE 3 Railbow Add-On
description: Add a splash of colour and ride in high-speed pride on Deutsche Bahn’s iconic ICE services; from the 10-year anniversary of DB’s pride initiative, to the many parades and celebrations throughout Germany. Embrace love and diversity with Train Sim World 3: DB BR 403 ICE 3 Railbow!

title: Train Sim World 5: DB BR 363 Loco Add-On
description: A true veteran of the rails, the DB BR 363 has spent decades on shunting duties and light freight work throughout Germany, and you can experience this for yourself along the stunning Ruhr Valley in Train Sim World!

title: Train Sim World 5: New Journeys - Silver 1972 Stock Add-On
description: Relive the classic days of the Underground, take on new challenges and explore more on Bakerloo Line with Train Sim World: New Journeys – Silver 1972 Stock.

title: Train Sim World 5: RhB Anniversary Collection Add-On
description: Climb aboard an eclectic mix of authentic and detailed Ge 4/4 II locomotives in celebratory liveries, and experience the wintry Alps from the classic observation coach, with Rivet Games’ RhB Anniversary Collection for the challenging Arosalinie.

title: Train Sim World 5: Bakerloo Line Route Add-On
description: Experience the hustle and bustle of packed-in commuters, trains every few minutes, the echo of screeching rails in tunnels with the classic Bakerloo Line, rendered in its entirety within Train Sim World!

title: Train Sim World 5: Tees Valley Line: Darlington – Saltburn-by-the-Sea Route Add-On
description: Experience a bygone era of British Rail in the historic birthplace of railways and the heart of the British Steel industry. Operate your trains over an aging rail network on a route deep in transition between old and new.

title: Train Sim World 5: Hauptstrecke Munchen - Augsburg Route
description: Race through Bavaria and experience the hustle and bustle of modern commuting with Train Sim World 2: Hauptstrecke München - Augsburg. It's your job to operate Inter-City Express and S-Bahn services across the busy München - Augsburg railway.

title: Train Sim World 5: Blackpool Branches: Preston - Blackpool & Ormskirk Route Add-On
description: The 1980s beckon and bumpy rides abound! Experience the infamous Pacer across multiple lines in the North of England. Just Trains make their show-stopping debut into Train Sim World with Blackpool Branches: Preston - Blackpool & Ormskirk!

title: Train Sim World 5: Niddertalbahn: Bad Vilbel - Stockheim Route Add-On
description: Take to the rails of Germany with no wires in sight! Experience diesel traction from a bygone era, and shuttle along the picturesque fields and rivers of Hesse in TSG's authentic 1990s recreation of Niddertalbahn: Bad Vilbel - Stockheim for Train Sim World 3!

title: Train Sim World 5: Tharandter Rampe: Dresden - Chemnitz Route Add-On
description: Lean into yesteryear and experience the challenge of unique tilting diesel traction. Power out of Dresden, tackle steep gradients bordered by forest, and drive through the picturesque valleys of Saxony and beyond to Chemnitz with Train Sim World: Tharandter Rampe.

title: Train Sim World 5: Northeast Corridor: New York - Trenton
description: Experience the City that never sleeps. From the Big Apple to New Jersey suburbs, non-stop action awaits aboard premier electric traction. Serve the East Coast well with NJ TRANSIT and Amtrak passenger equipment, brought to life in Train Sim World: Northeast Corridor: New York - Trenton.

title: Train Sim World 5: Ruhr-Sieg Nord: Hagen - Finnentrop Route Add-On
description: Deep valleys, tight curves and picturesque vistas are yours to experience in Train Sim World 2: Ruhr-Sieg Nord, bringing one of Germany's oldest railways to life.

title: Train Sim World 5: Isle Of Wight: Ryde - Shanklin Route Add-On
description: Experience one of the most unique railway lines in England and climb aboard the country’s oldest operational rolling stock with Rivet Games’ Train Sim World: Isle of Wight. It’s your job to operate Ryde Rail services over the Island Line, the portion of the rail network found on the Isle of Wight.

title: Train Sim World 5: LIRR Commuter: New York - Long Beach, Hempstead & Hicksville Route Add-On
description: Return to Long Island in Train Sim World and delve into an enhanced New York - Hicksville route, now including the Long Beach line, new lighting and skies, overhauled signalling, an all-new bustling timetable, and the state-of-the-art LIRR M9!

title: Train Sim World 5: Midland Main Line: Leicester - Derby & Nottingham Route Add-On
description: Experience passenger duties between a trifecta of scenic English counties. Swoosh through the countryside and sprint to the finish aboard renowned traction. The locals of Leicester, Derby and Nottingham await in Train Sim World 3: Midland Main Line!

title: Train Sim World 5: Fife Circle Line: Edinburgh - Markinch via Dunfermline & Kirkcaldy Route Add-On
description: From the Scottish Capital to the Firth of Forth Lowlands, embark on passenger services over iconic cantilevers and along picturesque coastline. A modern ScotRail Turbo stars in the spotlight of Rivet Games’ Fife Circle & Levenmouth Lines in Train Sim World 5!

title: Train Sim World 5: Hauptstrecke Rhein-Ruhr: Duisburg - Bochum Route Add-On
description: Experience bustling regional and commuter operations from aboard modern and well-known traction with Train Sim World: Hauptstrecke Rhein-Ruhr. Drive over a rail network represented how it is today, complete with both routes between Essen and Bochum, populated by different trains and services.

title: Train Sim World 5: Norfolk Southern Heritage Livery Collection Add-On
description: Celebrate the history of US rail with this stunning mix of Fallen Flag schemes, haul freight in colorful style with the NS Heritage Livery Collection for Train Sim World, which depicts 9 liveries carried by a fleet of Norfolk Southern’s ES44AC locomotives.

title: Train Sim World 5: Amtrak's Acela
description: America’s Fastest Train! Race along Northeast Corridor rails in iconic style, reaching incredible speeds through multiple states and suburbs. “Train approaching, please remain behind yellow line”, Amtrak’s Acela blasts into Train Sim World!

title: Train Sim World 5: Rapid Transit
description: Train Sim World: Rapid Transit is an all new First-Person Simulator that brings to life the experience of driving rapid transit commuter passenger trains on one of Germany’s most popular S-Bahn railways.

title: Train Sim World 5: Maintalbahn: Aschaffenburg - Miltenberg Route Add-On
description: Return to the portside town of Aschaffenburg, Germany and embark on Regionalbahn services along the Main Valley. No wires, no fuss, your next adventure awaits aboard the sleek DB BR 642 DMU, wind your way to Miltenberg in Train Sim World 4: Maintalbahn!

title: Train Sim World 5: Schnellfahrstrecke Kassel - Würzburg Route Add-On
description: Experience the thrill of racing through dense, forested valleys, over awe-inspiring viaducts and deep into swooping tunnels. Germany's classic Inter City Express awaits on our longest route yet with Train Sim World 3: Schnellfahrstrecke Kassel - Würzburg.

title: Train Sim World 5: Cane Creek: Thompson - Potash Route Add-On
description: Journey through the American West's awe-inspiring, rugged, and remote desert scenery while tackling heavy tonnage and daunting grades with the Union Pacific Cane Creek Subdivision route for Train Sim World!

title: Train Sim World 5: Great Western Express Route Add-On
description: Train Sim World: Great Western Express is an all new First-Person Simulator that brings to life the experience of driving high speed and commuter passenger trains on one of Britain’s busiest railways.

title: Train Sim World 5: DB BR 218 Diesel Loco Add-On
description: Climb aboard the mighty diesel-hydraulic DB BR 218 and embark on passenger and freight duties from Hamburg and beyond. Explore in a new way with the first true German go-anywhere, do-anything mainline locomotive in Train Sim World 4, courtesy of TSG.

title: Train Sim World 5: Diesel Legends of the Great Western Add-On
description: Take a trip back in time and experience classic loco-hauled expresses in Train Sim World: Diesel Legends of the Great Western!

title: Train Sim World 5: DB BR 204 Add-On
description: A hard-working classic comes to life in Train Sim World 2 with the stunning DB BR 204 diesel locomotive! In the 1950s, the Deutsche Reichsbahn were keen to get dieselisation underway, replacing steam locomotives with a modern fleet of standardised locomotives.

title: Train Sim World 5: Caltrain MP15DC Diesel Switcher Loco Add-On
description: Climb aboard for challenging switching, maintenance-of-way, and train rescue operations with the Train Sim World Caltrain Electro-Motive MP15DC diesel locomotive for the Peninsula Corridor: San Francisco – San Jose route!

title: Train Sim World 5: Spirit of Steam: Liverpool Lime Street - Crewe Route Add-On
description: Step back in time and discover the soot and sounds of the romantic steam era through historic Merseyside and Cheshire with Train Sim World: Spirit of Steam: Liverpool Lime Street - Crewe!

title: Train Sim World 5: DB BR 155 Loco Add-On
description: A classic loco dating back to the 1970s and Deutsche Reichsbahn's answer to the growing freight and passenger railways in Germany. The DB BR 155, or “Electric Container” as it's affectionately known by railfans, has stood the test of time.

title: Train Sim World 5: Cathcart Circle Line: Glasgow - Neilston & Newton Add-On
description: Experience the hustle and bustle of a modern suburban network using classic electric traction, link Glasgow's suburbs along the Cathcart Circle Line. Now fully remastered as part of a free update, take in the all-new detail in Train Sim World 4!

title: Train Sim World 5: Rail Head Treatment Train Add-On
description: Water tanks full, 2 locomotives raring to go, it’s Autumn and the tracks need a good blasting - power wash your way to success with the Train Sim World: Rail Head Treatment Train!

title: Train Sim World 5: Canadian National Oakville Subdivision: Hamilton - Oakville Route Add-On
description: Experience bustling freight yards, heavy industries, and classic motive power set in the stunning Lake Ontario territory with Train Sim World 2: Canadian National Oakville Subdivision.

title: Train Sim World 5: ScotRail BR Class 380 EMU Add-On
