description: Bastionfall is a challenging third-person Action RPG featuring skill-based combat and a unique online co-op follower system. Explore a fallen kingdom, master parries and dodges, and command loyal companions in epic boss battles to reclaim a legendary sword.

title: Gamble With Your Friends
description: An online 1-6 player co-op "casino crawler" where you and your friends share one bank account and one massive debt. Gamble, buy sketchy items, make terrible decisions, and climb an ominous casino tower to hit your loan shark’s daily quota in 5 minutes - or face the consequences.

title: Fractala Sandbox
description: Explore the elements of Fractala Sandbox and its large-scale physics-based simulation. A pure sandbox experience featuring everything from wavy water and sticky slime to viscous lava, coiling honey, squishy jelly, compressible snow, piling sand, aerodynamics, solids, rope, fire, and explosives!

title: Birza
description: A desktop birding simulator.Here, you won't need to worry about feeding or raising the birds.Simply leave it running quietly on your desktop, and adorable birds will visit on their own.You can purchase food and feed them.Use the camera to capture their cute moments.Create personalized birding books.

title: Rain and Respite
description: "Rain and Respite" is a relatively short visual novel where you talk to cute and weird girls at a tavern.

title: Nusantara: Bermuda
description: An otome game with intricate dark fantasy/fairytales. Can you solve the mysteries and find love?

title: The Lost Meowgician
description: The Lost Meowgician blends match-3, tower defense, and roguelite strategy. Match tiles to cast spells against waves of enemies. Combine spells and treasures to create unique builds and unleash satisfying combos in a charming, hand-drawn world.

title: Solstrike
description:
Solstrike is a turn based strategy game for 2 to 6 players.

Players enter the arena and then choose from a variety of actions. Will you beam down more units, upgrade your commander, or go for a direct attack? Will you play an offensive or defensive game? Utilize the unique strengths of each of your units to try to defeat the enemy commanders.

The game has a carefully balanced mixture of luck and skill, such that playing the right strategies will great improve your chances, but a new player can still beat a veteran.

The game has a clean, uncluttered aesthetic and is easy to learn, but as you play it more you will discover its hidden complexity, with surprisingly varied units and strategies and hours of content to

title: Kai UnEarthed
description: Explore an afrofuturistic 3D world scavenging and journaling your way to becoming a wildtender: someone who heals the relationship between humans and more-than-human beings. Reflect on the choices you make, the artifacts you leave behind, and the worlds that will grow out of them.

title: DDoD
description: DDoD is a single-player and co-op tactical roguelite shooter set in the near future, deep inside an abandoned industrial zone. Explore, fight, and mutate your way to the source of a semi-sentient biological AI anomaly.

title: Lens Of Fear
description: Realistic, hyper-immersive, intense action-adventure horror game. Developed by PlayableGraph as their debut title. This game combines a portable camera perspective with highly detailed environments and immersive sound design to deliver an authentic horror experience.

title: Chumaky
description: Chumaky is a game about traveling, trading, farming, and building your own homestead. Discover mysterious locations and enjoy atmospheric landscapes.

title: Strategic Command: American Civil War - Concert of Europe
description: Lead the giants of 19th-century Europe through five epic campaigns. Unite nations, outwit rivals, and fight the wars that will reshape the continent, from the Crimea to the Balkans, in this grand expansion for Strategic Command: American Civil War.

title: Watching from Afar
description:
After refusing to help someone in need, you’re cursed by a mischievous fairy to see the world only through other people’s eyes. Explore a realm of floating islands — not from your own view, but through the wandering gazes of strangers in this second-person platformer.

Platform through a world of floating islands and caves, with your camera perspective being only the eyes of those nearby. People are scattered across the land, watching from afar—watch them walk, trip, sneeze, or blink, or take matters into your own hands and toss them around. And for an extra challenge, activate hard mode and face it all with no checkpoints.

title: Uncle Sam's Supermarket Simulator
description: Manage your own supermarket, from stocking shelves to handling customers. Build, upgrade, and expand your store while making strategic decisions to keep customers happy and your business booming. Can you become the ultimate supermarket tycoon?

title: The Caretaker’s Lease
description: 083. In the aftermath of the Quiet Collapse, humanity clings to survival in scattered villages. You are the new caretaker for Sage Creek Outfitters’ most remote winter lease — a 900-acre stretch of frozen wilderness with a dark history. Track game, survive brutal weather, and uncover the fate of your predecessor, Jeb, who vanished without a trace. Every hunt is a test of skill, and every night brings whispers of something older… and hungrier.

title: Archlyphion: Migration
description: Archlyphion: Migration tells a story of a lone Beanie who, after a fire broke out in their habitat, must make a run for it. Perhaps the herd is waiting at the other side of The Maze, but not before it stumbles across other eras along the way. Will it have what it takes to survive the odds?

title: Presidential Beatdown
description: The Ultimate Political Party-Crasher! Presidential Beatdown is a silly local/couch 2-D multiplayer fighting game in which super-soldier Presidents battle it out for political dominance.

title: Attuned
description: Attuned is a cooperative Action Roguelike inspired by your favourite MMOs. Play with friends or unlock NPC-companions to form a 4 player party of tank, healer and DPS. Gain spells and items, maneuver enemy groups, kill bosses, chase loot but manage your risk or you might die and lose it all.

title: Rogue Reigns
description: Rogue Reigns is a dark fantasy rogue-like deck-builder that weaves together the haunting narrative depth and corrupted world-building of games like Elden Ring with the strategic card combat of Slay the Spire. Fight, discover, dies and repeat.

title: The Road of Dust and Sorrow
description: A story-driven, atmospheric thriller with pixel-art graphics and survival-horror elements. Short, intense, and unforgettable.

title: Sin Zero
description: Fast-paced, melee action game where the ground beneath you is just as dangerous as the enemies ahead. Armed with a katana—and any other deadly weapon you may find—you’ll slash your way through relentless waves of foes to survive.

title: Xentra Station
description: Xentra Station is a retro-inspired 2D shooting platform set in a futuristic mysterious world.

title: 100 Cats Lost in Argentina Find & Color
description: 100 mischievous cats are hiding. Search every corner, find them, and bring each scene to life with your colors.

title: Space Vomit
description: Survive an alien invasion, wipe out your enemies with powerful weapons, and collect perk cards and upgrades for your character!

title: Find All Things: Christmas
description: Christmas is coming! That means it’s time to dive into the holiday spirit with the new game Find All Things: Christmas. This time, you’ll explore a variety of themed locations filled with Christmas magic and an even wider selection of mini-games.

title: Fetch Re;Quest
description: After successfully leading her friends through a one-shot TTRPG campaign, part-time barista and full-time gamer Flora now faces a new challenge… How can she possibly muster up the courage to tell her DM that she likes him?!

title: Valkyrie Iteration: Mecha Pilot Raising Pocket Simulator
description: Step into the role of a technomaster in Valkyrie Iteration, a sci-fi visual novel. Train and guide Lana, a young pilot, and her sentient mech, the Valkyrie, as they prepare for high-stakes battles against otherworldly foes.

title: Lost in Random: The Eternal Die - Stitched in Style
description: Dress to impress - or intimidate - with the Stitched in Style Expansion! Unlock two patchwork-perfect sets for Aleksandra and Fortune, tailor-made by the Rug Reader herself. Wrap yourself in mystic flair with the Rulemaster's Set or embrace your sinister side with Ludo's Outfit.

title: Fetch Quest Remastered
description: Would-be adventurer Flora accepts a job to retrieve a stolen item for a shady bartender. To retrieve the item, she'll have to infiltrate a group of notorious bandits by posing as a new recruit. This expands the hit game Fetch Quest with more content, upgraded graphics and unlockable extras through different story routes.

title: Rhythmkill
description: Rhythmkill is a super-fast rhythm action game where your every kill strikes on the beat. Wall-run, dash, slide, and chain lightning-fast katana kills through neon-drenched arenas. Master the rhythm, maintain your momentum, and fight your way to the boss who imprisoned you.

title: Castella
description: Castella is a Tower Defense Rogue-like, where you will build a fortress to defend yourself from hordes of monsters besieging your castle. During the game you will unlock and upgrade towers and buildings. You will build walls to block the path and defend your resources and town hall.

title: Robo Miner: Remastered
description: Dig deep, collect ores, and upgrade your robot in this remastered classic mining adventure with improved graphics and smarter gameplay.

title: Before the Silence
description: In this turn-based strategy, you will take control of an anti-disinformation department and protect your citizens from terrorist influence. Manage your agents and resources, analyze media, and restore order in different regions of your country.

title: Pigeon Guild
description: Pigeon Guild is a non-combat, single-player action RPG where you play as Jules Corso, a rookie cadet in Cassandria's most prestigious airborne postal service. Navigate your flying cargo boat through a world of floating islands, where every delivery tells a story.

title: Fortune Seller
description: A gothic roguelike shopkeeping game where you sell antiques, read the tarot, and manage your inventory to survive crushing rent increases. Match strange customers with the relics they crave, unlock powerful cards, and gamble your way out of debt, one deal at a time.

title: Logic Leap
description: In this unique command-driven puzzle platformer, you don't directly control your character. Instead, you write an "action script" for it, acting like a "programmer." Your character will strictly follow the script to navigate traps, avoid enemies, and unlock mechanisms.

title: Dimenshot
description: An intense, fast-paced FPS that seamlessly blends parkour and shooting. Master fluid movement, engage in dynamic close combat, and unleash devastating firepower across diverse worlds and unique themes, each filled with dangerous enemies and epic battles.

title: The Spirit Weaver
description: The Spirit Weaver is a narrative-driven visual novel where you use the power of Tarot to guide lost spirits through their grief, and maybe figure out your own. Explore a mystical spirit realm, help its denizens, and restore balance in a bittersweet story of love, loss, and empathy.

title: Crimson System: VɅΔ Protocol
description: A dark retro-FPS born from a solo AI-creation experiment. Blast your way through a vampire-ruled station, slay twisted enemies, and uncover the secrets of the VɅΔ Protocol

title: Monumentum
description: Take control of a small rolling square and utilize long dormant mechanisms to ascend to the top. Watch your step!

title: Lethal Dungeon
description:
Lethal Dungeon is a roguelike card game. Win every battle using only the cards in your opening hand to defeat all enemies in a single turn.

Using as few cards as possible will earn you more rewards, and if you get stuck on an enemy, you can use money to shuffle and draw.

Upgrade your deck using the money you earn! Defeat stronger enemies to earn more money! Repeat this process until you clear the dungeon!

title: Shimmer's Quest: Way of the Whoop
description: Join Shimmer and waddle around in search for a way to restore the destroyed sacred flower in this silly point and click fantasy adventure.

title: Scav
description: Scav is a low poly looter shooter with survival elements. Gear up in the safezone, drop into quarantine zones, scavenge valuable loot, fight enemies and zombies, and extract before the nuke hits. Survive the raid or lose everything.

title: Udder
description: Reach escape velocity as a cow with no legs in this tiny reflexive one-button endless runner.

title: Holo Hidden: My Lovely Fans Can't Be This Hidden
description: The ultimate Hololive hide-and-seek adventure! Step into a world of coziness and colorful cuteness in Holo Hidden, a charming hidden object game where your are tasked to find hidden fans and missing items! Test your skill across 11+1 beautifully hand-drawn levels.

title: Astrohaulers
description: Astrohaulers is a sci-fi package management game that challenges you to build and expand your delivery network across the galaxy.

title: Nightfall of the Dead
description: Witness the fall of a city ravaged by an unknown viral epidemic that has brought the dead back to life. But the zombies will be the least of your problems in this frantic and terrifying adventure.

title: Monstrous Liberation
description: Sasha is a spunky internet streamer who finds herself transported to a fantasy kingdom where lewd acts are forbidden. Armed with a set of magical, curse-breaking scissors, Sasha must cut away the shackles of repression and lead a sexual revolution to save the world!

title: Crank It!
description:
A cunning computer game where you find yourself in a cave surrounded by various pieces of patented technology.

You are not alone in the cave.

Meet your supervisor and try to make it through the shift.

title: Eminent Domain
description: Eminent Domain is a 2D scrolling shoot 'em up where you pilot a mech on a mission to deliver former human lands from mutating plants that hijacked other mechs.

title: Customer Support
description:
The questions are all the same. Boring. Repetitive.

Until they’re not.

Your shift starts like any other: mop the floors, answer the phone, restock the shelves, clean the windows. But as the night wears on, the calls start getting... strange, more personal, More threatening.

title: Everspace: Ultimate Edition
description: Everspace combines fast-paced combat with roguelike elements, great visuals and a captivating story. It takes you on a challenging journey through an ever-changing, beautifully crafted universe full of surprises. Shoot, craft and loot your way to victory while the odds are stacked against you.

title: Stage 333
description: It's your first day as a courier, and your task is to deliver a package to the 333rd floor. The notorious megastructure Prometheus Plex is inhabited by thugs, cyborgs, cyborg-thugs, femme fatales, cannibal children, nanomachine-infected beings, and all sorts of other nastiness that anyone else would avoid like the plague. But work is work. So you get into the only functioning elevator... and let fate take its course.

title: Plants vs. Zombies 2 Gardendless
description: Plants vs Zombies 2 Gardenless is a rewritten PC port of the mobile game Plants vs Zombies 2 that incorporates features from the Chinese version of the game as well as original content.

title: Overdrawn
description: Overdrawn is a roguelike deckbuilder that twists blackjack into a tactical battle. Cards in your hand have hidden values and are revealed when played. Win the hand and deal some damage! This isn’t just luck, your cards have unique abilities which manipulate the game in your favor.

title: Saturn Quest: The Loneliness Of Captain Navigator
description: The loneliest journey in a universe destroyed by a virus. Go where you can go to find what you can find. Solve puzzles, navigate mazes, and prepare for the final battle with the last functioning bio-ship in the universe.

title: Zombie Lockdown Simulator
description:
It's easy - just take the cash delivery. Find the problem you need to solve. Clean the money. Send it back to your clients. Repeat.

Don't be afraid to get your hands dirty - it's a part of your business. You are a cash cleaner. So do your job. And do it well or you will face the consequences.

You need tools and equipment to get the result, so buy what you need and make your lab a dream place.

title: Bubsy 3D: ReFurBished
description: Is Bubsy a celebrated icon from the mascot wars of the early 90s or a platforming punchline? Bubsy in: The Purrfect Collection explores the franchise's troubled history and enduring popularity. A playable history that includes games, artifacts and interviews. What could possibly go wrong?

title: Haunted Mines
description:
Haunted Mines is a 4-player online co-op horror game set in old abandoned mines. Your goal is to investigate the location and restore the power, but beware—you won’t be alone down there. A lurking threat is waiting for you in the darkness.

Use weapons and gear to investigate and defend yourself. Try to restore the electricity by completing additional objectives to earn money, all while avoiding the deadly threat trapped within these haunted mines.

title: Mesmalie
description: MESMALIE is an occult visual novel/point & click adventure where you attempt to tame your Magickal ability under the guidance of a small Witches' coven in the middle of nowhere. Heed Mesmer's aloof teachings, strengthen your Magick, or just go home,,,

title: Wummsen Village
description:
Wummsen Village is a fast-paced party game for up to 4 players.
Choose your favorite mode, jump into the ring, and start throwing punches!
Combat follows a unique revolver-style system: press the attack button three times in a row to perform three distinct moves. This makes it easy for newcomers to get started, while giving seasoned players the depth to master timing, combos, and high-damage plays.

Whether you’re in it for friendly chaos or competitive glory, Wummsen delivers laughs, action, and unforgettable party moments.

title: The Elder Scrolls Online: Feast of Shadows
description: The second dungeon pack of 2025, Feast of Shadows, is coming to live servers soon. It brings with it two new dungeons, Naj-Caldeesh and Black Gem Foundry. For now, the forgotten ruin of Naj-Caldeesh remains a mystery—perhaps to be unveiled soon. Instead, journey into the depths of Molag Bal’s Oblivion realm of Coldharbour to witness the perils of the Black Gem Foundry dungeon. Learn how events have unfolded there, what deadly threats it holds, and the precious rewards to claim from it.

title: DreamWoods 2
description: DreamWoods 2 is a puzzle game where you guide a little girl through grid-based levels filled with different blocks. Match blocks to clear obstacles, use bombs to blast your way through, and outsmart a mischievous witch to reach the exit door. Between levels, collect points to decorate your magical garden and progress along a winding path toward the witch’s castle.

title: Delivery Up
description: Delivery Up is a chaotic vertical platformer about a stunt courier who must climb 10,000 meters to deliver every order on time. Lose your footing — but don’t lose your backpack!

title: Panzer Corps 2: Frontlines - Westwall
description: Lead the US Army through the Siegfried Line in late 1944. Break German defenses from Aachen to the Saar in a dynamic campaign featuring new battles, fortified zones, unique units, and a rising challenge with every step forward.

title: Panzer Corps 2: Frontlines - Cyrenaica
description: Experience the crucial North African Campaign like never before in Panzer Corps 2 Frontlines: Cyrenaica. Covering the battles of Operation E and Operation Compass, this DLC immerses you in the iconic struggles for control over Cyrenaica. Lead both the Italian and British forces in two expansive campaigns that bring the desert theater to life with unique units, innovative mechanics, and immersive desert warfare.

title: Fortnite OG: Chapter 1 Season 5
description: The sky is cracked and weird things are falling out! Rumors of a viking village and fancy golf resort (golf karts included) run amok, and some even say a floating cube is on its way. Grapple with all of this and more in Fortnite OG Chapter 1 Season 5, available from August 7 to October 3, 2025 Eastern Time!

title: BederSnake
description: Guide a snake whose mouth is on its tail through 284 increasingly tricky Sokoban-style puzzles, looping, growing and outwitting yourself in a minimalist top-down logic challenge.

title: The Story of Red Cloud
description: The Story of Red Cloud is a massive Dark Souls-inspired adventure built inside the world of Terraria using a custom map, mod and companion soundtrack. Your 1-4 player journey will span 18 dungeons spread across an expansive, hand-crafted open world, offering a 20 to 30+ hour experience for a first playthrough.

title: Croakspire
description: Dive into a fortress labyrinth crawling with monsters, defending yourself with your... tongue? As a frog, it's your best bet to traverse this retro-inspired 2D metroidvania title. Collect treasures to gain permanent upgrades, discovering new areas of the massive interconnected map with them!

title: Little Lures
description: A casual idle fishing sim that sits quietly at the bottom of your screen while you do other tasks.

title: Space Hole
description: Collect energy, grow your tail, and fill the SPACE HOLE in this bite sized arcade game.

title: Tales of the Cryptozoo
description: Explore, investigate, and survive in a dark world of cryptozoology, where each creature brings its own kind of terror. Will you uncover the truth or succumb to the horrors lurking in the shadows?

title: Gundam Breaker 4: Story Mission DLC 4 - Battle Fiercely
description: Story Mission DLC 4 - BATTLE FIERCELY includes an additional story, which is a sequel to the main storyline, and additional Mobile Suits.

title: Gundam Breaker 4: Story Mission DLC 5 - Beyond Borders
description: Story Mission DLC 5 - BEYOND BORDERS includes an additional story, which is a sequel to the main storyline, and additional Mobile Suits.

title: Arcade Archives: Aqua Jet
description:
"AQUA JET" is a marine sports game released by NAMCO LIMITED (current Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.) in 1996.

This game stood out at arcades at the time thanks to its large jet ski-style cabinet.
Savor the thrill of racing across shimmering waves under the blazing sun in a stunning, resort-like setting brought to life by the "System Super 22" hardware!

title: Arcade Archives 2: Aqua Jet
description:
The "Arcade Archives" (ACA) series faithfully reproduces classic arcade game masterpieces, staying true to its original.
You can customize game settings to your liking, such as adjusting the difficulty level, and depending on the title, even recreate the nostalgic atmosphere of CRT TVs back in the day.
Additionally, you can compete for high scores with players from all around the world through online rankings.

In addition to the “ORIGINAL MODE,” “HIGH SCORE MODE,” and “CARAVAN MODE” included in the “Arcade Archives” series, “Arcade Archives 2” series will add new features such as “TIME ATTACK MODE” and “NETWORK MODE.”In “TIME ATTACK MODE” you compete to see who can beat the final boss the fastest stating from the first battle. This mode focuses on how quickly you can complete the game, regardless of the score you achieve. In “NETWORK MODE” you can play against other users over the network.

Additionally, functionality has been significantly enhanced. Multiple save slots have been implemented instead of just one, along with a rewind feature that allows players to retry gameplay and a quick start feature for those who want to dive straight into the game. Furthermore, VRR support has been added, enabling more accurate reproduction of the original arcade game’s experience.

Enjoy the legendary arcade masterpiece with “Arcade Archives 2,” now more fun and user-friendly.

title: Mind's Eye Macrogolf
description: Mind's Eye Macrogolf is an online fantasy minigolf game for 1 to 10 players.

title: Your Judgment, Inquisitor
description: Your judgment, Inquisitor Medieval Spain. You serve as an Inquisitor in the shadow of the dreaded Tomás de Torquemada. Cast out demons from the possessed. Burn heretics. Spare the innocent — or condemn them. Every wrong choice will bring you closer to the wrath of the Church… or the fury of the mob.

title: Possum Boy!: The Ballad of Joey Virginia
description: POSSUM BOY! is a romantic comedy visual novel about finding friendship, finding yourself, and maybe even finding love... when you're the only animal person around!

title: Hero's Advent
description:
It's a brand-new RPG adventure. Starring you: The Legendary Hero!

Grab your legendary sword and go save the world from a mysterious tyrant known as The Benefactor! Along the way, you'll meet a colorful and quirky cast of characters who will be very interested in your adventure. Some will want to help you. Others will want to put a stop to you. Can you persevere through it all and save the world?

title: eFootball: Mourinho Edition 2026
description:
eFootball is a football simulation game developed and published by Konami.

In eFootball: Mourinho Edition 2026, manager José Mourinho appears alongside a new skill, the "Diagonal Long Pass A" Link-up Play. The edition also includes two Highlight players—Son Heung-min and Memphis Depay—who meet the conditions for the Centrepiece and Key Man roles. As a purchase bonus, it provides 150 eFootball Coins.

title: eFootball: Leo Messi Edition 2026
description:
eFootball is a football simulation game developed and published by Konami.

eFootball: Leo Messi Edition 2026 includes Lionel Messi as an Epic player, along with seven Highlight players—Chris Wood, Jonathan Clauss, Kevin De Bruyne, Luka Modrić, Nicolás Otamendi, Robert Lewandowski, and Yassine Bounou. The edition also features stadium elements such as the Leo Messi Edition ’26 stadium choreography and the Leo Messi Golden Statue ’26 giant props, as well as eleven 4,000 EXP tokens. As a purchase bonus, it grants 250 eFootball Coins.

title: eFootball: Leo Messi Edition 2026 - Deluxe
description:
eFootball is a football simulation game developed and published by Konami.

eFootball: Leo Messi Edition 2026 - Deluxe includes Lionel Messi as an Epic player, along with ten Highlight players—Chris Wood, James Rodríguez, Jonathan Clauss, Kevin De Bruyne, Luka Modrić, Mohamed Salah, Nicolás Otamendi, Robert Lewandowski, Stefan de Vrij, and Yassine Bounou. Additional content includes the Leo Messi Edition 2026 [Deluxe] strip, stadium elements such as the Leo Messi Edition ’26 stadium choreography and the Leo Messi Golden Statue ’26 giant props, three types of Leo Messi Edition 2026 avatar icons, a Leo Messi Edition 2026 avatar background, and twenty-two 4,000 EXP tokens. As a purchase bonus, it grants 450 eFootball Coins.

title: eFootball: Lamine Yamal Edition 2026
description:
eFootball is a football simulation game developed and published by Konami.

eFootball: Lamine Yamal Edition 2026 includes Lamine Yamal as an Epic player, along with seven Highlight players—Aleksandar Pavlović, Anatolii Trubin, Benjamin Šeško, Dean Huijsen, Josip Stanišić, Milos Kerkez, and Pedri. Additional content features stadium elements such as the Lamine Yamal Edition ’26 stadium choreography and the Lamine Yamal Golden Statue ’26 giant props, as well as eleven 4,000 EXP tokens. As a purchase bonus, it provides 250 eFootball Coins.

title: eFootball: Lamine Yamal Edition 2026 - Deluxe
description:
eFootball is a football simulation game developed and published by Konami.

eFootball: Lamine Yamal Edition 2026 - Deluxe includes Lamine Yamal as an Epic player, along with ten Highlight players—Aleksandar Pavlović, Anatolii Trubin, António Silva, Benjamin Šeško, Dean Huijsen, Josip Stanišić, Milos Kerkez, Nico Williams, Pedri, and Warren Zaïre-Emery. Additional content includes the Lamine Yamal Edition 2026 [Deluxe] strip, stadium elements such as the Lamine Yamal Edition ’26 stadium choreography and the Lamine Yamal Golden Statue ’26 giant props, three types of Lamine Yamal Edition 2026 avatar icons, a Lamine Yamal Edition 2026 avatar background, and twenty-two 4,000 EXP tokens. As a purchase bonus, it grants 250 eFootball Coins.

title: Talewarden: Riders of the New Day
description: Talewarden is a weird west adventure visual novel. Restore time on a planet where the sun never sets as you explore locations, talk, romance, and bond with your companions. Find the source of the voice in your head and discover why you all fell here from different worlds.

title: The Tovanian Stones
description: A single player first person role-playing game. Explore the land and find enemies to slay for treasure. Scour the world for resources and become a master crafter within a complex crafting system.

title: Wrench Towers
description: Wrench Towers is a tower defense game inspired by the golden age of Flash games, with a modern take on gameplay and pixel art.

title: Whispered Secrets: Song of Sorrow - Collector's Edition
description: Can you stop the malevolent Siren in time?

title: Replicomica
description: A short, atmospheric experience set inside a handcrafted dream. You are a small, solitary citizen drifting through augmented memories. Boot up your LonelyOS and let the robots guide you.

title: Skyborn: IronWings
description: A reimagined 3D arcade shooter that transforms the classic vertical scrolling formula with full spatial depth, immersive air-to-ground combat, and intense bullet hell action.

title: Axobubble
description: In Axobubble you control a friendly axolotl in a world of platforms and creativity. Your main ability is to create floating bubbles that act as temporary platforms. Use these bubbles to jump higher, cross dangerous distances, and collect shells while advancing to the big star shell at the end of each level.

title: Incredibug
description: Become the Incredibug: Control a cute pill bug, unite your fellow critters and rise up against a menacing smart home system in this physics-based platformer with metroidvania elements. Play together with a friend and let them support you as Lumi the firefly in our cozy 1.5 player couch-coop

title: Darkodai
description: The land was absolved, it fell to an ancient darkness, a spell cast by a mysterious force. Two beings from a pure realm of light are the only hope for this consumed land. Many adventures against the darkness await you in this small, RPG adventure known as Darkodai!

title: Plantiquarian
description: Plantiquarian is a First-Person 3D Exploration and Puzzle Game, in which you can collect a myriad of mysterious and magical plants - each with their own quirks and abilities! Consult your trusty Encyclopedia to first find, and then figure out how to uproot each specimen.

title: Explosiovania
description: After descending into a broken underworld, you are forced to learn new ways to traverse the harsh areas of hell. Rocket-jump using fireballs and master an ever growing moveset. Explore the non-linear corners of the underworld and reclaim the Eye of Evil.

title: Tales of Kathay
description: Tales of Kathay is a tactical turn-based RPG where every world is born from centuries of simulated history. Explore ruined kingdoms, join faction wars, craft your path through a living sandbox, and return generations later to see the mark your choices left behind.

title: Tempered Hue
description: Tempered Hue is a third-person grim-cozy game about running a blacksmith shop. Craft unique tools and items, sell your wares, and explore local caverns to gather crafting materials. Navigate treacherous caverns with your trusty grappler alone or with friends in this blacksmith slice of life sim.

title: Bofkin Island 2
description: You've ended up stranded on Bofkin Island... again! There's only one way off the island. Master the art of photography and capture lots of colourful little Bofkins whilst solving the Mystery of Bofkin Island!

title: Cardamom
description: Cardamom is a visual novel set in a Broadway musical. Play as a cartoon cat and befriend the cat loving residents of the building. Make decisions and listen to their outcomes in song.

title: Bus Stop Shuffle
description:
All aboard! Get ready for a colorful, brain-teasing puzzle experience where your goal is simple but oh-so-addictive: arrange all passengers to fit perfectly on their matching buses. Sounds easy? Think again!

In this fun and relaxing puzzle game, you’ll face increasingly tricky challenges as you sort passengers by color and seat them correctly before the buses depart. Each level brings new patterns, tighter spaces, and more passengers to organize — testing your logic, speed, and strategic thinking.

title: The Croaked Crown
description: In a world overrun with creature & corruption, salvation finds a way. It is up to Rib, the Wet One, to cleanse these lands.

title: Sector Shooter
description: Step into the chaos of Sector Shooter, a fast-paced action game where you’ll battle through a series of themed sectors, from dusty desert to deep industrial mines. Face a variety of enemies, collect coins and buffs, and push forward through increasingly challenging sectors. Each sector contains a set number of enemies that must be defeated before you can move on. As you progress, upgrade your character and weapons, sharpen your reflexes, and prepare for a challenging boss fight showdown.

title: Cloudy Day
description: Cloudy Day is a 2D casual hand-drawn platforming game made entirely by a single person. Play as a lonely cloud that embarks on a journey to learn how to fly and be able to joint their fellow clouds!

title: Taste of Blood
description: A real-time strategy game with a simple economy, designed so you can focus on the battle and crush your enemies.

title: Everlen: The Volgran Torment
description: In Everlen, a tactical action roguelite, explore vast procedurally generated areas, face relentless threats, and guide an enigmatic creation to the core of a living planet, where secrets and dangers lurk.

title: Nuggle
description: Nuggle is a delightfully cosy casual puzzle game with 100 levels at launch. It has a simple mechanic but you can quickly become unstuck trying to make sure there are no missing matches. It is unadulterated pure puzzles.

title: Project Octavia
description: A stylized third-person spy action game with infiltration, gunplay, Close Quarter Combat (CQC) and innovative and dynamic sabotage gadget crafting with brand new science-fiction based stealth action multiplayer gameplay!

title: Returns Outlet Simulator
description: Manage a successful shop using only returns from a large online retailer From tech to household, computer parts to kitchen knives, buy pallets filled with returned products and fill your shelves with a mix of new and used items.

title: Mysteries of Old Tokyo
description: Step into the Imperial Capital, where knowledge is your weapon. Research and explore 40+ real-life Tokyo locations, past and present. Encounter a cast of wandering spirits, interrogate their stories, and separate the truth from their lies.

title: Tokyo Trigger
description: Tokyo 2050 glows with neon, but darkness simmers beneath. Akihito, a warrior with a fractured past, uncovers a plot threatening the city. Blast through a top-down cyberpunk world in this fast-paced 2D shooter. Can you fight back against the tide of oppression and reclaim your memories and honor?

title: Biomass: Extermination
description: Biomass: Extermination is a first-person sci-fi shooter game, set in a world destroyed by alien invasion, created entirely by solo developer using Unreal Engine.

title: XLM's Dr. Harrison
description: XLM's Dr. Harrison is a puzzle, action/reflex, maze video game for Windows 3.1, created and published in 1995.

title: Jetz Rampage 4: Revenge
description: Ever want to just cause mass destruction in a city with a jetpack and loads of weapons? Well now you can. You can do the missions in the cities to unlock new weapons or work your way up through the different cop levels and defete the MEGA COP!

title: Enjaulados
description: Enjaulados is a fantasy and fiction video game in 3d in which the protagonist Sirius will have to dive into utopian worlds and save fantastic beings to get out of the cage of screens in which she finds. But is there an even greater danger outside that stalks the planet?

title: Bloodseed: The Last Helsing
description: Bloodseed is a game that combines two very distinct but terribly addictive genres; card combat and survival.

title: Eyes on Yuki
description: Think you can babysit a magical little frog with the IQ of a toaster and the chaotic energy of a squirrel on five espressos? Meet Yuki: an adorable creature who is both the reason and the solution to this mess. Grab your best bud, keep your eyes on Yuki and bring color back to the world!

title: Golden Gambit
description: Spin. Gamble. Conquer the Machine. Golden Gambit is a slot machine roguelite where every choice is a gamble. Build insane combos, unlock risky modifiers, and push your luck to the limit… or crash and burn trying. Use unique powers with each slot machine to win the Golden Gambit.

title: Desktop Heroes
description: Desktop Heroes is a unique idle RPG designed to be your faithful companion while you work. Set just above your taskbar, this game runs in the background, letting you build a team of courageous heroes, battle monstrous foes, and collect loot; all without disrupting your productivity.

title: IWA Retro Adventure
description:
A logical platform game.
Calm gameplay, but thought-provoking.
Save your brother from the clutches of an unknown monster that has kidnapped him and is now setting traps for you to hinder your search and pursuit.

title: Plum Road Tea Dream
description: Plum Road Tea Dream tells the semi-autobiographical story of 'S', a young game designer who creates virtual sanctuaries that reflect their own introspective journey out of need for safe havens, new rituals and space for grief.

title: Eel Game
description: Play dangerous games and try to survive. Only one player can win. Will it be you?

title: Elemental Saga
description: A Korean-exclusive action MMORPG

title: Wuthering Waves: By Sun's Scourge, By Moon's Revelation
description:
Version 2.6 of Wuthering Waves, including:
• New characters: Augusta and Iuno
• New area: Sanguis Plateau
• New story quests
• New echoes, events and more!

title: We Have Doom at Home
Websy and the Time Rogues
description: Websy and the Time Rogues is an action roguelike game about a spider using webs to swing through levels and string together enemies for combo attacks. The game centres around Websy, a small jumping spider who gets pulled out of time and recruited by the mysterious Time Rogues, an organization which fights evil enemies invading the past, present and future. Websy and their new allies must use their unique abilities to defend time and space by defeating enemy incursions and closing the time portals.

title: Runimals
description: One chicken, many wolves. You’re not the hunter — you’re the snack. Runimals is a chaotic 3D endless runner where you dash, dodge, and devour to stay alive. How long can you survive the food chain?

title: Trapformer
description: Trapformer contains 20 challenging levels with loads of hidden traps... Will you survive and make it until the end? Raging guaranteed!

title: Picaro
description: Master the cards in this high-stakes card roguelike! Every decision is life-or-death as you navigate treacherous dungeons. Use every card to escape. Strategy, resource management, and nerve-wracking choices await in an endlessly replayable challenge!

title: Chess Empire
description:
Chess Empire is a fast-paced, tactical twist on chess where gold, upgrades, and fog of war change every move.

The core rules are familiar-you command the classic board and pieces-but now every turn earns you gold: 1 for moving, 2 for captures, and 3 for taking down upgraded pieces. Spend it in the shop to recruit new units or unlock powerful upgrades that transform how pieces play.

Fog of war hides anything outside the vision range of your farthest pieces, making information as valuable as material. Position smartly, scout aggressively, and strike when your opponent is blind.

title: Daisenryaku VII
description: Dai Senryaku VII: Modern Military Tactics, known as Daisenryaku VII in Japan, is a turn-based tactics video game, originally released for the Windows on December 20, 2001.

title: Dressing Room
description:
You are left alone to manage an old clothing store and deal with the customers...

It’s closing time at the local clothing store, and you’re the last one on duty. You must do your tasks: Clean the store, tidy the racks, and keep an eye on the dressing rooms... Something is going on in there...

title: Grandia
description:
Grandia is a role-playing game that combines exploration, character progression, and turn-based combat within a structured adventure. Players travel across varied regions, develop a party, and engage in a battle system that emphasizes turn order management and strategic timing.
This version is a port of the original game, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

title: Die drei ???: Das Gold der Inkas
description: In this Point & Click Adventure the three ??? research the story of an Inca treasure that has disappeared in Rocky Beach and accompany the salvage operation of a sunken ship in Panama. In the process, they fall into the clutches of a shady police commissioner...

title: Apparatus: Exanimus
description: Apparatus: Exanimus is a walking simulator/exploration game with horror elements, aesthetically imitating (and explicitly pretending to be) a lost game developed in 1998 by a company long out of business.

title: Trainsanity
description: Hop into the drivers seat with Trainsanity, the only train-operating simulation brave enough to ask the real questions: what if you had to chase down your passengers while avoiding being eaten by a giant rat king?

title: Shovel Game
description:
After an unforeseen disaster occurs in a futuristic mining complex you find yourself stranded with nothing but the tool of your trade; a reliable old shovel.

Burrow and dig your way through a sequence of strange and unfamiliar spaces as you search for answers and escape.

title: Ichigo's Study Sessions
description: When one of your stepsisters asks you to save the academic career of another, how can you refuse?

title: Pokémon Photon
description:
Explore the region of Prism Outpost in a new adventure!
After crash-landing suddenly outside of the house of a young researcher, the two of you head out together on a journey to fill the region's Pokédex. Along the way, however, the two of you encounter dangerous glowing Pokémon, and get involved in a conflict that spans even beyond the region's borders.

title: Rabbit Run Carrot Hunt
description: Rabbit Run Carrot Hunt is a fast-paced endless runner where you play as a quick and clever rabbit trying to collect as many carrots as possible. Carrots restore your energy, which slowly depletes as you run. The longer you survive, the more points you earn. A black panther is chasing you and occasionally launches sudden attacks that you must jump over to avoid. At the same time, you need to dodge various obstacles along the way. Stay alert, keep collecting carrots, and run as far as you can before the panther catches you.

title: Cazzarion: Raccoon Valley
description: "Cazzarion: Raccoon Valley" is a relaxing nature adventure where you play as a curious raccoon exploring a lush valley filled with rivers, a serene lake, dense trees, and open meadows. Roam freely through the landscape in search of tasty critters like snails, worms, frogs, and more. With no enemies, it's all about foraging, exploring, and enjoying the peaceful rhythm of the wild.

title: Bombordiro Crocodilo: Flight Simulator
description: Let’s get this meme flight started!

title: To Farm Lands
description: Cultivate logic, harvest stars

title: Minecraft: Music Disc 11
description: Horror game inspired by Minecraft disk number 11

title: Arab Drift Cars 2: The Definitive Edition
Life in Terminal Simulator: Airport Adventures
description: Survive harsh nights and unpredictable airport dangers.

title: Hole Digging Simulator 2025
description: Dig deeper for priceless secret discoveries.

title: Tune My Car: Tuning Studio & Mechanic Simulator 2025
Steam-Heart's & Advanced V.G.: Saturn Tribute
description: Steam-Heart's & Advanced V.G.: Saturn Tribute is a compilation that includes the sci‑fi shoot ’em up Steam‑Heart’s and the 2D fighting game Advanced Variable Geo. Both titles are modernized for the “Saturn Tribute” line with features like rewind, quick save/load, difficulty/assist options, and an included manual.

title: Mainframent
description: This game is about cleaner Klof. He was trapped inside a huge supercomputer dungeon, which is filled with bugs and dust. Use your mop and upgrade it to find way out!

title: Grizzly Bear is Hungry
description:
Grizzly Bear is Hungry is the fourth installment in the charming Is Hungry series. Join a ravenous grizzly bear on a wild adventure to stock up on food before winter hits! Roll through forests, smash through obstacles, defeat pesky enemies, and shake down trees to gather every last bite. Only by eating enough can this bear settle in for a cozy, worry-free hibernation. It's a feast-or-freeze kind of journey—are you ready to help him get his fill?

Grizzly Bear is Hungry is a 2d Platformer with retro pixel art style. Enjoy a casual, simple and charming adventure where you control a bear with the power to do a powerful rollout, strong enough to defeat enemies and shake trees! Use wisely your power to gather all types of food. The more you play, the closer you get to winter! The scenery will change with the seasons, going from a forest full of greenery, to a forest taken by the orange color, with leaves drying and falling, up to the point where snow starts to fall. Will you be able to stock up enough food to hibernate without worries?

title: Sokmeal Time
description: Sokmeal Time is a cozy sokoban game where you guide a hungry corgi through handcrafted puzzles. Move empty bowls into place, solve satisfying logic challenges, and watch kibble appear as your reward. With a relaxing flow, playful charm, this is a game that makes every solved puzzle feel like a warm treat.

title: Ah, Love! Season 2
description: New season of a game about Love! Swap blocks to help hearts have a date, but avoid the black heart, spikes and other obstacles!

title: Dream of Things
description: Dream of Things is an adventure puzzle game packed with mystery. You had died in a bathtub and acquired the ability to talk to inanimate things. You need to enter their dreams to help them fulfill their wishes and figure out what happened.

title: Time Riddles: The Mansion
description:
Time Riddles: The Mansion is a hidden object game where most of the time, the objective is to find and click on all the items listed at the right side of the screen, on locations selected after throwing dice on a board game. The player assumes the role of the main character, playing a mysterious board game where objects have to be removed from scenes taking place on the mansion and its surroundings, to uncover its secret past. Each location has four optional awards, received after collecting all the six jewels, finding the list objects in order, avoiding wrong clicks and solving a riddle to find a special item.

The hint button is a green jewel set below the list, showing the position of one of the required objects when activated. There is a maximum of five hints available, with extra ones received after completing the tile-matching mini-game at the end of each chapter, where the player has to swap pairs of adjacent tiles to create lines or columns of three or more of the same type and make them disappear.

title: Droiyan Online
description: Droiyan Online is a fantasy MMORPG developed by Mgame. The current service area is Korea and China.

title: Black Souls II
description:
BLACK SOULS II is the censored release of the Dark Fairy Tale Fantasy x Psychological Horror RPG focusing on the themes of "Exploration of a Mad World" and "Life or Death Combat against Demonbeasts".

Despair. Fear, Madness, once again. An original work based on "Alice in Wonderland" and "Through the Looking-Glass."

title: Faith: Demon Siege
description:
'FAITH: Demon Siege' is a survival-shooter, roguelike, fangame of Airdorf's 'FAITH' series.

Welcome to Brimdale Forest. In the year 1951, multiple reports of demonic activity prompted the church to get involved in the matter. Priests were dispatched to the location but were never heard from again.

title: A Fistfull of Cowboys
description: Ultra hyper auto-shooting cowboy mayhem

title: School Game
description: School Game is a game with RPG elements. You create your character and evolve in a academy environement. Learn skills, buy equipement, meet students, build your reputation and budget, be a member of the student council and various clubs, and improve your relationship with the head of the student council, which you may decide to replace.

title: The Nightmare Begins
description: The Nightmare Begins puts players in the role of two detectives searching for missing family members in a terrifying dream realm. They explore eerie landscapes, solve puzzles, and face supernatural threats, uncovering dark family secrets as they fight to escape this relentless nightmare

title: Processor Tycoon
description:
Processor Tycoon is a business simulation game where you start your own hardware company and compete with other companies in the emerging industry of semiconductors.

The game starts in 1975 and goes until 2030. You can develop CPUs, research new technologies, and expand your factories.

title: The Cute Machine
description: In the 1990s, Australian artist Martine Corompt made video game artworks that blended biological theory with technological development to explore the concept of cuteness.

title: My Dream PC
description:
Designed as a loving tribute to the thriving custom PC community, My Dream PC invites players to share the joy of customising in a safe, cosy digital world.

My Dream PC celebrates the skills of the community and highlights that decorating and customising are as integral to building as choosing the right parts.

title: Mystiques: Haunted Antiques
description: Mystiques is an adventure mystery game about the four worst women you've ever met running a failing antique store. Also, it is haunted.

title: After the Janazah
description:
Go to Baba's funeral.

Made for the Neo-Twiny 2024 Jam. Word count: 499 words.

title: Samukid
description: A roguelike deckbuilding game where you build a skill deck based on dice faces and collect loot with lasting effects. Create the strongest samurai by combining skills and loot for powerful synergy. The legend of the blind samurai and the child begins with you. Join the start of a great journey!

title: Stranger Heroes
description: A survivors-like bullet-heaven with auto-shooting. Survive the ever-escalating waves of tainted staff and abominations in the secret research facility. Choose, upgrade and evolve your skills and weapons. Gain achievements to unlock more content. Progress the meta with permanent enhancements.

title: Spirit Rancher
description: Spirit Rancher is a farming sim with a twist, all your crops are alive! Every aspect of nature has a spirit that you can capture. Use them to fight, craft intricate ecosystems, and build a self-sustaining ranch. Explore the land of Spirit Rancher and paint life back into the world!

title: Clerks & Quirks
description: Run a magical shop where your appliances are alive, emotional, and doing their best to ruin your day. Win them over ♡♡♡ to unlock powerful bonuses while you craft items, serve demanding customers, and scramble through the weekly rush in this co-op roguelite, where every shift put you under pressure.

title: Eleven
description: In Eleven, customize your ship with powerful lasers, adaptive shields, and precision thrusters. Choose colors, ships, and thrusters to match your style. Master zero-gravity mechanics and outmaneuver rivals in intense space battles where every choice matters.

title: Goblin Buster
description: Goblin Buster is a short incremental tower defense game with deep upgrade mechanics. Obliterate annoying goblins, collect materials, invest in unique buildings and spend your materials to upgrade towers and magical spells with a massive skill tree!

title: Chivalry Quest: Sword and Flame - Collector's Edition
description: Awaken in a war-torn realm where knights and dragons are bound by a forgotten pact. Search for relics, battle the Ashen Knights, and decide the fate of Camelot in this epic hidden-object adventure.

title: Everranger
description: This is a moderately challenging single-player 2D puzzle game with approximately 100 levels. You control your piece to evade or capture other pieces, ultimately reaching the target point. Different pieces follow distinct movement logic. You must deduce these patterns through exploration.

title: Rust Moon
description: In a cyberpunk wasteland, play as a rogue Peacekeeper captain—explore Metroidvania-style worlds and rewrite humanity’s fate through gunfire and choice.

title: The Fatum
description: This situation is temporary, but it comes with a strict protocol that you must follow. Morality and cold calculation intertwine in a dark tale. You are an investigator, and your arrival marks a turning point in the lives of those you encounter.

title: Dash Dash Dead
description: Dash Dash Dead is a fast paced turn based roguelike. In a televised bloodsport of the future, you are a death row inmate competing for a shot at freedom. Each episode, you're thrown into a new and deadly world, forced to hunt down targets and survive with the help of powerful, unpredictable items.

title: Groove Coaster: Scream Out!
description: Title: Scream Out!Artist: A-One*Arrange from Touhou FuujinrokuDifficulty: Simple 2 / Normal 7 / Hard 11BPM: 165

title: Calc+-
description: Calc+- is a fun and brain-teasing puzzle game where you work with numbers. Each level gives you a set of number blocks. Using your controller, you can add, subtract, multiply, or divide them. Your goal? Make the final number match the target number. The more levels you beat, the harder it gets. How far can your brain take you?

title: Groove Coaster: Bonetrousle
description: UNDERTALE music DLC for Groove CoasterTitle: BonetrousleArtist: Toby Fox*From UNDERTALEDifficulty: Simple 1 / Normal 5 / Hard 8BPM: 150

title: Pic-A-Block
description: Welcome to Pic-A-Block, a brand new puzzle game from TreeFall Studios. Pic-A-Block is a 3D spatial brain teaser game. The goal of the game is to recreate 2D images in 3D by positioning blocks in a manner that matches the picture you are given.

title: Groove Coaster: Modelista
description: Arcaea music DLC for Groove Coaster - Title: Modelista - Artist: HiTECH NINJA - From 'Arcaea' ︎ lowiro 2019 - Difficulty: Simple 2 / Normal 7 / Hard 13 - BPM: 165

title: Beanball
description:
Beanball is a fast-paced arcade game where you pilot a small spaceship and dodge incoming asteroids. The longer you survive, the more points you earn. Collect coins to boost your score and stay ahead!

But the real twist? If your ship gets destroyed, you can rewind time to bring it back—just be careful, your rewind energy is limited. Run out, and it’s game over!

How long can you last in the asteroid storm?

title: Fly Light
description: Fly Light is a game in which you need to turn on lamps located on 4 different sides, thereby attracting midges to you. Thus, you need to lure as many midges as possible to the exploding area. But you need to be careful, because if you attract a midge too close to you, it can sit on the lamp, thereby partially blocking the glow range of the lamp, which will mean that you will not be able to attract a new midge so easily. You will lose when the midges stick to one of the lamps so that it can no longer shine. You get points for the number of midges destroyed using explosions.

title: Sonic CD's Scrapped Rounds
description: This mod returns the scrapped levels of the Sonic CD: Dubious Depths, Baneful Badland (reimagined Desert Dazzle) and Final Fever. Levels become part of the main game, not additional levels. They are made according to existing information and concepts about them, but at the same time, the mod does not try to authentically and accurately recreate the levels, but is a free interpretation of the author. All level's assets and objects are custom. The mod has a little customization of names and level music; some of the music was written specifically for the levels, while others were borrowed from other authors, most of whom are part of the team.

title: Hell of Fear: Mind Breach
description: Step into the boots of Major Axel Vex in this survival horror descent into deep space. You embark on a mission to investigate a distress signal coming from Cengona Base. What starts off as a simple mission quickly turns into a terrifying, action-packed fight for survival.

title: Tutien Path
description: 3D Xianxia Cultivation game, Fantasy Adventure RPG in UE5. You are free on your own path in the world. But you will be loneliness, and very consistency if you want to go to the highest. It’s a part of a web novel, Q-Style with stylized object model and colors world.

title: Shellborne
description: Shellborne is a chaotic co-op game, where you guide a giant mystical turtle, over a dangerous mountain path. Collect resources and flee from the evil fog.

title: And Then There Was No Light
description: A Game Boy-style Sokoban puzzle! Nostalgic pixel art and 8-bit sound. Starts easy, gradually becomes brain-teasing. For beginners to intermediates, clearable in 2-10 hours. No modern elements. Small surprise at the end. Enjoy brain training in a retro world!

title: My Beautiful Vacation
description: My Beautiful Vacation is a casual hidden-object and puzzle game set around a colorful carnival. Players guide Jack through themed locations by finding items, solving mini-games, and completing scene-based objectives across multiple chapters.

title: Eyewitness Virtual Reality: Cat
description: Eyewitness Virtual Reality: Cat is an educational video game made for the Eyewitness Virtual Reality Series, by DK Multimedia and released for Windows in 1995. The game is based on the Eyewitness first season episode Cat, and opens with the entire opening sequence for Cat.

title: HoneHone Zaurus X: Chou Gattai! Build & Battle
description: "Honehone Saurus X Super Combination! "Build & Battle" is a "build" where you can fully enjoy the assembly and reassembly that is the biggest appeal of the long-selling toy confectionery 『Honehone Saurus』, and you can control the original Honehone Saurus created by that build You can enjoy two types of "battles" where you can enjoy action battles.

title: Plambra Dash: The Parkour Game Part II
description: Jump, climb, and race your friends in this thrilling parkour adventure set in a mysterious tropical island reaching up to the sky. Dive into fast-paced, action-packed fun. Don’t miss out! Grab your spot and start the climb now!

title: Smile Dog
description: You’ve got mail. You shouldn’t have opened it. A classic creepypasta brought to life as a psychological horror, where one email is all it takes for things to go wrong.

title: Shadowbound
description:
Shadowbound is a 2D pixel-art horror platformer with multiple chapters.

The first chapter is focused on light mechanics. Some lamps stay forever, others disappear after a few seconds. Stay in the dark for too long and it’s game over.

But the game isn’t only about this mechanic.

Each chapter introduces something new: different gameplay mechanics, enemies, locations and challenges. Some parts focus on horror and atmosphere, others on reaction, precision or exploration.

title: Sonic Origins Ultrafix
description: Sonic Origins Ultrafix is a mod that changes, fixes and adds to various parts of the collection (including its games, the collection menus, and all the other side modes) to bring you the ultimate Origins experience!

title: Blank_01
description: blank_01 is a short, narrative-driven experience about routine, isolation, and quiet horror. You live in an ordinary house. You work a simple job. Every day is the same. Until something shifts.

title: Numeral Strike
description: A turn-based roguelite where battles take place on a field of numbers. Find pairs — either matching numbers or those that add up to 10 — to attack, defend, and overcome enemies in a world of magical medieval fantasy!

title: Grind Hero
description: 2D MMORPG with PvP, guilds, bosses, sigils, and a vast world to explore!

title: Chesstris
description: Chess meets Tetris in a series of handcrafted puzzles. Drop chess pieces to checkmate rival kings while avoiding checkmating your own. New to chess or a grandmaster, it doesn’t matter. The only way you’ll prevail is thinking outside of the board.

title: Ravenous
description: RAVENOUS is a first-person psychological horror game combining exploration, puzzle-solving, and tense atmospheres. Navigate unique rooms in a Victorian basement, uncover clues, and solve challenges to survive. The game focuses on narrative-driven horror, immersing players in a story of family, confinement, and mystery.

title: Petsitting
description: Your friend is gone for the weekend and has left you in charge of their beloved family pet, the giant worm named Dog.

title: Lost Seed
description: Lost Seed is a single-player visual novel combining RPG and dating sim elements. Featuring over 300,000 words of text and more than 30 beautifully illustrated CGs, the game immerses players in a rich narrative full of fantasy, magic, romance, and mystery. Your decisions shape Mia’s journey and the fate of her companions in a captivating story on the continent of Eden.

title: Trace: Definitive Edition
description:
You awake to find yourself locked inside a curious house. Explore your surroundings to find clues and helpful items. Solve the puzzles in each room and delve into the deeper mystery of this strange place.

TRACE: Definitive Edition is a 3D room escape with mind-bending puzzles, gorgeous visuals, and a mystery stemming from events of a dark past. Make clever connections to solve puzzles, immerse yourself in surreal 3D, HD environments and witness memories of a dark past to understand your situation.

title: Penguin's Love
description: Penguin's Love is a charming puzzle platformer that combines heartwarming storytelling with engaging gameplay. Players solve puzzles, overcome obstacles, and traverse varied levels to help the penguin reach his beloved. With cute visuals, creative mechanics, and a relaxing yet challenging experience, the game is perfect for casual players and puzzle enthusiasts alike.

title: Harvest Mall
description:
HARVEST MALL is a Farming Game where you play as Harvester, a Junior Farmer who goes through 4 different zones to farm as much as he can. Collect crops, badges, and friends in this simple farming game. Available to play on Browser and also available to Download.

Part of "The Way of the Canvas", the same universe as Copper Odyssey and other games in the Mall subseries.

This game is a very elaborate modification of the game "Farmland" by Altoc.

title: Wonderfall
description: A third-person adventure game in a dystopian 1920s Paris consumed by Entropy. As buildings crumble into sand, Léon, a young orphan with the ability to manipulate this sand embark on a quest for truth and confront the remains of a city collapsing beneath his feet.

title: Hell's Kitchen
description: A short game where you summon demons to resolve your clients troubles.

title: Wilderings: The Lost Spring
description: Wilderings is an open-world action roguelite with creature collection and metroidvania-like progression that tells an emotionally impactful story about friendship, family, responsibility, and restoration.

title: Deck & Conn
description: Take command of a nuclear-powered space corvette in a Cold War-flavored sci-fi campaign. Balance tactics, crew, and limited resources in a dynamic forever-war. Retro pixel art meets deep strategy fifteen minutes into the future of 1989.

title: Gallipoli
description: Land on the battlefields of the Middle Eastern Front of World War 1! Gallipoli brings the most authentic WW1 FPS battles yet, with desert warfare, beach landings, historical classes and realistic weaponry.

title: Shenmue III Enhanced
description: Step back into the world of Shenmue III with the Enhanced Edition, the latest release of Yu Suzuki's legendary adventure series. Faithful to its roots yet enriched with modern improvements, this enhanced version offers the most polished and accessible way to experience Ryo Hazuki's journey.

title: Harrowed World: What's Past Is Portents - Duncan's Story
description:
You are Dr Duncan Richard Edwin-Oswald, a renowned physician, a gentleman, and a kind-hearted philanthropist.

Cursed by guilt and consumed by grief, you consider taking drastic measures, when you are visited by a mysterious woman who is not all that she seems.

title: Double Dragon III: The Sacred Stones
description: Billy, Jimmy, and the whole Double Dragon gang fight for the Sacred Stones to save in the world in yet another beat-em-up.

title: The Sword Game
description: The Sword Game is a semi-fast paced retro styled 3D platformer, made to mimic shareware games of early 2000's. Your mission is to get the lowest time possible on all levels. You can cheat, find shortcuts, you have all the freedom in the world.

title: Fox Flare Night
description: Shape-shifting Kitsune Mio battles the mischievous Tanuki army in this fast-paced, comedic side-scrolling shooter! Unleash powerful yōjutsu and transformations to dodge bullet barrages. Packed with modes for both casual and hardcore players, offering plenty of content to master!

title: Wanting Shock
description: Owari and her 7 friends plan to solve an abandoned mystery, but quickly spirals into something sinister.

title: The Last Janitor: Data Cleanup
description: You are Zildo, the janitor of a company where employees have been replaced by robots. Enraged, you decide to destroy all of them and reclaim your place. Explore procedurally generated worlds, find weapons, and use power-ups to win.

title: Chickens Don't Fly
description: In this tough-as-nails physics-platformer, swing to freedom as a rooster whose only hope of escaping a harsh pit of hopelessness lies in a pair of plungers and his own strength. Grapple your way to freedom, but be careful—one wrong move can send you back to the start.

title: Breadieval
description: Create unique baked goods by combining ingredients you find at the market. Befriend the puppet villagers by baking their favourite recipes or by combining tasty flavours. Have fun, you don't have to follow a recipe here.

title: After The Afterlife
description: After The Afterlife: A challenging 2D platformer that puts your parkour skills to the test. Help our main character overcome every obstacle standing in their way as they strive to complete their journey!

title: TavernHold
description: Build, manage and defend your fantasy tavern.

title: Taina's Cursed Legacy
description: A text-based RPG with a nonlinear story set in a free Slavic fantasy world. Shape the heroine's character through your choices and unlock multiple endings. Mystery, folklore, and relationships — your fate depends only on you.

title: Stackflow
description: Stackflow is a hypnotically addictive strategic roguelike about the pure pleasure of fitting pieces perfectly. Discover unique blocks, create satisfying connections, and trigger explosive combos that release pure dopamine.

title: Party Play Mania
description: Party Play Mania is a local multiplayer party tabletop game that supports up to four players. Players can challenge their friends in Party Play Mania for a showdown!

title: Jackpoison
description: This game is a combination of slot and battle RPG!You eat mushrooms and control slots,You can accumulate coins to unlock skills!Rescue the fairies from the bosses who abuse the power of mushrooms!

title: TerraCube
description: Race against the clock to terraform cube-shaped planets and tackle over 20 unique minigames, each offering a different challenge to test your skills and strategy. Earn trophies in quick, time-paced games, and use them wisely to buy new lands and tackle even more goals.

title: Mira's Mirage Mirror
description: #mir3.exec is a subprocess in {mir3 nervOuS}_{which simulates a reincarnating world}. #a fit model is expected through an iterative method. #version 230527, created/modified by mira.

title: Ash Pines: The Motel
description: Something is watching you, can you escape?

title: Rhyme Star
description: A well drawn game which pits you against various monsters in an Othello-style board game battle, where there are card battles to determine if a square is taken.

title: More Than Words
description: More than words is a conversational game in which you can Chat with a smart, friendly, and beautiful chatbot powered by GOOGLE GEMMA 3. The chatbot remembers your past conversations. The conversations are local, so they're anonymous.

title: Flip for Cake
description: Flip for Cake is a precision Platformer with a bit of puzzle elements inspired by Celeste. You play as a boy who is veeery hungry for cake and the goal is to get the cake in each level.

title: Dungeons, Dungeons and more... Dice?
description: What if your dice turned on you? What if instead of the roller, you were the rolled? Find out in this DnD inspired bullet hell!

title: Dragonnet Havoc
description: A game about building a team to fight and defend the town. Prepare at daytime and fight at night in a mix between a tower defense, real-time strategy and creature collection game.

title: Bubble Investor
description: Bubble Investor is an investment game in which you run a bubble company and your goal is to achieve the maximum return from them without the bubble bursting.

title: Captain Puff MacFly
description: Shmup Roguelite – Dodge Hell, Power Up, Repeat, Conquer Netunia’s Sky with Captain Puff MacFly!

title: Pillar of Salt
description: The deity of this world has decided to destroy it in three days. His avatar awaits the world's champion at the top of the Mountain of Power. Can you build up your strength in time and reach the mountain in this unique real-time tactical roguelike RPG?

title: Alpha Point
description: Alpha Point is a solo-indie multiplayer FPS featuring ray-traced realistic visuals, slick gunplay, and an innovative rank & loadout system. Fight in FFA, TDM, and CTF across 3 maps using your customized loadout. Wishlist now and head to the Alpha Point.

title: Sunday League Manager: Horse & Spoon
description: Manage Horse & Spoon FC, a down-and-out pub team in Sunday League football. Guide veteran plumbers and aging shop attendants from car park pitches to regional glory. Sunday League football management at its most beautifully chaotic.

title: Word Worm
description: A cross between a word search puzzle and trivia game, alongside your little worm buddy.

title: Hockey Club
description: An up to 6v6 online multiplayer hockey game. Customize your build for each position (goalie builds coming soon). Form a team with your friends, or search for a game as a solo. Choose a position at the start of the game and control your player with a controller. Trade positions at intermission.

title: For the Wheat
description: A high score arena shooter. Run. Cull. Die. Repeat. Unlock advantages and beat your survival time. How long will you last?

title: One Shot X
description: Made in 3 Hours for the TriJam 190

title: Just Another Pong Clone
description:
Just a Pong Clone. Nothing special to see here.
Made for the TriJam106 in 2 Hours and 20 minutes

title: Ring Battle
description: An online multiplayer game in which you try to push the other player out of the ring by dashing into them.

title: Falling Guys
description: Made in 2 Days for the GMTK Game Jam 2021

title: Push'n Pull
description: A game where you open as many doors as possible within 60 seconds made in under 3 hours for the Trijam #189

title: Flying Guys
description: This is a re-imagination of a game called Luqman Reloaded made within 48 hours

title: Untitled Tomb Runner
description: A game originally intended for the Ludum Dare 50 jam with the theme "the end is inevitable".

title: Forest Restoration
description: You are tasked with restoring a forest that has been destroyed by a fire to its former beauty. Hire units and make them help you complete your mission.

title: Tony's Crispy Crisps
description:
Tony's is the largest company in the world that conquered people's hearts with its corn flakes chain "Tony's Crispy crisps".
The lovely mascots Molly and Tony are known and loved all over the world.
The unique thing about the cornflakes is their breath taking taste and the unthinkably low price.

title: Unstable Tower
description: Made in 3 Days for Ludum Dare 49

title: The Flower
description: You have a flower that only needs to be watered once a year but if you give it too much or not enough water it dies.

title: The Search For Above Average Life
description:
The Search for Above Average Life is a light-hearted bullet-hell adventure where friendship is a matter of overcoming the language barrier. Play as SAAL, a lonely exploration robot, scanning planets and befriending the galaxy’s strangest inhabitants.

Choose how to communicate—Speak, Write, Gesture, or Dance—then dodge red “misunderstanding” projectiles and collect green “understanding” to build trust. Expand your star map, meet eccentric aliens, unlock hints, and discover what it means to find life that’s truly above average.

title: Empty Box
description: Psychological horror dating sim for women. Navigate a seemingly perfect school life where every sweet moment hides a lie. Why is the rooftop locked? Why is *they* so obsessed? Why only ‘L’? Your choices shape the truth—and every move is watched. Discover chilling endings.

title: The You Quiz
description: The You Quiz is a multiplayer game where the questions are about you! Be the King and judge your friends' answers about yourself. Or be a Courtier, guess their quirks, tastes, and dreams. Win favor, climb the ranks, become the new King. 3-8 players, online or local.

title: I Wanna Ponder
description: A puzzle-heavy I Wanna Be The Guy game with 10 styles of puzzles with 10 puzzles each of quickly escalating difficulty. The focus is on presenting the player with all information and having them solve puzzles in a logical fashion, integrating a variety of classic puzzle concepts with traditional Fangame platforming.

title: Life is Strange Collection
description:
LIFE IS STRANGE is a single-player narrative adventure series that focuses on heartfelt, grounded stories with a twist of the strange, and a franchise that has won over 100 awards since its inception - including from The Peabody Awards, BAFTA, and GLAAD.

Over five cinematic, emotional adventures, you’ll Rewind Time as Max Caulfield and uncover the secrets of Arcadia Bay with Chloe Price, take a road trip with Sean Diaz and his telekinetic brother Daniel, find a new home with psychic empath Alex Chen, and return to Max to solve a murder across two timelines.

The box set comprises a disc with LIFE IS STRANGE: TRUE COLORS and LIFE IS STRANGE: DOUBLE EXPOSURE, alongside a redemption code granting entitlement to LIFE IS STRANGE REMASTERED, LIFE IS STRANGE: BEFORE THE STORM REMASTERED, LIFE IS STRANGE 2, and all associated DLC and pre-order incentive items.

title: We Build Below
description: A roguelite, co-op factory builder that is set on an alien planet. You're part of an rag-tag mining team trying to get rich. Meet the daily quota to keep your mining permit and defend against dangerous parasites to stay alive.

title: ZeroZeta
description: ZeroZeta is a minimal, precision racing game with chill ambient music. Glide through hand-crafted levels, chase personal bests, and discover the flow of perfect runs.

title: Kami Quest: Enter the Imagynasium
description: Kami Quest is a whimsical 3D platformer where you play as Sabbath, an energetic dalmatian exploring the ever-shifting Imagynasium, a living castle full of quirky spirits, surreal worlds, and hidden secrets.

title: Limit Zero Breakers
description: Explore the floating islands of Seraphia as a Breaker in this anime action RPG. Build a team of characters with different fighting styles and unleash stylish attacks as you battle through ancient dungeons and massive monsters in search of the Archive of the Gods.

title: Chiseler
description: Use logic to uncover artifacts in this casual picture puzzle game. With over 150 puzzles spread throughout a full story mode campaign, you'll have plenty of puzzles to keep you busy. Make and share your own levels with others with the included puzzle editor to keep the fun alive forever.

title: Forge the Fates
description: This roguelike deckbuilder transforms your classic hand of cards into a grid of runes. Play a rune and the ones behind it shift forward, so every move shapes what’s next. Build a unique deck, trigger match-3 combos, and outplay your enemies.

title: Pigbert
description: The Supreme Overlord has granted you the Award of Excellent Labour and you are required by law to accept it. Journey across the polluted, mushroom-farming nation to reach the palace, battling fanatics, enforcers, and desperate workers in turn-based RPG combat.

title: Ash Warden
description: Ash Warden is a fast-paced tower defense where you click to shoot enemies, teleport between three towers, and upgrade skills to survive relentless Redgaze waves.

title: Motamo
description: Motamo is a word puzzle game where players must guess a hidden target french word using color-coded hints. Each attempt reveals how close the letters are to the correct solution, creating a logical and linguistic challenge. The game features multiple levels, dictionary definitions, score multipliers, and special tiles that alter the difficulty. Designed to be both fun and educational, Motamo offers a unique mix of wordplay and puzzle mechanics accessible to all players.

title: The Silence After
description: The Silence After is a first-person atmospheric horror game where you play as a blind sole survivor following a distress signal through an apocalyptic reality, interacting with the environment and using your synesthetic ability to perceive sound as color to progress and avoid death.

title: Magic City Detective: The Carnival Begins DLC
description: Prepare to be challenged, thrilled, and enchanted. Can you maintain your integrity when faced with the allure of forbidden knowledge and power?

title: Monster Knockout: Idle DLC
