description: Monster Knockout Idle offers a delightful mix of engaging game play, charming visuals, and rewarding progression.

title: Monster Knockout: Bounce DLC
description: Make your way through some pipes and try and get to the other side

title: Mystical Riddles: Ghostly Park DLC
description: What is the price of eternal life? Stop the atrocious ritual! Possessed spirits never sleep. Will you be able to stop them?

title: Forza Motorsport: 2024 Ford Mustang Dark Horse
description: Forza Motorsport 2024 Ford Mustang Dark Horse

title: Square: Trial and Error
description:
Square: Trial and Error is a Puzzle Platformer game where you are tasked with restoring Town Square by completing 20 Trial and Error puzzles!

Each level has its own set of rules that you need to figure out by Trial and Error. No hints or clues are given in each level, and you must rely on observation and the outcome of your actions to figure out each level!

The game has a ton of features and fun for you to have! Find buried treasure, solve the riddle of the glitch zone, form your party, decorate your own home, and more!

title: Undockable
description: You are Hjorti, a living heart trapped in an absurd simulation. What does a heart do? Why, use space station modules to build a living weapon, destroy endless enemies, overcome complex bosses, all with a trademark dark sense of humor! Strategize, combine, and survive the madness!

title: SnowRunner: Season 15 - Oil & Dirt
description:
Oil & Dirt is Season 15 of SnowRunner. Included in the Year 4 Pass. Requires the base game SnowRunner to run.

Québec is bursting with exciting projects, and they need you to construct an oil platform by delivering building materials and a massive anchor. Link roads together to form a new highway network, help organize a major fishing festival and more, with 2 new trucks across 2 brand new maps.

Season 15: Oil & Dirt includes:

• Two new 4km² maps set in Québec, Canada. Complete new missions across a new winter region traversed by tall mountains and frozen rivers.
• Two new vehicles: the Sleiter ST 816 “Elephant”, a 6-wheel Heavy Duty tractor able to pull even the heaviest loads, and the Mercer K520, an agile and versatile Off-road truck with exceptional capabilities in exploration and rescue scenarios.
• New activities: Help Québec companies with major infrastructure projects after the Canadian winter had them grind to halt, and celebrate the region’s angling industry by helping organize a major fishing festival.

title: Revolution Editions: Shadow & Steel
description:
Dive into the past and enjoy acclaimed editions of Revolution Software's four award winning games from the 1990's.

Powered by proprietary emulation technology from Antstream featuring custom GPU emulation timing developed specifically for Broken Sword 1 & 2. Experience these Amiga and PlayStation classics as they ran on original hardware in one standalone offline package!

title: Tales of Xillia Remastered
description:
Experience Tales of Xillia, remastered for the first time ever.
Dive into the magnificent world of Rieze Maxia as either Jude Mathis, an aspiring medical student from the capital, or Milla Maxwell, a mysterious woman accompanied by four powerful spirits.

title: Goblin Sushi
description: In this rogue-like restaurant-action-sim, you play as a goblin that has the dream of becoming a sushi chef. Upgrade the restaurant, the menu and your ingredients to feed your fellow goblins the best and most expensive sushi any goblin can find in the cave!

title: HoloRun
description: HoloRun is a fast-paced, fun-filled game designed for Hololive fans to connect, compete, and celebrate their favorite talents in an exciting virtual playground.

title: Dialoop
description: This is a roguelike puzzle game where quick thinking determines your survival. Every run offers a fresh experience based on your choices—deck-building, puzzle-solving, and exploration all shape your journey. Master the mysterious stone tablets and uncover the secrets hidden within ancient ruins!

title: DeMon Researcher
description: DeMon Researcher is a sci-fi survival horror where rogue AIs rule and humanity hides. When a leader’s daughter is taken by the terrifying DeMon, one man must uncover the truth—if he survives. Face off against deadly AI across 4 intense stages using guns, grenades, and grit.

title: Merge Match March
description: An RPG that combines merge puzzles and battles, where you become the strategist of a hero-led army to command your troops and protect the kingdom from monsters!

title: Ninja Cats: Tactics
description: Build the ultimate ninja squad with your voice! NINJA CATS: Tactics is a battle RPG where communicating with your ninja cats builds trust. Train and nurture them through voice commands, shaping their skills and abilities. Enjoy chatting with them or streaming your adventure—it's up to you!

title: Smith & Dungeon
description: "Smith and Dungeon" is a hack-and-slash roguelite game, where you play as a blacksmith exploring dungeons, battling monsters, collecting materials, and crafting powerful weapons!

title: Erase: Missing Link
description: A TRPG-style card game adventure that delves into the mysteries of the Cthulhu Mythos. You play card games, grow your skills by interacting with people, get information by exploring, and solve the mythical incidents by unraveling the secrets hidden in the cards.

title: Omicrox
description: Omicrox takes Ultimate Tic Tac Toe and adds powerful one-use ability cards for unlimited strategic possibilities. Earn abilities as you play, like swapping boards, blocking moves, or stealing cards, and use them to outsmart friends or AI in this battle of tactics.

title: Power of the Horde
description: Power of the Horde is a single-player RTS with RPG elements. Its key feature is that hero equipment is permanently retained, so the goal isn’t just to destroy the enemy base. Players can loot new items in each skirmish or campaign — like playing an RPG within an RTS.

title: Scholar Adventure: Mystery of Silence
description: Mystery of Silence is a point-and-click adventure where William, a young writer in search of inspiration, enters an abbey shrouded in silence. What William finds within those walls is not just a story to tell, but a secret that should never be discovered.

title: Deep Line
description: Deep beneath the abandoned subway, an unknown threat awaits. Collect gold and find a way out.

title: PhotoLoop
description: PhotoLoop is a casual game about editing photos using an outdated editing software that only has the lasso tool. Make sure to make your edits clean and concise, or you might not be able to pay your rent due in five days!

title: Cinder City
description: Cinder City is an open-world cinematic third-person shooter set in a fallen near-future Seoul. Fight alongside allies, push back against overwhelming threats, and reclaim the city from the forces tearing it apart.

title: Killover
description: Kill the past over and over. Loop each time you kill all your previous lives, but beware not to be shot or touch them for an indomitable death.

title: Terraria: Lunar Veil Mod
description:
The Lunar Veil Legacy is an old expansive mod for the world of Aimacra. As a crossover from a personal game Diari,
Sirestias has sought to expand her skills in the world of terraria and she wants to eliminate all false gods and goddesses on the planet who cause harm to others.

The ones that pose a threat to existence on the planet of terraria would be gods who own singularities. They cause inreversible damage and often corrupts the worlds and the minds within them.
People go out to worship these gods and protect them, and nobody dare stand up to the ones who rule their domains.

title: Grindworm
description: A short horror game where you're buried alive in a collapsed underground mine, and your only hope for survival is an old mining machine. Workplace safety rules no longer apply. Just remember: Don't. Stop. Digging.

title: Victory Banner
description: Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of World War II in this real-time historical strategy game. Command a frontline company, make critical strategic decisions, and take direct control of any soldier or vehicle. Every decision comes at a price. What will be yours?

title: Bubsy 4D
description: The infamous, wise-cracking bobcat has returned to 3D in a new platforming adventure. Bubsy is back with new challenges, new moves, and even more purrsonality. Run, jump, glide, and roll across alien planets, battle robotic sheep, and collect tons and tons of yarn. What could possibly go wrong?

title: Late Amusement
description: Were they all just accidents, or were they? Late Amusement is a first-person survival horror from a small indie studio. You play as young student Liam Snow and survive for as long as you can to uncover the secrets of the theme park.

title: Battlestar Galactica: Scattered Hopes
description: In Battlestar Galactica: Scattered Hopes, take command of a fleet escaping the annihilation of the Twelve Colonies. Manage crises on board as you prepare for the next encounter with the Cylon Fleet. Times are dire, and hard choices must be made. Your only hope: rejoin the Battlestar Galactica.

title: Outlaws + Handful of Missions: Remaster
description: When outlaws murdered your wife and took your daughter, everything you had was gone. Your gut aches for blood and sweet revenge. Dyin's too good for 'em now!

title: Koshari Defense
description: Mysterious creatures are attacking the empire! The pharaoh needs you to build a defense to defeat them. You must channel the divine power to retake your temples and build towers.

title: Cook or Be Cooked
description: A walk-and-talk indie adventure game where you and your dysfunctional witch parents cook teens to stay young and powerful. But when they bring in a charming girl as your next meal, will you uphold the family tradition or risk everything to save her?

title: Denshattack!
description: Flip, trick and grind your train in a fast-paced, off-the-rails ride through a colourful Japanese dystopia. Outmatch rival gangs, wreck a shady megacorp, and take back the tracks with nothing but skill, speed, and style.

title: Snout About
description: Snout About is a chaotic co-op game where you and your friends play as dogs dragging your human through a stylized 3D park to catch the bus—avoid obstacles, collect treats, and work together to be the best buddies!

title: Emergency Call: The Firefighting Simulation 3
description: Be part of a professional fire department and prepare for your operations. Complete training courses and drills during your 24-hour shifts to qualify for roles from attack crew member to engineer across various emergency vehicles.

title: Media Circus
description: Launch your newspaper and sway the masses in a unique animal world! Direct reporters, plan stories, blow up Headlines for Impact and throw in Ads for Profit. With every faction gunning for a piece of your front page, how far will you go to keep your paper in print, and yourself out of trouble?

title: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe: Dragon Pearl of Destruction
description: Eternia’s favorite heroes including He-Man, Teela, Man-At-Arms and more in a two-player, retro-inspired 2D magic-brawler, drawn in beautiful pixel-art and featuring huge, highly-detailed sprites, designed to do justice to Eternia’s favorite peace-keepers.

title: Arcana Automata
description: In Arcana Automata, you program drones using Python to harvest a mystical resource, unlock upgrades, and encounter German mythical creatures. Perfect for curious minds who love to learn through play.

title: Armageddonica
description: Revolutionary ARPG/RTS where your hero shapes the battle, but strategy and your army decide the war. Hack-and-slash your way to commanding legions. Fight the dire gods, while the Gospel of Judas whispers a forbidden truth.

title: Valor Mortis
description: Valor Mortis is a first-person action soulslike from the creators of Ghostrunner. Rise from death as a former soldier of Napoleon’s army. Wield supernatural powers, battle horrifying monsters, and unravel a conspiracy that threatens all of humanity.

title: Bloodbreaker: Labyrinth of the Witch
description: Prepare to descend into the Labyrinth. Bloodbreaker: Labyrinth of the Witch combines the best elements of the roguelite and Metroidvania genres into an unforgiving, yet rewarding experience.

title: Dunestake
description: Dunestake is a single player, high-risk & high-reward auto battler, with an emphasis on combat bets, offering a wide variety of strategies & combos. Stake your units for gold and cross your fingers, for the dunes can be cruel.

title: Cosmodrill
description: Explore the vastness of space, dig deep into planets to find resources, upgrade your ship and survive against alien life in this 2D open-universe space mining adventure! How far are you willing to travel into the dark unknown?

title: Relics: A Dark-fantasy Deck-Survivor
description: Relics is a dark fantasy deckbuilding survivor where you battle relentless hordes in real time. Build your deck, unleash devastating card combos, and discover powerful Relics that reshape each run to match your playstyle.

title: Swords of Legends
description: Swords of Legends is a single-player action-adventure RPG set in the primordial age, a world drawn from the strange tales of classical Chinese literature, where mortals, gods, and wandering souls walk the same earth.

title: Off Course
description: Off Course is a narrative boat-parkour game in which the overthinker Noi finds herself stranded in the depths of her flooded subconsciousness. Will you manage to overcome her roaring thoughts and doubts to stay in the flow?

title: Road Kings
description: Drive a 40-ton semi hauling cargo across the coastal plains of the American South, managing multiple jobs, trailers, and routes. Grow reputation from rookie to veteran owner-operator, dodging disasters and rivals to become the hero of the open road.

title: Our Eyes See No Evil
description: A first person horror game knows when your eyes are open. Closing the player’s eyes provides safety from the terror, but also leaves them vulnerable to the unknown. Haunted by a clown doll, you can either hide, or open your eyes to the horrors.

title: Pac-Man World 2 Re-Pac x Sonic the Hedgehog
description:
Grants the Sonic the Hedgehog Collaboration Set for PAC-MAN WORLD 2 Re-PAC!

Sonic the Hedgehog Collaboration Set includes:
- 3 Collab Stages
- 1 Collab Costume
- 20 Collab Figures
• Collaboration Set Bonus: Legendary PAC-LAND Costume

title: Detective Sherlock: Shadow Stalker
description: Every character remembers, watches, tests, and may deceive you like a living person. They have emotions, voices, expressions, and buried secrets. Break them with words or evidence — or realize too late that you were only a pawn in their game. A detective game built around truly lifelike NPCs.

title: Here Comes the Swarm
description: Here Comes the Swarm is a survival RTS with a pause button! Create your strategy, build, manage, and defend your settlements at your own pace. Take the fight to the hive mind and lead expeditions to deliver a deadly blow and eradicate your foes. Will you reclaim Ulora from the relentless Swarm?

title: Steel Ark
description: A first-person survival sandbox game where you explore a post-apocalyptic world, scavenge resources, craft production chains, and keep your train base running against all odds.

title: Egglings
description: Hatch all kind of eggs collecting so called egglings. Sell, release or shelter them to unlock and progress in the game.

title: Akiiwan: Survival
description: Fall into a chill survival adventure, where your fire remembers 10,000 years of survival skills and the stars dance at night to show you how each craft is made. Harvest, craft, hunt and gather your stores for the harsh winter ahead, while exploring a strange land – with the help of a talking fire

title: Becoming Pablo
description: Becoming Pablo is a turn-based grand-strategy game where you build and lead a cartel empire. Conquer territories, manage your operation, and outsmart rivals in the gritty 70s-90s drug trade era. Every choice impacts your rise to power, or your downfall. Can you dominate the underworld?

title: Sequence Jump
description: Sequence Jump is a unique sequence-platformer where everything is glitching—except your mind. With just a single button, you control abilities like jumping, dashing, and teleporting. Think ahead, react at the right moment, and conquer challenging levels full of logic, timing, and digital chaos.

title: LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight
description: Rise as the Dark Knight and experience the essential Batman story in a bold, action-packed adventure with hard-hitting combat, an open-world Gotham City, and the signature LEGO charm that fans know and love.

title: Curse of Pirates
description: Ahoy, matey! How about slicing up some sea beasts and sending a couple of rivals to feed the kraken? Curse of Pirates be a true action roguelike, inspired by Vampire Survivors and Hades! Set sail upon the high seas, gather ye brave crew, and stand firm against the relentless tides of foes!

title: Echoes of Mora
description: Embark on a mysterious journey, filled with intriguing interactions and meaningful encounters, as you explore a sunken village and travel through time to help Mora find her lost brother. Playable in VR and non-VR on PC.

title: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV
description: Return to the RTS series’ roots with deeply satisfying strategy gameplay. Take command of four unique Warhammer 40,000 factions, including the Adeptus Mechanicus in their series debut! Fight through 70+ epic campaign missions, as well as the replayable Last Stand, Skirmish and multiplayer modes.

title: Valkyrie Rising: Hordes of Ragnarök
description: Battle the End of the World in this Norse horde-survivor roguelite. Unleash godlike powers, collect powerful runes, and build insane combos. Survive endless waves, crush epic bosses, and fight to save Asgard from the Hordes of Ragnarök.

title: Time Takers
description: Time is your resource to stay alive or to grow your strength. Gather it, use it strategically, and survive intense combat. No fixed roles—every match is built on your choices in Time Takers.

title: Love You More
description: Connor, a single father, visits a memory-restoration clinic in order to relive the days he had with his estranged son Bry. Experience what’s left of his past as he gets to relive his cherished memories and routine joys, while keeping away from the disturbing truth lurking beneath the surface.

title: Steal Out
description: A chaotic, laugh-out-loud game for up to 4 players! Pull off an epic heist and escape before you’re caught! Dodge traps, crack safes, and steal loot from rivals. Most importantly — have an absolute blast!

title: Rhythm Rat Rampage
description: Rhythm meets bullet heaven in a genre-smashing fusion. Strik-9 challenges you to dodge to the beat and shred your enemies in a music-driven gauntlet of chaos, speed, and style.

title: Another Pint
description: Another Pint is a dynamic management game where you get to build and run your own medieval tavern. Tasked with taking over a barebones shack, where you take it is up to you.

title: Pumuckl and the Crown of the Pirate King
description: The famous German kobold Pumuckl is back with a 3D puzzle adventure game “Pumuckl and the Crown of the Pirate King”. The player controls Pumuckl through 3D puzzle levels, plays mini-games, solves tricky challenges and has to defeat scary enemies.

title: Smash 'N Grab
description: Smash ‘N Grab is a destructive, speedrunning beat ’em up starring Smash and Grab - a robot and raccoon duo pulling off explosive heists. Tethered by a rope, they race against the clock for the perfect score!

title: Club Defenders
description: Club Defenders is the ultimate fusion of music, strategy, and action! It's up to you to protect our music from the Xilenz. Arm yourselves with powerful music-based towers, sound weapons and music instruments, sync up with your team and unleash the power of music to fend off the alien invaders.

title: Seaward
description: Seaward is a cozy exploration game where you build a ship to discover a flooded world. Find resources and power your ship with renewable energies. Meet unique characters and help them out to build a wholesome community. Make the journey your own by taking photos and filling up your journal.

title: Bot Slash Bot
description: You click - You dash - You slash. Bot slash Bot is a fast-paced, top-down Hack n‘ Slash in which you control a rogue robot slashing & dashing through your former co-machines holding you captive! It's all about speed. Time is running out.

title: Wolley's Dungeon Adventure
description: The land of Ballonia was thriving and peaceful, until the evil sorcerer Malvolio corrupted the land and its inhabitants. Wolley, the last Ballonian, gifted with special powers, sets off on a journey to restore and reclaim Ballonia from Malvolio's grip!

title: Little Chef: Cozy Cooking
description: Little Chef: Cozy Cooking is a physics-based cooking game full of discovery and playful chaos. Experiment with everything in the kitchen and unlock around 300 recipes on your way to becoming a master chef!

title: Mad King Redemption
description: Mad King Redemption is a unique blend of a traditional beat'em'up game with strong roguelite progression, mixed in a pixelated graphic style in a 2.5D world. Relieve the king from his madness while beating up corrupted enemies, in a fresh way at every run!

title: Magic Dodgeball: Homeless Edition
description: A chaotic PvP action bullet hell where unemployed wizards battle in magical dodgeball duels. Fight with your friends, choose buffs between rounds and build absurdly powerful spell combos to survive and entertain!

title: Space Tail
description: Space Tail is a 2.5D adventure platformer that follows an emotional, story-driven journey through the cosmos. Play as a brave space-traveling dog exploring mysterious planets, solving puzzles, and forming unique bonds with alien civilizations along the way.

title: World of Tanks 2.0
description: Start the next chapter of World of Tanks in the interactive Operations Room—a central place to reflect on your journey, prepare for what's ahead, and gear up for Update 2.0

title: Prescribe and Pray
description: Who said being a doctor was an easy job? In Prescribe and Pray, you're the Doctor! Check the patient's identity, diagnose their (often bizarre) illness, and issue their prescription. All without making a mistake! So, are you up to the challenge?

title: Zero Parades: For Dead Spies
description: From ZA/UM comes ZERO PARADES: For Dead Spies – a story-rich espionage RPG. You're a brilliant but tormented operant on a desperate assignment. Pick up the pieces of your broken network, untangle a bloody web of intrigue at the End of History, and prove yourself on the big stage or blow it all up – again.

title: SnowRunner: Rezvani Tank
description:
The SnowRunner garage keeps on getting bigger and better with a new scout looking as mean as it is powerful, the Rezvani Tank!

Fitted with the same engine as its big brother the Rezvani Hercules, it separates itself with softer suspensions, a lighter chassis and maximum ground clearance giving it incredible agility and power-to-weight ratio.

title: Siaty's Return
description: A challenging slow-paced bossgame inspired by both solo games and MMOs, featuring an innovative combination-based gameplay. Combine the three Facets of destruction, resilience and movement into powerful abilities to defeat your corrupted creations.

title: La Divina Commedia
description: La Divina Commedia is a Dark Fantasy ARPG inspired by the famous masterpiece opera of Dante Alighieri. The "procedural extraction dungeons generation" system ensures a unique and never repetitive experience. "Abandon all hope , ye who enter here". The journey to hell begins!

title: Last Antagonist
description: Last Antagonist is an intense first-person action and strategy game, entirely developed by a single creator.

title: Age of Empires IV: Dynasties of the East
description: Expand your legacy in Dynasties of the East—featuring 4 new variant civilizations, 8 maps, 6 biomes, and a new roguelite RTS experience with dynamic challenges and unpredictable wave-based attacks

title: Kingdom Come: Deliverance II: Legacy of the Forge
description: Put your blacksmithing skills to the test to repair a legendary burnt-down forge. Establish your own home in the heart of Kuttenberg, designing the forge, its surroundings and private quarters with the ability to customise and furnish to aid your gameplay.

title: Cult of the Lamb: Woolhaven
description: A lost God calls you from a mysterious mountain—rebuild the flock and reawaken winter to uncover the truth of the fallen lambs. Face the past before it consumes you in this full-length expansion for Cult of the Lamb.

title: World of Tanks: Heat
description: World of Tanks: HEAT is a free-to-play PvP vehicle shooter with powerful abilities and explosive team combat. Pilot customizable tanks and unleash Agent skills in 10v10 online battles, where tactical warfare meets FPS-style intensity. Take control. Rewrite the rules.

title: Ghost of Yotei: Legends
description:
Ghost of Yötei Legends is an online cooperative multiplayer mode, up to four players, where players can team up with friends to challenge monstrous, supernatural enemies across three distinct game modes:
• Survival - Team up with up to three other players to take down waves of increasingly difficult enemies on one of four maps. Fight to control territory on each map. While in control, you can choose to activate a Blessing to receive an advantage in battle, but losing control can activate a Curse that puts your team at a disadvantage.
• Story - Team up with another player to tackle a series of 12 missions. Work together, combining your unique skills to overcome a range of encounters, enemies and challenges.
• Incursion - Upon completing each set of three Story missions, you’ll unlock a large-scale, four-player assault on a stronghold belonging to a member of the Yōtei Six. Each Incursion will culminate in a boss fight versus a giant, supernatural version of The Spider, The Oni, The Kitsune, or The Snake.

title: HackSlash
description: Action RPG electronic game, with soulslike elements, the environment is an arena with infinite waves of enemies with a medieval fantasy theme. Your goal is to get the highest score possible, killing as many enemies as possible and passing as many waves as possible.

title: Black Myth: Zhong Kui
description: Black Myth: Zhong Kui is an action-RPG focusing on the legendary Chinese demon-slayer, depicting his journey from a wronged, scholar-turned-ghost into a powerful, fearsome judge of the underworld. The game features a new storyline distinct from Wukong, exploring themes of justice and fighting evil with evil.

title: Vampire: The Masquerade - Bloodlines 2 - Santa Monica Memories
description: Santa Monica Memories is a cosmetic pack with iconic items, with a Stop Sign, Voerman Portrait, and Ankaran Sarcophagus, to decorate your haven. Each time you complete the game as a new clan, your haven will also be adorned with a clan neon sign.

title: Vampire: The Masquerade - Bloodlines 2 - Shadows & Silk
description: Shadows & Silk includes two unique vampire clans and eight new outfits. Become a Lasombra, shroud yourself in darkness, and command the shadows themselves. Or, step into the spotlight as a Toreador, captivating and swaying hearts with your artistic charm.

title: Foreverthorn
description: Explore the dungeons of Rose Chapel, blast enemies with your shotgun, avoid deadly traps and collect roses for your wife's grave.

title: Predator: Hunting Grounds: Oni Predator
description: As a Yautja specializing in stealth, the Oni Predator dedicates all his resources to improving the technology, allowing him to engage his prey from the shadows. He is a warrior who prioritized speed and ranged combat, making him an extremely formidable foe.

title: Bot.vinnik Chess Masters Academy
description: Listen up, comrade! Tired of feeling like a terrible chess player? Ditch the flashy modern tools. My routine is simple: I teach you a sharp concept, you apply it in a puzzle, then I unveil the secret twist. Survive my training, and become a true chess master!

title: Harvest Moon: Home Sweet Home Special Edition
description: Harvest Moon: Home Sweet Home Special Edition includes new features for consoles and PC like the Hoverbike 5000 vehicle, two new marriage candidates, new cutscenes, and more.

title: Leksi
description:
Fight dyslexia in this typing and rhythm game. Defend yourself against a monster's attacks and use your magic glasses to decipher its trap attacks.

Master the four levels of story mode and take it to the next level with the two infinite modes to score the highest score!

title: Legends of Aria Eternal
description: Legends of Aria Eternal is a sandbox MMORPG where players shape the world. Now with faster skill gains, a reworked prestige and enchanting system, full in-game knowledge base, and powerful new tools to run your own custom server.

title: Onigiri Shop Simulator
description: Your own onigiri (rice ball) shop in Japan awaits! Serve perfect rice balls and crispy sides to hungry customers. As a solo operator, you'll manage inventory, perfect your cooking flow, and handle the rush. Can you turn your tiny stand into a beloved town eatery?

title: Vanran
description: Vanran is a dark fantasy action RPG where a human slave in the Demon Realm wields a sealed blade and rises in rebellion. Defeat your enemies, claim their powers, grow stronger, and escape. Seek salvation—or choose vengeance.

title: Afterschool : Reel Danger
description: Afterschool: Reel Danger is a fast-paced roguelite survival game with 2D pixel graphics. Choose from three different characters, face off against waves of zombies, earn money, and upgrade your skills from the Merchant & Enchanter to defeat stronger enemies!

title: Crankstone
description: A gallery shooter set in the legendary Wild West O.K. Corral, with a unique twist. Each level is broken up by fast-paced mini-games that take full advantage of the Playdate’s capabilities. Step into the boots of the town sheriff, take down outlaws, dodge the sheriff, protect the innocents, and blow up the scoreboard.

title: Shrapnel Sentinel
description: Shrapnel Sentinel is an arena based FPS with an emphasis on defence. The longer you survive, the more you will encounter.

title: Aim Trainer Asylum
description: Aim Trainer Asylum is a horror aim trainer with stylized black and white visuals. Survive all 4 nights in the asylum with varying difficulty levels and spooky monsters to escape!

title: Ameshidama
description: This is a horror adventure game where you guide a lonely girl into the outside world. The girl is stuck in a small room, alone and unable to go outside. She dreams of the outside. What is outside? Why can't she go outside? Even after learning the reason, will you still take her outside?

title: Infinite Soul
description: Infinite Soul is a breath of fresh air for competitive fighters. Every battle will test your skill, cunning, and resolve. Attack and defend with Water, Earth, Fire, and Air; choose wisely because each one has a strength and a weakness.

title: Seriously Warped Deathmatch
description: Official Deathmatch mode for Serious sam Classic by Croateam

title: Can't Even See the Sky
description: Your character is a man with a troubled past who finds himself trapped in a city on the brink of civil war. Look for ways to get out of the city and make peace with the past. Will you pull yourself together or drown in the abyss of despair?

title: Sprunki Horror From the Loop
description: Will you break the circle of madness, even if you have to lose everything? Discover the dark secrets that the world of Sprunki hides. Be careful, because an ancient evil is waiting for you there.

title: Jump Verse
description: JumpVerse is a fast-paced 2D jump’n’run game with retro pixel style. Master 18 action-packed levels, collect secret coins, dodge tricky traps, and uncover hidden paths. More content coming soon!

title: Project Rot
description: Players will interact with their environment, talk to unique characters, and battle in real-time against their own emotions. Dive into the mind of a younger Nicole as she battles to situate herself in the Other-World whilst learning to cope with the separation from her Mom.

title: Whisper of Y'Ryando
description: Whisper of Y'Ryando is a Lovecraftian puzzle-solving game that showcases a layered papercraft aesthetic. In this game, players will uncover the ongoing stories of the town through a unique perspective, acquiring hundreds of clue fragments by rolling dice.

title: GCS: Salvage Rat
description: A gritty first-person space sim where you mine, trade, fight, and salvage across a procedurally generated universe—then breach derelicts in tense FPS missions with permadeath and full ship customization.

title: The Uncalled
description: A young romantic shepherd is not called to arms for the war in the territory's north. However, witless enough, the enemy has changed its attack route. He is left alone with women, children, and animals to protect and with lots of pain of being belittled by men of the locale and his beloved one.

title: Children's Sandbox
description: A simple interactive, touch-screen supported, game targeted to younger children to help build up early motor and logic skills

title: Shiath
description: Sitting on the brink of extinction, you keep doing what you do best: take and survive. But deep down, you know. Something horrible is about to happen.

title: Fall or Nothing
description: Set the time trial world record in falling by guiding your stuntman through narrow gaps and launching them off of gnarly ramps as they rocket down a hill. Trade off with a friend to see who can slap the fastest time on the leaderboard and bop along to a most radical 80s synth score.

title: Pasta House Simulator
description: Every day is a new challenge! Rent a shop, buy new products, fulfill orders on time, and be ready for surprise visitors! Stay afloat on a limited budget in this immersive simulation game where you can grow and even own your shop!

title: Snooze: A Choice
description: Wake up. Get ready. Go to work. Wake up. Get ready. Go to work. Wake up. Get ready. Feed the demon? Go to work. Daily life might be getting to you, but your medication is taking care of that, right? Or maybe it's making things worse. Rise and grind or choose to snooze?

title: Wolf Mate
description: Escape from the locked school by solving puzzles while running away from Freya.

title: Fear of Energy
description: As a detective following a missing person case, you encounter a mysterious creature. With limited ammo and nowhere to run, can you survive and uncover the truth? A tense and terrifying survival horror experience awaits you.

title: Last Heist
description: Last Heist is a multiplayer horror-heist game. Looters must steal valuables and escape, but one player is secretly the Killer, sabotaging and eliminating the others to keep the loot for themselves.

title: 6days
description: In 1979, a man named Masao Satomi was involved in an accident. He was taken to the hospital and woke up safe and sound, but had amnesia. When he wonders if there is any memory he can recall, he recalls an intense childhood memory from 16 years ago.

title: Antyavan
description: Explore a forgotten forest steeped in Indian culture. Solve ancient puzzles, awaken the Nature, and confront your inner demon, your Kaliyug, in a haunting, story-driven psychological experience

title: Yatsuakari
description: Light all eight candles. Ignite the candles hidden in a haunted midnight maze and escape the sealed space.

title: We Don't Cry: Zombie Survival
description: Survive waves of zombies and raiders in this action-packed survival horror shooter. Defend, build, scavenge, and adapt in a post-apocalyptic world where every choice matters.

title: Interstice: Journey Into Darkness
description: Interstice - Journey into Darkness is a first-person horror game where players explore the Interstice, find candles holding memories of their past life, solve environmental puzzles, and complete character narratives to uncover the truth behind their death.

title: The Roadside Motel
description: The Roadside MOTEL: 10 rooms. 10 dark pasts. Silence tells more than lies. No one is who they seem. If you dare, knock on the door. But sometimes, the loudest scream is no answer at all.

title: Lantern of Remembrance
description: A faint light is your only clue. A branching psychological horror through memory and darkness.

title: Before You Get Trapped in the Black Lilies.
description: A horror adventure game in which you control the main character, a young girl with amnesia, as she explores a strange and terrifying Western-style house. Help the girl regain her memory and escape from the Western-style house by solving riddles and disarming tricks that obstruct your escape.

title: Castle Forbidden
description: You came to explore an old castle with your friends. But you ended up trapped inside alone. In this horror game, you must explore the shadows, hide from paranormal creatures, and solve strange puzzles as you search for your friends. Unravel the castle's sinister past and escape…before it's too late.

title: Anant Express
description: Anant Express is set aboard a haunted sleeper-class train. You board the train as an ordinary traveler, but as the journey progresses, strange events begin to unfold. Mysterious passengers. Shifting compartments. Whispers in the dark. Nothing is as it seems.

title: 9 R.I.P. Sequel
description: Whether we are alive or dead, he and I still stand on fragile glass. If it shatters, we fall to darkness...

title: Tomo the Wildcat
description:
Tomo the Wildcat is an Azumanga Daioh fangame inspired by Sonic Generations and other fast-paced platformers. You'll play through a variety of stages inspired on the anime with a few twists!

In this adventure, Tomo gets transported by Chiyo's father? to a dream world where she has to save her friends from an unkown force, you'll go from running on the highschool, to flying over the city, surfing over water on the beach and more!

title: Suika Sprunki Edition
description: Suika Sprunki Edition is a fun puzzle game where you drop and match Sprunki heads to unlock new forms. The higher you score, the closer you get to the creepy Horror Mode — and the top of the leaderboard. Can you reach the final form — Black?

title: Final Signature
description: Final Signature is a psychological horror game set in an abandoned hotel. Players must find hidden clues and compete with other participants for the grand prize. As tension rises in the dark corridors, they will face new dangers with every step.

title: Slumber Realm
description: Enter the Slumber Realm and battle your adolescent fears. Discover powerful synergies, unlock upgrades and equipment, duel broccoli. Decorate your crib with relics of the 90s.

title: Come to an End
description: Race to the END in this horror labyrinth speed runner. Use abilities and survival instincts to get the END. Avoid traps and enemies while you are keeping an eye on the timer. Each level is unique with its own challenges and 3 different game modes. Are you up for the challenge?!

title: MP3D
description:
mp3d is a 3D Platformer/Puzzle Game where you collect sound files to solve puzzles with arithmetic and intuition! Solve the puzzle by decyphering the riddles, doing the math, or just plain playing around making some music!

Originally created for GMTK Jam 2025

title: Just Another Night
description: Just Another Night is a first-person psychological horror game. You play as an ordinary office worker who has recently moved to an unfamiliar city. Everything seems normal: a new apartment, new coworkers, and your first day on the job. But the very next day, reality begins to crumble.

title: Ignis Dei
description: Heralded by a comet, seen as a harbinger of doom, the Black Death arrived in Florence in 1348. Wander through the woods to escape the plague, face various riddles and encounter mysterious creatures.

title: Doomed Inheritance
description: Doomed Inheritance is a first-person psychological horror puzzle game set in a decaying Gothic manor where a brain-shaped sanity meter steadily drains. Explore eerie rooms, solve immersive environmental, light-and-shadow, and pattern puzzles, and collect vials to stave off creeping control drift.

title: Dark Knight
description: Can you restore the honor of the fallen knight—or be consumed by the shadows you once served?

title: Grind Survivors
description: Grind Survivors is a fast-paced action roguelike where demon hunters face endless hellspawn. Dodge, loot, and blast through brutal bullet-hell combat with dynamic builds and ever-changing weapons in a scorched, demon-ridden world.

title: Raybounder
description: A unique top-down puzzle shooter where you control a robot with an unusual weapon. Throw your laser gun across gaps, hit switches, and fire the gun to shoot beams that ricochet off walls, destroy enemies, and hit targets. Make every shot count as you solve puzzles in 60+ stages!

title: The Ultimate Box Games
description: The Ultimate Box Games is a simple but chaotic multiplayer filled with throwable props, power ups and more that can help or hurt you as you race to complete your goal of moving the most boxes(and other items) to their new home.

title: Quarantine City
description: Survive alone against a never ending horde of undead! How long can you survive?

title: Soul Scar
description: Evil waits behind a random mask. Choose your party of four and travel to Ashfall- a cursed town doomed to relive its suffering. Uncover its secrets, hunt the hidden boss, and forge your legacy through blood and ash.

title: Cloud Cats' Land
description: Adventure on the mysterious Island of Cloud Cats! Explore picturesque locations, meet magical creatures, and solve unusual puzzles. Dive into the secrets of the wonderful island!

title: WhamPunch
description: First-person superpowered high-speed combat.Exaggerated physics destruction—destroy everything from streetlights to skyscrapers.Explore diverse stages, complete challenges, and defeat enemies.

title: Unfoldink
description: Unfoldink is a 2D logical puzzle adventure game where you craft unique combinations of cards, to come up with animated stories that explain the tribe's depararature. Use the cards they left behind to your advantage and explore the tribe's ways of living.

title: The Quiet Hum of a Lonely Heart
description: Ten-year-old Margo exists in the shadow of her vibrant older sister, Janice, a shadow cast by parents who are too busy admiring one child to truly see the other, leaving Margo to navigate a world of quiet yearning and internal suffering.

title: Autumn Waifu
description: Autumn Waifu is a fun puzzle game with anime girls in an autumn theme! Collect 30 unique levels, enjoy the gallery of collected images and achieve goals with the achievement system. Colorful graphics and autumn atmosphere will give you an unforgettable experience!

title: The Sushi House
description: On your first day at the sushi shop, everything seemed normal. But as you learn the ropes, you begin to notice strange signs. And slowly, you find yourself drawn toward something hidden within.

title: Corrupted World
description: Get to your target in side-scrolling platform, beat him up in bullet hell.

title: Yomegami: My Sweet Goddess
description: "Yomegami: My Sweet Goddess!" is a lighthearted visual novel set in a fantasy world, developed by ALcot. It tells a love story about a demon reincarnation with a goddess mother, a mob boss's daughter, a clumsy class president, and a naive dog-eared girl in their daily lives.

title: Perception: Heart and Mind
description: Perception: Heart and Mind is an action-adventure game that emphasizes precision platforming, mental and physical combat, and decision-making driven by either your heart or mind. Navigate a dangerous, interconnected world and confront the unpredictable behavior of Rootbranch's residents.

title: Sasaeng
description: A first-person psychological horror game about the life of a K-pop idol. Explore a luxury apartment, Korean streets, and your agency building as you confront the unsettling truth hidden beneath the surface.

title: No Sweet Looks
description: Nothing but ocean in every direction, and monsters eyeing you down everywhere you go! Wake up, confront the monsters, and find your way home in this top down rouge-like, with a unique take on shooting mechanics.

title: Verbal Beatdown
description: Type words to battle enemy books in this fast-paced spelling game! Unlock characters and perks to explore new strategies!

title: Just Grandma and Me
description: Just Grandma and Me centers around Little Critter, a lovable creature always ready for new adventures. In this story, Little Critter is on his way to the beach with his grandma. Little Critter is ready to have lots of fun, but he might get more than he bargained for!

title: The Xen
description: Add up to 10. THE XEN is an adrenaline-pumping puzzle roguelike where every number counts. Test your game sense against the world.

title: Mining My Own Business
description: Enslaved you're forced underground to mine to buy your freedom. Manage stamina, weight, and torchlight as you dig for valuable ore. Sell when prices are high, upgrade your gear and shelter. Every swing of your pickaxe gets you closer to freedom. Right?

title: Volt Ventures Idle
description: An idle game of growth and strategy. Build, upgrade, and prestige your way to limitless power.

title: Gangsters Way
description: Gangsters Way is a dynamic, adrenaline-fueled third-person fighting game where you step into the shoes of street gangster John Brown. Challenge the mafia and earn respect and a place in the criminal underworld through fists and blood.

title: Shadow of the Matrix
description: Shadow of the Matrix is an exhilarating third-person shooter set in a futuristic space environment. Engage in combat against a mysterious enemy disabling the spaceship's vital systems. Can the protagonist save the crew, or will the mission end in disaster? The fate of the voyage rests in your hands.

title: Valdis
description: Valdis is a pirate bullet hell adventure! Explore the high seas of Valdis and find treasures. Defeat enemies in cold-blooded combat dodging endless projectiles.

title: Synthwave Burnout VR
description: Synthwave Burnout VR is an explosive arcade racing game in VR, inspired by the aesthetics of the ’80s and synthwave style. Strap on your headset, rev your engine, and blaze through neon-soaked tracks where every move, turn, and crash feels like you’re in the heart of a glowing retro-futuristic storm

title: RogueViz Collection
description: The discovery of non-Euclidean geometry has changed how we perceive the world... but geometry goes even more exotic than that! Games of various genres designed for Thurston and space-time geometries.

title: Zeroth
description: Zeroth is a run-based action platformer with mechanical depth and interplay inspired by traditional Roguelikes. Learn the rules of Zeroth through hilarious deaths and guide your heroes as they seek to escape the 0th circle of Haell.

title: ScootX
description: ScootX is the ultimate scooter sim with satisfying physics and endless spots to ride. Hop on, drop in, and send it. The first scooter game where everything, from the wheels to the rider’s head, is powered by physics. Every grind, whip, and slam reacts the way it should.

title: Nonogram Piggy Valley
description: Nonogram Piggy Valley is a classic logic-puzzle game with a special farm twist. Solve picross puzzles, adopt cute pigs, build your farm, collect all pigs and themes.

title: The Evil's Nest
description: The Evil's Nest takes inspiration from the classic survival horror games from the early 2000s

title: Frostpunk 2: Icebreaker Edition
description:
The ICEBREAKER EDITION of Frostpunk 2 is a special version of the game that includes some unique extras. In addition to the base game, which lets you build and manage a city in a post-apocalyptic world, you'll get:

• A New London pop-up diorama, a detailed miniature model of the game's frozen city.
• An official artbook, featuring behind-the-scenes concept art, sketches, and more.
• A novella called "Warm Flesh", a gripping short story set in the Frostpunk universe.

title: Kevin Toms Football Star Manager
description:
The original retro-­styled football management game remade and re-released in 2025. It's a faithful recreation of the original groundbreaking 1982 Football Manager, the title that launched the football-management genre!

Classic simplicity with subtle depth: Manage your club across four divisions, with promotion, relegation, domestic cups, and European cup competitions. There's a transfer market, tactics to set, player fitness-wise decisions, and club finances to balance — all designed to be quick to learn but hard to put down.

Match highlights: Stylised, text and graphic match highlights reminiscent of the original 8-bit title. It’s charming, easy to follow, and still engaging.

Customisation & roster controls: Rename teams, edit kits, or retitle players. Player ratings consist of skill, fitness, and age. Aged out players retire or decline, while younger talent can improve season by season.

Strategic decisions: Purchase loans to fund signings, manage morale boosts (twice per season to lift spirit), bid on players with risk/reward valuation, and navigate transfer valuations that fluctuate with division status.

title: Sansagari
description: Tranquil, casual, minimal puzzle game with soothing audio visuals and unique gameplay.

title: Miss Bullet
description: There’s a thin line between good and evil, so aim and kill your enemies! You like addictive gun shooters? Then fulfill the urge to kill terrorists in this new 3D shooter game. Miss Bullet FPS game is the one for you!

title: Princess Trouble
description: Princess Trouble is a 2D pixel platformer featuring unique movement mechanics and key-finding challenges. Explore a mystical castle, solve puzzles, and navigate traps to find your way back to the living world.

title: Dumb Witchfinder
description: Dumb Witchfinder is a 2D pixel roguelike platformer where you play as a dark elf battling demons in a forest. Dodge enemy attacks and kill them to upgrade your abilities.

title: The Writ
description: Let's see how diligently you follow orders.

title: Ignifugo
description: Ignifugo is a top-down action roguelite with auto-battler elements. Control a combat shell and modify it with auto-attacking units. Take advantage of class bonuses, items and abilities to create unique builds as you fight heated battles through five biomes. Will you survive or be reduced to ash?

title: Proxyma
description: Proxyma is a hardcore retro-style 2D platformer that challenges you to finish 13 increasingly hard levels in a single run.

title: Gensou Gold Rush
description: Rogue light shooting game based on Touhou Project!You can pick up reinforcement items by defeating enemies and progressing to a certain degree!Increase your firepower and defeat enemies as you go!

title: Bone Fixer Shop
description: A simple economic simulator of a repair shop for skeletal minions in the land of demonic creatures. You have to balance between fixing skeletons and gathering materials.

title: Kingdom Come: Deliverance II - Mysteria Ecclesiae
description: In this DLC, Henry navigates the complex dynamics of Sedlec Monastery to discover hidden truths. This DLC is included in the Golden edition and season pass.

title: Earthworm Jim
description: A port released for different mobile devices.

title: Magical Girl: Taboo Village
description: The girls awaken in a mysterious village cursed by flowers. Every night at 8 PM, one girl is chosen as a sacrifice to the Kamibana—and hanged. Unravel the village’s tangled mysteries and sever the ritual’s endless cycle. A magical girl × folk-horror suspense visual novel from Acacia.

title: Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024: City Update 12 - Germany 2
Tropico 7
description: Get rich or die trying! In Tropico 7, you step into El Presidente’s shiny boots again to build your island nation and – literally – move mountains. As glorious leader you guide your loyal citizens (and your Swiss Bank Account) through the ages toward untold prosperity.

title: Void Raider
description: In the depths of a ruined galaxy, laws no longer exist. You embody a Void Raider, a space marauder with no ties, ready to do anything to get your hands on rare resources and forgotten artifacts.

title: Bloomwalker
description: Travel with a moving house and restore a tainted world in this heartfelt crafting adventure. Build and tend to your own little world beyond the door, and breathe new life into a fallen world alongside the versatile familiars and the spirits known as higgledies.

title: Beastro
description: Welcome to Beastro! In this charming fusion of fantasy adventure, not all heroes wield swords… Some prefer the spoon. And, sometimes to save the world you’ve got to start with a really good meal.

title: Freestyle Football 2
description: Freestyle Football 2 is a fast-paced, 5v5 match-based online multiplayer soccer game. Each position has a unique role, and you'll utilize a variety of strategies and skills to achieve victory with your team. Stylish play and unique characters transform the pitch into a stage.

Cut them down .
Hit the crystal .
Throw your life
and you'll slowly die .

title: Earthworm Jim 2
description: This port featured an upgraded CD-DA music soundtrack, more voice clips and redrawn graphics, but lacked the "Lorenzen's Soil" level.

title: Blood of the Tyrant
description: Experience the weight of gladiatorial combat in this techno-Roman survivor where every weapon swing matters. Clone warrior seeks freedom through arena bloodshed in a cycle of power and corruption.

title: Global Rescue
description: Build your own base in Global Rescue and take command of firefighting, police, EMS, and SWAT operations — either in your hometown or any city around the world! Manage your fleet, hire staff, and take on a variety of authentic operations. Are you ready for your shift?

title: Project ReMind
description: "Welcome to the end. My end" Manipulate machinery, open secret passages and bypass computers to remember your life, from your first discovery to your own death bed. In this first-person narrative puzzle game investigate a mysterious presence looking for the answer that haunted you since THAT day.

title: Cosmo Tales
description: Cosmo Tales is a third person, action adventure inspired by the '70s retro sci-fi aesthetic mixed with modern looks and gameplay. Use the dimension shifting ability to change between realities as you fight your way through the outer space.

title: Bootloop
description: Electrocute your enemies and loop around the circuit in this shocking roguelike game! How many viruses will you destroy before perishing?

title: Metal Gear Solid Delta Snake Eater: Day One Edition
description: Discover the origin story of iconic military operative Snake and begin to unravel the plot of the legendary METAL GEAR series. METAL GEAR SOLID ?: SNAKE EATER brings unprecedented new graphics, immersive stealth action gameplay and sounds to its riveting story as players once again return to the world of METAL GEAR. Rival nations are secretly developing weapons that could threaten the future of mankind. Deep in the jungle, an elite soldier must combine stealth with survival to infiltrate the enemy and stop a weapon of mass destruction from triggering the largest full-scale war the world has ever seen

title: Dune: Awakening - The Lost Harvest
description:
The Lost Harvest is a paid DLC with a complete standalone storyline. A carryall transporting a Miner’s Guild spice harvester has been shot out of the sky, and its cargo could change everything. Your job is to find it.

The DLC also includes several unique cosmetics, including a brand-new vehicle, the Treadwheel, complete with its own unique animations and tier upgrades. The vehicle and other cosmetics provide no material benefit over its base game counterpart.

Other cosmetics include several armor and weapon skins, and the Dune Man building set, letting you build bases in the style of those pragmatic and weathered workers of Arrakis.

title: Dune: Awakening - Chapter 2
description: Chapter 2 the first major content update. Embark on the next chapter of the main story following the sinister revelations at the end of Chapter 1. Explore new locations, meet new and familiar faces, delve deeper into the nature of your origins, and unravel a web that stretches into the darkest corners of the Imperium.

title: Custom Fortress
description: Custom Fortress is a community-driven Team Fortress 2 sourcemod that attempts to make TF2 as customizable as possible by removing as much hardcoded elements as possible to make it as easy as possible to create new content, implementing new convars to control every aspect of your server, and lots of new community content included is base game for you to try out including new weapons, taunts, cosmetics, and gamemodes!

title: Hell Let Loose: Vietnam
description: Step into the explosive fury of war with Hell Let Loose: Vietnam. Play a decisive role in one of the most iconic conflicts in history with expansive 50v50 player battles, where teamwork, tactics and an arsenal of destructive weapons combine to shape the battlefield in your favour.

title: 1348: Ex Voto

title: Kode Zero

Step into a universe where the neon-lit streets are your battleground, and every pixel pulsates with adrenaline-fueled action. Welcome to Kode Zero, the ultimate free-to-play multiplayer shooter that thrusts you into a cyberpunk world like no other.

Prepare for mind-bending gameplay with an abundance of abilities at your fingertips. Blink across the battlefield with teleportation, soar through the skies like a rogue AI with flight, or manipulate time itself with dilation powers. Adapt on the fly, outwit your opponents, and showcase your strategic prowess as you harness these dynamic skills to secure victory.

title: Persona 5: Dancing in Starlight - Catherine Set
description: Catherine costume set for P5 Protagonist, Ryuji, Ann, Yusuke, Makoto, Haru, Futaba and Morgana.

title: Persona 5: Dancing in Starlight - Futaba's Shujin Academy Uniform & Loungewear Set
description: Costumes 'Summer Shujin Outfit', 'Winter Shujin Outfit' and 'Shut-in Clothes' for Futaba.

title: Persona 5: Dancing in Starlight - Atlus Selection Set
description: Atlus Selection costume set for P5 Protagonist, Ryuji, Ann, Yusuke, Makoto, Haru and Futaba.

title: Kill the Brickman
description: A brick breaking, turn-based rogue-like bullet-builder - Blast bricks to break the bank.

title: Honkai Impact 3rd: For the Stars Shall Defy Fate
description:
Version 8.4 of Honkai Impact 3rd, which includes
• New Part 2 Story Chapter IX-EX: Yet the Stars Still Sparkle
• New S Rank Valkyrie: Behold! Fate-Defying Dragon (Coralie)
• New AstralOp: Chenxue
• New Featured Event: Assemble! Summer Friendship Resort
• ...and more!

title: Disney Dreamlight Valley: Emotional Rescue
description: The 18th free update for Disney Dreamlight Valley adds the Inside Out Realm, adds Joy and Sadness as villagers, new Photo Mode features and starts the Retro Roadtrip Star Path, with the new Routine Duties.

title: Frozen Feathers
description: Frozen Feathers is a charming multiplayer game where cute penguins engage in fun snowball battles, scoring points in frosty PvP encounters.

title: Bleaklight Falls
description: Bleaklight Falls is a 2D top-down Action RPG Tower Defense game. Play as Meelu, a boy living in the secluded forest village of Bleaklight Falls. More than a century ago, the Dreadblight consumed the world. Only the Bleaklight, a mysterious everlasting flame, protects Meelu and his friends from the encroaching darkness. But when the Bleaklight's protection wanes, the Dreadblight monsters invade at nightfall. Meelu and the other villagers must defend their home - the last bastion of humanity - or their light will be snuffed out for good.

title: Upgrades & Enemies
description: Don't get swarmed in this incremental top-down shooter! Unlock new mechanics and upgrades as you defeat more and more enemies. Let drones aid you in combat and use your abilities to become unstoppable.

title: Star Catcher: Heart Master
description: Release Lucy's heart into the cosmic field so that it may experience wonders beyond our world. Compounding interactions will send Lucy's heart back to her with bountiful value – if she is so courageous to catch its return.

title: Futa Nights: Bloody Sluts
description: A sexy cyberpunk visual novel where you play as a futa fighter battling vampires to save your kidnapped friend. Brutal arena fights, spicy choices, and steamy scenes await in a neon-lit world of blood and lust.

title: The Master of the Land
description:
An interactive fiction intrigue in an immersive and dynamic world.

Text is mixed and combined to show a changing place, with many characters moving around, weather, different events -balls, dinners, ceremonies- and interlocking storylines. With more than 80 thousand words and more than ten major plots, each playthrough shows only a fraction of the possibilities.

title: Farmageddon
description: In this Action Roguelike, defend your farm from waves of enemies attacking with live vegetables. Dodge, catch, and use their own projectiles against them to survive. Uncover the conspiracy driving their revenge—a secret they don't even know themselves.

title: Wildekin
description: Wildekin is a 3D pixel-art adventure where up to 4 friends can build, explore, survive and thrive—or at least try to before some creature tries to turn you into a light snack!

title: Overwatch 2: Season 18 - Stadium Quickplay
description: Dive into Stadium with Hero additions, all-new ways and places to play, fresh features, and a beefed-up Item pool. Experiment and rank-up with the 50 new Hero-specific Perks, a full rank reset and the new Hero Skill Rating. Become Ascended with Hero Progression 2.0. Ride the wave with Wuyang, the aquatic prodigy from Wuxing University’s Water College. Unlock the dual Mythic drop at launch—Mythic Ultraviolet Sentinel Sojourn Hero Skin and Mythic Cassidy’s Mythic Blazing Sunsetter Weapon Skin—, and score big in Summer Games with third-person POV Lucio Ball. Make a splash, a BIG one!

title: Happy Time
description:
Happy time is First person horror game. You are Detective who went to explore the old and abandoned hotel in the hope that you will return.
Come explore this mysterious old hotel, chances are you're not alone

title: A Storied Life: Tabitha
description: A wholesome narrative puzzle game about the objects we leave behind and the stories they tell. Complete a loved one's damaged memoirs by exploring their home and packing away their things.

title: Hold the Mine
description: Explore and defend your mine against waves of monsters in this innovative roguelike survival game! Collect and manage your resources, discover buildings with unique effects and unleash mighty heroes to hold monsters out of the mine until the sun rises.

title: Holdfast: Age of Sail
description: Ahoy! Prepare to raise the black flag. Holdfast's Age Of Sail Expansion

title: The Corn Maze: Rebirth
description: Trapped in a massive corn maze, you must survive monstrous threats, uncover hidden truths, and follow cryptic notes from a mysterious figure. Shoot, scavenge, and explore twisted portals as you unravel a dark conspiracy blending science, cults, and control.

title: Scent of Sorrow
description: Play as a dog named Lula, waking up lost in an eerie forest. Use your keen sense of smell to explore the environment where fragments of your memory will help you unveil your past. This heartfelt narrative adventure is a new take on the theme of animal abandonment.

title: I Lost Someone
description: The story of a father and son experiencing the ups and downs of life, and how they try to make the best of the twists and turns life puts them through

title: TinyCraft Town
description: TinyCraft Town is a simple 2D pixel art survival game focused on light resource management, crafting, and exploration. Gather materials, cook food, fish, build workstations, craft weapons and restore a small ruined village. Inspired by games like RuneScape and Conan Exileswithout the complexity.

title: Planet Finder
description: Earth is on the brink of collapse! Explore space, discover new planets, and gather vital resources to save humanity. No weapons, no wars—just you and the vastness of space. The future depends on you!

title: The Sims 4: Essential Glam Kit
description: Makeup for all.

title: The Sims 4: Grange Mudroom Kit
description: Decorate and organize your entryway into the perfect mudroom.

title: The Fame Game: Welcome to Hollywood
description:
The Fame Game is an interactive full-motion video (FMV) experience where your choices determine the outcome of your Hollywood journey. You play as Jonathan, an everyday guy who suddenly finds himself cast as the leading man in America’s most-watched television drama, right as its famous on-screen couple breaks up in real life.

As you rise to stardom, you’ll encounter seven distinct love interests, from the glamorous series star to the shy caterer backstage, and navigate the cutthroat world of entertainment, romance, and scandal.

Will you charm your way to the top, find true love, or watch your career crash and burn under the spotlight?

title: Heroes and Forsaken: The Wheel of Time Digital Card Game
description: Heroes and Forsaken is a digital card game set in the world of Robert Jordan's The Wheel of Time. Each player takes a side, the Light or the Shadow, picks a Leader from the books and builds a 30-card deck of Beings, Spells and Equipment around that Leader and a Companion. Cards are paid for with the One Power, which grows by one each turn up to ten. A turn-based match is won by bringing the opposing Leader's Health to zero.

title: Qub
description: Click Qub, gain points and delete bits on this clicker roguelike!

title: Boring Movies: Boring Television
description:
Why should only movies be boring? Now you can make television boring as well!

This DLC allows you the ability to make lobbies be able to select television shows to describe as boring as possible as well.

title: Boring Movies: Spooky Bunny
description: Have you ever wanted to hangout with your friends in a creepy bunny costume? Well now you can with everyone's favorite Spooky Bunny. Warning, costume known to be related with falling debris.

title: Boring Movies: Groovy Chainsaw Man
description: Maybe a more groovy avatar is more your style? Try out Groovy Chainsaw Man, he's got everything you want from a low budget hero!

title: Boring Movies: Friends of Stolen Jewelry
description: Grab your friends and journey across the world to return some stolen jewelry! Don't forget your wizard, every journey needs an old wizard.

title: Boring Movies: Scientist
description: Everyone knows a whacky mad scientist who works out of their garage, right? Like they have that weird unpopular car before it was cool?

title: Boring Movies: Public Domainers
description: What do an Ape, a Mouse, an Archer, a Monster, and a Detective all have in common? They're all in the public domain! Enjoy these classic characters reimagined for Boring Movies!

title: Boring Movies: Metal Action Man
description: He's metal. He's full of action. He's a man. He's from a time of much violence and needs to protect a boy from other metal action men!

title: Dusttale: Last Genocide
description:
Dusttale: Last Genocide is an Undertale fan-game developed by Team DTLG.

The Universe which the fan-game is based on is the result of the combination between the Dusttale AU and the fan-game Undertale: Last Breath.

title: Western Shadowlands
description: Create unique card combinations to grow stronger and stronger. Reach a certain number of cards to obtain a special card! With a wave progression system, enemies become increasingly harder to defeat!

title: Suddenly Meow Christmas
description: A fun holiday adventure with furballs Tim and Spooky! A blend of Match 3 and Puzzle like no other!

title: Face of Another
description: Use your phone to survive the horrors, capture clues, and solve puzzles in this first-person psychological horror experience. Trapped inside a warped digital nightmare by a mysterious entity, you must navigate a world where technology distorts reality.

title: Lines of Balls
description: Remove the balls from the field by making lines. Make lines of five or more balls of the same color. The more balls in a line, the more points you get.

title: Galactic Slice
description: Galactic Slice sci-fi shooter game all about pizza, you use the WASD keys to move & the spacebar to shoot. Galactic Slice is all about an alien race wanting to destroy & ruin pizza forever, which simply cannot happen! Your job is to eliminate the aliens & save all pizzakind.

title: Pepper Blast
description: Experience explosive match-3 gameplay with 5 sizzling modes: Classic, Rock, Ice Block, Thief, and Fusion. Overcome unique challenges across 85 fiery levels. Ready to feel the burn? Chili Blast is waiting!

title: Only Dodge!
description: "Only Dodge!" is a game inspired by The World's Hardest Game. The player remotely controls the main character with the goal of helping them escape. Players must avoid blue spheres, touch all yellow objects within each stage, and reach the green area to clear the stage.

title: Bordermind
description: Tired of playing fancy games that have lost all their mystery? Looking for something different? Look no further. Bordermind is a retro horror-themed FPS with a PSX/PS1 aesthetic. It takes the player into an intermediary world between the material and the spiritual.

title: The Grey Company
description: Tabletop Tavern: RTS meets roguelike chaos. Recruit mercenaries, command them in real-time on a tabletop battlefield, and face endless goblin hordes. Unique runs, tough choices, infinite replayability.

title: Lilia
description: Explore the island with your unique companions and aim for the top of the tower! An action RPG where you explore using various items and magic.

title: Blackthorn Witch
description: A psychological horror story set in the town of Blackthorn; a place that lives in constant fear of a witch. The two main suspects? Levis mom and sister! His only lifelines to the outside world. Can they live a peaceful life? Or will they be dragged down by the dying town?

title: Tales Beyond the Tomb: Route 86
description: A psychological horror anthology inspired by real-life cases. In Route 86, a group of friends ends up in a remote nightmare. Explore, hide, and survive in this first-person experience with multiple playable characters and rising tension.

title: Evenfall
description: A game about befriending robots in a dying city.

title: Bomcat
description: Throw bombs and charge ahead! In this stage-clearing action game packed with respect for 80’s arcades, rescue the lady imprisoned in the factory!

title: Waterjacked!
description: Waterjacked! is a roguelike puzzler where you are a cactus with a gun. Chosen to wield the GRID, construct ever-more complex Rube Goldberg machines to outwit the invading robots keen on stealing all the water in The Valley. Will you be the hero to save your people?

title: Murder at Chateau de Rouge
description: This choices-matter visual novel is narrative-heavy, filled with beautifully illustrated characters, intricate stories, and two distinct endings.

title: Ratcheteer DX
description: Explore the interconnected caverns below the frozen surface and a vast Snowcean above as you set out to rescue friend, foe, and stranger alike in this lo-fi action-adventure!

title: Dusttale: The Genocide's End
description: DustTale: The Genocide's End is the official sequel to DustTale: Last Genocide. There is no longer any ULB inspiration behind it, and it is now purely a fresh take on DustTale hardmode, where things aren't as they seem...

title: Mail To The Moon
description: A princess is trapped in the dark side of the Moon when a space pirate crashes in. Both mesmerized, they decide to become pen pals. Follow them to see how their romance develops. Will they be able to get together?

title: Distant Sunlight, Endless Regrets
description:
Sun is a failure of an angel, exiled from heaven for their sins. As they aimlessly wander the world, they meet Laura - a lonely girl who is very excited to pick up this stray angel she found, and seems to accept them as they are. Can Sun free themselves from their past and find happiness with her?

A short visual novel about trauma, self hate and trying to accept love. Featuring nonbinary yuri and a lot of regrets.

title: My Tiny Island
description: Survival, simplified.

title: Gas Station: Idle Simulator
description: Turn traffic into profit.

title: Electronics Puzzle Lab 2
description: Learn circuitry and electronics engineering in a fun way with concepts simple enough for beginners but engaging for enthusiasts!

title: Thief Simulator: Mastermind Edition
description: Step into the world of high-stakes burglary in Thief Simulator Mastermind Edition - the ultimate version of the hit stealth sandbox! Now bigger, smarter, and packed with new heists.

title: Summer Games Challenge: Running
description: Ready for the starting signal?

title: Summer Games Challenge: Swimming
description: On your blocks, get set, go!

title: Summer Games Challenge: Throwing & Lifting
description: Powerful. Entertaining. Competitive.

title: Silky Winds
description: A Serene Journey Through a Stylized Eastern Landscape

title: Anime Dream Match: Rodents
description: A charming and relaxing memory game where you match pairs of adorable anime rodents.

title: Reel it! Ocean Fishing
description:
Get ready for a powered-up fishing trip to the vast ocean!
With stunning scenery and a wide variety of fish, the fishing is more thrilling and content-packed than ever!

title: Punyan Connecty
description:
Easy for anyone! Connect them together for simple combos!

The“Punyan”are back! The cute, squishy cats living on Nyanten Island are now featured in a puzzle game where you connect them to have fun! Enjoy the Punyan great adventure unfolding on Nyanten Island.

The puzzle allows for big chains with simple controls. Combine skills to potentially earn tons of points! With 30 stages in total, what skill deck will you use to conquer them all?

title: Autumn Isle
description: A peaceful island experience

title: Arcade Archives: Chopper 1
description:
"CHOPPER 1" is a shooter released by SNK in 1988.
Pilot a combat helicopter deep into enemy territory in a mission to restore peace to your homeland.
Wielding overwhelming power far beyond what’s needed to simply protect one's family, what will these men discover at the end of their path of destruction?

title: Dude My House Is Haunted
description: Welcome to a Haunted house full of ghostly shenanigans and spooky jump scares! You are a top G ghost hunter and you must capture all the ghostly anomalies that terrorize this luxurious home. This isn't just paranormal activity, this is paranormal BRUH-tivity.

title: Death Train!!! Samara – Voronezh.
description: An exhilarating visual novel blending thriller and dark comedy. A tale of a train, money, greedy people, and bears.

title: Coloring Game 10k
description: Coloring Game 10K is a new game of the franchise, coloring by numbers. It is a bright representative of anti-stress games.

title: Rise of Rana
description:
Rise of Rana is a single-player open-world action-adventure filled with humor, destruction, and complete freedom of movement.
Play as two main characters (with dozens of costumes and accessories) and explore massive cities where you can fight, complete missions, cause chaos, or just have fun.

title: Truck Driving
description: Think you can drive it and park it perfectly?

title: Spot the Wrong Character
description:
That Aha! moment feels so refreshing!
A new kind of brain-training puzzle using letters and clever thinking

description: Four disciplines, one goal: higher, further, accuracy!

description: Solve puzzles, uncover secrets, and admire every detail of stunning artwork!

description:

Train your programming brain with a fun puzzle game!

description: Monsters need pampering too.

description: A classic falling-block puzzle game! Connect four Puyos of the same color to clear them!

title: Ludo XXL 2
description: Prepare to keep (or lose) your temper online!

title: Anime Girls: Nimble Ninja
description: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!

Mandragora: Whispers of the Witch Tree - Digital Deluxe Edition

description:
The Deluxe Edition Includes:

Little Nightmares III - Base Game

Secrets of the Spiral Expansion Pack + Ferryman Costumes Set
Resident Costumes Set (4 Total Costumes)

title: Mandragora: Whispers of the Witch Tree - Dark Ale Quest
description: Embark on an exciting new quest within the world of Faelduum.

title: Ice Em': Race to the Grave
description: High-octane real-time strategy. Put the pedal to the metal, jump between speeding cars, and slam the competition off the road! No need to survive as long as your marks lose... their life!

title: Orbitous
description: Orbitous is an action roguelike where every object has gravity. Every planet, moon, star, enemy, projectile, is attracted to one another. Nothing is stationary in this procedurally generated galaxy. Fly between star systems, build weapons, and fight enemies.

title: Flipsum: A Puzzle by Claris Richter
description: FlipSum is a bold new twist on classic number puzzles! Inspired by sudoku, this brain-teasing series challenges you to flip, cancel, and balance numbers on a grid to match the target totals. It's a thrilling game of logic, deduction, and number.

title: T.B.M: The Blueppers Mayhem
description: The best f2p play there is! Play against a friend or in a public match in fast paced 1v1 battles. Win matches to get resorces for progresion and unlock as many clishers as you can so you can promote as many of them for great rewards. The more support this product gets the more updates it will get!!!

title: Bat & Ball
description: A fast-paced, mouse-controlled reflex game where every swing matters—hit the ball, build your streak, and push your focus to the limit in this minimalist baseball challenge.

title: MineSweeper Rush
description: MineSweeper Rush brings a fresh twist to classic Minesweeper with a growing minefield and fast row clearance. Every second counts as you race to beat your high score and climb the leaderboards.

title: Container Terminal Simulator
description: In Container Terminal Simulator, you can immerse yourself in the atmosphere of the owner of a cargo terminal. Drive the loaders and decide for yourself whether you are ready to take on a new challenge. Feel like the owner of a company, develop it alone and with friends and become the best manager!

title: Zombie Outbreak 1943
