description: Hardcore arcade survival shooter where you pilot a mech completely blind to the battlefield. Your only sight? The minimap. With relentless waves of enemies closing in, precise movement, and total awareness are your only chances at survival. How long can you survive?

title: Kittenship Care
description: Kittenship Care is a cozy life-sim where you nurture, train, and play with an adorable kitten while preparing it for adoption. Personalize and upgrade your space to create the ideal home in a relaxing sandbox full of warmth, whiskers, and feel-good feline fun.

title: Quiz Kingdom: Elementary Math Kids RPG
description: Learning math has never been this thrilling! Slash monsters while looking your best in stylish, badass outfits. Navigate labyrinths, defeat monsters, conquer mighty bosses — all while tackling 2nd-3rd grade math quizzes right in the heat of battle.

title: Side Hustle City
description: Explore the streets of Side Hustle City, a sandbox life-sim where every hustle counts. Build your wealth by trading assets, investing in businesses, and acquiring properties to create the lifestyle you've always dreamed of — from small beginnings to luxury living.

title: Astro Spider: Between Threads and Stars
description: Help a spider connect stars in this minimalist, relaxing puzzle game. Discover perfect paths through beautiful star patterns across 40 calm and clever levels.

title: BloodBasket
description: a community map jam by the blood discord channel

title: Arcade Archives 2: Scrambled Egg
description:
Kick, launch, and get chased! It's a scramble emergency!!!

"SCRAMBLED EGG" is an action game released by Technos Japan in 1983.
Kick the eggs to crack them open and hatch chicks. Then launch all the new chicks into the sky!
Red chicks and chickens will help you take down enemies. Be sure to take good care of them!

title: Arcade Archives: Scrambled Egg
description:
Kick, launch, and get chased! It's a scramble emergency!!!

"SCRAMBLED EGG" is an action game released by Technos Japan in 1983.
Kick the eggs to crack them open and hatch chicks. Then launch all the new chicks into the sky!
Red chicks and chickens will help you take down enemies. Be sure to take good care of them!

title: Anime Girl Kawaii High School Dress Up
description:
Create. Style. Shine.
Design the cutest anime looks with endless outfits and accessories.

title: Crash The Car Death Race
description:
Race fast. Smash harder.
No rules. No mercy.
Only the last car survives.

title: Cat Clinic Simulator: Vet Hospital
description: Love and care for every pet.

title: Eggconsole Lord Monarch PC-9801
description: Take the throne as ruler of your nation, govern your lands, and read the ever-changing tides of battle to conquer all enemy nations!

title: Find the Cats: Japan Journey
description: Spot the sneaky cats hidden across beautiful Japan! Relax, explore, and test your sharp eyes. Can you find them all?

title: Gal, Geek and Summer
description: A lonely honor student, an outgoing gal, and me... an ordinary guy.More than friends, less than lovers, it's time to leave our youth behind.

title: Kawaii Girls: Rural Romance
description: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!

title: Make it! Pancakes
description:
Get ready for a delicious pancake-making challenge!
Make tons of pancakes and watch your food cart prosper!

title: Off-the-Ground Survival
description: Trapped on the top floor, 99 stories off the ground, you hope to reach the ground floor and escape. With limited food and supplies, find your exit and survive the apocalypse!

title: Yatzi 2
description: Dice games bring people together!

title: Zumba: Soccer Marble League
description: Get ready for kick-off in Zumba – Soccer Marble League! Match and blast marbles before they reach the goal! Unlock power plays and climb the league ladder!

title: Aery: Viking Saga
description: Enjoy a breathtaking journey in Aery Viking Saga, where you take flight as a majestic bird soaring through stunning Viking inspired landscapes.

title: Focus and Find Stereogram Training
description:
Stare closely and a hidden image will pop out!
Train your eyes and brain with mysterious stereograms

title: Forbidden Ground: Lair of Aooni
description: It is a forbidden place that must never be entered. Strange events encountered in the decadent school building. And a Japanese doll that begins to speak. There is something here. ......This is a Japanese horror game that reveals the abominable history hidden in an abandoned school.

title: Aphrodite's Bathhouse
description: Can you conquer the challenges of the maidens?

title: Spy Guy The Circus Mission Edition
Brain Workout! Jellyfish Puzzle
description:
Spin the pieces and peek into the world of jellyfish!
A mesmerizing underwater art puzzle that you can't take your eyes off

title: Mate in Eleven
description: Auto-chess. Position your units, and the engine plays for you. Last player standing wins.

title: World Wonders Hidden Histories 3
description: Explore world landmarks, search for hidden artifacts, solve mysteries and uncover forgotten stories of ancient civilizations.

title: The Curry Simulator
description: Mindlessly mixing curry. That's the best time. Curry will burn if you take your eyes off it for even a moment. Give it lots of love and keep stirring it slowly to prevent it from burning.

title: W.A.PU Space Orderty
description: The motto of W.A.PU Space Orderty is — running a business doesn't have to be a hassle or tiring! You've just opened an interstellar freight agency. Your daily task is simple: neatly stack all the packages to be delivered. Pick up your mouse and start with ease

title: Mythic Factor: Leaving the Labyrinth
description: Golf your way out of a monster-infested magical dungeon! Use enchanted powers to launch glowing crystals into portals while dodging traps, monsters, and each other. Up to 7 players can join the chaos—expect wild shots, accidental sabotage, and a lot of yelling.

title: Denrei Survivors
description: This is a survivor-style game. Fight off waves of enemies—middle-aged men turned into Denrei (electric spirits)—while choosing weapons and items to power up your own unique build. Dive into randomly generated dungeons and experience the addictive gameplay set in a one-of-a-kind world!

title: Sixyato
description: Sixyato is an action-puzzle game featuring numerous highly creative levels that put players' mind and skills to the test. Unlock these levels, gather information, help Sixyato to uncover the secrets of the symbol world

title: Operation Dimera
description: Operation Dimera is a co-op game for up to 3 players where you and your friends must save the world. Tackle diverse missions. Work together to solve puzzles that stand in your way and customize your weapons to be ready for anything! The fate of the world is in your hands!

title: Sudoku-Zen
description: This is a variant of a very classic Sudoku game. Within a 9X9 grid, 9 different icons are placed, ensuring that each row, each column, and each section contains 9 different icons. It is extremely challenging.

title: Triple Miracle
description: Juggle three boards at once in this innovative falling-block matching game. Activate your miracle and go for the high score! With soundtrack by shmup legend YASUSHI KAMINISHI.

title: Novice in the World
description: This game includes RPG content such as exploration, self building teams, battles, and growth, as well as multiplayer gameplay such as interacting with other players, forming guilds, and competing in battles.

title: Chrono Space 7
description: An isometric twin stick shooter where the player has only seven minutes to defeat the entity that is going to destroy the solar system. Level up, unlock new powers and win against the clock... and the cosmic dangers.

title: Mini Rugby: World Tour
description: Arcade style Rugby. Play as the top male and female teams in dynamic seasons complete with drills, friendlies and monthly tournaments. Manage fatigue and increasingly difficult opponents to climb the rankings and reach the coveted world number 1 position!

title: Big Giant Tanghulu: Tanghulu Legend
description: I want more Tanghulu! Stack more Tanghulu and unlock skins for the girl who loves sweets

title: Dubai Chocolate Simulator
description: An Arab man asks you to make Dubai chocolate. Box, race horses, complete obstacle courses, defeat enemies, and gather ingredients to craft the Dubai chocolate!

title: Xetter 2020
description: Collect all the dots to clear each of the 30 action-puzzle scenes. Dodge two types of enemies, drop blocks to crush them, and avoid being crushed yourself. Use limited lives wisely, restart levels when needed, and unlock cleared scenes for replay. Can you beat them all?

title: The Narcotic Operation
description: Step into the role of a shadowed undercover police officer in Dark Eyes, brave an area dominated by vice and crime, where allies and enemies blur. Every smirk, tear, and lie tightens the web of deceit—will you destroy the empire or lose yourself in its shadows?

title: Space Chess
description: Play Capture-the-King Raumschach, invented in 1907 and made more playable by futuristic visuals! Spread out cells and helpful highlighting maximize the player's ability to visualize the board. The game features public and private lobbies.

title: Number Place Cats
description: The number place (Sudoku) puzzle with cute cats that beginners can enjoy. There are total 900 puzzles. 100 puzzles of different difficulty levels. With erase function, undo function and hint function, you can challenge yourself to solve difficult puzzle.

title: Sweet Lyoria: Cozy Homes
description: Sweet Lyoria is a cozy pixel art life sim set in a magical snow-dusted village where you build your dream cottage, form meaningful bonds, and uncover a gentle, heartfelt mystery. Decorate, Work, and collect characters in our cozy game.

title: Vintage Pinball
description: Vintage Pinball is a retro pinball game with great sounds and stunning graphics.

title: Stretcher Together
description: Stretcher Together is a cooperative 3D platformer for two players. You play as medics rescuing a patient after a fall. Jump, balance, and climb your way up—but don’t drop the patient, or you’ll have to go back down to retrieve them!

title: Sudoku-X
description: This is a variant of a very classic Sudoku game. Within a 9X9 grid, 9 different icons are placed, ensuring that each row, each column, and each section contains 9 different icons. It is extremely challenging.

title: Sea Hotel: Fish Scales
description: Experience the laid‑back joy of fishing in **Sea Hotel: Fish Scales**! Run your very own floating houseboat, explore uniquely themed ocean zones, and fully customize both your vessel and your character. Climb aboard now and embark on a deep‑sea fishing adventure that's as stylish as it is relaxing!

title: Light-Strucked
description: Challenging and humorous fantasy RPG with turn-based battles. Based on the books about Tunuss.

title: Sudoku-9
description: This is a variant of a very classic Sudoku game. Within a 9X9 grid, 9 different icons are placed, ensuring that each row, each column, and each section contains 9 different icons. It is extremely challenging.

title: Bandits vs. Lords: Epic Clash
description: Prepare for a thrilling adventure where every decision counts. Construct your base, gather resources, and train unique troops to outsmart your opponents in tactical combat. Raid enemy villages for loot, forge alliances with other players, and expand your territory in a quest for ultimate dominance.

title: Anime Dream Match: Birds
description: A charming and relaxing memory game where you match pairs of adorable anime birds.

title: Argonauts Agency: God of the Storm
description: Pelias, the wise mentor, joins forces with Jason and Medea to uncover the deeply hidden causes of divine wrath.

title: Cotton Plicker
description: Make yourself rich by growing a cotton farm in this short incremental game. Expand your farm, upgrade plants, and sell cottons to earn money!

title: Lost Flight: Survival
description: Find yourself stranded on a mysterious, uncharted island after a devastating plane crash. With no signs of rescue, your only goal is to survive

title: TechGuardian: Territory Defense
description: This is a sci-fi strategy game featuring a Defense Mode focused on tower defense and an Attack Mode focused on combat. The game includes over 30 different buildings and units, all of which can be upgraded through entry editing to enhance their performance and firepower.

title: Grow Harvest Repeat
description: Plant, grow, harvest, sell, upgrade tools, and craft. Level up skills to build your farming empire!

title: Walk the Plank
description: Walk the Plank is a next gen VR plank walking simulator set high up in New York City. Bring family and friends together for this intense intro to VR experience!

title: Bay: Zero
description: With many, many bossfights, this FPS PvE is extremely fast paced, and could be a great distraction from reality when you finish it!

title: Majoris Nightmare
description: A dark, story-rich puzzle adventure where every clue matters. Think carefully, read with attention, and make meaningful choices and be ready to act fast when danger strikes to uncover the truth and save your daughter.

title: Car Tuning Garage Simulator
description: Build your dream garage, customize every detail, and tune high-performance machines. Restore classics, fulfill client orders, and race your creations on streets and tracks. Car Tuning Simulator is your ultimate playground for creativity and car culture.

title: Click Adventure
description: Click Adventure is an exciting game where you click to increase your score. You can use the points you earn to buy boosters or unique skins. Compete with your friends and colleagues to see who has the highest score.

title: Hack & Po
description: Hack & Po is a 1v1 strategy card game with a 5-class RPS system. Draft your deck, predict your opponent, and battle using cards and timed consumables. Victory comes by outplaying your rival until their lantern fades or you gain a +10 life advantage.

title: Meaningless Suffering
description: Meaningless Suffering is a 2D platformer where you push a simple circle up an unforgiving mountain. But don't be fooled; the true battle isn't physical. It's psychological. Every fall chips away at your patience. Every restart tests your will. How far will you go in the face of failure?

title: Idle Pixels
description: A complex idle clicker game with infinite possibilities. Prestige, tiers, perks, bosses, different worlds, interest, bets and many more gameplay features are available!

title: Akolyte
description:
Akolyte is an unreleased action game for the Sega Dreamcast developed by Ionos. It was cancelled for unknown reasons and the studio closed.

A PC version is rumoured to have existed at one stage, but this too did not materialise.

title: Taxi Chaos 2
description: Taxi Chaos 2 is an arcade taxi driving game in a city ruled by AI taxi bots. As the last human taxi company, deliver extreme fares, adapt to an unpredictable city, and outdrive rival machines to take back control.

title: Burger Maker
description:
Burger Maker is a puzzle game in which you operate a machine to assemble hamburgers to match each customer's order, one after another.

Ingredients fall randomly onto 10 rotating turntables. Spin them to combine the right pieces in the right order — but it's not just about filling orders as they come in. Preparing stock in advance based on available ingredients is equally important. Use combos and chains wisely to keep your rating climbing.

As your restaurant's reputation grows, new menu items are unlocked, making things increasingly hectic. Can you reach the coveted 5-star rating?

Winner of the Grand Prize in the Indies category at the 8th CESA GAME AWARDS (2004).

title: Honkai: Nexus Anima
description: Honkai: Nexus Anima is a brand-new creature-collector adventure strategy game and the latest installment in the Honkai series. You’ll take on the role of a plane-hopping traveler who has escaped captivity, forging deep bonds with mysterious creatures in a new world, battling through thrilling encounters, and uncovering the truths buried within your past.

title: Untapped
description: "Untapped": A co-op cooking roguelite where every run is a fresh new challenge. Team up with friends to serve impatient customers, using cards to unlock new recipes and upgrades! Adapt and improve your kitchen on the fly as the challenge ramps up.

title: Dora: Rainforest Rescue
description: Are you ready for an interactive adventure with Dora and her amigos? Stop Swiper, fix the Duplicator and restore the Alebrije tree. ¡Vámonos! Let’s go!

title: Mandragora: Whispers of the Witch Tree - Collector's Edition
description:
Collectors' Edition includes:
An exclusive Art Book showcasing never-before-seen illustrations
A CD Soundtrack featuring the haunting Original Soundtrack (OST) composed by Christos Antoniou (from the Greek metal band Septicflesh) and primarily performed by the FILMharmonic Orchestra of Prague!
A double-sided poster
The physical game
A collectible tuck-in box housing all the contents

title: Monument Valley: The Trilogy
description:
Monument Valley: Trilogy is a puzzle game featuring geometric landscapes and optical illusion-based levels. Players navigate through surreal architectural environments, solving spatial puzzles by manipulating the game's architectural structures. The series follows a silent protagonist through interconnected puzzle worlds, combining minimalist design with intricate spatial challenges.

It includes:

• The complete series in one physical edition
• Includes Six Premium Art Cards, featuring gorgeous scenes from each game
• Exclusive, Sleek all- black O-Sleeve design
• Pre-orders receive a download code for all three Monument Valley soundtracks
• Region Free - Worldwide Compatibility

title: 20XX / 30XX
description:
Jump, shoot, and slash your way through 20XX and 30XX in the ultimate co-op action-platformer roguelike collection!

This physical edition includes both 20XX and 30XX for Nintendo Switch on a single Game Card, as well as:

A double-sided 14 page instruction booklet featuring character bios and boss info
A digital download code for a copy of the complete soundtrack
Two kiss-cut sticker sheets
A 9x12 inch double-sided folded poster with a comprehensive list of in-game augments on each side
Reversible cover with double-sided artwork

title: Mostly Trash Sometimes Treasure
description: You've volunteered to clean a beach but the shore hides more than trash. Recycle the waste, upgrade your tools and discover the treasures.

title: Employee 925
description: Employee 925 is a short psychological horror game about compliance and the quiet erosion of self in the workplace.

title: Shidunzi Parkour
description: Ever looked at a humble street bollard and thought, "I want to be that"? Now you can! Dodge and crash your way through endless streets as a sentient stone bollard in this quirky, stress-relieving arcade game.

title: Astra Protocol Remake
description: Cassette futuristic space simulator

title: Mouse Required
description: Mouse Required is a web-playable puzzle game where you find and free your cursor friends.

title: Evilbane
description: Evilbane is a dynamic and action-packed strategy-based experience that you can tackle solo or with friends. Switch freely between ranged and melee weapons, and customize your skills for every situation to create your own unique warrior. Your choices and teamwork will determine your victory!

title: Tales of Bloomrise
description: Explore, farm, and fight in Tales of Bloomrise! Enjoy a relaxing village life with fishing and crafting, and test your skills in procedural dungeons. A pixel art world that grows with every update, blending cozy vibes with intense action combat.

title: Sokker
description: Sokker is a fast-paced soccer game for 1-4 players! Kick by flicking the control stick! Play your friends in Versus mode, or try co-op in the World Cup!

title: Gnomeball
description: Gnomeball is a fast-paced soccer game for 1-4 players, set in a charming miniature garden. Become a goal-scoring machine, pass like a maestro, and channel your inner Messi as you gracefully dribble past defenders!

title: Brain School
description: Brain School is chill card-based deduction game. A set of playing cards are shown face down: Solve the code by asking questions such as "What is the sum of the face cards?" or "Where are cards with the same value?" and unlock new items that will help solve increasingly harder rounds.

title: Rat Game
description: Asymmetrical horror comedy co-op for up to 8 players. Play either a pack of Rats trying to sabotage a restaurant, or the Chef determined to stop them.

title: Grail
description: In this deckbuilder your deck fights for you. Upgrade, enchant and stickerize your cards to create clever cascading effects that defeat monsters and other players. Can you reach the Grail?

title: Orebits
description: Smash through alien rock with oversized mining gear, collect rare ores and uncover strange secrets. Orebits is a gritty sci-fi idle game full of mystery and metal.

title: Cow Online World
description: Design your own animal self and meet other creatures in this colourful MMO! Graze with your friends and level skills like Basket Weaving, Trivia, Kindness, and more in a world that humans have left behind.

title: Digging Town
description:
Brace yourself, it is finally Digging Day! Every year, Digging Town organizes a big celebration named "Digging Day"!

On this day, all the people are asked to find a given number of objects by digging in the ground of the city.

Ready to take part of it?

title: Forkraith
description: You are trapped in the middle of urban labyrinth, and you have to exit ASAP! Examine the surrounding and find out if there are any anomalies or not. Can you choose the correct route and escape?

title: The Life of Buzludzha
description: The game is the abandoned monument of Buzludzha and the game included a winter season of atmosphere as real. You have to look for some buttons and an exit.

title: I am a Princess from Another World
Iftar for Two
description: Iftar for Two is a very short kinetic novel made for Ramadan game Jam 2024. It features two former friends who decide to have iftar together and talk about bits about this and that.

title: Jumping Jean
description:
Play as the blue-collared everyman in this retro-inspired sidescroller!

In Jumping Jean, you play as an everyday hero, a simple worker determined to save the day.

You're no superpowered plumber, and you're certainly not the heroic electrician of the kingdom, Jumping Jean!

You are a humble minion tasked with defending your homeland! You'll move left, right, and... actually, that's about it!

Can you survive an oncoming onslaught of dangerous electricians using nothing but your ability to move sideways?

title: KopiCat
description:
KopiCAT is a cat feeding simulator where stray cats will strut into your shelter as if they own the place. Feed them, and maybe they will leave you with gifts. Discover their quirks, win their favor, and maybe, JUST MAYBE, your shop will be allowed thrive.

The game was made by animal-loving folks at Twilight Foundry Games in a 4-day internal game jam. KopiCAT is a pilot project for the DevCares Initiative.

title: Siegeturtle
description: Upgrade your turtle, recruit cute animals, and blast through waves in an idle roguelite RPG. Swim farther each run, unlock new skills, and edge closer to home with every upgrade.

title: Liminal Skies
description: Welcome to Liminal: Skies, the opening chapter of a new creative universe. More than just town building, here you can design your own characters, bring them to life with dialogue, and craft entire worlds through play. With Liminal, creation is the game.

title: Basalt: The Cursed Vein
description: Basalt is a haunted roguelite match-3 mining adventure. Dig for precious ores, battle unsettling creatures, and rebuild a town of strange, whispering residents. The deeper you reach, the greater the rewards… though the villagers keep warning you - don't dig too deep!

title: RatScum
description: Fallen into the sewer, a lone rat embarks on the long journey of returning home in an estranged, crumbling apartment. Navigate forgotten corners and unfamiliar spaces, befriend unlikely allies, and slip through dangers and shadows in the cracks of a broken world.

title: Nourish
description: Nourish is a retro-styled 3D horror game about survival, responsibility, and the terrifying cost of failure.

title: Dove Days: Time Flies
description: Welcome to "DoveDays"! This is an engaging and compact casual puzzle game. Easy to use, simple to solve puzzles. We have combined the essence elements of various casual puzzle games. Without complicated operations, just open and play. It is both a stress-reliever and a brain-energizer.

title: Sushi Cat: Tower Defense
description: Battle back waves of rogue sushi in this cute-but-chaotic roguelite tower defense! Build, upgrade, and reshape the battlefield each run.

title: Xplorite
description: Xplorite is a hand-drawn 2d action-exploration metroidvania full of enemies and secrets. Get in Sy's shoes and explore the depths of planet Nargal in look for the missing research team. Travel through different biomes full of enemies and hazards and try to uncover what is happening on the planet.

title: Project Freefall
description: Grab your squad and dive into a frantic chase for the lone parachute as you play the ultimate game of tag at 10,000 feet! Toss a grenade, spray a fire extinguisher, or dodge the shark as you skydive with your friends and try to survive the fall. Will you go on to victory or go splat? Free to play.

title: Echo Point Nova: Under the Clouds
description: Explore a massive new world with swimming and a day and night cycle.

title: Need for Seat
description: A fun kart(chair) racing game where you can drift in a chair, race through office hallways, and even use random power-ups.

title: Sanctuaries
description: The conquistadors just landed and they are coming for your treasure! You must protect your Sanctuaries against this new threat. Take arms, lay down traps, improve your empire and lead your Heroes into battle to repel the invaders!

title: Phantomware 0
description: It starts like any other late shift—quiet office, dull glow of the monitor, work dragging on. You think you’re alone. But then the screen flickers. A message pops up. Not from your team. Not from anyone you know. Suddenly the silence feels heavier. Something’s here. And it doesn’t want you to leave.

title: CTRacer
description:
The world's first MMO Racing game implemented in Full 3D.
It is a car game designed to make users enjoy it easily and quickly by introducing RPG elements in tuning up, trading, and exchanging vehicles and parts, focusing on free driving, various modes of battle events, and communities against the backdrop of Gangbuk, Gangnam, Busan, Shanghai, and Manhattan maps in Seoul.

title: Plinkidle
description: Falling balls, rare buffs, and steady upgrades unlock colorful, cozy stages and immersive environments.

title: Escape Protocol: Online
description: In this co-op horror game, escape an unknown realm where reality is shattered and dimensions collide. Solve puzzles, avoid deadly entities, and uncover the hidden saboteur.

title: Everspace 2: Galactic Edition
description:
This Bundle Contains:

EVERSPACE 2
Experience a 30 hour adventure in this fast-paced single-player spaceship shooter with exploration in space and on planets, tons of loot, RPG elements, mining, and crafting. Explore an exciting sci-fi story set in a vivid, handcrafted open world full of secrets, puzzles, and perils.

EVERSPACE 2: Titans
The Dreadnought and Leviathan have arrived in Cluster 34. Collect new weapon and gear sets by tackling massive repeatable challenges. Discover two exciting storylines alongside a cast of new and returning characters!

EVERSPACE 2: Wrath of the Ancients
The Ancients have awakened! Their wrath has laid waste to human settlements in Cluster 34, and the path of destruction leads to the Okkar Homeworlds. Take flight in this massive expansion containing a post-game storyline, exciting side quests, four new star systems, new weapons and gear, and the Wraith starfighter.

EVERSPACE 2: Supporter Pack
The EVERSPACE 2 Supporter Pack opens up new cosmetic options for series megafans to customize ships. Contains more than 50 customizable additions including adjustable ship skins, decals, engine and thruster effects, and cybernetic glow lighting options.

title: Mr Wonder
description: Explore an abandoned creator’s studio in this dark psychological horror experience. Survive lethal traps and twisted challenges. Uncover hidden secrets and the truth behind Mr Wonder.

title: Noctiluca
description:
Noctiluca is the Spanish word in for the dinoflagellate, the luminescent plankton.
Illuminate, absorb and transform cells in 13 sweet and tricky levels.

A submission for the GMTK Jam 2024 with theme "Built to Scale".

title: Hexashell
description: Hexashell is a classic arcade style puzzle game with global high score leaderboards, colorful visuals and fast paced decision making. Progress through 15 levels of Arcade Mode to unlock additional game modes, custom color selections and a full original soundtrack!

title: Hollow Stories: Lockdown
description: A neo-retro survival horror noir game where you explore, solve puzzles, and fight to survive in a city ruled by corruption and cults.

title: Gladiatorum: Sacramentum
description: A deep management strategy sim blending political intrigue and character-driven narrative. Acquire and train gladiators with unique backstories and skills, manage your ludus from resources to staff, and navigate a world of political maneuvering and sabotage. Every choice leads to glory or ruin.

title: Solbrand
description: 2409. As the new Spook on HMS Solbrand you dive deep into a past steeped in grand norse myth and quiet local legend. Command your submersible, survey sunken ruins, uncover puzzling fragments, commune with the dead, and untangle a pseudo-historical knot of cosmic proportions: Why is the sun so loud?

title: PaperCars Tycoon
description: Papercars Tyccon is a small old school tycoon game about automobile. From a humble garage startup to a global automotive giant, your mission is to design cutting-edge vehicles, manage your factories and your staff in order to avoid bankruptcy.

title: One More Tower
description: One More Tower is a horde survival TD set in a medieval fantasy world. Pioneer an unexplored forest, build your town and defenses, and hold out against the onslaught of enemies. How long can you survive?

title: Untime
description: After an unfortunate incident, Circe moves from the big city to the small town of Dugo to start fresh. But maybe there are some things she can't change.

title: ChickOut!
description: Chickout is a co-op puzzle platformer for 2-6 players, playable locally or online! Team up as cute chicks, overcome obstacles, and enjoy chaotic fun together.

title: Luzhanqi
description: A modern, digital take on the classic Chinese abstract-strategy game Luzhanqi. Deploy your army, outmaneuver your opponent, and capture their flag in this turn-based war game. The battlefield waits for no one!

title: Junk Rise
description: Build your recycling empire from junk. Collect, process, and craft valuable products in a chill, satisfying simulator where garbage becomes gold.

title: Kill Code
description: Hunt the last remnants of humanity in a world shattered by war. Master brutal melee weapons, unleash powerful relics, and transform ORB your deadly robotic companion into the ultimate weapon of destruction.

title: Crush Point
description: Crush balls, dodge blades, and survive explosive chaos. A fast-paced arcade puzzle where every crush creates more challenges.

title: WordCross
description: Crosswords meet battle royale! Think fast, play smart, be the last one standing!

title: Shā Diāo Zhī Lù
description: A bizarre open-world action RPG by a Chinese independent studio, seemingly abandoned after some time in Early Access.

title: Infinite Game Cartridge Collection: Balloon Story
description: Inflate the balloon but don't blow it up.

title: Pyrotoad
description: Pyrotoad is an action platformer where you leap, shoot, and puzzle your way through 35 challenging stages. Harness flame powers, unlock new moves, and battle through diverse biomes in your quest to reclaim Pyrotoad’s stolen sunglasses!

title: Neuroxus
description: A third-person, mech-powered, fast-paced shooter with roguelite elements—Doom-like intensity in a lifeless machine-ruled world.

title: Der Räuber Hotzenplotz
description: "The Robber Hotzenplotz" is a faithful multimedia implementation of the children's book classic by Otfried Preußler. The game is very closely oriented to the original and transforms the book template into a fun and child-friendly adventure game. Various tricky tasks, puzzles and games are to be tackled.

title: Momo Pop
description: Momo is a bubbly witch who's travelling all around space to visit her emo girlfriend, Kiki. However, her task won't be so simple: Kiki's galaxy is all full of hazards that Momo must avoid.

title: Floramino
description: Floramino is a cozy roguelite puzzle game where you manage an ever-growing garden, hand out flowers to customers, and keep Springtime going.

title: TropicHell
description:
It's summer, and that means Doomguy needs a vacation. And where else to go but the tropics?
TropicHELL is a 24-map community megawad for Doom 2, themed around the tropics, the ocean and island scenery. Sail the seas on the S.S. Doomguy and fight tropical hellspawn, as you try to figure out why your vacation went so wrong.

- 24 maps of tropical island action across 3 episodes!
- A wide variety of locales to explore (beaches, temples, villages, etc)
- Tropical-themed monster and weapon sprites
- Custom map screens as in Doom 1
- Sail on The Boat aka the majestic S.S. Doomguy

title: Celestial Golf
description: Hit your ball on orbital trajectories around a realistically sized solar system. Discover the secrets hidden in the planets and moons, learn orbital mechanics, and boldly go where no golf ball has gone before.

title: Memo to the Underlord
description: A rogue-like dungeon crawler where you play as a disgruntled employee just trying to quit his job - by force. Battle your way through a corporate hell, full of hostile co-workers, feral creatures, and everything in between.

title: Hero of Sunset
description: Venture into this retro pixel art action-adventure with an open world. Explore, fight, solve puzzles, challenge bosses — and, most importantly, you can romance the cute girls!

title: Herotome
description: Be a hero or be a menace! Herotome is a choice-heavy visual novel with a colorful cast of characters. Seize the moment to find love and worldwide renown, or use your gift of gab to annoy your heroic peers.

title: Winter Makes Me Lonely but at Least I Have You
description:
a short extremely indulgent spinoff of Yuki's 4P i wrote for the holidays while feeling sick!

this is a kinetic novel of ~3k words with no choices, so sit back with a cup of hot cocoa or warm soup and enjoy!

playing the original game isn't required, but i recommend it so you get to know the characters better!

title: Lilacs in the Breeze
description: A trans otome game about a woman beginning a new leaf—until her childhood friend shows up at her door.

title: Galactic Vault
description: Build your weapon to its full potential in Galactic Vault, a fast-paced FPS roguelite. Discover endless upgrade combinations, craft diverse builds, and unleash devastating abilities. Get ready to infiltrate high-security vaults and recover lost tech.

title: Ash & Adam's Existential Treads
description: A mini action city-builder in a post-post-apocalyptic world. Grow your settlement. Fend off waves of enemies. Restore nature.

title: Quake Rally
description: Quake Rally is an attempt to turn Quake into a fully fledged Rally game.

title: Zero Tenshi: Blue Sun
description: Find the red buttons hidden in the world of your dreams and discover your destiny.

title: Shin Megami Tensei V: Vengeance Randomizer
description:
This is a randomizer for Shin Megami Tensei V: Vengeance.

This randomizer allows you to shuffle:

- Demons, encounters, bosses, items, and miracles
- Mix any or all options in settings

Key Features:

- Encounters are replaced with demons of the same level
- Demon levels, skills, stats, races, and alignments can be randomized
- Bosses and special fusions randomized within categories
- Unique skills can be assigned in vanilla, random, or free mode
- Items and miracles randomized while ensuring key progression items remain obtainable
- Shop, chest, enemy drops, and quest rewards randomized
- Gameplay adjustments allow more demons to be recruitable and flexible fusion combinations

Compatibility:

Incompatible with most mods due to extensive file edits

title: Monastery: Ora et Labora
description: Lead your monks in prayer and labor to build a thriving medieval monastery. Manage resources, brew ale, craft manuscripts, and face trials like war and weather. Customize, expand, and guide your brotherhood to achieve spiritual and economic prosperity.

title: Life with a Homunculus
description: A homunculus-raising simulation game. While talking with the homunculus, you teach her about daily life and the world. Her personality changes depending on your actions! Take walks together, earn money through part-time jobs, and enjoy crafting through alchemy.

title: B.E.S.T
description: B.E.S.T is an adult visual novel where romance, competition, and betrayal intertwine. 100 participants. $500,000 at stake: who will you trust? Make your choices, build your relationships, seduce or betray… and become the last one standing.

title: Rock Paper Clash
description: Rock Paper Clash is a multiplayer battle arena where your only weapons are the timeless trio: rock, paper, and scissors. Join friends and players from around the world in the ultimate game of chance and strategy across a variety of unique arenas.

title: Cats of the Yuan Dynasty
description: Embark on a relaxing search for hidden cats in the majestic ancient scroll Autumn Hunting in the Plains of the Yuan Dynasty!

title: Bustafield 2: Hoodline
description: Partake in a war of the Grove Street Gang against the Ballas and Vagos.

title: Kaelaverse: Pemascape
description: Kaela Kovalskia of Hololive ID has gone missing! Play as her army of assistants, the Pemaloe, and set off to explore caves, dungeons, and mazes and discover the truth about Kaela's whereabouts!

title: VectaGuard
description: Arcade-inspired shmup action where neon vector caverns explode with modern visuals, dynamic music, weapon upgrades and intense score chasing.

title: Dun Dun Crawl
description: Dun Dun Crawl is a creature-collector roguelite. Command monsters, battle foes, complete mini-games, make strategic choices, and face powerful dungeon bosses!

title: Laughingstock Apocalypse Redux
description:
Odd things keep happening in the tranquil Styrofoam Grove.

Play this single player 3D adventure and uncover the secrets surrounding the Grove and its shady, otherworldly inhabitants. The sequel to Laughingstock Apocalypse.

title: Loki the Lynx
description: Join Loki in a vibrant 2D action-platformer as he rescues his friends from the dastardly Dr. A. Migdala! Explore colourful worlds, collect treasures, and uncover secrets in a side-scrolling adventure packed with lovable characters, hilarious moments, and epic platforming fun!

title: Girder & Hearts: Reel Romance
description: Girder & Hearts: Reel Romance is a roguelite love-and-strategy sim where you play as a civil engineer striving to work smart at construction sites, build your charm, and romance captivating heroines.

title: The Blood's Way
description: A short narrative-driven 2D side-scrolling action game inspired by ancient Chinese legends. It all begins with a dream. Perhaps someone is pulling the strings—or maybe... it's destiny?

title: Sky City Rush
description: An action-packed racing game where you unlock tracks, master cars with unique stats, and compete in elimination, time trial, and classic races.

title: Screen Boy
description: Screen Boy is a fun 2D platformer adventure full of excitement and danger! Join Screen Boy as he explores colourful worlds, dodges traps, and takes on massive bosses. With smooth controls and action-packed levels, it’s a thrilling quest that keeps you playing! Can you Save Screen Girl?

title: Fishing Time
description: Fishing Time Is a chill fishing game where you collect rare fish. Every 2 hours, you can catch a fish, which is added to your Steam inventory. There are +140 different fish and 6 different rarity levels! Relax, cast your line, and complete your collection!

title: Vegas Casino & Slots: Slottist
description: Discover the world's best Casino Slots Games! Play slots with unique game mechanics, explore amazing mini-games and master your casino skills!

title: Death Burger
description: A cheerful man excitedly arrives at a popular burger shop in town. However, it turns out to be a terrifying facility controlled by the evil Emperor "Pattypatine"! Ravenous, rampaging burgers are everywhere... Fight back with the shining fries, the "Potato Saber"!

title: Dungeon Shifters
description: Dungeon Shifters is an action RPG set in a world broken by a magic comet. Explore ancient dungeons, uncover lost secrets, and battle deadly ememies in third-person combat. Choose your adventurer and shape your fate in the depths.

title: Boyfriend or Cake??
description: alternatively: caring romantic partner or delicious confectionery dessert?

title: Bilge Su Bullet Baroness
description: Bilge Su: Bullet Baroness is a mission-based first-person shooter where you take on waves of enemies with powerful weapons and explosives. Fight through linear combat zones, complete objectives, and survive without checkpoints. Pure action from start to finish.

title: Myth Finders
description: Discover MythFinders: magical worlds, hidden secrets, artifacts, challenges and mysteries await true adventurers!

title: Xd Clicker
description: XD CLICKER is a game about obtaining XD via clicks, unlocking meaningless upgrades and playing cutting-edge mini-games. There are strategies to learn, levels to unlock and battles to win. There is no other game like XD CLICKER because there never should've been one in the first place.

title: Levantar La Botella
description: Levantar La Botella means "stand the bottle" —a classic Taiwanese night market game where you use a handle, a string, and a ring to skilfully lift a bottle into a standing position.

title: Folie Fatale: Kousaku Fanaticism
description: A DLC for Folie Fatale, telling past stories of the love interests, as well events that take place after the main story.

title: Exit Plan b
description: Exit Plan b is a fast-paced action-puzzle roguelite where you explore intricate mazes, collect coins, evade and outsmart relentless enemies, and gather gems and points to unlock powerful new skills and progress through increasingly challenging levels.

title: Book Travelers III: A Gothic Story - Collector's Edition
description: Enter the pages of Dracula and survive a world of vampires, dark magic, and literary betrayal. The collector's edition includes goodies and a bonus gameplay chapter to throw a party that defies the darkness.

title: SCP: Echoes
description: Hidden away from the public, you must survive in a top secret facility, filled with anomalous entities. Will you save the world, cause destruction, or end humanity as we know it?

title: Mining Merchant
description: Your uncle’s once-thriving jewelry shop is crumbling, and it’s your job to bring it back to life. Mine precious ore, smelt it into shiny jewelry, add rare gemstones and sell to every customer who walks in. Mine by day, sell by night, solo or in co-op, and become a successful merchant.

title: When Stars Collide
description: In this sci-fi romance visual novel, join the crew of The Ophelia after awakening from a 500 year slumber. Forge new bonds, find romance, and unlock a secret that could change the galaxy's future.

title: Cyberpedia
description:
Cyberpedia is a fictional CD-Rom game released in the 90's, in which kids could boot it up on their home computer, and through the power of the internet, the game would generate a museum full of exhibits for you to explore and learn all about. It's the information superhighway all in one place!

You're booting this game up over 30 years later though... and the state of the internet is a lot different to how it was back then. As you go through the game you'll find that links go missing, information gets lost, and a certain, 'generative', trend has been spreading like a plague across the game.

While you explore Cyberpedia, you and your helpful museum assistant, Bookworth, can help sort out these issues! as best as you can at least...

title: Love in the Time of Spellphage
description: A one-hour spellpunk narrative adventure about pandemic, wizards, and first love.

title: Nekketsu Legend Baseballer
description:
In a world where baseball plays a pivotal role in people's lives, teams compete against each for supremacy, using spiritual and magical moves, as well as robots. Recently, a powerful demon took control of the land, and some humans began using the art of baseball for evil purposes. The malevolent Dark Baseballer has been terrorizing innocents, and it is up to a group of young people to restore justice.

Nekketsu Legend Baseballer is a role-playing game dedicated to baseball. There is no actual baseball simulation in the game: much of it plays like a traditional Japanese RPG, with top-down overworld, town and dungeon explorations, party management, leveling up, equipment, items, etc. However, all the usual RPG paraphernalia is completely baseball-themed. Random turn-based battles occur less frequently than in other comparable games, but last a considerable amount of time due to their mechanics: each party member is in control of a group of "baseball robots", and defensive and offensive actions are named after real baseball moves.

title: Biscuit Mafia
description: Biscuit Mafia is an action-shooter where you have to defend your oven from the ruthless Biscuit Mafia, deep in the heart of the jungle! Survive three intense minutes armed with nothing but feathers, screams and bizarre power-ups!

title: Winnie The Pooh: The Serial Killer
description: Winnie The Pooh: The Serial Killer is a third person shooter were your goal is to get the best score. Winnie The Pooh can kill civilians and enemies by ranged weapons. Winnie The Pooh can use a hostile approach by using ranged weapons to kill as many enemies as possible. The game has many enemy types including melee police, pistol police, sniper police and even helicopters. This game has many wanted levels which will affect the spawned police.

title: Daimu
description: Daimu is a bite-sized visual novel utilizing minimal assets to tell a unique, narrative-driven story. This short game features roughly 2,200 words, three endings, an original soundtrack, and a single illustration.

title: Faded Solitude
description:
Faded Solitude is an atmospheric adventure game with a gritty pencil-drawn art style!

All of our art is hand drawn by a professional artist located in Denmark to create a surreal and unique art style which shapes the universe created in Faded Solitude.

title: To-Fu: The Trials of Chi
description: To-Fu: The Trials of Chi is a puzzle game. You control a piece of tofu by dragging and flinging them around the level. The goal of each level to reach a fortune cookie, and each stage has a limited number of moves, as well as optional goals such as collecting orbs.

title: Hexa Fusion 2048
description: Hexa Fusion 2048 is a fun and addictive hexagonal puzzle game! Shoot number blocks onto the board, merge them to create bigger numbers, and aim for the highest score. Use booster hammers to clear obstacles, but be careful—if a block reaches the limit, the game ends! Can you master the fusion?

title: Dungeon Defenders: Warden Hero DLC
description: An ancient forest spirit seeking tranquillity, the Warden joins the battle against the Old One's army. While at fist glance she might look peaceful, if you get on her bad side you'll be in for a world of hurt. With powerful abilities, she tries to protect even the smallest of critters from harm.

title: Astro Defender
description: Defend Zytherion in frantic battles against alien hordes! In Astro Defender, pilot the legendary Zenith-01 and face a galactic threat in a fast-paced action-platformer. Will you be the galaxy's last hope?

title: Jack & Detectives: Black Magic Expansion
description: Mad Resonance, Judging Sorcery! New roles, "Occultist," "Elite Jack," and "Elite Jack Maniac" appear! A new battle between the collaboration of Jack's side and the sorcery to stop it!

title: Rhythmetric
description: Defeat your geometric foes by placing attack, move, and shield elements in a rhythmic sequence to catchy music loops.

title: Blade of Jinshu
description: Betrayed and left to die, you rise as a cybernetic-enhanced warrior on a relentless path of revenge. Slash through corporate enforcers, master high-speed combat, and survive deadly challenges in a fractured world where every move counts. Upgrade your abilities and carve your way to vengeance!

title: Squarely
description: Squarely is a chilled-out puzzle game of precision and strategy. Push, Slide, Boost and Teleport your way through 200 handcrafted levels with no time pressure. Learn new mechanics as you advance, unlock colorful tiles, and challenge yourself to master each puzzle.

title: Nothing is Known: The Innocents
description: As a young detective, you will have to investigate the disappearance of a little girl, while simultaneously living in the missing little girl moments.

title: Yuuki Yuuna ha Yuusha de Aru: Gyoki Danshou
description: A free fangame taking place 5 years after Yuusha no Shou's ending.

title: Shadow Boxing
description: A game based on the movie "Бой с тенью" ("Shadow Boxing"). Developed in less than a year and released in 2005.

title: Shadow Boxing 2
description: A video game tie-in to the sequel of a Russian movie "Бой с тенью 2: реванш". Released on October 26th, 2007.

title: Halo Infinite: Operation - Shadows
description:
New directives received. Operation: Shadows has the green light.
ONI’s latest intel reports a new weapon, a new vehicle, and two dangerous new modes that enshrine them both in all their glory. All Spartan operatives are hereby encouraged to report to Famished Famished Falcons to earn their wings in the Falcon, followed by extensive drills with the new Vestige Carbine on the proving grounds of Banished Slayer. Complete the latest free 20-tier Operation Pass to acquire the new Whisper armor set. Upgrade to the Premium Operation Pass to unlock a durable, 50-tier reward track featuring four full armor sets and an exclusive bundle of classified customizations. Arriving with expanded Weapons Bench customizations, improved Firefight features, and a massive Forge overhaul, Halo Infinite’s Fall Update is one op you won’t want to miss. Risk it all. Deny everything. Play Operation: Shadows through September 9.

title: Halfmoon
description: halfmoon is a short adventure game set in a reception office for the deceased, the final stop before the afterlife.

title: Peter's House
description:
Enter the dark and ominous world of Peter's House, where you play as Steve, a man hired to move boxes for the new owner. As you explore the house, you quickly realize that something isn't right.

Be aware of your surroundings.

title: Uppies!
description: A family friendly platformer, problem solving and overcoming obstacles to reunite Ducky with their family on the floating farm.

title: Liberation Army
description: Liberation Army is a freeware strategy/shooter hybrid game by Japanese indie developer KOU (Koushi Okada).

title: Wu Xing Chess
description: A game that requires the intelligence of multiple players (2-4).Adapted from the traditional Five Elements gameplay and the traditional Chinese Five Elements elements.Each player will be assigned a type of attribute, striving to connect their attributes into a line of 5.

title: Dont Jump: Gamesforfarm
description: A small green dinosaur once discovered a mysterious artifact in the ruins of an ancient temple - the last key to home. Now he is racing through the ruins of a prehistoric world, collecting coins to activate a portal leading to his native forest

title: RoboDoc Jr.
description: A fun space adventure game where kids become alien medics! Use cool futuristic tools to help friendly aliens across 12 exciting missions. Solve puzzles, fix alien tech, and save the day with steady hands and smart thinking!

title: In Your Flesh
description:
Visual novel told with handmade art dolls.

Made for the Toxic Yuri VN Jam.

Laura lives in a big house.

Ruby should not be here.

title: Vampire: No Survivors
description:
In this reverse Vampire Survivors style game, you play as the Vampire, summoning hordes of minions and trying to survive against the Survivors.

Kill the Survivors to protect your coffins, collect gems to summon more powerful minions, and open chests to unlock and upgrade your units.

title: Mobia's Trip
description: A puzzle platformer about screen loops and strange geometry. Position your firefly correctly to phase through walls, gain momentum, and perform cool rolling tricks to unlock new areas.

title: Fallstreak 2: Traum
description:
For Adelise Cotard, the peaceful world of Socotrine is but a stifling prison. While the cost of her yearning may haunt her forever, it will bring her to cross paths with another world of fables and fae. Will her heart whisper to her to preserve that dream, or will it call for her to shatter it as well?

In this next entry of the Fallstreak franchise, experience a tale of tragedy spanning over 10 hours, complete with evocative graphics, poignant soundtracks, and carefully crafted prose.

title: Rube-like Gold-berger
description: For tinkerers and contraption builders. Build wacky contraptions to launch enemies, zap parts across the screen, and create unlimited power.

title: Why the Long Gun?
description: Why change guns when you can attach them to each other? A shooting game where you're either forced to use all your weapons all at once, or you must launch them at enemies.

title: Caw Across Time
description: Ring ring, it's your future cawing! You play as a curious crow attempting to solve the mystery of a strange ancient clocktower. Request items from your future self to solve puzzles, but be sure to close each time loop to maintain the law of caw-sality.

title: Battleships Combat: Evolved
description: A classical game, but with a twist! 20 different ships, each with an interesting damage pattern, fight on a battlefield with customizable size and possibly also islands. Against AI or other players on local network.

title: UnderHolo
description: The VTuber industry is rigged. Let's win it anyway.

title: Draftula
description: Every 100 years, Count Draftula returns to wreck havoc on this Mortal World. He remains in power until a hero of mankind strong enough to defeat him shows up to topple his reign. But before that, Draftula has to build his castle first.

title: While 1:
description: Don't touch the walls. While 1 is a minimalist mouse-only action game centered around this simple concept. Create a loop around the level while avoiding obstacles synchronized to the music.

title: Fairy Nook
description: The tales of 4 Fairies living in a book nook

title: Mycelium Mayhem
description: You are a tiny mushroom fighting isopods on a stump. Player and enemies are tied to a looped ability system that perform actions automatically in a cycle. Each wave increases in difficulty, try to survive as long as you can.

title: Retro Glitch
description: You just got yourself a nice retro game, The Demon Cycle, that you can't wait to try out. Uh oh, maybe it's a little bit damaged...

title: Funk-E
description: Move to the beat in this rhythmic puzzle platformer. Using a music sequencer, you can control various elements of the level. Careful timing is needed to make hard levels easy and make the impossible possible.

title: Loopedal
description: As the DJ for Fantasma Night Club, use looping instruments to curate the vibe.

title: Möbius Trip
description: The edges of your world loop. But the edges also aren't fixed in place. Manipulate the framing and the looping of the world to get to the exit tunnel.

title: Beat Demon
description: Demons are invading Cyberspace. The only way to defeat them... is crafting sick beats. Mix up beats on your drum pad to kill incoming demons.

title: Play It Back
description: You're a musician on the go. Make looping beats and record new samples from your surroundings to use in your songs. Solve problems with the power of music.

title: Loop Archer
description: Come back stronger after each death to defeat The Loop.

title: Chaos among Realms: Reborn The Game
description: A game inspired by Minecraft Dungeons, Astro Bot and classic adventure RPG’s, but with our own personal taste. With a simple and charming chibi style, we expect the player to dive in this world, have fun in co-op with friends and enjoy of:

title: Loopy Goes Fishing
description: Become Loopy's new helmsman, travel around, catch different kinds of fish, and uncover the secret of the archipelago.

title: Ninja Step
description: Program the looping choreography of your ninja to get through baddies.

title: Management Wanted
description: Brings the world of Five Nights at Freddy's into Minecraft! Includes animatronics, decorations, various systems/mechanics, and survival mode compatibility!

title: Wait, Is That Me?
description: Fight hordes of enemies, upgrade your character and conquer bosses. Be wary of your actions, as each one is recorded and will be played back by an exact replica of you in future loops. Your clones can become either allies by fighting alongside you or they can become enemies by damaging you instead.

title: Pimby's Workaround
description: Help Pimby get to the end of each stage of this puzzle platformer. Use Pimby's unique looping abilities and bananarang to navigate through confusing geometry and dangerous enemies.

title: Shinsei Project: Collapse
description: Explore the Shinsei Project and stop the time loop that is threatening to bring the entire universe to a total standstill.

title: The Easiest Way
description: Defeat waves of angry-looking red enemies with a cubic figure named Kyubi and their boomerangs.

title: The Golden Mare
description: The ouroboros killer has challenged you openly to find him or else he keeps his kill streak. Kill not only challenges you but also mocks the police department. Find him before anyone else is killed.

title: Threadbare
description: A short game about being old and looking back at how you spent your time on earth. People you met, dreams you left behind, endless hours of working... just for the cycle to begin again.

title: Loop Merchant
description: You play as a man from another dimension who is sent universe to universe selling questionable items to people. Strategically plan and convince your clients to buy your items in the most efficient way possible.

title: Run It Back
description: Going nowhere has never felt so familiar.

title: Learning the Ropes
description: Blessed with opposing thumbs, a monkey girl scout named Roxana saves the week by tying loops and knots. Can you help her get the elusive Rope Ruler badge?

title: Helleidoscope
description: Get in the groove and help Lux, Scratch, and Sui escape from the disco demon and her technicolour hell.

title: Time Wiza
description: Tetris meets... Pong? You're a bad wizard, but you have a magic stopwatch. Turn back time and overcome an opponent far stronger than you.

title: Hellivery
description: Experience every deliveryman's personal hell, being stuck in an endless shift with terrible working conditions. Deliver doughnuts to hungry demons and avoid obstacles along the way.

title: PotDuckRun
description: Escape from the pot by eating as many apples as you can. Bonk the trees to make the apples fall down, but look out for the sly hedgehog.

title: The Tangled Tapestry
description: You're a monster who got banished to a very strange world, a prison shaped like a Möbius strip: The Tangled Tapestry. Use your unique morphology and understand the shape of this looping world to find a way out.

title: Not Again, Hero
description: In a child’s never-ending imagination, the quest keeps looping. Arrange scene cards to build your timeline, and watch your story unfold—again.

title: Recordeca
description: A revolutionary spin on the rhythm game formula. Each song is served to you on a record, where you'll have to hit the notes as they come around to you.

title: Dance of the Stereomancer
description: Create a loop of magical powers to find the funkiest and deadliest synergies. Face waves of enemies and awaken the Party God in a fast-paced and chaotic survivors-like.

title: Karaoke Squad
description: A tower defense that makes you dance! The blues are ruining the party. Place mics by tapping on the rhythm and defend the stage against the ghosts to keep the party going.

title: Cadmium Red
description: You're stuck in some kind of facility, and you don't remember anything. Your goal is to figure out what's going on.

title: Distant Colony
description: Explore alien planets in sci-fi survival adventure, gather resources to craft tools, overcome environmental hazards, uncover hidden secrets, and build thriving, self-sustaining colonies with advanced technology. Prepare humanity for a new future among the stars.

title: Punch Lunch: Foodtruck Fighter
description: Jump, dash, and brawl your way through beautifully animated 2D platforming levels, then shift perspectives into dynamic top-down 3D street zones to gather rare ingredients in chaotic, GTA2 - style street battles! Every fight feeds your menu. Every level is a recipe for madness.

title: Terminal 13
description: Horror simulation 13 nights of horror inside a train station Check. Approve. Refuse. Survive. Every train hides a secret. Every night brings terror. Duty turns to nightmare in the shadows of the station.

title: Wrangle Ranch
description: Wrangle animals, grow your herd, and discover game breaking combos in this farm-to-desktop, roguelike barnbuilder.

title: Keep Digging
description: Keep Digging is a laid-back co-op mining game where the only objective is to dig ever deeper, sell what you find, and keep upgrading your kit. Nothing more, nothing less. There’s no combat, no stealth, and no enemies. Just pure, satisfying excavation.

title: Pinball Paladins
description: Pinball Paladins is an action roguelike with pinball physics and rpg progression. Defend your convoy and power up your heroes using dozens of unique items. With an upbeat chiptune soundtrack and original handcrafted pixel art, you’ll find endless replayability.

title: MX Racing World
description: Experience the offroad racing with dirt bikes, tough AI rivals, and rugged circuits. Race through clear, sunny and rainy weather while tackling sharp track turns and jumps. Customize your rider outfits, adjust AI opponents, and push your limits on challenging dirt tracks to prove your racing skills.

title: Sign Off
description: Money, Ammo, Power-ups!

title: Vestigia: Joust
description: The first historically accurate jousting simulator, running on Unreal Engine 5. Choose an environment and an opponent, then prove your worth in the lists through a physics-based confrontation adhering to Renaissance-era jousting rules and behaviors.

title: Combo Master
description: Test your fighting game skills in Combo Master! Complete the ultimate combo, the flower of fighting games! Use all skills with rules exclusive to Combo Master to earn the title of Master!

title: Chemical Plant Worker Simulator
description: Play as “牛大胆” in the “胆大牛化工厂”. You’re not the hero—just a worker on shift. But every chat, every task, carries a story.

title: JungleBoys
description: Enter the jungle to fight for your survival in this local splitscreen showdown. Heal up, collect items to use in combat, and look for other players to fight in custom lobbies with friends. Last player standing wins. Gameplay in the jungle supports Xbox controller use for up to 4 players.

title: Speed Rally
description: Try Speed Rally, the retro inspired top-down arcade racer! Compete for online highscores or battle friends in local multiplayer matches in this top-down throw back to the golden era of single button controller fun.

title: Flowtris
description: Flowtris is more than just Tetris: it’s a tool for evaluating unique gaming experiences. Flowtris is designed with game modes that can deliver unique experiences and comes with a feedback survey tool that you can fill out and contribute to better games.

title: Kana No Mado
description: Learn to read Japanese hiragana and katakana with this calm and focused educational app. Practice kana recognition through sound and visual quizzes. No writing or grammar - just reading practice at your own pace. Ideal for beginners in Japanese.

title: CinemaLandVR
description: CinemaLandVR is a VR game specifically designed for immersive cinemas. It offers a diverse range of architectural modules and an extensive selection of furniture. Players can build their own dream villa in the embrace of nature, creating a magical and immersive movie-watching experience.

title: Tone
description: Tone is a short puzzle game based on color and sound.

title: IlhaZ
description: IlhaZ is an online survival game set in a post-apocalyptic archipelago. Survive against zombies, hunger, and harsh weather while interacting with other players in a brutal open world.

title: ProcW
description: ProcW is a 2D Top Down Local Multiplayer shooter, with up to four players.

title: Dungeon Tracer
description: A puzzle RPG where you connect tiles to fight and survive strategically in ever-changing dungeons.

title: Emergency Crew 5: Blazing Vacation
description: Emergency Crew: Blazing Vacation: New Challenge: The rescue team battles chaos even on vacation!

title: Cube1 vs. Cube2
description: Engage in an epic clash and dominate the cubic battleground! Join the fray and showcase your skills in this addictive cube game!

title: Escape of the School
description: Explore an abandoned Brazilian school, escape from the murderous teacher, and uncover the secrets behind a massacre that happened 20 years ago in this first-person horror filled with cultural references. Survive, hide, and escape.

title: Sword Hockey
description: Top-down 3D air-hockey-style game requiring only your mouse. Using swords instead of mallets, score goals by hitting the puck into your opponent's goal, or prevent goals by hitting your opponent away from the puck. The player with the most goals after 3 minutes wins!

title: SkinCrawler Ranch
description: SkinCrawler Ranch is a Campy Horror FPS Cryptid Hunting Adventure. A camping trip, turned bad trip. Now it’s up to you to defend your well-endowed gothic girlfriend from the Cryptid Horrors!

title: Epimythos: The Forgotten Legends
description: Explore the mythic tapestry of ancient Greece through immersive quiz-based gameplay. Test your knowledge of gods, heroes, and epics sagas in four distinct modes—including Speed Mode, with Steam Leaderboards. Contains 530 handcrafted questions, 160 AI-enhanced illustrations.

title: One Shot All Kill
description: "Perfect catharsis from one calculated shot" Meticulous planning and precise execution. Utilize every element of the map to find seemingly impossible solutions, sweep away all targets with perfect trajectory, and clear this game. Your meticulous strategy is your firepower.

title: Mechasaur vs Punchatron
description: Take on the role of Mechasaur, a kaiju turned war machine that has escaped from the labs and is running loose through the city. The only thing stopping you from razing the entire city to the ground is Punchatron, the giant robot that originally captured you.

title: Scope Battle Royale
description: Scope, a fast-paced 100-player battle royale where memory wiped warriors fight for survival on a remote island. Dropped into a stylized world with no powers, only skill, strategy, and will-power.

title: ShockJump
description: Somebody, not us, screwed up. And now, the bugs are out of the containment area. A new nest has been established somewhere in the region and we're going to take it out.

title: Chainsaw Dodge
description: Being a tiny log creature in a giant, hostile world isn’t easy - especially when vicious lumberjacks won't stop trying to turn you into their new coffee table. Run, jump and dodge an onslaught of airborne chainsaws in this chaotic arena as you fight to survive and chase the highest score possible.

title: Mythic Trials 2
description: Mythic Trials 2 is a Hack'n'Slash Rogue-Lite where each player has different skills. PvP Battle Royale, PvE Cooperation modes, Diablo-style loot, pet breeding, world bosses, rankings, drafts, and much more.

title: Mech Attack
description: Mech Attack is a third person shooter where the player controls a mech with a machine gun on the right side and a cannon on the left side. The player also has a short range thermal vision at their disposal. An onslaught of agents chases the player and shoots at them. The player must survive as long as possible and defeat enemies.

title: Blindsided Labs
description: Recruit Swordsmen, Archers, and Templars, then watch your pixel squad auto-battle across the screen. Crush the enemy base before its ever-tougher waves crush you in an endlessly escalating tug-of-war!

title: Idle Together
description: A resource management and collaboration game where you gather, build, and progress through a unique constellation-based upgrade system. Accessible, relaxing, and endless—perfect for playing with family or friends.

title: Clippy Commando
description: An arcade top-down shooter where you play as a genocidal paper clip armed with heavy weaponry fighting hordes of office supplies to the death. Save the Clipenberg Empire from the threat of the Rulerian Alliance in Story Mode, or go for a high score in Infinite Mode.

title: The Overnight Screening
description: The story unfolds through the eyes of a first-person protagonist. While working part-time at an old movie theater, the protagonist begins to experience strange and unexplainable events. You must survive the presence that lurks within the theater and uncover hidden clues to reach a meaningful ending.

title: GenesisScroll
description: The story takes place in a village near Galur Castle. When the lost scroll reappears in the world, he will uncover the story from a long time ago, follow the guidance of the scroll, continuously learn magic, enhance strength, and challenge the aura of the strong!

title: Clash of Rock Paper Scissors
description: A fast-paced multiplayer twist on the classic rock-paper-scissors game! Shape-shift in real time, outsmart opponents, and clash in colorful arenas. Easy to learn, fun to master—perfect for quick battles with friends or smart AI.

title: Dig Dig Spud Spud Harvest
description: “Dig-Dig, Spud-Spud!” Dig up the ground and harvest the potato without damaging it! Sounds simple, but it's surprisingly tricky.

title: The Queen Riding Insects
description: It is a 3D game with a third-person perspective. The game is an open world, and the game has real four seasons day and night and changing weather..... Players have to explore the unknown world, challenge hidden dangers, find weapons to defeat monsters....

title: Deep Inside: Amore Sola MI Fa Remirare
description: An old fashioned RPG Horror Game. Venture into the mansion, investigate the truth behind the fire. The deeper you delve into the mistery, the more choices you will have when everything will unravel.

title: Sweetie Candy Maze: Green Apple
description: Dive into a vibrant candy world! Collect delicious sweets and find your way through playful green apple mazes in this sweet and colorful adventure.

title: Front Frontiers
description: The World is on the brink of irreversible Tragedy. Global tensions are rising, alliances are falling apart and states are preparing to decide their fate in the shadow of a massive war. Front Frontiers invites you to fight a massive war, offering an in-depth strategy experience.

title: Baggage Handler Simulator
description: BH Simulator is a fun and immersive airport logistics game. As a baggage hub manager, build efficient conveyor systems to sort, unload, and load luggage. Plan smart routes, avoid bottlenecks, and prove you're the boss of the baggage game. Can you turn chaos into perfect order?

title: The Next Journey of Life
description: "The Next Journey of Life"is a simulation management game. You, who work in the real estate industry, are unemployed due to the company's "optimization".A lost horse is not a blessing, as long as we have hope for life, we can walk "The next journey of life" well

title: FrenchConnection
description: Identical in looks, height, and figure yet polar opposites in heart, twin sisters pull me into a dilemma: pursue the high-school first love I've longed for, or the coworker twin who openly longs for me? A sweet, bittersweet tale of tangled affection.

title: Alphabetron
description: Alphabetron is a retro 8-bit wordsearch game with 50 neon-lit levels, weird word themes, and an arcade soul. Stretch across tiles, outsmart the grid, and spell your way to pixel glory — no CRT monitor required.

title: Ghost of the Diced Steak
description: This is a game where you control a diced steak and aim for the goal located deep within each stage. But it's not just any diced steak. This steak has the power to create ghosts. These ghosts replicate your past actions and can be strategically used to overcome obstacles.

title: Rocket Golf: Tap
description: A physics-driven, side-scrolling golf adventure where timing, terrain, and wind challenge your every action. One ball, infinite shots.

title: Twelve Succubus
description: Semi-Turn-Based RPG! Ruiya faces doom. You, interdimensional hero, are its last hope! Master skills & gear, battle charismatic witches. Defeat → Recruit → Unlock galleries. endless monster battles with abundant loot, plus unlimited revives and auto-combat.Go to carve your legend!

title: Mow Grass
description: Grass Cutting Game - Survive endless enemy waves! Choose from 3 weapons: Assault Rifle, Poison Field, or Light Saber. Upgrade through 5 levels + ultimate forms. Stunning particle effects!

title: MaLaTang
description: MaLaTang is a horror cooking game. In the late night cafeteria, players have to cook delicious food for customers in a cozy late night snack shop. Little do you know, the local urban legends have become your nightmare...

title: Tactical2
description: Tactical2 is a turn-based strategy board game where two teams of ancient Greek deities battle for supremacy across a 10x10 grid. Take command of powerful gods, deploy them wisely, and harness divine abilities to crush your enemies and invade their territory!

title: Jumbot
description: This is a simple box-jumping game, almost no plot. What player need is to control the blue robot move and jump to complete 9 different types of levels. The game takes about 30 minutes (that also depending on your proficiency).

title: Truck Titans
description: TRUCK TITANS is a high-octane monster truck racing game with 9+ levels of intense action. Customize your truck, pick sponsors, and compete in score attacks and races across city arenas, deserts, and night tracks. Nail stunts, crush obstacles, and become a monster truck legend.

title: Cupcake Galaxy
description: 80's Retro-style space game designed for kids but fun for the whole family!

title: Nemesis Galaxy at War
description: An endless sci-fi asteroid shooter where each level gets harder. Battle enemies, collect upgrades, and survive infinite waves of intense space combat!

title: Canvas: The Board Game
description: Create stunning paintings, layer cards strategically, and score ribbons in Canvas - a digital board game where art meets strategy. Choose and combine Art Cards to create beautiful paintings and enjoy a mix of artistic expression and tactical gameplay.

title: Survivors Dawn: Zombie World
description: A tactical zombie survival shooter where you lead a squad, scavenge for supplies, and fight to outlast the undead.

title: Just Work
description: Just Work is a first-person horror game set in a massive industrial complex owned by the enigmatic corporation EternaTIMA. You've just accepted a suspicious job offer, desperate to make money for your mother's hospital bills—but this facility holds secrets you were never meant to uncover.

title: Cube Ninja
description: Cube Ninja is a fast pace platformer. By the power of shuriken, he could weaving through the air and piercing enemies like flash. Confront the spraying blood and blade in front, can the Cube Ninja overcomes this wild hunt?

title: Arcade Archives 2: Chopper 1
description:
"CHOPPER 1" is a shooter released by SNK in 1988.
Pilot a combat helicopter deep into enemy territory in a mission to restore peace to your homeland.
Wielding overwhelming power far beyond what’s needed to simply protect one's family, what will these men discover at the end of their path of destruction?

"Arcade Archives 2" series includes "ORIGINAL MODE," "HIGH SCORE MODE," "CARAVAN MODE," and "TIME ATTACK MODE."
It also features multiple save slots, a rewind function that lets you restart your gameplay, and a quick start function for those who want to get started right away.
Furthermore, VRR support has been added, enabling more accurate reproduction of the original arcade game's experience.

title: Zip's Jumping Adventure
description:
This vertical platformer challenges your reflexes, timing, and precision across 40 adventure levels and an endless arcade mode with over 1 billion unique combinations.

Collect coins as you ascend, and try to beat the gold time on each level. Collecting every coin and finishing under the gold time awards gold stars. It’s all about precision, speed, and finding the best path upward.

As you progress, you'll travel through a variety of environments and experience shifting times of day, including bright middays, glowing sunsets, and quiet midnight climbs. Each level encourages players to push their skills further.

Compete with friends and players around the world on global leaderboards. Every adventure level tracks your best time — can you claim the top spot?

Whether you're collecting every coin or racing for the best time, Zip’s Jumping Adventures delivers a focused, skill-based challenge with plenty of variety!

title: Earth Defense Sticks
description:
Earth Defense Sticks is a fun and fast-paced 2D arcade game where you play as the planet Earth!

Asteroids are coming from all directions, and your job is to survive as long as possible. To help you, you have four powerful defense sticks — one on each side of the planet: top, bottom, left, and right. Press the matching buttons to extend the sticks and smash incoming asteroids.
