Each asteroid you destroy gives you points. The more you hit, the higher your score!
Simple to play, hard to master — how long can you protect the Earth?

title: Icenoid
description:
Icenoid is a fun and easy-to-play brick-breaking game. Use the paddle to bounce the ball and destroy all the blocks on the screen. Break them all to complete each level!

Collect a wide variety of power-ups that make the game easier — ball, paddle upgrades, and even rockets that blast through bricks. But be careful! Not all drops are helpful — some power-downs will make things harder, so you’ll need to dodge them quickly.

title: Pixicharm: Brotillery
description:
Grab your bandana and load up — it’s time for Brotillery!
Dash through chaotic warzones as a one-bro army, blasting enemies, dodging traps, and collecting coins. It’s a wild, fast-paced run ’n gun with retro vibes and nonstop explosions.

Simple controls, endless action, and full bro-power!

title: The Chase: Police Rush
description: The Chase is an endless driving game where you take the role of a driver on the run from the police. Set on an open, continuous maps, the objective is simple: stay ahead of the cops for as long as possible while avoiding obstacles and collecting essential items like fuel, magnets, coins and presents. With high-speed chases, explosive crashes, and unlockable vehicles and environments, The Chase delivers a heart-pounding experience.

title: Wolf Simulator 2025: Wild RPG Survival
description: The hunt begins - are you ready?

title: To Put Your Childhood Sweetheart Into A Refrigerator
Ragnarok: The New World
description:
Ragnarok: The New World is a massive online role-playing adventure set in the legendary world of Midgard. Explore vast fields, bustling cities, and mysterious dungeons where every journey holds new challenges and stories.

Create your own character and choose from classic jobs such as Swordsman, Mage, Archer, and Merchant. Customize your appearance with a wide variety of outfits, raise pets, ride mounts, and truly express yourself in a vibrant open world.

Beyond combat, build and decorate your own home—design a personal sanctuary to relax, gather with friends, and show off your creativity.

Join forces with allies to defeat powerful bosses, tackle dangerous raids, and grow together in guilds and communities. Or simply wander freely, trade, and enjoy the world at your own pace. With nostalgia and freedom at its core, Ragnarok: The New World invites you to relive the spirit of Ragnarok while writing your own legend in an ever-evolving online world.

title: Elea Eluanda: Das verschwundene Tröstereulenbuch
description: Elea Eluanda: Das verschwundene Tröstereulenbuch is an adventure game for children.

title: Reiten lernen mit Anna und Flocke
Petracal
description: PETRACAL is a first person dungeon-crawler survival set in the tunnels of a cave. Chart, plan, explore, devour, stay sane, and crawl your way to escape using everything you have at your hands reach to survive.

title: Fyte
description: Twitch-Integrated Viewer Spectacle with a bit of the ultra-violence. Host a chaotic physics driven tournament for your viewers to !play and watch as their ragdoll Fyters battle one on one until one reigns as your channel's Champion.

title: Interstate 1982
description: Interstate '82 is a Battlefield 1942 modification based on the original game for PC. The mod was released back in August 2003 and transforms BF1942 into a semi-modern day auto combat game. Pick your classic car and race around weapon mounted cars, this isn't your every day demolition derby!

title: Rotten Survivor
description: Rotten Survivor is the ULTIMATE 2D top-down horde survivor game! Fight massive hordes of bizarre enemies! Upgrade your equipment, create crazy combinations between all of the different weapons and modifiers and become an unstoppable force!

title: Cards of the Abyss
description: Cards of the Abyss is a movement based roguelike deckbuilder between Slay the Spire and Dofus. Move on a grid, dodge enemy attacks, and unleash explosive card combos to explore the Abyss and uncover the secrets of a lost civilization.

title: Vehicle No. 4
description: Vehicle No. 4 is an exciting horde survival game: Build your own combat vehicle, freely place weapons, and upgrade them with modules. Every decision matters as you face waves of enemies. Tinkering meets action – create your ultimate survival vehicle!

title: Smells Like Fear Blossoms
description: Misaki moves into her grandmother’s old home and takes part in the annual “Flower Festival” held in the town. What she thought was just an ordinary festival soon turns out to be something else entirely… Flight and exploration, choices and discovery—by collecting hidden items and fragments of memory scattered around the town, she forges ahead through a world steeped in fear and mystery.

title: Civil Purgatory
description: Interrogate, investigate, and judge in an authoritarian regime. In Civil Purgatory, real-time AI-generated role-playing dialogue adds depth and dynamism to this narrative simulation full of moral dilemmas, where you decide who walks free… and who doesn’t.

title: Mado
description: A vast ecosystem, crumbling ruins, towering creatures, a world in collapse—cut, connect, control, replicate, and blast your way through it in this Metroidvania, shaping it as you please.

title: Hello, Boss!
description: A BL visual novel about a successful CEO looking to hire a secretary!

title: Cult Vacui
description: Cult Vacui is a horror point-and-click adventure with survival and time management elements where your choices could keep you alive... or not.

title: Hiding
description: Every 20 seconds - the rules change! This fast-paced FPS arena with a 90s hip-hop vibe features phases of invisibility for looting and visibility for combat. Collect crystals, activate the portal, and escape - or fight to survive. 10 maps, 5 modes, unique characters, and unlimited ammo!

title: After Heaven
description: Battle relentless zombie hordes in this dark, action-survival shooter. Fight close-up, use sound to survive, and manage healing wisely—or face side effects. Intense combat, eerie atmosphere, and no mercy. How long can you last when death is always near?

title: Auto Drive
description: Top-down racing with armed cars. Upgrade performance, attach weapons and customize the visuals of your car. Build a huge parking lot and let your vehicle fleet grow.

title: BitSlaps
description: BitSlaps is a chaotic, interactive multiplayer game where streamers become gladiators and viewers pull the strings. Compete in outrageous challenges, survive sabotage, and rage your way through custom maps built for laughs, skill, and pure madness.

title: Fate's Ultimatum for Destiny
description: Control your djinn's destiny in this thrilling turn-based TCG, where a ticking ascendancy timer tests your strategy. As a warden, command dragons, wolves, goblins, and angels in fierce battles. Manage time wisely, or your djinn's fortitude will fade, sealing your fate.

title: Obscurite Magie 3: The Divine Stones
description: Cialis of the Royal Knights of Alzario is ambushed by an evil group of heretical fanatics that call themselves Regalus. Backed into a corner and on the verge of defeat, she has no choice but to form a pact with the spirit named Myuei to fend off the heretical fanatics.

title: Tourist in Trouble: Escape The PickPockets!
description:
Sub-minute runs, dodge pickpockets, race the sights!

I made a tiny time-attack game after seeing pickpocketing spike around tourist hotspots and wondered if that tension could work as a speedrun. Each run lasts seconds to a couple of minutes; the timer is your score. You sprint across crowded tourist maps to hit five random landmarks, dodge pickpockets that blend into the crowd, and invest coins in a small skill tree (including literally shouting at people to clear your path). Built for quick resets, routing, and shaving off seconds.

title: Scaredy Cat
description: A scaredy cat steps into the forest alone to find a rare flower for her friends — but some journeys are more than they seem.

title: Just Waiting Cats
description: What kind of game is this, you ask? Well... you just wait for cats. That's it. Really. Even if you don't do anything, having someone come to see you— now and then— can feel surprisingly warm on an otherwise dull day.

title: Pizza Blitz
description: Prepare and Cook Joe's classic pizzas while drinking on the job. Deliver them while evading an active warzone. Make your mark as the worlds last chef / delivery driver! Uphold the distinguished Hungry Joe's Pizzas reputation!

title: All The Stars
description: Welcome to All the Stars, a retro-inspired space shooter where thrilling combat meets a cosmic narrative. Face waves of enemies, alien horrors, and a galaxy-changing choice. It’s an amateur passion project but it just might surprise you, no load screens, no microtransactions, just pure arcade action.

title: Lands of Mine
description: Mine resources, craft tools, and battle fierce underground enemies as you explore, trade, and build your way back to the stars. Level up, upgrade your gear, and automate your processes for ultimate efficiency. Play solo or team up with a friend in this 1-2 player mining and combat adventure.

title: Snowscape
description: Snowscape is a roguelite adventure that combines top-down survival with snowmobile racing. Race down risky snowy mountains by day and survive the monstrous horrors lurking in the dark by night. Can you escape the twisted nightmare of this mysterious, frozen wilderness?

title: Fear to Face
description: It is a psychological horror game and walking simulator. Take care of a cat and a house. Monsters jumping towards at your screen.

title: Mine: Forever
description: Mine rocks, alchemize treasures, fill the mushroom codex, and rebirth! Infinite growth, endless fun—step into the world of limitless mining and become a legend!

title: Dine-In Dungeon
description: Things end up in an unexpected turn for Matcha the halfling as her search for a small part time job ends up with her taking up the role of not only the cook of a diner in the dungeon. But also it's hunter and waitress! Will she be able to push through?

title: The Amazing Digital Circus Visual Novel: Candy Chaos
description: A fangame Visual Novel that adapts the second episode of "The Amazing Digital Circus", "Candy Carrier Chaos!".

title: Micro Titans Wrestling
description: Micro Titans Wrestling is a nostalgia fuelled roguelike deck builder themed on the golden age of professional wrestling. Prepare to step into the ring with a roster of era defining characters and take it to the mat with a unique card battle system.

title: Fire & Light: Thrones of Tyberion
description: Fire & Light: Thrones of Tyberion is a fast-session rogue-survivor in which sitting on your throne allows you to reign over the battlefield.

title: Cloudspan
description: In this bite-sized city builder, your goal is to stack and stretch your town as far as physics will allow. Tiny Island. Big mess.

title: Cascadou
description: A satisfying solitaire roguelike where you find and create cascading, exploding poker hands. Stickers, special cards and badges turn your deck into a rule-breaking machine. Will your deck crumble, or cascade to victory?

title: Laugh Track
description: You're now the lead writer for Juno's World, a perfectly normal sitcom in which nothing strange or horrible happens, ever! Choose your scripts, decide what characters to build relationships with, and keep those audience ratings high -- or get cancelled in more ways than one! Welcome to Must See TV.

title: Donkey Jump: In the Loop
description: Jump, build, and survive! Guide a goofy donkey through endless loops with card-based paths and unpredictable challenges.

title: Nex-Ara
description: Nex-Ara is a tactical sci-fi strategy game where you command a fleet of ships in order to protect your home system from an alien threat. Forge interplanetary connections and select between 3 upgrades because it is a roguelike to defeat your enemies across a shifting galactic battlefield.

title: Path of the Heart
description: Alone and lost for falling asleep on the first day of school, the only option left for Tsuki Ito is to trust a peculiar-looking girl with a radiant presence. Follow this story of romance and suspense inspired by the classic tale of "Little Red Riding Hood."

title: Dream Strikers
description: Dream Strikers is a high-mobility 3D action fighting game set in a cyber-fantasy world. Choose to become a Hunter of conviction or fall into darkness as a Nightmare. Execute fast-paced combos, dodge skillfully, and finish with ultimate moves in a clash of belief and obsession.

title: Withdrawal
description: An FPS roguelike heist. Play as Mr. (?) Norton on his way to exterminate the whole headquarters of the Cranterry Wealth Corporation.

title: The Pagemaster
description: The Pagemaster is a video game published in 1994 on Windows 3.x by Turner Interactive. It's an adventure game, set in a licensed title, graphic adventure, puzzle elements and movies themes.

title: Warn
description: What if, all of a sudden, your routine was turned upside down?In WARN, Josh must choose between duty and heart, but no choice comes without consequences

title: Blighted Deep
description: Blighted Deep is a minimalistic, linear roguelite in a dark, mysterious setting. Encounter various strange figures and evil creatures on your quest to cleanse the deep. Equip shackles, items and heirlooms to make your character more powerful.

title: The Tavern at the End of the Road
description: A souls-like deckbuilder in first-person 3D where each run is a new life told by a mysterious innkeeper. Journey to the north, Errant, and travel the Road to become Legend. A replayable mystical experience with tactical combat in a world that remembers your choices.

title: Myth of Lumi
description: Myth of Lumi is a 3D physics-based turf war game where you duel rival magicians in card throwing showdowns. Recruit Lumis, mystical creatures bound within your playing cards, to aid you in battle and carve your path to fame and fortune.

title: Solitaire Zero 21
description: Card game fit for all the family! The aim of the game is to clear the playing area of all cards whilst keeping your deck score between 0 and 21. If you hit 0 or below, or hit 21 or above, it is game over.

title: Zomb'Invasion
description: Shoot,Kill,Buy,Adapt,Keep going and Win. Zomb'Invasion is an FPS multiplayer wave zombie shooter game where you need to defeat a countless number of zombies in chaotic conditions!

title: A Dog Story
description: A heartwarming and hauntingly mysterious short story exploring the spirit of a dog that lingers on Earth to deliver a final goodbye to its young master.

title: Buko Boko
description: Incremental Games inside an incremental game! In Buko Boko you'll collect tokens to spend on unlocking and upgrading new games, and completing their challenges.

title: Fish Collector: Aquarium Story
description: Run your own aquarium and evolve fish into mermaids! Fish Collector is a relaxing aquarium tycoon game that blends fish farming, idle resource production, match-3, and merge gameplay to build your fantasy ocean world.

title: The Gallery: A Riley Magras Exhibit
description: Step into a digital art gallery showcasing the works of Riley Magras. Explore immersive paintings, uncover hidden paintbrushes, and experience art like never before.

title: The Callers
description: Explore a medieval land as a Nim named Skybrighten and try to save your world from disaster. Find friends to help along the way, but try not to cause more trouble than you fix! Travel where you want, solve a few puzzles, and be nice to people!

title: Only Up: Brainrot Together
description: ONLY UP: BRAINROT TOGETHER is a chaotic multiplayer climbing adventure for up to 8 players. Navigate surreal levels, avoid traps, and survive encounters with bizarre brainrot creatures. Precision, timing, and teamwork are your only way up.

title: Bloom 'N' Buzz
description: Serve your hive in this relaxing tycoon-style game. Fill the role of a dedicated worker bee, pollinate flowers! Build up your hive! Produce honey.

title: Mazzy
description: Mazzy is a pixel-style casual puzzle game built around the core concept of rotating the level. Rotate the level, collect the items, and reshape the maze to reach the goal. Simple and fun.

title: Real-time Shogi
description: Welcome to a world of Shogi freed from the limits of turns. From an infinite number of possibilities, find the shortest path to victory. Your tactical reading and sharp judgment will dominate the board. This is a new challenge for even the most seasoned Shogi fans.

title: Uncommon App
description: Uncommon App is a narrative-driven simulation game where you play as an admissions officer balancing academic merit, magical ability, and finances. Review diverse student profiles, conduct interactive interviews, and make impactful decisions that shape the school's future.

title: Flying Courier
description: In Flying Courier, pilot an airship, deliver packages, and explore a charming Victorian world. Help others through generosity in this cozy simulation adventure.

title: Attack on Ghosts
description: Build magical towers, gather resources, and defend your base from waves of ghostly enemies in this fast-paced pixel art tower defense game!

title: Purple Maniac
description: A short horror visual novel where you hide in a bathroom stall with your baby while a murderer drags his latest victim into the same bathroom. Keep your baby quiet to avoid becoming his next victims.

title: The Last Prisoner
description: The Last Prisoner - Hardcore Sci-fi platformer. You are the last prisoner awakened from a corrective cryo-sleep, your task is to escape a space prison containing a rebellious AI and find out where everyone else is? The only way to escape is to manipulate gravity and adapt to the chaos around you.

title: Changgwi
description: First-perspective Co-op horror game (up to 4 online players). A terrible incident has struck a Joseon-era village. Become an investigator and survive the cursed night.

title: Pickscover 2
description: Build, Fight, Craft, and Transform your world while harnessing it's resources to become more powerful. Use a variety of weapons, from swords to magic spells, to fight off the darkness that plagues this world. Fight tons of bosses, both dark and light, to return balance to this land.

title: Bubble Tea Revolution
description: Run your own bubble tea shop! Take customer orders, purchase ingredients, prepare delicious drinks, serve your customers and become the ultimate Boba Master!

title: Last Wave
description: A survival action RPG with fast-paced combat and strategic decision-making. Fight waves of enemies using combos, elemental spells, and techniques. Master the command system to unleash devastating attacks and achieve high scores. Inspired by 5th-gen low-poly visuals with modern action RPG gameplay.

title: Finding Ivy
description: Finding Ivy is a cute casual 2D platformer where 1-4 players make their way through a kid-drawn world to win back their runaway cat. Run, jump, climb, and discover items and friends that help you along the way!

title: Backrooms: No Level
description: Backrooms: No Level is a cooperative horror game for 1-4 players. You think you can complete anything, but what if you can't? What if nothing is real and you can't complete anything, even with friends, it will be extremely difficult to complete this game!

title: Liar Luna
description: Play as Luna, a girl caught in a fight between armed insurgents and spies. Help her navigate her way to saving her friend. Explore a laboratory dedicated to the production of new materials. Enjoy a lighthearted and chaotic story of a girl out of her depth in an espionage mission.

title: Dungeon Maiden: Survivor
description: "Dungeon Maiden: Survivor" combines horde-shooting, roguelite builds, character growth & cosmetic swaps. Strategic choices empower your maiden through escalating upgrades, blending frenetic combat with deep meta-progression.

title: Raze Vol. 1
description: Raze Vol. 1 is a satirical punk rock VR puzzle-platformer. Team up with Raze, a punk guitarist zapped into an influencer-run nightmare. Use her power arm, dive into her mind, and spot hidden clues with her damaged eye. Voiced by Lzzy Hale. Story + Arcade modes. Raze is gonna blaze!

title: Planet Drop
description: Drop and merge planets to create your ultimate galaxy in this space-themed puzzle game. Compete in the leaderboard with unique abilities and planets, and play your way with normal, vanilla and chaos modes. But always make sure your planets don't go over the limit.

title: Bot Rush
description: Control a small combat bot in this fast-paced arcade shooter. Survive waves of enemies charging in straight lines, upgrade your abilities, and push your limits in an endless fight for survival.

title: Glitch & Glory: Tales of Honeywood
description: Glitch and Glory: Tales of Honeywood is a parody RPG where you, an adventurer, tackle absurd quests in a satirical MMORPG world. Save sheep, negotiate with ghosts, and avoid fines. Sarcastic dialogue, impactful choices, and retro graphics await!

title: Zombie Arise
description: Zombie Arise is a Zombie Retro FPS based on console classics from 1990.

title: Haze of Lucidity: The Fracture
description: A psychological horror from a first-person view. Explore a quiet night that slowly unravels into something you can’t explain. Find out what’s real… and what should’ve stayed hidden.

title: SummonArk
description: Conquer the SummonArk Maze with the power of your deck! Unravel your own strategy in a dungeon full of the unknown!

title: Cubes Go
description: Build, Eliminate, Evolve in 3D! Experience epic block-smashing thrills! Unlock powers like Nuclear Strikes, Infinite Lives & Score Multipliers via a deep Skill Tree. Strategically upgrade, build devastating combos, and shatter cubes!

title: Contingence
description: Detective story. A cat accidentally gets infected with a secret computer virus and gains superpowers. Agents try to catch the cat who is causing trouble in the city. 2D novella with text subtitles.

title: Antinarkomania
description: The insidious drug is spreading across the country and ruining the lives of millions of citizens. The task of Federal Drug Control Service employees - Inspector, Schoolgirl and Schoolboy - is to eliminate this system. On their way will stand many obstacles and bandits and only you can prevent them!

title: Zerun
description: A fast–paced ritual run across magical worlds. Walk the path of the shaman. Solve ancient puzzles, survive the trials, and gather what’s needed to heal your world. Earn every artifact, complete every rite, and bring your world back to life.

title: The Almagest Anomalies
description: The Almagest Anomalies is a short Anomaly Finding game inspired by the Japanese game Exit 8. Find an Anomaly, go back the way you came, to complete a loop. Don’t find an Anomaly, keep moving forward, to complete a loop. Complete ten loops and the exit will reveal itself.

title: 1 in a Million: A Game of Odds
description: Can you get the 1 in a million achievement on Steam?

title: 2 in 1 Experience Hidden Objects
description: Discover ancient artifacts, explore the mysterious temples of Egypt, roam through the dense, green jungle full of exotic animals and hidden treasures, and explore ancient Rome with its magnificent buildings.

title: Stahldrache
description: Stahldrache is a top-down shooter set in the skies of far-flung planets. The automated terraforming system has gone rogue, and must be stopped. Fight against time and waves of drones to make the planet safe! Bomb the control nodes and neutralize the AI before the defenseless colony ships arrive!

title: Waiting for Your Food Delivery Simulator 2025
description: Modern life's greatest horror: waiting for takeout. You've got 40 minutes to kill before your order arrives. Stare, pace, join a cult, block a toilet—whatever it takes. Miss the delivery and face eternal hunger. The survival horror game nobody asked for.

title: Dungero
description: Dive into the realm of offline roguelike action RPG. Game with easy gameplay, innovation, and addictive loot mechanics. Fight Monsters, Crawl Dungeons, Loot treasures, Have fun

title: Zombie Smash
description: Zombie Smash is a thrilling 2D top-down arcade-style game where players face endless waves of zombies. Packed with adrenaline-fueled action, power-ups, and fast-paced gameplay, this game challenges your reflexes as you survive and smash your way through hordes of the undead.

title: Eco-Sentinel: The Bottle Mission
description: Collect bottles, avoid the police, and earn money by recycling in a tough city. Sneak, run, and survive as you unlock new areas and chase a better life.

title: Lost My Collection of 600 Stars
description: Lost my Collection of 600 Stars is a casual 2D hidden object game with a cute, stylized and relaxing aesthetic.

title: Ascention Suvivor
description: AscensionSurvivor is a roguelike action game where you survive against approaching enemies using unique weapons and customizable ability sets. With roguelike elements, players also inflate, but enemies are strengthened just as much or even more. Do your best to survive!

title: Dice Saga
description: Dice Saga is a RPG/multiplayer party game where four players compete against each other. Build up your character and tear other players down in this colorful and chaotic digital board game!

title: Outwall
description: Outwall is a fantasy survival adventure where you play as a villager captured by an evil sorcerer and forced into a deadly game. Your only goal: escape.

title: Back to Modern World: Fantasy Hero
description: Yoha Taka only want one thing is to go back to his former world and stay besides his sensei again but that's only possible if he defeats the demonlord. So what will happen if a chuunibyou got sent to another world that only filled with fantasy.

title: Unpredictable Star
description: Unpredictable Star is a strategy adventure game. Players need to protect their base in the unpredictable star domain, manage the cafe inside the base, recruit new partners, explore and battle.

title: Quest & Rest: Inn Simulator
description: Run a cozy fantasy inn where adventurers rest, restock, and head off to glory. Assign quests, serve buff-granting ales, sell magical gear, and manage your guests—then watch their stories unfold from the comfort of your inn.

title: Strategic Stalemate
description: A 2D turn based strategy and management game with a dynamic soundtrack and emergent gameplay starting in the 1960's. Balance different mechanics as you progress through the Cold War without being voted out or starting World War III.

title: Snapshot Girls
description: Solve puzzles, uncover secrets, and marvel at every detail of stunning photorealistic masterpieces!

title: Egypt City Builder
description: Build, expand and shape a glorious ancient empire.

title: Contraband Patrol Simulator
description:
Step into the high-stakes world of border security in Contraband Patrol Simulator, where every decision you make could mean the difference between law and chaos. As a newly assigned border officer, your mission is to control the flow of goods and people across a tense border zone, uncover smuggling operations, and maintain the fragile peace of your homeland.

Inspect vehicles, interrogate drivers, and use advanced tools to detect hidden contraband. But the job doesn’t end there—chase down fleeing smugglers, fend off attacks from dangerous gangs, and upgrade your station to stay ahead of the escalating threats. Each day brings new challenges that test your vigilance, integrity, and survival skills. Will you uphold the law or be tempted by corruption?

title: Nun of Your Business
description: Nun of Your Business is an action game where players control anime-styled nuns battling against demonic forces. Featuring fast-paced combat, multiple playable characters, challenging boss fights, and dark themed environments, the game blends supernatural horror with stylized visuals and arcade-style action.

title: Hora
description: co-op (1–6 players). close the VENTS, manage resources, and explore dark, procedurally generated sectors filled with unique enemies and upgrades.

title: Motor Racing Battle
description: This is a thrilling and challenging motorcycle combat game. In this world, speed and power are the keys to victory. You can choose to surpass all opponents with excellent driving skills, or arm yourself and use various weapons to sweep the enemies on the road into the trash pile.

title: Battery Farm
description: A grave robbery gone wrong sends you tumbling down an absurd rabbit hole.

title: Father's Love
description: This is a casual puzzle game, where the position of each game image is random and can be repeated.At first, it may be very chaotic,Then gradually place the image in the corresponding position,The image gradually becomes complete,Come and give it a try!

title: Deserter: Prologue
description: Deserter: Prologue is a free stealth-RPG game. Use stealth, cunning, and thieving skills to escape from a military camp in the heart of a dystopian war.

title: Revolver Gambit
description: A tense multiplayer mind game of risk, instinct, and deception. Read your enemies, bluff with nerve, and survive the standoff. One table, one shot - Revolver Gambit pulls the trigger on minimalistic psychological warfare.

title: Typingvania
description: A typing trainer with a focus on variety and accuracy where you type words from real books tailored to your current skill. Speed comes with accuracy and the game will gently push you to be highly accurate.

title: Mush Dash
description: A cute, lighthearted asymmetric furry mini-game! Four players act as Furries collecting items to escape, while one plays a gooey tentacle monster using claws, grabs, and slime balls to trap them. Enjoy fun props, rescues, dances, photos, and silly battles—bringing laughter and cozy joy!

title: GONE: Game of Necromancy Education
description: A strategic game where you must kill all Goblins before you get overrun. Utilize everything at your disposal and harness the power of the undead to cleanse this world from the Goblins.

title: Stocks
description: A collector simulator and clicker where you earn rare items just by staying in the game. Collect stylized company “stocks,” track their value, join seasonal updates, and profit!

title: Narrow One
description: Join fast-paced archery battles where you and your teammates fight to capture the enemy flag medieval style. Master your bow, and outplay the enemy in tactical 5v5 matches

title: Ashen Destiny
description: Conquer randomized lands in a brutal turn-based strategy epic. Recruit generals with random stats and command massive armies in battle. Forge your legacy through tactical warfare, resource control, and ruthless ambition.

title: The Most Epicest Snowball Fight Ever!
description: The snowball fight of your dreams! Take up arms against imaginary snow monsters in this charming turn-based tactics game where a child's imagination is their greatest weapon. Can you defeat the forces of the evil Baron von Slushie?

title: Exam
description: This is a game that simulates student exams. By skillfully using cards, you can increase the scores and accuracy of questions, pass exams with gradually increasing difficulty, maintain sufficient vitality, and ultimately graduate successfully.

title: Dirty Piggy
description: A cozy idle game about cute pigs, care and little discoveries. Feed, wash, decorate, collect coins and strange finds. They say grandpa hid something... Are you and the pigs really going to solve a family secret?

title: Harvest Loop
description: "Harvest Cycle" is a Rougelike game that mainly features farming simulation and management. In the game, you need to use special crops with various abilities to adapt to the changing seasons and fight against the greedy "locust army" to protect the normal operation of the farm.

title: Lappy Games
description: LAPPY GAMES is a lively party action game where you compete to collect hearts with Lappy and friends. Up to four players can join in at once, with support for online multiplayer. Make use of all kinds of stage events to your advantage—the player who gathers the most hearts wins!

title: Spacebar X
description: A follow up to Spacebar! This time, you will need both the spacebar and X key to survive this minimalist arcade platformer! Jump, flip, fly, and warp your way through the endless levels!

title: Spot the Difference 3D
description: A calming experience of doing 3D spot the difference. Going between rooms identifying extra items and getting rid of them as you find them.

title: Cronos: The New Dawn - Deluxe Edition
description:
Deluxe Edition Contains:
• Base Game
• 48h Early Access
• 1x Core Resource
• 8x Pistol Ammo
• 3x Shotgun Ammo
• 2x Small Health Pack
• 1500 Energy
• Unique Armor Skins (limited to Pre-Order and Deluxe edition)
• Digital Artbook and Soundtrack

title: Antivirus
description: Defend the CPU of your computer from the waves of virus invasions in this pixel-art tower defense game!

title: Air Dash: Sky Racing Simulator
description: Race across the skies in Air Dash: Sky Racing Simulator! Experience high-speed split-screen races, diverse maps, and customizable planes. Easy to play, hard to master—become the ultimate sky racer!

title: 99 Action Arcade
description: 99 Action Arcade is a CD-ROM collection of arcade type games.

title: Ultimate Riders
description: Mini-car racing in the retro style. Night city, country, hipermarket and other open route, you can drive where you want.

title: Dosmic
description: In a world consumed by darkness, a boy embarks on a perilous journey to rescue a lost girl. Navigate through cosmic horrors and unravel ancient mysteries in this cinematic puzzle-adventure. Experience a hauntingly beautiful tale of despair and hope.​

title: Metal Gear Solid Delta: Snake Eater - Tactical Edition
description: The same gripping story and engrossing world, but now with cutting-edge graphics and 3D audio, which bring the jungle to life. Get ready for the ultimate survival, stealth and action experience.

title: Summit Drive
description: A difficult game about driving up a mountain.

title: Shattered Mythos
description: Sally forth into the shattered remains of the world with a party of heroes at your command in real time combat. Explore the world, gain loot and levels by defeating the mythology inspired monsters to challenge the bosses and break through to the Lich's realm.

title: Stones of Power
description: Stones of Power is a roguelite deckbuilder with autobattler elements that is in early development. The game has a calm vibe set on the beach with challenging gameplay.

title: Free as Birds: Uazo
description: Soar as a curious bird on a mysterious island filled with secrets, ancient ruins, and hidden wonders. Explore with your friends, gather resources, build, survive and uncover the island’s story in this serene adventure.

title: Ocean's Venus
description: A point and click horror game aboard a ship with inscrutable history. Your job as a maintenance worker aboard is to make sure everything runs as it should, or so you've been told...

title: Fartal Error
description: Fartal Error is a third-person survival horror set in an abandoned Mexican asylum, where a single fart can literally get you killed. Explore a nightmarish labyrinth, take down deranged cannibal cultists, keep your guts in check... and try to escape. If you can.

title: Break Through the Door
description: Keywords: mechanism, cracking, challenge, battle pet, battle. A wise, patient player grows powerful in Trial Grounds, bonds with an ancient battle pet, and cracks every mechanism en route. Despite repeated challenge failures, he safeguards the crystal and ascends the summit.

title: Good
description: Experience a day in the life of an American teenager: Do you think you have free will? Play sports. Listen to philosophical discussions about food, parties, relationships and the future. Avoid learning anything.

title: Whisper Village
description: A story full of extreme tension and fear that a man who came just to shoot a documentary went through. Let's see if you can see the end of the story

title: Monster War
description: Monster War is an action RPG where players battle hordes of creatures while crafting equipment and brewing potions in an open-ended progression system. Players continuously strengthen their character through combat, crafting, and alchemy in a world that allows unlimited power advancement.

title: A Porter Story
description: Step into the worn boots of a Porter and remove the trash inside a towering post-apocalyptic apartment complex. Shoot the breeze with tenants while steering clear of otherworldly phantoms. All in a day's work.

title: Berserker Girl
description: Berserker Girl is a 2.5D side-scrolling action game with tight platforming, intense boss battles, and a rich narrative told in a visual novel style.

title: Train Maze Master
description: Navigate steam trains through mazes of train track! Challenge your brain to solve intricate maze puzzles. Train Maze Master is your ticket to vintage steam locomotives galore and train track maze heaven!

title: Not a Dream Job
description: Have you ever found yourself in a situation where you have no other choice and have to act according to circumstances, trying to survive? When your words and actions literally depend on your life? This game is about that. Read below for more information about the game.

title: Trash Sorter Simulator
description: Sort trash, earn money, purchase upgrades, and perhaps find a way out of this oddly addictive job. You will master the facility's color-coded bin system, receive cryptic emails, and discover hidden collectibles. Can you escape?

title: The Atlas Problem
description: Defend Atlas Station from waves of asteroid bombardment. Build towers, shoot and survive in first-person, collect resources from destroyed debris, then upgrade your defenses and the station itself. Die and try again with permanent upgrades in this roguelike tower defense game.

title: 3 Seconds Remaining
description: 3 SECONDS REMAINING is a simple top-down shooter made by tiny.ROM,

title: Solaris: Arcade Edition
description: You take control from a spaceship called DV-01 to towards on stages until reach the "Special Stage" that is endless! Shoot on enemies to earn more points this is the focus. Enjoy! This is the Arcade Version from "Solaris The Second Law" my another project.

title: Building Jumper
description: You're trying to climb to the top of a very strange building somewhere. What is at the top of the building? Feel the thrill of climbing a building!

title: Card World
description: Card World is a card game entirely under your control. You can adventure in this card world, create new cards, new themes, new BGM, new backgrounds, and even make a completely new game.

title: War of Banners
description: War of Banners is a sandbox turn-based tactical RPG set in a medieval open world. Recruit companions, lead your army, and claim victory across brutal battlefields. From a wandering mercenary band to an empire-ruling sovereign — your fate is shaped by strategy and choice.

title: Cursed House 15
description: Cursed House 15 is a new game in the series. It's new not only by number, but also in terms of gameplay mechanics. Some of these updates aren't directly visible to players but allow for more engaging Match-3 puzzle levels. However, there are also updates that players will see and appreciate.

title: Just Dig
description: "JustDig" is an incremental mining game. Dig ore through clicks and idle play, and thoroughly upgrade your drill. Combine modules to create your very own ultimate drill. When you complete your own unique build that creates perfect synergy, the ultimate satisfaction awaits you.

title: Louis
description: The Mouth is trying to take over Louis's place. Hold to rise and release to dive. Dodge obstacles, travelling from fruit to fruit, collecting seeds, buying clothes and battling almighty monsters to reclaim your home with style!

title: Boss Up
description: Boss Up is a love letter to videogame bosses, from infuriating RPG final bosses, to kart racing rivals, and even dating sim ex-wives. Fight your way through 18 bullet hell bosses with your powerful dodge roll, and try not to break your keyboard in half in this tough as nails action platformer!

title: Orbital Siege
description: A solo indie-developed pixelated 2D arcade space shoot-'em-up that captures the nostalgia and high-octane fun of beloved 80s and 90s arcade experiences.

title: Fire State
description: Experience hyper-realistic visuals and fluid controls from an unprecedented Bodycam perspective. The world's first shooter with truly playable 3DGS environments. Every pulse-pounding firefight and precise tactical move is captured by your chest-mounted camera for unmatched battlefield immersion.

title: Wonderstries
description: Harvest natural resources and build machines to rebuild society following a terrible war that left the world scarred.

title: Armed Animals RPG
description: Armed Animals RPG is a top down action RPG with an emphasis on highly reactive sandbox style tactical combat and complex health simulation systems. Make friends and enemies in a world of colorful animal characters!

title: Stair Tap
description: Tap your way through never-ending staircases, racing to the top before your time runs out!

title: Boll's Journey
description: Zoom through the landscape as Boll, a mysterious glowing sphere, uncovering a forgotten past and the truth behind the world they've landed in. Gather all sorts of collectibles, evading Shapes and Nature alike. Uncover the mysteries...

title: Curse of Woney
description: A Turn-Based RPG + Roguelike following a Familiar trying to free himself from a witch. Optimize your build, and sling spells until you're free.

title: Animal Smash
description: Animal Smash is a lighthearted game where you fling adorable animals at your own pace. Enjoy colorful farm-themed levels, master your aim, and have fun with charming critters in a playful, easygoing experience!

title: Ruins of The Titan
description: A 2D Rougelike action game with pixel art style. You are a summoned "hero", in exhilarating combat, smooth action and dazzling combo, defeat and execute enemies. Build from 100+ skills! Blending adventure, action, and strategic builds, the journey offers endless possibilities in every fight.

title: Fly a Kite
description: This is a casual puzzle game, where the position of each game image is random and can be repeated.At first, it may be very chaotic,Then gradually place the image in the corresponding position,The image gradually becomes complete,Come and give it a try!

title: Prison Out
description: Prison Out is a game that uses 3D action and a physics engine to help you escape from a prison. It's up to you to use the powers you gain from the demon to escape from prison and defeat it in order to be restored to your original form, or to just run away.

title: Crap Game, Don’t Play
description: This is a true piece of junk. Every second you spend opening this game is a waste of your precious time. Your time is valuable—open your eyes and stay away from trash games.

title: Lord of Ogre
description: Lord of Ogre is a turn-based strategy game with action combat, where players manage their own attacks and defenses. It also features RPG, board game, and strategy elements for a unique victory quest.

title: Between Adventures Idle
description: An Idle RPG Strategy game where you gather resources in a magical world, battle powerful creatures, and upgrade your gear. Explore new locations through main and side quests; your progress continues even in the background. A simple and enjoyable idle experience awaits you.

title: As We Unite
description: As We Unite is a political strategy simulation game where you play as a high-ranking Consul of a secretive cult aiming to unite the world before an impending global calamity. Instead of controlling a country, you manage agents across different nations, each run has a crisis you have to resolve!

title: Midnight Souls
description: Explore the mysteries of the small town of Camomile Peaks! Date the girl of your dreams, fight your enemies, and make socially acceptable friends in this dark humor-flavored RPG. And keep your cat, Charlie, out of trouble!

title: Paranormal Roulette
description: Descend into a haunted hotel casino where fate is twisted by a magical 8-ball. Shake it, interpret the signs, and place your bets as paranormal events guide your moves. Stack your chips, spin the roulette, and try to outwit the house in a game where intuition meets illusion.

title: Outbreak Zero
description: Outbreak Zero is a third person survival horror game that blends modernized gameplay, a gripping storyline, and AAA quality visuals to deliver a heart pounding, immersive experience. powered by Unreal Engine 5, The brave protagonist, Max, sets out to uncover the truth behind the mysterious story.

title: Roguebound Pirates
description: Loot, upgrade & dominate! In this action roguelike, your inventory IS your ship. Combine weapons to become absurdly powerful, search for epic treasures, and claim your place as a pirate legend!

title: Peggy's Post
description: As the new owner of a lighthouse-based post office, it's your role to sort mail, assign postage, and load parcels onto the correct delivery vehicle for shipping. Manage your earnings to upgrade your tools, purchase stamp packs, charter new ships, and above all else, pay off your loan in time -- or the lender *will* foreclose on your lighthouse.

title: Tiny Shop
description: Leave the hustle and bustle behind and bring your dream of a cozy little shop to life! Create, decorate, and watch visitors fall in love. Let your imagination run wild and craft a beautiful, inviting space they'll want to return to again and again.

title: Versalis
description: A fast-paced, grid-based, card-flipping tactical CCG for up to 4 players! Archetypes and team Dynamics bring powerful abilities to move, defend, swap, or reorient cards. Capture the board and flip your way to victory!

title: Dungeon Pizza
description: A cooking game with a fantasy twist! Knead the dough, spread the sauce, and prepare… the rat chunks?! Open your own pizzeria deep inside a dungeon, serving weary adventurers who come to rest and refuel between their quests and bounties.

title: Jumpbound
description: Jump and dash your way to the top in this challenging first-person platformer. Embark on an adventure through a mysterious world, unlock more mechanics as you progress, and make every jump count while enjoying the view and relaxing atmosphere.

title: IterativeCollapse
description: ITERATIVECOLLAPSE is a narrative-driven, surreal psychological game about emotional loops, intrusive thoughts, and the painful persistence of existing inside your own mind.

title: Casino Casualty
description:
Welcome to the Crimson Casino.

You are the owner and manager of the Crimson Casino, a place once popular for its advanced robotic entertainment and high-tech games; now, feared for it, following an incident in which patrons were brutally attacked by the robotic workers. This incident has forever tainted the Crimson Casino's name, and its doors are set to close for good at the end of the day. After seeing the last of your patrons out, you lock the doors, only to be struck in the back of the head.

You wake up around an hour later, surrounded by your robotic employees. You've been locked in, and you're being forced to earn your way out using the games that you rigged.

title: Burger Bots Inc.
description: An online co-op burger flipping game with scary and strange customers that you shouldn't anger. Play either solo or up to group of 8!

title: FNF: Spooky Mix
description:
IT'S SPOOKY MONTH!
Play as the spookiest kids around town, Skid and Pump, in spoOoOoOoOky remixes of ALL 26 songs from base game! Every level has been given a spooky fresh coat of paint in the spirit of Halloween.

title: Memoirium
description: Traverse a chaotic and crumbling realm of dreams composed of liminal spaces. Adapt to the world’s odd rules as a Dreamer, and defy others like you to escape the strange and eclectic subconscious landscape.

title: Idle Acorns
description: Inspired by the clicker games of the old internet, Idle Acorns brings a narrative to the mobile clicker arena but without getting weighed down by Advertisements, In-App Purchases or Data Mining. Explore the Forest and Ocean with Benny the Squirrel and enjoy everything from Fishing, to gardening. Featuring 4 Mini-Games, Game Center support, and more.

title: After Burner II
description: A PC Engine port of arcade game After Burner II.

title: Calamity: Wrath of the Gods
description: Calamity: Wrath of the Gods is an unofficial addon for the Calamity Mod that adds three interesting new bosses and a story-based character.

title: The Hordes of the Dead
description:
A quiet routine patrol in the middle of the night, becomes your worst living nightmare! Unknown sounds from the darkness start coming for you.

This is Survival Shooter, Horror game.

In the middle of the night, you are awakened by a strange sound. Something is coming...

You will have to face fast zombies that are deadly and agile, as well as slower, stronger zombies that can grab you, and tear your flesh.

title: Fungal Colony Sim 2
description: You awaken deep beneath the soil to the Sporemothers call. Gather Mushrooms and grow The Mycelial Network in this incremental adventure

title: Cube Cube 2
description: "Cube Cube 2" is an immersive 3D Rubik's Cube simulator featuring various popular cube types like the classic 3x3, Pyraminx, Mirror Cube, and Megaminx. Whether you're a beginner or an expert, enjoy fun and challenges tailored to all skill levels.

title: No Forgiveness
description: In this psychological horror, you are a guilt-ridden, drunken father who wakes in his dark room, alone. As you search for your missing family, reality twists, and madness takes hold. Something is watching, guiding you—will you uncover the truth, or become its victim?

title: Space Mantlet
description: Bite size colossal battle! Build an army in minutes as infantry upgrade with orbital drops into war machines! Then combine those machines to form the giant Mantlet mech! All while bullet hell rages! In a transhuman future, command Mantlet One to secure New Terra!

title: Jellyfish Blind Box
description: 【Jellyfish blind box】 is a light-hearted placement game where you can buy jellyfish blind boxes to raise your tiny jellyfish, sell them for a profit as they grow up over time, or leave them in the tank for admission.

title: HardDriverz
description: Burn rubber across futuristic cityscapes on twisting gravity defying tracks with customizable karts in this competitive arcade racer!

title: Ivan
description: Trapped in the middle of Siberia in an isolated laboratory, can you escape from the russian scientist Ivan before it's too late? Collect the keycards and escape before you meet your demise!

title: Deliver This!
description: DELIVER THIS! is a FAST-PACED-ACTION SHOOTER dropping you into a cyberpunk fusion of firepower and parkour-driven package delivery carnage! Dash, wall-run, and obliterate rogue drones to achieve perfect delivery efficiency or run it again. The city demands speed, DELIVER OR DIE!

title: Youmu's Cube Adventure
description: Youmu Konpaku has been turned into a cube! Help her escape by navigating her through 100 levels in this challenging physics-precision game inspired by the Ball Revamped flash game series! Also includes a lower-difficulty option for a less strict experience.

title: Marktopia
description: Run your own supermarket and keep your customers satisfied! Restock shelves, set product prices, and serve a growing crowd. Watch their reactions in real time — happy faces when pleased, angry ones when not. Can you meet demand and run a successful store?

title: Shotgun Science
description: Play as a test subject for a shotgun focused research company, while the tests keep coming the AI that overviews the testing seems to be getting aggressive.

title: Burned One
description: Visual novel «Burned One» - story that tells about a post-apocalyptic world in post-soviet decorations, and about its people. In the center of the story a stalker Voyla, who trying to find his wife, disappeared during the Cataclysm...

title: Matchuie
description: Matchuie is a fun and flexible match-three game with hundreds of levels and unique themes to explore. Play at your own pace, then get creative by turning any image into your own match-three masterpiece. Share your designs and discover what others have made!

title: 101 Cats in Chennai
description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 kittens in the hand-crafted Chennai landscape. Earn lots of achievements. How many can you find? Be quick!

title: Bodyguard: Cellwars
description: Take control of the body’s defense system in this fast-paced action shooter. Step into the role of a powerful immune cell and use precise touch controls to target and eliminate waves of invading bacteria and viruses.

title: Purrrification
description: An innocent-looking platformer. Jump, collect, progress. But something feels off. Levels shift, sounds distort, the screen... reacts. This is more than just a game. How far are you willing to go?

title: Survive the Grid
description: Dodge deadly traps on a dynamic grid. Use power-ups to restore tiles, clone yourself, and survive the escalating chaos. Easy to learn, hard to master. Each run lasts under 5 minutes for quick, pure, high-intensity action

title: Goblin Adventure: Free From Lore
description: A short and absurd goblin RPG about portals, mushrooms, and post-ironic freedom. Challenge a mage obsessed with order, or just dance in the mud. It's your lore now.

title: Topzerah
description: A funny 2D bossfight game. While running, jumping and shooting, defeat 10 unique bosses, progress in the game and make your very own bossfights using the in-game boss creator!

title: Click Me Harder
description:
Click Me Harder is the ultimate anime girl clicker experience you didn’t know you needed — and probably shouldn’t admit to playing. Start with one lonely anime girl and a dream: to click her. Hard. For money.

Every click earns cash. Upgrade your clicks, automate your earnings with idle anime assistants, and snowball your empire into a full-blown waifu industrial complex.

title: Clean Freak! Perfect Cook!
description: A Germaphobe's Life-or-Death Cooking. The sheer terror... of touching raw ingredients. The kitchen— the most dangerous room in the house. And now, you're trapped in it. Forced to cook. Against your will.

title: Chicklet
description: Cute chick falls from the real world into a pixelated, multi-dimensional machine. Pull levers, solve unique puzzles, and guide it to freedom. Challenge your mind as you navigate the pages and help the chick escape!

title: Citadel Siege 2
description: Citadel Siege 2 is a tactical tower defense game where strategy, timing, and adaptation are the keys to survival.

title: OctoCraps
description: OctoCraps — the craps you never asked for! Roll eight-sided dice, place your bets, and try your luck in this fast, unpredictable twist on a casino classic.

title: Childhood's End
description: Childhood's End is a fan-made kriselle (the ship between the characters Kris and Noelle) visual novel based on Deltarune covering stories following the ending of that game's weird route as of Chapter 4. It was originally released in Korean, but has since received an English translation.

title: Fairytale Thief: Snow White
description: Stealing hearts and magic mirrors. Snow White reimagined as a vampire,

title: Cause to Exist
description: Cause to Exist is a Narrative First-person Combat Platformer set in the mindscape of Yuno. Traverse and fight your way through Yuno’s anxieties, fears, and insecurities in this corrupted and organic environment as you uncover her heartbreaking story.

title: Ardor 2
description: Ardor is a fast and lethal turn-based tactical card game. Play cards to dodge danger and kill enemies. Combat is simple but deep, with a high skill ceiling. Win fights to upgrade your deck and take on stronger foes.

title: Crimson Tower
description: A dark fantasy occult-themed puzzle game set in a rich and expansive universe. Featuring open-world exploration and intuition-based puzzles blended into the narrative and world itself. It is centered around a dark narrative of tragedy, love, and redemption.

title: Ichorless
description: Battle mighty gods, earn game-changing Blessings, and shape the fate of Greece through your choices in ICHORLESS — the RPG that lets you forge your own path and play your way!

title: Blackwood: Beneath the Silence
description: Search for a missing student in the long-abandoned Blackwood school. A narrative, exploration-driven psychological horror with environmental puzzles and choices that lead to multiple endings.

title: The Death of the Video Star
description: A visual novel about dealing with the aftermath of killing God, and maybe having to kill Her again.

title: Darn Guy Adventures
description: Darn Guy Adventures (AKA DGA) is a ~ 4 hour RPG adventure based around attempting to find news about a certain videogame

title: Guardian Realms TCG
description: Guardian Realms TCG is a cross-platform, fantasy-themed trading card game set in a realm of shifting alliances, rebellion, and magic. Players command powerful Guardians, along with Equipment, Effect, and Field Cards, to battle across three strategic lanes with the goal of destroying their opponent’s Stronghold. By defeating Outposts, players can disable lanes and control the flow of battle, adding layers of tactical depth.

title: Guardian Realms RPG
description:
Guardian Realms RPG is a story-driven fantasy role-playing game set in a war-torn world divided by rebellion, ancient magic, and shifting alliances. Players step into the role of Artha, a young Imperial captain caught in the collapse of the powerful Rythguard Empire, as the Carrowlands Rebellion rises to challenge its dominance.

The game blends classic turn-based combat with exploration, crafting, and side activities like farming, fishing, and cooking. Players can recruit a diverse cast of companions, each with their own quests and storylines, while customizing their party to face powerful enemies and uncover the truth behind the conflict.

title: FNF: From the Top!
description:
5 ORIGINAL SONGS.
Babybatter, I'm Scary Guye, BeRzErKeR, Soundcheck and the newest song in v5.0: HEIGHTS & FRIGHTS, an original song featuring a beautiful christmas tune with Girlfriend and THE (definitely real) Santa Claus!

Still hungry for more? Good news, there's plenty where that came from.

16 REMIXES.
Full remixes of Tutorial, Week 1, 2, 3, 4 and Week 5, with spicy new events and backdrops that revitalize original concepts and scrapped ideas!

Hopefully they invoke the same feeling of hype you got the first time you played them!

FULL LIP-SYNCING AND UNIQUE RATING-BASED POSES.
All playable characters have 36(!!) total animations that change depending on the note sung in the song, and your rating! Even the ones you don't play as still have a pretty impressive 12 different note sprites. (And don't worry nerds, the animations use animation atlases. ;3)

It'll either stroke your ego or spit in your face depending on your skill level.

title: Links
description: Challenge your Brain with this fun and smart puzzle game

title: Tentacle Wars
description: A 2D vertical-scrolling sci-fi shooter that combines classic arcade combat with adult-themed story progression, where enemy Valkyries are gradually converted into your exclusive co-pilots through resonance.

title: Black Shadow
description: Black Shadow is a first-person survival horror game built with UE5. Players take on the role of investigator Eric Stone, who ventures into a dark-matter zone. You must explore warped timelines, sneak through the shadows, and evade unknown threats while gradually uncovering hidden secrets.

title: Calamity Black Dragon and the Princess of Lies
description:
This is the tale of a human princess who teaches a powerful and cold-hearted black dragon the meaning of "love".

In this world of swords and magic, the God of Creation had left behind a prophecy:
"This year, the dragon of darkness will capture the princess of the kingdom and perform a blood sacrifice in three years."

As the king's illegitimate daughter, you were chosen as the scapegoat, forced into the role of princess in this time of crisis.

For three years, the evil dragon and the human criminal live together. Will the princess be able to warm the dragon's heart and bring a ray of hope for herself?

Friendship, affection, important people. Danger, conflict, dragons and humans.

The optimistic, strong-willed, and lively Princess Sacrifice;
With the lonely, cold and powerful Dragon of Calamity—destined to exist in solitude.
Between the cheerful and radiant older sister x the lonely and paralysed black dragon, an absurd yet extraordinary life unfolds! This winter shall no longer be cold!

title: Small Void
description:
SMALL VOID is a cooperative two-player “call and response” game exploring the limits of language, attachment theory and cosmic annihilation.

Developed through the Collide residency program between Arts at CERN and Copenhagen Contemporary, the game’s mechanics are inspired by the paradoxes of black holes and quantum entanglement, and conceived in dialog with theoretical physicists at CERN.

title: Systemic War
description:
SYSTEMIC WAR is a next-generation strategy game that fuses grand geopolitical decision-making with real-time tactical combat.

Command entire nations: manage economies, build alliances, and secure logistics across a living global map. Then step onto the battlefield—deploy drones, leverage electronic warfare, and lead authentic units in real-world locations.

Every decision reshapes the course of history.

Plan like a strategist. Fight like a commander.

title: Swords of Blood
description: Unleash Your Fury in a High-Speed Hack-and-Slash RPG! Enter Swords of Blood, a fast-paced free-to-play hack-and-slash RPG featuring razor-sharp controls, explosive combat, multiple game modes, a rich narrative, and stunning visuals.

title: Down with the Ship
description: Strategic auto battler where you design a heavily-armed spaceship. Draft 200+ items, outfit your hull, and unleash it in async PvP. Blend captains and factions for absurd combos and galactic domination. Roll, buy, place, pray.

title: Suki Suki Love
description: Welcome! I'm Artemesia, your charming host in this reality show set in an academy that hides more than meets the eye. Every decision could lead you to redemption... or damnation. Do you dare to unravel its mysteries and face your own?

title: Tales of Fablecraft: Brawler Collection
description:
The Brawler Collection for Tales of Fablecraft.

Fulfill your party's murderous desires with the Brawler Collection!

Face off with a Kelp Monster at the docks, slay a Glimmerfang in the serpent's throne room, or tackle some highland horrors in a series of underground caves. From small menaces to gargantuan BBEGs, this fresh crop of monsters and maps is sure to put your party's combat skills to the test.

The Brawler Collection Includes: 6 Battlemaps, 14 Foes

title: Tales of Fablecraft: Storyteller Collection
description:
The Storyteller Collection for Tales of Fablecraft.

Fulfill your party's murderous desires with the Brawler Collection!

Face off with a Kelp Monster at the docks, slay a Glimmerfang in the serpent's throne room, or tackle some highland horrors in a series of underground caves. From small menaces to gargantuan BBEGs, this fresh crop of monsters and maps is sure to put your party's combat skills to the test.

The Brawler Collection Includes: 6 Battlemaps, 14 Foes

title: Don't Let Me Rot
description: This is a psychological horror game where you will solve puzzles and explore a 90s-style house. The realistic art style enhances the eerie atmosphere of the game. (Please do not play this game before bedtime.)

title: Galacard: Ackian Archives
description: A collection of retro-style card games featuring friendly aliens! Galacard: Ackian Archives features enhanced ports of three installments in the strategy-based Galacard card game series: Galacard, Galacard Platinum and Galacard Advance.

title: Plague Doctor and Panacea
description: “Plague Doctor and Panacea” is a thrilling game where you are the last ray of hope for a doomed city plagued by a mysterious epidemic. Your mission is to infiltrate the gloomy castle dungeon full of dangers and find the ingredients for a universal cure.

title: Cardfight!! Vanguard: Dear Days 2 - Complete Playset 05 "D-BT⑤"
description:
A set of four copies each of C,R,RR and RRR rarities. The acquired cards will be added to your collection.
Note: Any cards exceeding the possession limit will be converted to CP.

・D-BT01 ""Genesis of the Five Greats""
・D-BT02 ""A Brush with the Legends""
・D-BT03 ""Advance of Intertwined Stars""
・D-BT04 ""Awakening of Chakrabarthi""
・D-BT05 ""Triumphant Return of the Brave,Heroes""

title: These Are Them
description: Protect the hearts known as 'these' from the approaching corruption of monsters known as 'them' with the last remaining survivors in this twisted dark fantasy realm.

title: Avitium
description: Play as a knight unraveling his relationships with kingdom, king, and country in this card battler RPG. Make your convictions known through tricktaking gameplay and defend them in turn-based combat.

title: MazeCraft
description: Turn based pixel art roguelike RPG for hardcore players. Procedural generation of mazes and caves. A large number of characteristics of the game world. Monsters hunt the player and fight each other. Strong boss and his minions. Each new game is unique and randomized as much as possible.

title: Winged Warrior
description: In this role-playing game, it is your duty as a warrior to restore peace to the kingdom. You do this by gathering information from the people you meet, training to become a powerful warrior, and fighting enemies along the way.

title: Trench Face
description: Trench Face is a horror turn based war RPG featuring exploration-based dungeons, with hanging monsters lurking around each corner. Every enemy varying in strengths and weaknesses. Escape the trench with your life.

title: The Locked Room
description: The Locked Room - is a psychological horror with detective elements, where you'll navigate an bizarre motel. The linear storyline, investigation mechanics, and survival elements immerse you in an atmosphere where every action brings you closer to the truth.

title: Atomanta
description: In Atomanta, you step into the role of Taria Takara, a space pirate on a mission to recover a highly valuable artifact hidden on the planet Azavuraz. Armed with the powerful Atomic Manta warship, Taria finally has a chance to claim the bounty and pay off the debts from her previous handlers.

title: [K]night City
description: Parry your way through Old York with Sir William!

title: Metro Mini Market Simulator
description: Manage and grow your mini market in the metro station in Metro Mini Market Simulator! Expand your product variety and multiply your revenues with strategic decisions. Become a successful entrepreneur in this fun simulation world!

title: Paint the Snow: Idle
description: An idle resource management game set in a snowy cartoon world. Shift resources between mining and monster battles, unlock powerful upgrades, automate production, and enjoy endless progression across a screen full of action and snow.

title: Lovecraft's Cat
description: Edgy dark comedy where you play as H.P. Lovecraft’s cat—yes, the one with a slur for a name. Look up his name. Lovecraft didn’t have the pass when he named you, so you’re out for blood. Fight ALL his famous eldritch monsters and stack dope loot to VANQUISH the legendary racist himself.

title: Snekteks
description: Snekteks is a fully physics-based snake game. Experience different environments with other players with unexpected new twists and turns. Relax, explore or join quick action-packed matches - the choice is yours.

title: Gigabot Run
description: Gigabot Run is a fast-paced non-stop action game that will challenge your skills

title: Fastro Dude
description: You are a space traveler. Your spaceship crashes on a hostile planet and you have to embark on a difficult journey to survive.

title: Dreamcatcher 2003
description: A unique psychological horror game featuring strange characters, many different types of gameplay, lots of monsters, and a full narrative (No chapters) that is sure to be the greatest game you have ever played ever

title: Winged Warrior II: The Alien Empire
description: Continue your journeys as the Winged Warrior. In this adventure, you travel to a new land to aid your alien neighbors who have fallen into the hands of an evil emperor. Explore this new world by seeking help from those willing to assist you and defeating others whose purpose is to stop you.

title: Drift Cart
description: "Drift Cart" is a drift cart racing game that supports both multiplayer and single-player modes. Featuring 15 maps, the game requires players to reach the finish line without crossing boundaries or colliding to clear a level.

title: Astra Moment: Dimension
description: Astra Moment:DIMENSION is a keyboard-type rhythm game with four lanes. Experience the new play experience of SF rhythm games with original music by students from Jeonghwa University of the Arts, a dimension note system with vibes processed in the air, and operators to help you play.

title: Calyssa
description: Follow Calyssa on her quest to find the entrance to ancient ruins!

title: Ultrasound
description: A sci-fi horror 3D point&click game. Use an ultrasound machine to diagnose and do surgery on a grotesque infection spreading aboard a space freighter. Craft meds, upgrade your machine, find new surgical tools, and restore ship systems before you collide with a star. Soon, something will be born.

title: NoSlack Pets: Lo-Fi Paws
description: No Slack Pets is a desktop idle game where your cute cat companion joins your daily work, study, and chill time. Enjoy collecting over 300+ adorable headgears, customizing your DIY room, and focusing better with Lo-Fi white noise and a built-in Pomodoro timer—fun, chill, and full of surprises!

title: Super Pinball Adventure
description: A colorful casual pinball game for all ages and skill levels. Delight in knocking out enemies, collecting coins and solving the puzzle of each level! A fun and quirky reimagining of a beloved arcade classic with all the dopamine-hits of those games from your childhood.

title: One Button Defense
description: A fast-paced one-button defense game with endless difficulty, explosive effects, and built-in mod support. Rotate your weapon, survive the chaos, and create your own mods with JavaScript - all inside the game.

title: Battle Royale Manager
description: In Battle Royale Manager, you don't control the fighters—you build them. Train survivors, develop personalized strategies, place bold bets, and watch the chaos unfold in fully simulated AI-driven battle royale matches. You're not a fighter. You're the mastermind behind the fight.

title: Void: Icarus
description: Is the year 2074. The alien race named as the Cosmonauts arrived and conquered Earth 14 years ago. In this 2D Side-Scroll Shooter everything goes around Icarus, our main character, who got his hands on a strange artifact capable of save it's bearer from certain death.

title: Midnight Murder Maze
description: You find yourself in a darkened maze at the stroke of midnight. But the wolves howling, the blades sharpening and the crows calling out tell you that you are not alone. The only question that remains is how many times will you die before you stumble upon the exit to this fiendish construction.

title: Rusty's Adventure
description: Meet Rusty, a goofy but shy alien, and help him find his way back home in Rusty's Adventure!

title: Horror in the Forest
description: Too much has gone wrong — and now, together with your companion, you must uncover what hides among the trees.

title: Graveyard404
description: A first-person observation horror where you must spot unsettling anomalies in a repeating graveyard to break a deadly loop. Your memory is your only weapon.

title: Happy Cookies
description: Happy Cookies is a click-based simulation business game that can be fully experienced with just the left and right mouse buttons. Players need to decorate the cookies with chips by clicking on the surface of the cookies to make money.

title: Blue Hawaii Aniki's Soft Ore Demand Debut
description: The Blue Hawaii Aniki's legend begins. The debut of the late-night variety show-style novel game is here! Experience the puzzling and hilarious developments of the cast and their eccentric characters. The next installment is scheduled for release in November 2025!

title: Dave a Nice Guy
description: fast paced action game

title: Boredom Survivors
description: Survive. Upgrade. Dominate. Step into a relentless roguelike survival shooter where the odds are stacked against you and the clock is always ticking. Hordes of enemies swarm from every direction—your only hope is to adapt, improvise, and annihilate everything that moves.

title: TimeNot
description: This arcade platform game will challenge your skills to complete as many mini levels as you can before time runs out, with a minimalist pixel art style TIMENOT comes to offer a fast, responsive and accurate gameplay to platform games. Try not to run out of time.

title: Obsessed: Night Shift
description: A PSX Inspired horror game where you must work and cook at a shop late at night and the horrors that comes with it.

title: Late Emergency
description: Late Emergency is a horror experience where your goal is to quickly explore an abandoned waterpark after you received an emergency message. The more time you spend there, the more twisted will be the outcome. Get through the area as FAST AS POSSIBLE.

title: MachineGunner2: Bullet Transcending
description: MachineGunner 2 is a 2d top-down shooter game that Player controls four characters to clear stages and complete them as fast as possible. One hit will take you to the start line of the stage. So push it at your own pace.

title: Depths Unseen
description: Fall into the ruins of the long abandoned Mariana Corp Lab that now sits vacant just below the surface. Can you survive this unforgiving world?

title: Sleep and Girls
description: Help the beautiful girls to immerse themselves in their memories and remember the wonderful moments of their lives. This game is a classic puzzle game with several levels of difficulty and beautiful artwork. All characters appearing in this game are over 18 years of age.

title: The Mailroom
description:
A horror job simulator where you work in the mailroom of a small regional office of Hell located in Modesto, California.

You just started working in the mailroom of that weird building on 5th. The job was easy enough at first. Sort the mail and use their creaky old pneumatic tube system to send it to the correct departments. But then shit started getting weird. Can you figure out what's really going on in this place and find a way out?

title: Winged Warrior III: The Nova Knight
Bakar Game

• Superkid (for C64, Amstrad CPC, and ZX Spectrum) - Become a superhero and save the city

title: Sport Animals
description: Sport Animals is a physics-based game about a group of animals playing a sport! Customize your animal, practice your game, and get onto the field start scoring goals in 1v1s, 2v2s, or 3v3s. Compete against your friends or join public lobbies to play against other animals!

title: FBC: Firebreak - Deluxe Edition
description: Unlock a collection of exclusive cosmetic items and premium voice packs.

title: Food Hell
description: Food is your salvation and your downfall. Jump across platforms as you feast on the rain of food. Eat 100 to pass, and 150 to show off. Beware, too many or too few calories will kill you, and the rising tide, born of what you let fall, will swallow you whole.

title: The Tiny World
description: The Tiny World is a drama visual novel. A New Year's story about a long separation from home, family, friends, and tears freezing in the cold.

title: Locust_4457
description: Locust_4457 is a self-contained compilation of puzzles with elements of cryptography, escape rooms, and some ARG tropes.

title: Ruins Of Fear
description: Lucian wakes up on an ordinary school day to find himself in a deserted world. Together with Elora, he must solve puzzles, evade creatures in dark corridors, and uncover the mysteries around him.

title: The Smoke
description: The Smoke is a 2D Metroidvania where players wield a gun to disperse the smoke that threatens to engulf the world. Explore a world filled with hidden pathways and treacherous chambers. Blast away enemies, clear toxic clouds, and unlock new abilities. Stop the darkness before it swallows everything.

title: Creator Chronicles
description: A game within a game. In this entirely new kind of simulation RPG, become a guild master, develop your town, recruit guild members, and conquer dungeons. Every decision you make becomes your own chronicle.

title: A Kingdom of Soil
description: A Kingdom of Soil is a pixel-art RPG set on a contested medieval frontier. Farm, hunt, and forge to survive; manage your tavern and sway allies; plot in shadows or confront rivals in the open. Every choice shapes the legend you leave behind.

title: Steel Hail
description: Become humanity's last hope. Gear up, upgrade, and unleash hell in a relentless third-person sci-fi shooter against a ruthless robotic army. The future is yours to forge in fire and steel.

title: Arcade Archives 2: Mach Breakers
description:
Seven new contenders compete in an unprecedented super competition!

"MACH BREAKERS" is a sports game released by NAMCO LIMITED (current Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.) in 1995.
The superhuman sports series continues with this sequel to “Numan Athletics”!
Now featuring 7 athletes and 12 kinds of events, the action is even more intense.

Break the sound barrier and shatter expectations!

title: My Infamous Dungeon
description:
It's time to be evil. Build and master your dungeon, hire despicable monsters, and rise to conquer the overworld. Gaze from below as your dark tendrils creep across the land, snatching treasures from the forces of good and funding an ever growing empire. But beware! Saint Million the Hero King and his table of royal knights are always watching. Leave your dungeon weak, and a single cleave from the hero's sword will end your reign.

My Infamous Dungeon is a roguelite dungeon builder. Take time to carefully plan your dungeon, then protect it against waves of greedy heroes.

title: Eggconsole Crimson II PC-8801mkIISR
description:
Fifty years have passed since Crimson was defeated by the Hero.
