description: The arena beckons. Sharpen your steel. Slash, stab, and spear your way through the ranks of Rome’s toughest warriors, taking yourself from a lowly pit slave to the land's most glorified gladiator. Your audience awaits…

title: Hexborn
description: An occult-fueled roguelite FPS inspired by Blood and Vampire Survivors — but instead of one arena, explore cursed labyrinths that reshape every run. Draft brutal perks, wield occult firepower, and survive escalating horrors with a retro shooter soul.

title: Brainrot Battle Royale
description: Dive into Brainrot Battle Royale! Fight to the death in Ohio with the greatest brainrot characters in the ultimate Gen Z showdown. Join the fight now, aurafarmer!

title: The Möbius Strip
description:
A scientist, famous for making a sense-enhancing innovation, is recruited to work for the Silver Bed Foundation on a new project: a way to make immortality real.

A short puzzle RPG with three major acts.

title: The Dead House
description: Play as an ambitious YouTuber known for exploring paranormal and creepypasta stories. Your latest video takes you to a hauntingly beautiful, abandoned mansion, rumored to hide dark secrets.

title: Red Vanilla 2
description: Survive and destroy all 33 of your memories. Time had no meaning and I couldn't save her. Something wasn't right in her mind. I focused and fought this as hard as I could but in the end, no matter the result, nothing good would happen. I should've been there and now I ask her to forgive me.

title: Oikizo
description: Oikizo is a city-building game. Start by placing your first building and a few citizens, then make your city prosper. The strength of Oikizo lies in the ability to manage a city cooperatively with your friends.

title: Cook and Play: Animal Friends
description: Cook and Play: Animal Friends is launching in Early Access! It’s a wacky co-op cooking game full of chaos, power-ups, and hilarious kitchen disasters. Team up or face off in fast-paced matches where every second counts. Cook, laugh, and survive the madness — just try not to burn everything!

title: Bananaganza
description: A fast-paced casual arcade game where you peel, slice, and catch flying banana pieces to feed monkeys and rack up high scores.

title: Malevilent
description: A missing envoy. No telegraphs for a month. Something's gone wrong in the mining town of Gunsight, Arizona. As an agent of the newly-formed Federal Secret Service, it's your job to get to the bottom of what's happening in this third-person, open-world RPG.

title: The Population Must Grow
description: Start with just one citizens to build up your city. Grow it more and more and more. There is no limit in size. Just the limit of your own PC.

title: 101 Cats in Macau
description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 kittens in the hand-crafted Macau landscape. Earn lots of achievements. How many can you find? Be quick!

title: Dungeonborne Settlement
description: Defeat monsters in dungeons, gather resources, grow your settlement, and combine and enhance tactics to lead the battle. Use auto-battle and flexible challenges to create and change tactics as you face stronger dungeons.

title: Orbloom
description: Take deckbuilding and replace the cards with ball physics so you can combine abilities in creative ways!

title: Motorcycle Boy
description: This is a casual puzzle game, where the position of each game image is random and can be repeated.At first, it may be very chaotic,Then gradually place the image in the corresponding position,The image gradually becomes complete,Come and give it a try!

title: Presidential Psychologist
description: You're not a real psychologist. He's not a sane president. Welcome to the most unhinged therapy session ever held in office.

title: Static Boy
description: 2D Platformer Action/Adventure Game. Use space bar to jump. Use arrow keys to go left and right. Use mouse/trackpad to navigate menus. Using Xbox controller: Right joystick (up): jump. Left joystick: Left+Right.

title: Pretty Peculiar Lovers
description: Pretty Peculiar Lovers is a visual novel dating sim with a compelling twist, where your decisions impact which romance candidate you engage with, and what secrets you may uncover about them. Come prepared, these seemingly kind and welcoming individuals may not be how they appear.

title: Ludus Manager
description: Found your Ludus. Train your gladiator, set up your camp, and dominate fights across different cities in the Roman Empire. Shape your story based on the character you choose. Make different choices in dialogues to determine your path.

title: Mad Carnival
description: Rogue AI mascots have taken over a once-happy theme park. Blast through deadly attractions, rescue your girlfriend, and survive the chaos in this weirdly fun top-down shooter — now with a playable demo!

title: Korean Drone Flying Tour Paldang Water Fog Park
description: This game is a drone simulation game that allows you to experience real drone flight based on footage shot by a real flying drone. There is no up, down, left or right direction control, only the control to increase or decrease the drone speed.

title: Korean Drone Flying Tour Deulkkoch Arboretum
description: This game is a drone simulation game that allows you to experience real drone flight based on footage shot by a real flying drone. There is no up, down, left or right direction control, only the control to increase or decrease the drone speed.

title: A Pig Game: A Pee Wee Premiere
description: Join Pee Wee the Polka Dotted Pig - your silent (but determined) ceramic protagonist on a mission to collect toothpicks! Flip, fling, and fly through a kitchen full of cozy characters and curious quests!

title: Bloodquest From Hell
description: Bloodquest From Hell is a first person exploration game made in Unreal Engine. You play as a humble fry cook, who must journey through a mysterious portal in order to keep your job.

title: Arcade Archives: Video Hustler
description:
Experience the thrill of the pocket!

"VIDEO HUSTLER" is a sports game released by KONAMI in 1981.
This game is a simplified version of pool (pocket billiards). You strike the white cue ball to roll it, hit six balls, and sink them into the pockets.
The game’s most distinctive feature is that the score can vary greatly depending on the numbers on the balls and the different multipliers assigned to each pocket.

title: Arcade Archives 2: Video Hustler
description:
Experience the thrill of the pocket!

"VIDEO HUSTLER" is a sports game released by KONAMI in 1981.
This game is a simplified version of pool (pocket billiards). You strike the white cue ball to roll it, hit six balls, and sink them into the pockets.
The game’s most distinctive feature is that the score can vary greatly depending on the numbers on the balls and the different multipliers assigned to each pocket.

title: Anime Warriors Clash
description: From shadows to victory – become the ultimate warrior!

title: Band Girls
description:
Cute girls in rock bands appear in large numbers!
An easy puzzle game anyone can play!

title: Adrenaline: May the Sun Return
description: ADRENALINE: May The Sun Return is a first-person parkour game where you try to escape a procedurally generated futuristic district. Master your reflexes as you make your way through this hermetically sealed city.

title: Car Stunt Hero Simulator 2025
description: Race, jump, and become the ultimate stunt legend!

title: Eggconsole Daidassou PC-8801
description: Infiltrate the prisoner-of-war camp!Use guns, grenades, and more to blast through the enemy and complete a great escape with your five comrades!

title: Fling it! Shoe Kicking
description: Fly, shoe, fly! Up into the sky! Swing and kick your shoe as far as you can! Become a shoe-kicking master!

title: Gangsters in Love
description: 24/7 with Dangerous Gangsters?!

title: Gang Wars: Cards and Bullets
description: Become an underworld mafia boss in fast, tactical card battles!

title: Gravity Trials: Underground
description: Gravity Trials: Underground – an exciting motorcycle game with realistic physics and spectacular stunts!

title: Gudetamarun: Running Gudetama! But Gudetama wants to be Gudegude
description: Unique and Cute! A Laid-Back Side-Scrolling Action Game

title: Legendary Tales: Map of Hope
description: Follow the dream of haven to reclaim your freedom.

title: Meatshaker
description: The Ultimate Solution to All Your MEAT Dilemmas!

title: Meow Moments: Celebrating Beats & Books
description: Join cute cats in festive scenes! Find feline friends and pop balloons as you explore a vibrant music festival and a lively university campus full of discovery and fun.

title: Snapshot Girls 2
description: Solve puzzles, uncover secrets, and marvel at every detail of stunning photorealistic masterpieces!

title: Samurai Academy: Paws of Fury
description: The village of Kakamucho is under attack by the Shogun’s cat armies! Join Hank, a dog samurai in a world of cats, and his friends as they reveal a sinister plot and save the day, samurai-style. Slash, dash, and laugh through this wacky third-person action adventure.

title: Strike Warfare: Force Recon
description: Be the last one standing! Ultimate survival FPS in the blood-soaked Middle East! Take on impossible missions with devastating firepower and lethal weapons!

title: Sugoi Girls: Attractive Archer
description: Meet over 50 pretty anime girls in this relaxing puzzle game!

title: The Jungle Challenge
description: Join Buzzy, an energetic bee, along with his friends Lilo the ladybug, Tito the beetle, and Rocco the grasshopper in this exciting visual novel.

title: Voltline
description:
Connect the spark, calm your mind.
A relaxing logic puzzle where each tap sparks a chain reaction across the grid.

title: Where the Sky Is
description: "Let's create in a mysterious world!"

title: Brain Training! Art Puzzle
description: Spin to an aha moment! A brain-training puzzle where you complete a masterpiece by intuition

title: Marisa of Liartop Mountain: Digital Deluxe Edition
Idle Time Slime
description: A relaxing virtual slime pet that lives at the bottom of your screen while you do other tasks.

title: My Cozy Room: Mexican and Asian
Space Storm
description: Space Storm is a fast-paced space racing and combat game where players navigate high-speed stellar tracks across distant galaxies. Asteroids, hazards, and unexpected events challenge reflexes and strategy as the starship duels rivals and pushes toward the finish line.

title: Axis Shift
description: Switch between Tank, Spaceship, and Submarine in this third-person sci-fi arcade shooter, battling waves of rabid mechanical beasts to uncover the truth behind Stroth XVI.

title: License to Grill
description: Pick your favorite meat character and cook up to 8 friends using the environment, wacky weapons, or your trusty frying pan in this online 3rd Person Combat PVP game!

title: quilt
description: A Yume Nikki Fangame by rataratata, catcatcat6, nunu and luok.

title: Super Choppy
description: Challenging indie action platformer with beautiful retro pixel art. Play as Choppy and master the platforming gameplay mechanics of using his axe to throw, fly, climb, and chop your way through a silly revenge-fueled adventure.

title: Dragon Ball Sparking Zero: Shallot (Dragon Ball Legends)
description: Shallot from the mobile game DRAGON BALL LEGENDS joins the battle!

title: Puzzle Parasite
description: Puzzle Parasite is a sci-fi puzzle adventure where you wield telekinetic powers and a cricket bat. You send energy cores flying, power alien tech, and avoid deadly lasers, as you go deeper to uncover the hidden secrets. A handcrafted tribute to the classics that made us think in new ways.

title: Meme Wars
description: Skill-based 1v1 3D arena fighter based on memes. Dash, block, and combo through quick 3-minute duels. Climb ranked online PvP or train against bots. Manage Stamina & Mana, stack status effects and outplay with skill. Easy to learn, hard to master

title: Immune Attack
description: Immune Attack was designed, developed and evaluated for learning outcomes by the Learning Technologies Program at the Federation of American Scientists. Funded by a major grant from the National Science Foundation and the National Institutes of Health. All the code, art, sound and voices are by Garry and Melissa Gaber of Escape Hatch Entertainment.

title: Night Shift: 1999
description: Balance work, vampirism and socialising as you explore Kings Cross, Sydney during the last year of the millennium. Keep a lid on your darkest desires and be rewarded with a deeper understanding of what it means to live again. Or don’t — no one will stop you. You’re a vampire, after all.

title: Gravity Was A Mistake
description: Traverse a gravity-inverted world using physics-based movement. Interact with floating structures, unlock new traversal abilities, and climb through a shattered vertical landscape.

title: Backrooms: Reminiscence
description: Backrooms: Reminiscence is a single-player horror game where you experience something unexpected, and now you're left all alone in the cold world of The Backrooms.

title: If Monks Had Macs...
description: This is a collection of several stacks, with topics ranging from St. Thomas a Kempis’s Imitatio Christi, to a Christian anti-Nazi movement whose leaders were executed during World War II. Interspersed with all of this are games, including some pinball simulations and a role-playing spiritual adventure about a monk’s trek through the medieval wilderness to a monastic library.

title: Train Sim World 5: BR Class 86/2 & Mk2f Coaches
description: Tap into classic British AC traction with the BR Class 86/2 from Just Trains. The Class 86 brings additional challenges to the stunning WCML: Preston - Carlisle route, as well as all-new variety in the form of British Rail's Mk2F coaches!

title: Cora
description: CORA (Counter Offensive Rapidfire Automata) is a singleplayer/multiplayer top-down shooter created by Empty House Games borrowing inspiration from other arcade top-down shooters.

title: Train Sim World 5: Manchester Airport Commuter: Manchester - Alderley Edge
description: From Piccadilly station to the modern airport terminus, multiple lines combine to serve Greater Manchester commuters aboard Northern Trains traction. Experience a variety of services with Alan Thomson Simulation's first route in Train Sim World 5.

title: Rocket League: TriTrim Wheels
description: Blade-sharp and effortlessly brilliant. Roll up to the Arena with the TriTrim Wheels that make a bold statement with every rotation. Grab them for free and get ready for a cutting-edge ride!

title: Astrobarian
description: Astrobarian is a 3D action RPG game where you and Cordina travel to different worlds — some cultivated, others filled with deadly hazards. Along the way, you may encounter others with different motives and unresolved mysteries.

title: TrailRail
description: Your path taken is the key. "TrailRail" is a physics-based action puzzle game where the trajectory of your movement becomes a tangible object. Control the girl and aim to escape from the mysterious research facility.

title: Songs of Conquest: Roots
description: Songs of Conquest's second new faction is The Roots, who have spread from deep within the Wyldwoods of the Bleak East. Take command of flora, fungus, and the bones of the repurposed dead to spread the Roots across Aerbor!

title: Medieval Dynasty: Echoes of Nature
description: The Echoes of Nature DLC adds a range of outdoor decoration options, focused on natural elements and seasonal variation. It introduces new types of trees, shrubs, hedges, and stone features that can be placed in the environment.

title: Hell Let Loose: Operation Overlord Units
description:
Fight throughout Normandy with the Operation Overlord Units DLC.

The Operation Overlord Units contains: -

3 New Uniforms:
1x ROA
1x Rangers
1x Field Division

3x New Headgear:
2x New Netted 2nd & 5th Rangers Helmets
1x ROA Cap
1x Field Division
1x Field Division Foliage

3x New Heads:
2x Axis (Friedrich & Nikolai) + Winter Variants
1x US (Gordon) + Winter Variant

title: The Battle of Polytopia: Ragoo
description: The scourge of the waters, the bane of navies, the serpents of the seas - The Ragoo Pirates! Their fleets of ships and lust for plunder are ready to expand their operations from the Kickoo Isles to the rest of the Square!

title: The Battle of Polytopia: Hoodrick
description:
The yellow autumn leaves of the Hoodrick woods are perfect hideouts for its peculiar mushroom stuffing inhabitants.
Hoodrick starts the game with Archery Tech

title: The Battle of Polytopia: Yorthwober
description: Can you hit a BuzzFly with an arrow from 2 tiles away? Then you might be ready for the Hoodrick Yorthwober. These expert sharpshooters have been personally trained in combat and survival by Yorth, the legendary archer, and comprise the most elite force the Hoodrick can muster.

title: The Battle of Polytopia: Lirepacci
description: The honor of forging your helmet into a laurel is reserved for the Lirepacci, a group of scholars, philosophers, and magistrates near the top of Imperius society.

title: The Battle of Polytopia: Baergøff
description: Bardur who have survived the 5 Tests of Strength are given the rank of Baergøff, meaning “Elite Baerion Hunter”. The sanctified Baerion pelt is thought to let the wearer channel the animal's raw ferocity in battle.

title: The Battle of Polytopia: Sha-po
description: The Sha-po are a secretive legion of soldiers, saboteurs, and assassins trained in the ways of warfare and subterfuge from the moment they're hatched.

title: The Battle of Polytopia: Anzala
description: The disciples of Anzala eschewed the scientific lifestyle of their Zebasi siblings and followed the calling of art and unrestrained expression! Now they're here, with the Square as their canvas, and no one will hinder their creative conquest!

title: Wibby Buddy
description: Explore a beautiful forest and bond with adorable animals! Build closeness with various creatures, and as your bond grows, gift them cozy homes to live together. Gather resources and craft to create a unique home with your animal friends. Turn a shabby, lonely space into a warm, lively haven!

title: Northgard: Gardariki, Clan of the Hippogriff
description: From Southern Lands, Sindri, eldest of Brok and Eitria, returns clad in fire and steel, his twin hammers echoing both legacy and defiance. A figure of both might and mastery, bringing with him the legacy of the forge and the discipline of distant Kingdoms.

title: Rogue Skies
description: Conquer the skies in this tactical roguelike deckbuilder! In Rogue Skies, you'll assemble your crew, load the cannons and defend your airship from raiding sky pirates as you blow them out of the sky!

title: The Cube, Save Us
description: A post-apocalyptic extraction action game built around brutal, close-quarters combat. Step through the Cube Gate and discover ever-shifting worlds filled with strange landscapes and terrifying enemies. Escape the Cube by fighting your way through twisted mutants and Raiders you once called allies.

title: I'm a Gensokyo Observer 2: Chen's Duty
description: After Thomas finished the observing duty and got sent back home by Yukari, few weeks later, the anomaly starts to haunt few more places within Gensokyo again. Yukari wants Thomas to have a break so someone else need to do an observing job and that's when Chen decided to step in. You'll be playing as Chen and you must observe the haunted locations, report the anomaly and survive until sunrise.

title: Colton Owen: Ace Attorney
description: A group of uni students attend a meeting at an Occult Club on campus, when the unthinkable strikes. A campus rumour comes to life and claims a victim! ...Or does it?

title: Super Farmer
description: "Super Farmer" is a fast-paced game where you compete against pests and farmers in a vibrant orchard. Run, harvest fruits, and use items to outmaneuver rivals. Race through 100 levels, manage energy, and battle farmers to become the ultimate champion!

title: Capoeira Origins
description: Capoeira Origins is an action-adventure experience set in colonial Brazil during the period of slavery. Experience history from the perspective of those who resisted, taking on the role of capoeiristas determined to fight for freedom, justice, and survival.

title: Upload Labs
description: A sci-fi management game where you build and optimize your computer's system from the ground up. Connect and configure interconnected nodes to efficiently download, process, and upload files. Manage your setup, solve system challenges, and become the ultimate system architect

title: Flint
description: A action-adventure game with a top down perspective and a heavy emphasis on story. Become the legendary Knight of Hamarolf and take on a myriad of foes from the Golden Oath to save the world from evil's reign while engaging with memorable characters and a thrilling combat loop.

title: Space Mash
description: Space Mash is a bullet-hell shooter in the retro style of the earliest arcade games. To help beginners, older players and those with a motor impairment, there are five levels of slow-down that can be activated at any time during game play.

title: Super Mario Galaxy + Super Mario Galaxy 2
description: Travel the stars with Mario in enhanced versions of these beloved adventures.

title: Bloodless Heart
description: Squeeze the heart, gain elements and eventually synthesize your own blood. In this incremental game, every organ (not only your heart) matters. Use their synergies to achieve your ultimate bloody goal.

title: Mario Tennis Fever
description:
Hit the court for explosive action in the latest Mario Tennis game!

Join Mario and friends for over-the-top tennis mayhem! Use topspins, slices, lobs, and other familiar shots—along with other fancy footwork and new defensive maneuvers—to outpace your opponents on the court. Keep a rally going, build up your Fever Gauge, and unleash powerful Fever Shots that can be augmented with special effects by equipping Fever Rackets!

title: Super Mario Bros. Wonder: Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Meetup in Bellabel Park
description: More experiences are coming to the Flower Kingdom! Enjoy a variety of attractions in the Bellabel Park plaza that lets you team up with (or work against) friends and family. Collect the most coins, run and hide in Phanto Tag, work together to pass a Bob-omb to the goal and more! This Nintendo Switch 2 Edition adds even more content and enhancements as well.

title: Put Out the Fire
description: Team up in this chaotic local co-op rescue game! Extinguish fires, save lives, and battle disasters in fast-paced, time-critical missions across stylized environments.

title: Yoshi and the Mysterious Book
description:
Join Yoshi for a new adventure in Yoshi and the Mysterious Book, launching on Nintendo Switch 2 in spring 2026.

One day, on the island where Yoshi and his friends live, a peculiar talking book named Mr. E suddenly falls from the sky. This peculiar book’s pages contain information about unusual creatures, so Yoshi decides to jump in and help investigate!

As Yoshi wanders through the book, you'll make all sorts of discoveries about the creatures you find and those discoveries will be written down. You'll find lots of unusual creatures residing within the book – a page-turning adventure awaits!

title: Dragon Quest VII Reimagined
description: DRAGON QUEST VII Reimagined is a modern remake of DRAGON QUEST VII, which originally launched on PlayStation in 2000. In this new reimagined version of the game, the core concept of the original title remains, but the battle mechanics, graphics and story have all been updated and improved, providing players with a more streamlined and focused experience. In particular, the graphics in the game were completely overhauled from the original, using real-life doll figures for the characters and monsters that were scanned into the game to create stunning hand-crafted visuals. This definitive version of the game is perfect for fans who want to revisit the beloved story or newcomers who are diving into the world for the first time.

title: Curse of Dominion
description: Crowned for saving the king, you wield the coveted Blessing of Dominion. Command tense tactical battles, deepen companion Loyalty, evade those who would kill for your power, and watch a secret moral scale quietly reshape Elvorith’s fate.

title: Still House
description: A peaceful, cozy home-building sandbox experience where every corner tells a story. Build your space from the ground up, decorate with care, and let your tiny helper bring life to each room.

title: Demand Dial Exorcist
description: In Demand-Dial Exorcist, you play a demon hunter solving eerie puzzles. Investigate clues, place ritual items on the pentagram, and banish demons before they claim you as their next victim.

title: Too Many Bots
description: Too Many Bots is a first-person action arcade. Dive into brutal, retro-PS1 mazes, alternate between prey and hunter, face endless bot swarms, collect temporary power-ups, and adapt to ever-changing rules. Every run ramps up difficulty, testing your reflexes and strategy.

title: Fatal Frame II: Crimson Butterfly Remake
description: The full remake of FATAL FRAME / PROJECT ZERO II: Crimson Butterfly. This Japanese-style horror adventure game follows twin sisters lost in an abandoned village haunted by evil spirits. Using the Camera Obscura, they fight ghosts as the story unfolds.

title: Suika Game Planet
description:
A new Suika Game is here from a new setting in space! Turn, target, and aim for the watermelon!

Drop the fruits freely from any direction as "Poppy" flies 360° around the planet. Make fruits of the same type collide to make them "evolve" and aim to create watermelons for a high score!
Make a lot of fruits "evolve" to enter the new "Super Evolution Time" mode! Special background music, dramatic effects, and a bonus score bring the excitement to a peak!

The "Suika Game Planet" has evolved in many ways, including with a customization function that allows you to freely decorate the game screen (skin), and a collection function that allows you to collect stickers for completing missions and use them to create your original name tag. Try playing it now!

title: Donkey Kong Bananza: DK Island & Emerald Rush
description: Sightsee across this modern take on Donkey Kong’s home, packed with nostalgic views like DK’s Treehouse, Gangplank Galleon, and other iconic locations. Take in-game photos with familiar friends Diddy Kong, Dixie Kong, Cranky Kong, and Rambi, and Squawks, and decorate DK Island with DLC-exclusive character statues that you can obtain with Banandium Chips. You might even find some hidden bonus stages among the mine cart tracks and jungle ruins!

title: Pokémon Pokopia
description: Pokémon and people once lived happily together, but the world has withered and the humans are gone. The only remaining resident appears to be a lone Tangrowth. After waking from a long slumber, a peculiar Ditto decides to restore the desolate land using its transformation skills and its surprising new crafting abilities. Play as a Ditto and build a charming world alongside your Pokémon friends. After a satisfying day of crafting, building, and gardening, relax in your very own paradise or invite Pokémon and your friends to visit. As you restore your world and cultivate its natural beauty, you'll encounter more Pokémon who will teach you useful moves! Your Pokémon neighbors are excited to play together, as well as help you build houses to welcome even more friends! Pokémon might even ask for your help – work with them to build a cozy utopia.

title: Pokémon Legends: Z-A - Mega Dimension
description: Mysterious distortions have appeared without warning in Lumiose City. They seem to connect to a space known as Hyperspace Lumiose...and the mythical Pokémon Hoopa might have some part to play.

title: Danganronpa 2x2
description:
A new killing game begins in the same setting and with the same characters as Danganronpa 2: Goodbye Despair. A brand-new scenario with different victims, culprits, and tricks! Reveal the truth by shooting down contradictions in a Class Trial and uncover the culprit of a murder.

The original scenario from Danganronpa 2: Goodbye Despair, with revamped visuals and presentation for modern consoles, is also included.

title: Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave
description:
Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave is a turn-based strategy RPG centered around the Heroic Games, a tournament where warriors with different motivations compete for a chance to have their greatest wish granted by the Divine Sovereign. The game builds on the tactical foundation of previous Fire Emblem titles, featuring turn-based combat with combat arts, gambits, and crests. A new mechanic called Blaze Arts lets units spend health to perform powerful special abilities on the battlefield.
The game appears to be set in the same world as Fire Emblem: Three Houses, though in a different era, and follows characters like Cai, who enters the tournament to save his father's life.

title: Backyard Football '99
description: Backyard Football 1999 is back and now enhanced to run on modern systems. Whether you're picking Jerry Rice or Barry Sanders for your dream team, scoring TDs with Pablo Sanchez, or enjoying the witty banter between Sunny Day and Chuck Downfield, simple controls let anyone pick up and play football!

title: Mega Man Star Force: Legacy Collection
description: The Mega Man Star Force series, which expanded into an anime, is back in the Mega Man Star Force Legacy Collection! This collection includes seven games and additional features like a gallery of illustrations and music! Online play is also supported!

title: Super Mario Galaxy 2
description: The version of Super Mario Galaxy 2 released as part of the Super Mario Bros. 40th Anniversary contains added features like an Assist Mode and the addition of Rosalina's Storybook.

title: Disney Miraness Fitness
description: With a varied selection of full-body aerobic, anaerobic, and stretching exercises, this title lets players have fun with genuine workouts at home.

title: Dumpster Divers
description: Dumpster Divers is an online co-op scavenging game where rejected puppets turn trash into treasure. Dive into alleys and dumpsters with up to 4 friends, outsmart bumbling cops, and haul your loot home to sell. Use scraps to craft helpful tools and climb the ranks of society one dumpster at a time.

title: Bonehold
description: Dungeon Crawler with elements of rogue-like and ARPG games. Kill hordes of enemies, duel mighty bosses, and acquire legendary loot!

title: After Hell Freezes Over
description: Venture into the desolate frozen wasteland in this open-world survival horror. Struggle to survive in the cold, where strange creatures roam in the darkness. Build a shelter, collect supplies, fend off unimaginable threats, and fight for survival After Hell Freezes Over.

title: Tetsudou Nippon! Real Pro Tokyo - Kanagawa! Tokyu Dentetsu-hen
description:
A train simulation game from Sonic Powered's "Japanese Rail Sim" series.

In this entry, you can drive trains on three different lines of Japan's Tokyu railway.

This game is compatible with Zuiki's Densha de GO!! dedicated one-handle train controller for the Nintendo Switch.

title: Art Attack
description: Art Attack is an action roguelike with a unique paint based combat system, and a distaste for GenAI.

title: Scamster Kombat
description: Welcome to the world of Scamster Kombat — an exciting clicker where every mouse click brings you closer to your cherished goal! In this game you have to take on the role of a funny guy who hides under a blanket and earns coins by tapping on the screen. But be careful! Your quiet life can be disrupted by uninvited guests!

title: Orangia
description: A yuri visual novel that tells the story of two childhood friends, from their first meeting to falling in love and the everyday moments of their life together with a multi-branching storyline.

title: Orangia DLC
description: The story takes place after the true end of the main game and tells about the couple's life in college and after work.

title: The Endless Elegy at the Flowercape
description: A dark fantasy style pixel ARPG. Players will travel in a world ravaged by natural disasters and tyrannies, encountering various companions, overcoming endless sadness and despair, until they reach the end of the world called "Flower Cape".

title: B-e-e-t-l-e: Be right back!
description: The sequel to b-e-e-t-l-e, b-e-e-t-l-e: be right back! is a short, cozy keyboardventure where you can type casually and take your time. Explore strange lands, solve unique puzzles and discover whimsical new ways to use your keyboard as you embark on a journey to find your lost beetle.

title: Plants vs Zombies Expansion
description: PvZ Expansion is a mod that mostly adds new content and fixes some bugs while also making the game somewhat more challenging, but not extremely so. This mod does not overhaul the entire game significantly, though there are some balancing changes and new features.

title: Honkai: Star Rail - Back to Earth in Evernight
description:
Version 3.6 of Honkai: Star Rail, which includes:
• New characters: Evernight and Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae

title: Hard Truck 2
description:
Hard Truck 2 is the original version of the more well-known upgraded release called Hard Truck 2: King of the Road. Some of the major differences that separate this release are the lack of extended interface at gas and repair stations that allows player to choose how much fuel to fill or which parts of the car to repair, the lack of ability to buy lighter vehicles such as BMW M5 at the beginning of the game or even start playing as one immediately, weaker AI, far better rewards at "The Circuit", the lack of need to stop for refueling/upgrading in the "Simulator" mode, and some other elements.
This original version cannot be upgraded to the Kind of the Road re-release via patching.

It was initially released in US back in 2000 (v4.0), followed by a few updated versions that also saw release in some European countries as well (such as v5.8 being released in Portugal and Lithuania). Original Russian release v6.5 never had an official English translation, yet v6.5-7.4 were localized and released in some European countries (such as Lithuania).
The upgraded version King of the Road 1.0 released in 2002 wasn't compatible with its predecessor and started a completely new version numeration, effectively becoming a separate expanded version of the game.

title: Road to Fame
description:
Road to Fame is a street racing game. It is set in "Old Steel City" where the mayor, unable to put an end to illegal street racing, decided to start entirely legal street races for professionals. The player is an amateur driver who is trying to earn his position in the racing world.

The game offers a training mode, where the player can choose any track and practice driving around it, and an arcade mode, which consists of a series of time trials (where the track must be completed within a limited time) and races against other players. Completing the races grants the player money, which can be used to purchase better cars. The game also contains a workshop where the player can repaint his car, or buy decorations.

There are 10 tracks to choose from and 27 cars, based on actual car brands but with false names; each car has slightly different capabilities.

Prepare to explore 7 abstract environments, while 7 instrumental sound-tracks inspired by Trance, Techno, Hardcore and other dance related music guide you through your journey.

title: Magic Tiny Lands
description: Magic Tiny Lands is an action-platformer where a small knight travels through a mystical forest to defeat the evil unleashed by a magical monolith.

title: Strawberry Chocolate
description: Strawberry chocolate" is a "Bang Dream" Doujin Game. It's a pixel style RPG, Players will operate Anon and Taki in different game worlds to carry out crazy adventures, and the cute and loving interaction between the two is the game's greatest charm ......

title: Hello Loaf
description: In Hello Loaf, you’re dropped into unique illustrated environments. These aren’t just static text, they’re alive. Each letter you discover triggers a unique animation, sound cue, and sometimes even changes the world – unveiling secrets, triggering mechanisms, or telling a story piece by piece.

title: Study Arcade
description: Study > Play > Repeat

title: Edge of the End
description: A young kid returns to his boyhood home in search of closure amid strong family ties and regrets while uncovering bittersweet memories.

title: Ivan Poe
description: Ivan Poe is a third person find-your-way puzzle adventure following this cuboid character as they keep truckin' on through the Cosmic Soup.

title: Merica Tale
description: This is a female-led alternate history visual novel where all historical figures have their genders reversed. The story begins with General Georgina Washington’s execution, and France falling alongside Merica. A young lady, Napoleon Bonaparte rises to challenge Queen Georgina III of Britain.

title: Is This a Game?
description: Is THIS a game? Well, it has everything you'd expect: buttons, pixels, achievements, a mouse-cursor to point and click sometimes, an axolotl, more than 50 mini-”games”. Is this enough? What even is a game? How much interactivity do you need? Are games art? Are there TOO many axolotls in this game?

title: Yap Wizards Tower Defence
description: Dynamic tower defence with an ever-scaling battlefield and unexpected twists!

title: I Suppose
description: A story of a simple walk home, with a sprinkling of intrusive thoughts. Make a few choices, decide what's best, and please, try not to overthink.

title: 50 Cents Please
description: You are stranded in a subway where everybody has seemingly disappeared. With only a penny to your name, solves puzzles around the map and find your way out. Explores shops, and various rooms--and avoid the train tracks.

title: Pocket Garden
description: Pocket Garden is a super cute little indie game where you can build the coziest gardens and have the best time ever! No worries about resources, fighting, or health. Just sit back, relax, and enjoy!

title: AcroChallenge
description:
Unleash Your Wit in AcroChallenge: The Ultimate Acronym Game!
Dive into the hilarious and engaging world of AcroChallenge, the fast-paced word game where creativity reigns supreme! Compete against friends and strangers alike to craft the wittiest and most memorable phrase for a randomly generated acronym, ranging from 3 to 7 letters (e.g., "XYZ"). Think fast and type faster – the clock is ticking!

Showcase your linguistic prowess and impress your friends with clever and insightful phrases, or simply elicit laughter with silly and absurd interpretations. AcroChallenge is perfect for players of all skill levels looking for a fun and challenging party game experience.

Play Your Way: Bots, Friends, or New Acquaintances
AcroChallenge offers multiple ways to play! Jump into a random game with a single click for instant action. Or, create your own custom game and challenge AI bots, Steam friends (coming soon), or make new connections with players from around the globe. It's your game, your rules! This is a great online multiplayer game to play with friends.

Take the Acronym Challenge to the Next Level
Want an extra layer of difficulty? Introduce round-specific "Topics" to guide your phrases, adding a strategic element to the word association game. Set by the server, game winner, or game creator, these topics will push your creativity to its limits. Enjoy real-time chat with fellow players during the game but fear not, you have the power to mute anyone whose words don't contribute to the fun!

title: Invasive Species
description: Invasive Species is a couch co-op tower defense game where you and your friend plant towers in pots to protect your grandparents greenhouse from the robot invasion! Get scrap from defeating enemies and buy upgrades in the catalogue to fend off against more difficult waves of enemies.

title: Math Attack
description: Math Attack is a mathematical puzzle game about using math operations to reduce expressions to zero. Each level presents a clever numerical riddle hidden behind deceptively simple notation. It’s a game of logic, foresight, and elegant solutions.

title: Hentai Unlimited
description: Dive into the world of Hentai Unlimited, a captivating and relaxing puzzle game where your goal is deceptively simple: rotate pieces to reveal tantalizing, lewd artwork. But beware, it's more addictive than you might think! Each picture is randomly selected, pulled fresh from the web for an infinite supply of hentai puzzles.

title: Call of Hentai Neko
description: Dive into a unique puzzle game where your goal is to match pairs of images to unveil the full picture. Experience the satisfaction of completing each lewd puzzle and unlocking stunning visuals. Call of Hentai Neko offers a leisurely and rewarding match-two game experience.

title: Night Furries
description: Escape into the tranquil world of Night Furries, a beautifully crafted puzzle game designed for pure relaxation. Immerse yourself in the soothing gameplay as you strategically rearrange tiles to reveal stunning images. Night Furries offers a delightful and calming experience for players of all skill levels.

title: Zenith Realms
description: Guide Ninami on a heartfelt journey through the realms of a fractured planet. Solve intricate puzzles, uncover hidden secrets, and piece together the truth of a shattering past with a mysterious raven.

title: Fallen Knight: Rise of the Fallen
description: Lancelot returns in our third DLC! Take on the role of Lancelot, the Knight of Round, after being rescued by his friend Galahad. Imprisoned for five years, Lancelot is tasked with a mission to defeat the world's greatest threat - Cathedral. Take back the Holy Power from hostile enemies, save humanity, and get revenge for your friend. The 'true ending' of the Fallen Knight series will end in this chapter.

title: Creepy Camping
description: Indie Horror. The main character arrives in the forest in a Motorhome. The forest is covered with secrets and mysteries. Exploring the forest, over time, the campsite turns into a real nightmare. The hero understands that he is not alone in the forest...

title: The Googol Clicker
description: Could you reach the googol value which is 1e100? Idle clicker game with simple goals but very addictive gameplay!

title: I Can't Hear Your Words, So I Want To Listen To Your Heart
description: This is a visual novel that tells a story of healing and pure love, with a focus on inner descriptions, set in a school.

title: Let's Learn Korean! Hangul
description: Study Hangul as you explore the Republic of Korea and learn about its culture, cuisine and history. Practice each new Hangul letter by playing fun mini-games.

title: Let's Learn Korean! Vocabulary
description: Learn over 200 Korean words by completing fun challenges. Unlock mini-games, art and music.

title: Chasing the Universe
description: Chasing the Universe is a light fast FPS platformer. Slide and teleport to gather the stars as fast as you can !

title: Landline
description: Prevent murder cases with the telephone.

title: Desktop Pet Project
description: Elevate your PC experience with charming desktop pets. Inspired by such a wonderful invention as Shimeji, Desktop Pet Project has tried to collect the most interesting and curious mechanics. You can summon up to two pets that will have slight personalities in behavior.

title: Blue Shutter
description: Uncover the secrets of the night in a 2.5D pixel art adventure. Explore, unveil mysteries and fight.

title: Hentai Heroes
description: Dive into the captivating world of Hentai Heroes, a unique puzzle game where solving sexy puzzles unlocks the hearts of adorable anime girls! Use your strategic thinking and one-handed gameplay skills to conquer 25 challenging levels filled with engaging and relaxing scenarios.

title: Lines'98
description: Lines'98 is a classic computer logic game. The object is to strategically arrange balls into lines or shapes on a 9x9 game board. Once balls are aligned, they're destroyed and you're awarded a certain amount of points. However, each time you aren't able score, the program throws three additional balls into the mix.

title: World Eater
description: WORLD EATER is a bossfight game about an underpaid astronaut fighting a giant worm in space. Fight your way through varying planets and defeat the colossal worm!

title: Blest
description: In BLEST, you are responsible for defending the sacred statue. You must use all your wits and the goddess's divine power to eliminate all the monsters that enter through the cathedral's main gate. May the goddess be with you!

title: Sporeborne
description: SporeBorne is a top-down, action hack-and-slash game where you play as an estranged mutation of a fungus infesting the planet H311. Embark on a journey, slashing through your enemies, growing more powerful, and uncovering abilities as you traverse this planet's infested land.

title: Gear Combination
description: Gear Combination is a puzzle game where you combine gears of different sizes to reach a target rotation speed. Place gears freely and watch them spin together. Multiple quests can be played in any order and replayed. Simple yet strategic. Perfect for gear lovers.

title: Subspace Reticulum
description: Blow up bots beyond the stars. AI Driven 2D Spaceship Warfare

title: SoulGatherer
description: One world. One soul. Countless fragments.

title: My Putrid Ponies
description: A zombie ponies game where you have to survive with a shotgun.

title: The Chroma: From the Wasteland
description: A western occult FPS game against the unknown on a train speeding through the western wilderness.

title: Shifting Sands
description: Welcome to the Nexus. You died, the sandpit brought you back, and now you have a shift to finish as a scrapper. Scavenge crashed ships, cram your pack with dangerous salvage, meet odd survivors, and make it home each day through a weird desert world before the storm resets the sands and you with it.

title: Boukyaku no Edicius
description:
She wants to “end” happily ever after...

Saku Koshimizu, the protagonist of this story, is a victim of power harassment and has no courage to commit suicide.

On the day he skipped work, he met a girl who calls herself Nagisa, and they went out on a one-day date.

title: After Mankind: TD
description: A sci-fi Tower Defense game where you build your own towers by combining different modules to create unique structures. The damage system and unique enemies will force you to choose weapons for each threat separately. Study the glossary to learn more about each enemy.

title: Ratatata
description: Ratatata is an isometric Tower Defense game where you lead a space rat kingdom fending off a ruthless cat invasion! Fight across diverse environments and adapt your strategies to survive the relentless waves of these fierce felines!

title: Panama Canal Clash
description: Who will become the master of the Panama Canal? Everything will be decided in the game Panama Canal Clash!

title: Sad Virus
description: Walking simulation in open world where player controls virus whose mission is to find beer bottles so he can be happy again

description: Bereaved by the war, the heroine had been into sleep in the ruins of gods for three hundred years. After awakening, she lost her memory in order to save the life of the man who had awakened her from the miracle. But the new life seems not so smooth as expected...

title: Kitty's Hungry Adventure
description: Kitty's Hungry Adventure is a hardcore cozy platformer about Kitty’s adventures as she tries to cook the most delicious dishes while overcoming dangers and solving puzzles.

title: Make Tracks Great Again
description: This is a simulation management game about how to Make Tracks Great Again: Only by ensuring trains depart the platform fully loaded with correct cargo can you earn more money and restore the station's greatness.

title: Witch & Bun Cats
description: A light ARPG game that integrates backpack management. In the game, players will play the role of a little witch and help the cats take back the cans that were taken away by monsters. But as you explore deeper, you find that things are not as simple as they seem...

title: Mind Rift
description: Mind Rift is a sci-fi visual novel where you follow your guide, Oni, to explore consciousness splitting in a multi-consciousness simulated world. description: Underground is a first-person horror-puzzle game where you explore a mysterious subway system, solve deadly puzzles, and escape the creatures lurking in the dark. Will the train take you home—or deeper into the nightmare?

title: Deadliest Pigeon
description: Equip weapons against physics-based enemies, swing through chaos with grappling hook and destroy everything in your path to avenge the little chick!

description: My Sticker Zoo is a relaxing strategy and puzzle game where you build your own zoo. Construct impressive habitats for your sticker animals by placing tiles. Manage a variety of wildlife parks as you unlock new scenario's. Collect all the stars, set new high-scores and become an expert ranger!

title: PandaBomber
description: Step into the explosive world of PandaBomber, a modern reimagining of the classic Bomberman experience! Engage in fast-paced, strategic gameplay that challenges you to think on your feet while delivering heart-pounding action.

title: Summer Beach Trip
description: Escape to a sunny getaway with Summer Beach Trip, a captivating puzzle game where you'll spend a memorable summer day at the local beach. Unlike usual, you're not alone! Meet and interact with seven lovely girls, each presenting their own unique puzzle challenge.

title: Magic Frog
description: Control a magic student who, after messing up a spell, turned into a frog. Fly on a broomstick, dodge and shoot obstacles and enemies, collect items, and gain new abilities while trying to survive as long as possible.

title: Deadly Runner
description: Help the Girl to overcome her fears and get out of the world of nightmares. Jump over obstacles, spikes, traps and beware of monsters!

title: Save The Bear Cubs
description: Save the bear cubs is an incredibly challenging 2.5D platform game. In this game, you can die from absolutely everything! If you like challenging platform games, then this game definitely deserves your attention! Playing as a polar bear, you will need to save all the cubs.

description: SHEL: The Cure is a Replicant Diagnostics Simulator. Perform alchemy with spinal fluid, analyze brain scans, commune with otherworldly beings and prescribe treatments with the help of the Manual - an objective and unbiased* guide provided by your interstellar corporate employer.

title: The Room Stalker
description: You are trapped in a hotel room. Find the anomaly and break free from the loop.

description:
Dive into Sweet Beach Holidays, the ultimate adult puzzle game where relaxation meets romance! Join three unique and stunning 3D girls on a tropical island getaway and experience a vacation filled with sun, sand, and sweet surprises.

As you progress through 18 challenging card levels, unlock tantalizing rewards including 36 real-time, adult CG scenes. Each girl has her own distinct personality and desires, rewarding you for your attention.

title: Dark December
description: Engage in fierce battles against powerful enemies and create your own combat style through unique combinations of weapons and skills Each character comes equipped with distinct abilities and weapons, and by strategically allocating bonus stat points, you can take on even the most formidable monsters

title: Pig
description:
In a final bid to cheat death, you challenge The Alleyman to a high-stakes dice game where every roll could be your last.

Though the game is simple... what The Alleyman offers isn’t: more time. Beat him, and attain extra life—lose, and he takes what time you have left.

And you? You’re dying anyway, frail body ravaged by an incurable disease.

A single die. A single choice: Will you take the deal?

title: Dào zhī Zhàn
description: The combat system of this game is roughly divided into three directions - real-time combat system, semi-real-time combat system and delayed combat system, which correspond to the three classes of martial artist (not yet open), fighter and celestial master.

title: Football Manager 26 Console
description:
New foundations set the stage for you to shape your football destiny. Built on the Unity engine, FM26 Console places you at the heart of the beautiful game. This is the legacy, redefined.

Delivering effortless, instinctive console control, a redesigned user interface combines with the most immersive matchday experience in series history to bring you closer to every match-defining moment.

Build your superstar squad with new transfer tools and bring your footballing vision to life through innovations that deliver enhanced tactical realism.

title: Ursid
description: Ursid is a zen puzzle game inspired by the constellations and the beauty of their imaginary pictures. Connect the stars, explore the hidden images, you will gradually reveal an emotional father-son story while counting down to the moment the Ursid Shower appears.

title: Football Manager 26 Touch
description: Football Manager 26 Touch launches digitally on December 4th.

title: Wild Snap
description: Wild Snap is a relaxing short puzzle game about finding creative, strange and logical ways to attract animals and take pictures of them.

title: Beautiful Summer
description:
Dive into Beautiful Summer, a captivating 2D adventure game where you'll navigate the joys and challenges of finding love at a vibrant recreation center. After a sudden breakup, your solo vacation turns into an unexpected opportunity to connect with a variety of captivating characters.

Explore the open world setting, filled with charming locations and intriguing storylines. Your mission? To win the hearts of the girls you meet. Engage in meaningful dialogue, discover their interests, and shower them with thoughtful gifts. Plan unforgettable dates and unlock their gratitude as you build bonds and experience the joys of summer romance.

title: Cardygon
description: Cardygon is a 100% single-player strategic deckbuilder. Collect 80+ cards from the Batpolygon universe crossover. Devise powerful strategies, customize your profile, and build the ultimate deck!

title: Ben's World
description: This game takes you through many open worlds. Explore the worlds through stunning graphics and beautiful views. You have to explore what this game has to offer, this game will truly blow you away.

description: Test your limits in Only Up 2025 — a dynamic adventure where every step, jump, and movement takes you higher and higher. This game combines spectacular vertical arcade action with realistic movement simulation, delivering a unique climbing experience.

description: In Oldschool Tennis you can set the settings to emulate every version directly on your computer!

title: Upon A Darkening Flood

title: Boat Racer
description: Three mini games. "Boat Racer" - high replay ability in that obstacles are spawned randomly each race. No 2 races the same."Knazi Knockout" 3rd person brawler - it's just fun to beat up Nazis, right? "Nazi's in the Mist" FPS that is the crown jewel of this trifecta of minigames

title: Ares Fighter
description: Ares Fighter" is a vertical scrolling flight shooting game. The player controls the protagonist fighter to fight the enemy in the air.

title: Islet Hell
description: This is a flight simulator in which you control a plane flying over a sea of small islands. The game is organized in a series of 10 levels of increasing difficulty. You have to shoot down all enemy planes and sink all enemy ships in order to win at each level. A radar at the bottom right of the screen allows you to locate all enemies as red dots with regard to your position, which is a black dot at the middle of the radar. Navigate the plane with the arrow keys in typical flight-simulator style: Left and Right for roll and Up and Down for pitch motion. Shoot with the space-bar. That is all! You have no bombs so you have to sink ships by simply shooting at them. However, they can fire missiles at you.

title: Love Girls
description: Indulge in a tranquil puzzle game that is sure to uplift your spirits.

title: So I bought a little chainsaw
description: So I bought a little chainsaw is an Interactive Fiction game featuring reviews for a little, cursed chainsaw. Will the small decisions you make change the fate of the world?

title: Covid Quest 2077
description: Earth has fallen to COVID-2077. Your mission: Rescue your fellow survivors throughout the universe.

title: Super Sonday
description: This is a 2D action platformer where you star as Sonday, a young girl who can transform into a powerful tanooki to save the world.

title: Gate Warfare
description: "Gate Warfare" is a medieval fantasy roguelike tower defense game where players take on the role of a kingdom's hero. Fend off endless waves of demonic hordes, recruit companions, upgrade your skills, and defend the last bastion of hope—the great city of Belrak.

title: Let's Play Cards Solitaire
description: Let's Play Cards Solitaire is a classic single-player card game that is perfect for players of all ages.

title: Reformpunk
description: This is a co-op puzzle game centered around time control and object manipulation. Player 1, Sofia, has the ability to control time. Player 2, Thirteen, can alter objects using their energy, and even transforming themselves into energy to access unique abilities.

description: Cold Dead Hands is a "2D Infinite Runner-Shooter" where you, the player, have to survive as long as possible while shooting, crushing, and dodging zombies along the way. Post your score to the leaderboard to see if your score is one of the best around the world!

title: City of Stories: The Hunter's Heart - Collector's Edition
description: This is a Hidden Object Puzzle Adventure game, meaning a specific genre of story-driven, point & click adventures. Throughout the game, players are tasked to find a list of objects hidden within a particular scene, and to occasionally complete various mini-games/puzzles.

description: This cute and bubbly game is everything you ever wanted in a vanilla sexy game. There are no frills or complicated mechanics, just simple and pure vanilla erotic scenes. Girls are cute and welcoming! The gameplay is highly polished and fun match 3 puzzle.

description: Party fantasy RPG. You control a party of characters, moving around the game world. Collect items, complete quests, communicate with NPCs, try to survive, destroy enemies with various magic and weapons.

title: PK War
description: Enter the arena in PKWAR, a hardcore PvP MUD where text-based combat meets competitive glory. Choose from 5 unique classes, battle players simultaneously, and rise through military ranks from Private to Captain. No graphics, no distractions - just pure skill-based combat. Death or glory.

title: Kuafu Chases the Sun
description: "Kuafu Chases the sun" is an exhilarating adventure parkour game deeply rooted in the rich tapestry of ancient Chinese mythology. In this immersive gaming experience, players are instantly transported to a bygone era, assuming the role of the mighty and legendary giant, Kuafu.

title: GrimRail
description: Step aboard Grimrail, a story rich psychological horror set on a purgatorial train. Confront passengers through choices that shape their fates and alter the course of your journey, while enduring abominations and cursed trial stops, armed only with a radio that can bend reality.

title: Curtainfall
description: A fast-paced action roguelike where you fight through cursed circus arenas, unlock powerful abilities mid-run, and build your own combat style with every performance.

title: A Familiar World
description: Solve jigsaw puzzles to unlock exciting scenes. Discover the mysterious circumstances that led nine women to leave their world and run towards a new life.

title: BeamStruggle
description: In the midst of a chaotic beam struggle, as the beam closes in, no matter how fast you type, it gets closer and closer, there's no hope, unless you believe in yourself, and scream really really loud.

Sunny love is a short visual novel where you play as a young photographer who didn’t strike big in the capital. He decides to visit his hometown to get some inspiration and new ideas for a comeback. Lady Luck smiles at him as he meets a certain redhead muse...

How this meeting will change his life? Will this muse allow him to get his dream job or will she become more important than anything else? It’s up to you!

description: Dare to enter a chilling labyrinth where you, a captivating young woman, are destined for a gruesome sacrifice! In this intense stealth horror game, you must use your wits and cunning to outsmart your captors and escape the clutches of an ancient evil.

A woman is born to be in the same class as the untouchable class. But her destiny helps her with trying to deny the irrational black magic.

description: Slide Furry Futanari is a puzzle game, with the objective of getting the cards to be combined, to release amazing futanari girls.

title: Otaku's Challenge
description: Embark on a delightful journey with Otaku's Challenge, a captivating casual puzzle game designed for everyone to enjoy! Immerse yourself in the enchanting world of anime kawaii style with a diverse cast of characters and scenarios.

description: Alex is a present day student who accidentally “teleport” to another different dimension world. He will reveal the truth of this changes throughout his journey. But, is Alex able to accept the truth?

title: Dawn vs Dusk
description: An over the shoulder arena battle multiplayer game. Battle as either the Dawn or Dusk teams for supremacy of the arena by holding capture points with your team mates. Last team standing at 20 minutes wins the game!

title: Bunny Battle
description: Bunny Battle is a competitive first- and third-person shooter in which you have to fight against other players or bots. There are five different levels and seven game modes available to you. Choose your team and start fighting!

title: Pixel Sentry
description: Do you have nothing to do? Don't want to load up a game where it takes a while to get into it? Well here is the perfect solution for you.

description: Find as many of your friends as possible before the monster gets you. Save all you can, as the amount of friends you have is endless! You can't save them all but find the best strategy and do your best sweetie! I hope everything's ok and hope you'll enjoy this mini game I finished for you.

description: Enter a quiet place where you can relax and solve sliding puzzles. There's no tracking scores, no hidden doors, and no plot twist, just a zen place for your mind to wander.

title: Lighthouse Stories: Book One - Part One
description: The Lighthouse universe now is open with this new Point and Click game, highly narrative with psychological horror.

title: F1 Crazy Stunts
description: Have you ever imagined doing stunts with a formula 1 car? Welcome to the parallel universe!

title: Zen Paint
description: A peaceful color-by-numbers game set on a hexagonal grid. Play at your own pace and relax while you complete a variety of levels with differing themes, sizes and complexities.

title: Pedros Eggventure
description: we are doing this game for a project at "univercity". we hope you enjoy this game that we made. we have everything you would want, a main character who totally does not look like Pedro Pascal, a dragon, a run for your life and just some good old egg puns. - Ms Maddy of Breakfast Crew

title: GreenIsland
description: You need to survive on this unknown island after your helicopter crashed Powered By Unreal engine 5.1

description: Aria, a cherished companion and lover, lost her life during an adventure. To fulfill her wish, the protagonist sets out to help the villagers and gather Hatsuka flowers. Enjoy enchanting pixel art, strategic battles, and a heartfelt story that captures the nostalgia of classic JRPGs!

title: Summoner VR: The Ruined Village
description: There are many mystery places including school, hospital, mansion, and dangerous dungeons. Move forward looking for clues to avoid all kinds of traps and monsters. Adventure, Horror, Mystery, Puzzle, Escape and Action will give you a new experience.

description: Get behind the wheel of your truck and go on a long journey along difficult forest roads.

title: The Shadow of the Cherry Trees
description: Immerse yourself in a magical world inspired by Japan, where Hana must save Yuki by communicating with spirits, solving puzzles, and navigating an enchanted forest. A poetic adventure blending magic, tradition, and courage.

It is based on the Three Kingdoms and incorporates traditional Chinese elements.
