description: Welcome to Bullet of Armor! Bullet of Armor is a shooter game with a 2d that you can play offline. It is a shooter game where you can compete against your enemies on game maps. You can earn more points by making headshots, and you can earn more points by killing more enemies.

title: The Jumping Ball
description:
Get ready for an addictive challenge where precision, timing, and quick reflexes are the keys to survival!

Guide your ball through a narrow brick tunnel filled with dangerous red spikes and tricky obstacles. Jump at the right moment, avoid deadly traps, and collect shining stars along the way to boost your score. Every second counts as you push your limits to stay alive longer and rack up points.

title: For a Few Minutes
description: For a Few Minutes is an emotional visual novel that explores love, grief, and the fragile hope of moving forward.

title: Bike Runner
description: Welcome to the ultimate proving ground for fearless cyclists. This is a world where skill is everything, and your next ride is always more demanding than the last. Carve your path down treacherous mountainsides, launch off impossibly huge ramps, and chain together insane trick combinations to dominate the leaderboards. Every jump, every whip, and every landing is a test of precision.

title: 1-2-Exquisite Word Search!
description: 1-2-Exquisite Word Search is the fourth game in the 1-2-Word Search series. Building upon the previous entries this classic word search puzzle game returns with a brand new set of levels, themes, and music! Exquisite Word Search packs in all new hand crafted puzzles built on 3 different grid sizes. 7x7, 10x10, and 12x12 word search grids return. Choose your puzzle solving mood by changing the background theme set and switching up the music on the TreeFall Radio. Embark on a fun and relaxing journey solving word searches in 1-2-Exquisite Word Search! Fun new puzzles await the discerning eye.

title: Jump Land Glow Challenge
description: Jump Land Glow Challenge is a fast-paced arcade game where precise timing is everything. Jump high, dive fast, and land perfectly on glowing platforms to change the background and earn points. Each successful landing increases the challenge, speed, and intensity in a vibrant, ever-shifting world of color. How long can you keep up the rhythm?

title: Shards of the Banished
description: Shards of the Banished is a dark fantasy action-RPG set in a cursed medieval world. A fallen king, a cursed queen, and a power-hungry usurper have plunged the land into ruin. As the exiled heir, you must rise, face powerful foes, and reclaim what is rightfully yours.

title: Yasuke: Black Samurai Legend
description: Based on the extraordinary true story of history's first African samurai, embark on an epic journey in feudal Japan. From slave to legendary warrior, live the incredible tale of Yasuke as he masters the way of the samurai and shapes Japan's destiny.

title: The House of Hamelin
description: A deckbuilding roguelite game where you must save Perdita's cat from the horrors of The House of Hamelin! Navigate the ever-changing, twisted hallways and become strong enough to defeat the gruesome creatures that lurk within... if you can.

title: One Pass
description: "One Pass": A Stress-Reliever,a New Leisure Favorite!Control adorable little characters,collect gold coins, and navigate through fantasy levels.But don't underestimate the challenges, as each level hides the author's "little pranks" full of traps and humorous moments.Are you ready? Let's get started

title: Potatogeddon
description: Take on the role of a potato and become a hero! Explore generated levels, develop skills, fight against enemies. Play solo or gather a team. The potato revolution is waiting for you! Take up the challenge in Potatogeddon and prove that the potato is king!

title: MoonDrop Chronicles
description:
A cozy space adventure with tiny, powerful friends!

Crash-landed and alone, space pirate Callisto must find her missing crew. With the help of her loyal Moonies, you’ll fight enemies, explore strange worlds, and uncover secrets across the stars.

title: GPMoto Challenge
description:
GPMoto Challenge is a game developed and published by LOSEDEAD, with its release date for PC on June 17, 2022.
The game is described as a pulse-pounding, arcade-style racer that features a simulation feel, allowing players to drive powerful cars on famous tracks from around the world, with options for day and night-time races, varying weather conditions, and unique car handling.
It supports various game modes including single-player, online multiplayer, co-op, PvP, and local multiplayer, and includes full controller support.
The game is available on PC and has been featured on platforms like Steam, although it is currently not listed on Steam's storefront.

title: Crash Bandicoot Mayhem
description: A since-delisted Crash Bandicoot fangame by Mrmediamanx. It has additions and changes not seen in other Crash games like a keyboard-and-mouse control scheme, a continuous bound move and a "floor is lava" combo system for defeating enemies and breaking boxes.

title: HandleIt
description: As a newcomer to the gaming industry, I present you with the game I made to kill time while you waiting anything or anyone. The game was created as a car simulator. In subsequent updates, new cars will also be added open world, physics will get a new character similar to real life

title: Cannabis Shop Simulator
description: Step into the budding world of entrepreneurship with Cannabis Shop Simulator, the ultimate business management game where your dreams of running a thriving cannabis shop become reality. From a humble start to dominating the green market, every decision you make will shape the future of your empire.

title: Contrabandist: Contraband Cartel Simulator
description: Step into the dangerous and thrilling role of cartel in the ruthless world of Contrabandist: Contraband Cartel Simulator! In this high-stakes crime simulation, you begin as a small-time hustler and rise to become one of the most feared barons in the drug trade. Navigate the treacherous underworld, where wealth, power, and violence go hand in hand. Outwit rival cartels, bribe officials, and smuggle contraband across dangerous borders as you build a criminal empire that spans continents.

title: Black Cat Brawl
description: Have you ever wanted to prove to your friends that you truly are better at gambling than them? Here's your chance! Black Cat Brawl has you going up against 7 of your friends in a team-based slamfest!

title: Anarko Zmeu
description: A fast paced arcade maze chasing game inspired by the 90s media portrayal of hackers and their culture. Download files, evade enemies, collect power-ups, launch rootkits, worms, and forkbombs and unleash total chaos.

title: A Difficult Game About Climbing: Chapter 2
description: A free update for A Difficult Game About Climbing including an entirely new map similar in size to the main game. It contains 9 new areas with new kinds of surfaces and obstacles.

title: Speedrunner
description: The title says it all, SPEEDRUNNER. Run, fast, until you reach the finish line. Gain 3 stars on the levels and open chests for rewards. From which you can customize your player. Keep your head tilted and your finger down because when you end up slacking, you will lose time...

title: VataZombie
description: Vata zombies have announced the beginning of a "special military operation" on your territory. Their claims were absurd and pointless, they want to take away your home and your quiet life. Your task is to repel the waves of Vata Zombies and protect your freedom!

title: AstroDrop
description: A 2D platformer about an astronaut who drops from space all the way back to Earth.

title: Forest Mansion Incident
description: An ordinary evening after routine cleaning turns into a nightmare... Will you be able to get out of the mansion, unravel all its secrets and defeat the voracious entity that lives in this unfortunate place without losing the remnants of humanity?

title: Desktop Kitten Girl

title: WTF Am I Playing?!

WTF AM I PLAYING?! is a first-person shooter with elements of platforming, puzzles, and experimental comedy. It blends fast-paced action with unexpected scenarios, minimal guidance, and surreal humor.

Gameplay & Features:
-Uniquely designed levels with their own mechanics.
-First-person shooter gameplay with puzzle and platforming elements.
-Stylized retro graphics and effects.
-Unique enemies: angry chickens, mutant burgers, giant gorillas, and more.
-Dynamic soundtrack and sound design tailored to each level’s tone.
-No loading screens between core sequences — just smooth, weird transitions.
-Short session-friendly level structure. (15–20 minutes per level.)
-Main content offers around 2–3 hours of gameplay.

And yes — you’ll keep wondering what’s going on, and why you’re enjoying it.

Perfect for players who enjoy:
-Unconventional, unpredictable gameplay.
-Retro-inspired visuals and effects that evoke classic gaming nostalgia.
-Fast-paced FPS action with a twist of humor and unexpected challenges.
-Players with no expectations.
